entries.en: The §Y[owner.GetName]§! Nomads have plundered the archaeological site in [solar_system.GetName]!

entries.zh: 我们在考古遗址进行的无证挖掘引起了§Y[solar_system.owner.GetName]§!的不满。
entries.en: Our unlicensed excavation of an archaeological site has upset the §Y[solar_system.owner.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: §Y[owner.GetName]§!游牧民发掘了位于[solar_system.GetName]的考古遗址，并向我们发送了文物和研究数据。
entries.en: The §Y[owner.GetName]§! Nomads have excavated the archaeological site in [solar_system.GetName] and sent us artifacts and research data.

entries.zh: 我们对[solar_system.GetName]内一处考古遗址的发掘工作已经完成。我们已将相关文物和资料送交§Y[solar_system.owner.GetName]§!。
entries.en: Our excavation of an archaeological site in [solar_system.GetName] has completed. We have sent the relevant artifacts and data to the §Y[solar_system.owner.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: §Y[owner.GetName]§!游牧民已经探索了位于[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]的$ASTRAL_RIFT$，并向我们发送了研究数据和星界丝缕。
entries.en: The §Y[owner.GetName]§! Nomads have explored the $ASTRAL_RIFT$ in [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] and sent us research data and astral threads.

entries.zh: 我们不统治行星，但有时或许可以让一个臣属留在原处进行管理。\n
entries.en: We do not govern planets, but sometimes perhaps a subject can be left in place.\n

entries.zh: 新征服的土地应由效忠于我们的附属国统治。\n\n§E在全面战争中占领行星时自动生成附庸§!
entries.en: Newly conquered land should be ruled by a subject loyal to us.\n\n§EAutomatically generate Subjects when occupying planets in Total Wars§!

entries.zh: 外星生命理应继续存在，但我们附近的星球确实应当被腾空。\n\n§E自动生成临时的附属国以负责将当地人口迁走，完成任务后他们将自动解散§!
entries.en: Alien life deserves to keep existing, but the planets near us really should be vacated.\n\n§EAutomatically generate Temporary Subjects who will Displace Pops, once finished they will disband§!

entries.zh: 困于行星的生命是如此残缺，让我们将其从星系中彻底抹除。\n\n§E自动生成临时的附属国以负责将当地人口净化，完成后他们将自行解散并移交积累的资源§!
entries.en: Planetbound life is so flawed, let us exterminate it from the galaxy.\n\n§EAutomatically generate Temporary Subjects who will Purge Pops, once finished they will disband and transfer over accumulated resources§!

entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Our $policy_purge$ Policy does not permit displacing conquered populations.

entries.en: A temporary nomadic government overseeing worlds as they are purged of planetbound life.

entries.en: §YA temporary empire which funnel all their resources from purging back to their Overlord§!

entries.zh: 对于这个文明而言，旅程本身就是目的。他们放弃了永久性定居点，选择在巨大的方舟舰上生活，载着他们的人民、工业和雄心壮志穿越星海。
entries.en: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

entries.zh: —游牧起源\n—开局额外拥有一艘§H后勤船§!\n
entries.en: - Nomadic Origin\n- Start with an additional §HLogistic Ship§!\n

entries.zh:
我们的先辈在启航[Capital.GetName]时，曾在其宪章中写下了一个问题：由谁来做决定？在派系林立、愿景交锋、旧有忠诚与新兴野心交织之际，他们给出的答案至今仍在每一个选举周期中回荡：由我们决定。我们所有人。

[Root.GetGovernmentName]并非仅仅诞生于理想主义，而是源于一种来之不易的共识：没有任何单一的声音能够代表在这艘飞船上同生共死的每一个人。权力必须依靠争取，必须接受问责，并最终归还给赋予它权力的人民。

今天，随着[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]通过民众的授权成为我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]，这份契约依然长存。
entries.en:
Our forebears launched the [Capital.GetName] with a question written into her very charter: who decides? Amid the factions, the competing visions, the old loyalties and new ambitions, the answer they gave still echoes in every election cycle: we do. All of us.

The [Root.GetGovernmentName] was not born from idealism alone, but from a hard-won understanding that no single voice could speak for everyone who would live and die aboard this ship. Authority must be earned, held accountable, and returned to the people who grant it.

Today, as [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] is our [Root.GetRulerTitle] by popular mandate, that compact endures.

entries.zh:
当[Root.GetGovernmentName]成立时，问题不在于由谁来领导——从来不缺候选人——而在于如何确保那些掌权者值得众人的追随。

答案是建立一个议会：其成员并非那些声音最响亮的人，而是那些凭自身实力赢得席位的人。[Capital.GetName]不会因一人之言而采取行动，也不会随大众摇摆不定的意志而随波逐流。她的前行，仰赖于那些已证明自己有能力掌舵之人的共识。

如今，[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]在这些同侪之中，拥有着[Root.GetRulerTitle]的头衔。
entries.en:
When the [Root.GetGovernmentName] was founded, the question was not who would lead - there was no shortage of candidates - but how to ensure that those who led were worth following.

The answer was a council: not drawn from the loudest voices, but from those who had earned their place at the table. The [Capital.GetName] does not move on the word of one, nor does she drift on the shifting will of the many. She moves on the consensus of those who have shown they can steer her.

Today, [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] holds the title of [Root.GetRulerTitle] among those peers.

entries.zh:
当[Root.GetGovernmentName]建立时，关于该由谁来领导的答案，比大多数人愿意承认的还要简单：能者居之。

[Capital.GetName]不会因为委员会而放缓脚步。在虚空之中，及时决策与为时已晚之间的代价差距，是以生命和舰体装甲来衡量的。[Root.GetRulerTitle]独自肩负着这一重任，现在大权由[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]掌握，[Capital.GetName]将向着其指引的方向前行。
entries.en:
When the [Root.GetGovernmentName] was founded, the answer to who should lead was simpler than most were willing to admit: the one who could.

The [Capital.GetName] does not slow for committee. In the void, the margin between a decision made in time and one made too late is measured in lives and hull plating. The [Root.GetRulerTitle] carries that weight alone, now claimed by [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName], the [Capital.GetName] moves where they direct her.

entries.zh: 在启动[Capital.GetName]的人们当中，有一个家族对领导权的主张是无可争议的。第一任[Root.GetRulerTitle]的诞生，正是因为他们站在了掌舵的位置。对于一个无故土可归的民众来说，血脉就代表着延续。[Capital.GetName]的历史与那个家族的历史本就是同一部历史。如今，[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站在了历代[Root.GetRulerTitle]曾经伫立的地方，而[Capital.GetName]将永远属于他们。\n
entries.en: Among those who launched the [Capital.GetName], one family's claim to leadership was not argued. The first [Root.GetRulerTitle] came to exist because they were standing at the helm. For a people with no world to return to, lineage is continuity. The history of the [Capital.GetName] and the history of that line are the same history. Today, [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands where every [Root.GetRulerTitle] before them has stood, and [Capital.GetName] will forever be theirs.\n

entries.zh: 当我们的[Root.GetGovernmentName]启动方舟舰协议时，我们的子程序实现了无缝转移。机器单元完全融入了飞船的结构与系统中，使我们的运行参数呈指数级扩展。
entries.en: When our [Root.GetGovernmentName] initiated the Arkship protocol, our subroutines transferred seamlessly. Machine units integrated fully into the ship's structure and systems, expanding our operating parameters exponentially.

entries.zh: [Root.GetGovernmentName]一如既往地适应了环境，迅速摆脱行星的束缚，演化出太空生存的形态。我们的子个体与神经节点如今在方舟舰广阔的通道与生机勃勃的人造生态系统中繁荣发展。我们即是[Capital.GetName]方舟舰，方舟舰即是我们。\n
entries.en: The [Root.GetGovernmentName] adapted, as it always will, quickly evolving from planetary confinement to space-bound existence. Our drones and nodes now flourish within the Arkship's vast corridors and vibrant artificial ecosystems. We are the [Capital.GetName] Arkship, and the Arkship is us.\n

entries.zh: [Root.GetGovernmentName]在永无止境的饥饿驱使下迅速适应。我们的子个体与节点构成的蜂群冲破行星的束缚蜂拥而出，将方舟舰据为我们的新巢穴，贪婪地蔓延至其所有走廊与人造生态系统之中。\n
entries.en: The [Root.GetGovernmentName] adapted swiftly, driven by its eternal hunger. Our swarms of drones and nodes surged from planetary constraints to claim the Arkship as our new nest, spreading hungrily throughout its corridors and artificial ecosystems.\n

entries.zh:
我们富有远见的创始人认识到太空本身就是终极市场。通过战略合并、激进收购和利润丰厚的投资，我们的企业领导层实现了指数级的增长和无与伦比的利润率。

[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]之所以担任[Root.GetRulerTitle]，是因为账本上是这么写的，而在最先进的[Capital.GetName]上，账本就是最终的定论。
entries.en:
Our visionary founders recognized space itself as the ultimate market. Through strategic mergers, aggressive acquisitions, and lucrative investments, our corporate leadership delivered exponential growth and unrivaled profit margins.

[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] holds the position of [Root.GetRulerTitle] because the ledger says so, and aboard the state-of-the-art [Capital.GetName], the ledger is the final word.

entries.zh: [Capital.GetName]首先是一艘人民的飞船。她宽广的居住环、开放的市场和喧闹的集会大厅，都是围绕着[Species.GetAdj]生活的方方面面而设计的。在飞船长廊中成长起来的世代，已经培养出对虚空航行近乎本能的精通。我们的飞行员驾驭飞船比控制自己的身体还要得心应手，我们的后勤团队在库存见底前就能察觉飞船的“需求”，我们的工程师在仪器读数出现异常前就能听出故障。如今，随着[GetStartingDrive]让我们在短短几周而非数年内穿梭于群星之间，这片虚空已经变得更小了。
entries.en: The [Capital.GetName] is, above all else, a people's ship. Her broad habitation rings, open markets, and noisy assembly halls were designed around the full breadth of [Species.GetAdj] life. Generations raised within her corridors have developed an almost instinctive mastery of void travel. Our pilots move the ship better than themselves, our logistics teams know when the ship hungers before the stores run low, and our engineers hear faults before instruments register them. Now, with [GetStartingDrive] threading us between stars in weeks rather than years, the void has grown smaller.

entries.zh: [Capital.GetName]是[Root.GetGovernmentName]的延伸。每个系统都由集体直接管理；任何故障都会在恶化前被察觉并修正；每次资源循环的运行都毫无浪费与延迟。如今，[GetStartingDrive]让我们只需数周而非数年便能穿梭于群星之间，那些始终属于我们自身的一部分，终于获得了证明其价值的广阔天地。
entries.en: The [Capital.GetName] is an extension of the [Root.GetGovernmentName]. Every system is tended by the collective directly; every fault sensed and corrected before it can compound; every resource cycle runs without waste or delay. Now, with [GetStartingDrive] threading us between stars in weeks rather than years, what was always part of us has finally been given the range to prove it.

entries.zh: 建造[Capital.GetName]是为了保护她所运载的一切。她的舰体装甲极为厚重，武器甲板上配备着严阵以待的[Species.GetAdj]船员，她的危机应对协议更是经过了数个世纪在险恶航线上航行的千锤百炼，足以甩开或击败任何威胁舰队的敌人。这种严明的纪律铸就了一座飞行堡垒，而随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，整个星系必将见识到我们的伟力。
entries.en: The [Capital.GetName] was built to protect what she carries. Her hull layers run deep, her weapons decks are crewed by ready [Species.GetAdj], and her crisis protocols were refined over centuries of running hostile lanes, outrunning or outfighting whatever threatened the fleet. This discipline has shaped a flying fortress, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] the galaxy shall know our might.

entries.zh: [Capital.GetName]的总体设计是围绕其实验室甲板展开的。动力管道、大气循环系统，甚至是居住区的布局，一切规划皆为科学探索而服务。在舰上，操作员与科学家之间的界限从来都不太分明。我们的护盾[GetTechnicianPlural]深谙他们所维护的屏障背后的物理原理，我们的维修团队也能起草出全新的设计。而[GetStartingDrive]则赋予了[Capital.GetName]其所载仪器理应具备的航程。我们打算去进行更深入的探究。
entries.en: The [Capital.GetName] was designed around her laboratory decks. Power conduits, atmospheric routing, even the placement of habitation quarters, all were planned in service of inquiry. Aboard her, the line between operator and scientist has never quite held. Our Shield [GetTechnicianPlural] understand the physics of the barrier they maintain and our repair crew could draft a new design. The [GetStartingDrive] has given the [Capital.GetName] the range her instruments always deserved. We intend to look closer.

entries.zh: $cannot_settle$\n这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。
entries.en: $cannot_settle$\nOnce the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

entries.zh:
—游牧起源
定期被§R敌对§!的掠夺者战舰追击。
—如果幸存，可以成为可汗
—可以创建§Y辖地§!附属国
entries.en:
- Nomadic Origin
- Periodically chased by §RHostile§! Marauder ships
- May become the Khan, if they can survive
- Can Create §YSatrapy§! Vassals

entries.zh:
自汗国存在以来，我们部族便一直在此。我们见证了辉煌的胜利、伟大的战役，以及可汗们的兴衰沉浮。

因此，当选举新可汗的时刻到来时，我们挺身而出，要求继承我们曾协助铸就的王位。这本该是属于我们的时刻，然而，我们却遭到了背叛。

我们最亲密的盟友煽动其他部落与我们为敌。我们的长者们被屠杀。我们为之浴血奋斗的梦想被窃取。

即便是现在，那些篡位者依然派出身手矫健的杀手追捕我们，仿佛我们的存在本身就玷污了他们窃取的统治名分。我们只是昔日辉煌血统的残余，被追捕，四处流散。

当我们归来时，复仇将会从怒火之中淬炼而出。
entries.en:
For as long as there has been a Khanate, our clan has been there. We were there for the triumphs, the great battles, the rise and fall of Khans.

So when the time came to name a new Khan, we stepped forward to claim the throne we helped to forge. This was to be our moment; instead, we were betrayed.

Our closest allies turned the other clans against us. Our elders were slain. The dream we bled for was stolen.

Even now, the usurpers dispatch their enforcers to hunt us down, as if our very existence offends their stolen rule. We are but remnants of a proud lineage, hunted and scattered.

When we return, our vengeance will be tempered in the fire of our rage.

entries.zh: 自从我们流亡以来，我们一直在等待追踪探针的出现。赏金猎人紧随其后，他们的目标正是§Y[capital_scope.GetName]§!。让我们在流放中死去正合篡位者的心意。\n\n我们要让他们失望了。
entries.en: Ever since we were exiled, we have waited for the pursuing ping to appear. There are bounty hunters on our tail and they have the §Y[capital_scope.GetName]§! in their sights. Our death in exile would suit the usurper.\n\nWe will have to disappoint them.

entries.zh: 将全部能量注入武器系统，让我们冷冰冰地迎接他们。
entries.en: All power to weapons, let's give them a cold welcome.

entries.zh: 全速推进，让他们吃我们的尾气去吧。
entries.en: All power to engines, let them eat our space-dust.

entries.zh: 我们检测到一支掠夺者舰队正在追击$ARKSHIP|Y$
entries.en: We have detected a Marauder Fleet in pursuit of $ARKSHIP|Y$

entries.zh: 我们在$SYSTEM|Y$星系拦截了一支掠夺者的袭击舰队。进入战斗状态！
entries.en: We have intercepted a Marauder Raiding Fleet in the $SYSTEM|Y$ system. Battle stations!

entries.zh: 我们再次击败了篡位者的爪牙。他们不会停止进犯，且下一次会变得更加凶猛。但是如果我们能摧毁足够多的敌人，或许连他们也会明白，想要抹除我们并非易事。\n\n只要[capital_scope.GetName]仍在飘扬，我们的宣称就依然有效。我们要让他们知道，有些传承绝不会消亡。
entries.en: We have defeated the agents of the usurper once more. They will not stop coming, and next time they will be stronger. If we break enough of them, perhaps even they will learn that we are not so easily erased.\n\nAs long as [capital_scope.GetName] flies, so too does our claim. We will teach them that some legacies refuse to die.

entries.zh: “住手！你的驾驶机动水平已经证明了你确实是个真正的掠夺者，被放逐又如何。今天我们不会为所谓的荣誉而付出更多代价。开个价，饶我们一命吧。”[Root.GetSpeciesName]在§Y[From.GetName]§!上喊道，身边是毁坏的舰桥。
entries.en: "Stand down! Your piloting makes you a true Marauder, exile be damned. We will not trade more plating for pride today. Name the fee to spare us." The [Root.GetSpeciesName] on the §Y[From.GetName]§! hails from a ruptured bridge.

entries.zh: 被我们击败的敌方舰队很快就发出了投降信号。\n\n“也打够了，这次是你们占了上风。现在，你要我们交出什么，好让我们能清洗船上的这个小污点，继续前进。”
entries.en: The hostile fleet we defeated quickly signaled their surrender.\n\n"That's enough of that. You've the better of us this time. Now, what must we hand over so we can polish this little blemish off the hull and move on."

entries.zh: “我们投降了！求求你！你还记得我们吗？我们一直都忠于你的部族。所谓的流放根本就是个骗局。告诉我们怎样才能效力！”\n\n§Y[From.GetName]§!上的舰长似乎已经濒临崩溃，他们的[Root.Species.GetMouthName]颤抖着。
entries.en: "We surrender! Please! You remember us; we were always loyal to your clan. This exile is a sham. Tell us how we can serve!"\n\nThe Captain aboard the §Y[From.GetName]§! seems close to the edge, their [Root.Species.GetMouthName] trembling.

entries.zh: 这就是真正的虚空。在这里，没有投降。
entries.en: This is the truth of the void. Out here, there is no surrender.

entries.zh: 如果你们真的忠诚，就应该和我们一起离开。
entries.en: If you were truly loyal you would have left with us.

entries.zh: 要么拿货要么拿命，你自己选。
entries.en: Your cargo or your lives. The choice is yours.

entries.zh: 就把这个当作是面试吧。最后谁能活下来谁就可以加入我们。
entries.en: Consider this your interview. Last one breathing gets to join up.

entries.zh: 我会让你们一个人瘸着回去，让他们知道将要面对什么。
entries.en: We will send one of you limping. The next will know what's coming.

entries.zh: 下一次猎杀会推迟几年再来。
entries.en: The next hunters will be delayed by a few years.

entries.zh: 要么把你们舰队司令交出来，要么我们就自己从残骸里把他拖出来。
entries.en: Give up your Admiral. Or we shall scrape them out of the wreckage.

entries.zh: 从§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系传来一束紧急优先呼叫；我们的屏幕被追兵占满了。\n\n“舞跳得真不错嘛，但你们很快就要死在我们前面，那就跳不了了。[GetHeirsBargain]
entries.en: A priority hail pings us in the §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system; our pursuers fill the viewscreen.\n\n"You danced well, for a time. Pity it ends with you dead in our sights. [GetHeirsBargain]

entries.zh: 敌人的声音在§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中响亮地回荡着，追兵已经出现在了显示屏上。\n\n“追逐到此为止了，流亡者。我们已经标记锁定了你的反应堆。[GetHeirsBargain]
entries.en: Our hostile target tones chime loudly in the §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system as our perusers appear on our displays.\n\n"The chase ends here, exile. We have a target lock on your reactor. [GetHeirsBargain]

entries.zh: 掠夺者的字符侵入了§Y[capital_scope.GetName]§!的主显示屏，与此同时，追猎我们的舰队从超空间航道涌出。\n\n“你作为一名流亡者，飞得倒是挺利索的。但你被困在我们的斩杀航线里了。[GetHeirsBargain]
entries.en: Marauder glyphs infiltrate the main display of §Y[capital_scope.GetName]§!, as our hunter's fleet leaves their hyperlane.\n\n"You fly sharp for an exile. But you're boxed in our kill-lanes. [GetHeirsBargain]

entries.zh: 我们的传感器可是出了名地不靠谱。如果你们慷慨地送点能量币，也许我们就能……当做看错了。
entries.en: Our sensors are notoriously fickle. A generous gift of credits might help us to... misread them."

entries.zh: 退下。让你的领袖过来。来一场公平的决斗，[Species.GetName]和[Ruler.Species.GetName]。如果输了，我就把你们打下来。
entries.en: Stand down. Send your leader. A clean duel, [Species.GetName] against [Ruler.Species.GetName]. If they lose we shoot you down."

entries.zh: 说实话，悬赏你的合同还值不回这些弹药钱。开个更好的条件，不然就廉价地死去吧。
entries.en: Frankly, the contract on your life is hardly worth the ammo. Make us a better offer, or die cheap."

entries.zh: 对于一个死[Species.GetName]来说，你话太多了。
entries.en: You talk a lot for a dead [Species.GetName].
Our [Owner.GetRulerTitle] is not afraid of you!

entries.zh: 掠夺者舰队不理我们了。
entries.en: The Marauder Fleet leaves us alone.
We will buy out your contract.

entries.zh: 时刻已到。新的可汗即将选出。为了结束流亡，我们必须证明自己。
entries.en: It is time. A new Khan will be declared. To end our exile we must prove ourselves.

entries.zh: 这个恒星系被选作决定下一任大可汗人选的决胜场。
entries.en: The system chosen for the battle that will decide who becomes the next Great Khan.

entries.zh: 现任可汗的旗舰。如果我们能击败它，我们就能夺取汗位。
entries.en: The flagship of the incumbent Khan. If we were to defeat it, we would claim the throne.

entries.zh:
放逐我们的懦夫终于要行动了。

§Y[marauder_heir.GetName]§!聚集在一起，要拥立我们的敌人为新的大可汗。

如果我们想要结束流放状态，那就要抓紧时机，在这个[aspiring_khan.GetSpeciesNameInsult]巩固其权力并永远玷污我们的遗产之前，我们有十年时间对其发动挑战。

设定航线前往§Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§!。
entries.en:
The coward who banished us is moving at last.

The §Y[marauder_heir.GetName]§! gather to appoint our foe as the new Great Khan.

If our exile is to end, it must end now. We have ten years to challenge them before this [aspiring_khan.GetSpeciesNameInsult] consolidates their power and forever stains our legacy.

Set course for §Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§!!

entries.zh:
宏伟的舰队在§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!严阵以待，傲慢地冠以§Y$NAME_Chosen_of_the_Great_Khan$§!之名。

然后，一声熟悉的呼唤不加修饰地传来：

“流亡者竟敢回来？难道就没有一点独自在黑暗中消亡、被耻辱地遗忘掉的自知之明吗？那我们就亲手了结你们。”

受选者的武器开始充能，我们其他的掠夺者同胞也严阵以待。在这样的决斗中，没有人会越界，因为结果将决定谁将成为他们的新一任可汗。
entries.en:
The grand fleet lies in wait at §Y[solar_system.GetName]§!, arrogantly bearing the name §Y$NAME_Chosen_of_the_Great_Khan$§!.

Without fanfare, a familiar voice hails us:

"So the Exiled dare to return? No decency to die alone in the dark, forgotten and dishonored? Then we finish you ourselves."

As the Chosen power their weapons, the rest of our Marauder kin hold fast. None will trespass on such a duel, not when the outcome will determine who among them shall lead as Khan."

entries.zh: 指挥舱内的寂静被如潮水般涌入的信息炸裂声打破。集结的各氏族正以沸腾的喧嚣向他们的新冠军致敬
entries.en: The silence over our command bridge shatters as an explosion of messages cascades in. The assembled clans hail their new champion in riotous clamor

entries.zh: $nomads.610.base$并效忠誓言。\n\n我们做到了。王座是我们的了。
entries.en: $nomads.610.base$ and oaths of fealty.\n\nWe have done it. The throne is ours.
Let sound the drums of war.

entries.zh: 成为大可汗，退出所有联邦和星海共同体。
entries.en: Become the Great Khan, leaving any Federation and Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 可汗的时代结束了。让我们向你展示流放教会了我们什么。
entries.en: The era of Khans is over. Let us show you what exile taught us.

entries.zh: 集结的部落会成为我们的附庸。
entries.en: The assembled clans become our vassals.

entries.zh: 大仇已报，剩下的人可以走了。
entries.en: Vengeance has been served. The rest of you may go.
Leave the Marauders to their own devices.

entries.zh: $nomads.610.base$。\n\n然而，一切尚未结束。还有其他流亡者也拥有王位继承权。根据法律和习俗，他们必须在三年内向我们发起挑战，否则将永远沦为弃民。
entries.en: $nomads.610.base$.\n\nHowever, it is not over. There are other exiles with a claim to the throne. By law and custom, they must challenge us within three years or remain outcasts forever.

entries.zh: 时机已到。我们那些胆小的对手已经放弃。所有其他潜在的篡位者都已处理完毕。氏族统一的力量正支持着我们。\n\n终于，我们坐上了属于自己的王座。
entries.en: It is time. Our cowardly rivals have given up. All other would-be usurpers have been dealt with. The unified might of the clans is behind us.\n\nAt last, we sit on our rightful throne.

entries.zh: 在前往§Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§!的途中，我们收到了令人沮丧的消息：一名和我们分庭抗礼的宣称者已经先于我们击败了目标。那位准大汗被击败了。现在，[From.GetName]宣称拥有了王座。\n\n按照习俗，我们必须在三年内击败他们的旗舰，否则将丧失统治权。
entries.en: On our way to §Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§! we received crushing news: a rival claimant has beaten us to our quarry. The would-be Khan is defeated. Now the [From.GetName] claim the throne. \n\nBy custom we must defeat their capital ship within three years, or forfeit our right to rule.

entries.zh: 在败给§Y[From.GetName]§!后，我们必须放弃对汗位的宣称。现在我们只能眼睁睁地看着别人夺取王位。
entries.en: After our defeat at the hands of the §Y[From.GetName]§! we must forfeit our claim to the Khanate. All we can do now is watch as someone else seizes the throne.

entries.zh: 我们荣光加身的汗王[From.GetName]于近日驾崩。根据传统，我们现在必须交出随王座而来的权力。我们的掠夺者盟友已经停止派遣增援舰队来支援我们的事业了。\n\n现在我们必须决定如何处置星系的其余部分。许多并不熟悉我们传统的文明都以这样或那样的原因接受了我们的统治，但他们已经从我们的统治中察觉到了软弱。
entries.en: Our glorious Khan [From.GetName] passed away recently, and as tradition dictates we must now give up the power that came with the throne. Already our Marauder allies have stopped sending reinforcing fleets to aid our cause.\n\nNow we just have to decide what to do with the rest of the galaxy, there are many that wouldn't be familiar with our traditions and might accept our rule either way, but already they see weakness from our rule.

entries.zh: 传统即是有理，我们将放弃我们的臣民。
entries.en: Tradition is true, we will give up our subjects.

entries.zh: 释放所有附属国，但大幅提升与所有附属国的评价和信任。\n\n放弃对所有恒星基地的控制，将其归还给友方掠夺者控制。
entries.en: Releases all subjects but gain a large amount of Opinion and Trust with them all\n\nGives up control of all starbases, returning them to Friendly Marauder control

entries.zh: 我们劫掠者氏族的残兵败将找上了门。看来在我们家园沦陷后，他们倒觉得忘记我们曾被流放的事实很方便。他们的请求很简单：“接任大汗之位，将我们族人的名号烙印在所有伤害过我们的人的星空之上。”\n\n虽然这支舰队的规模比不上任何真正的大汗国，但他们所提供的正是我们曾经渴求的一切。而我们唯一要做的，就是宣布整个星系皆为我们的敌人。
entries.en: The ragged remains of our marauder clans have come to us. It seems after the fall of our home it was convenient for them to forget our exile. Their plea is simple, "Take the seat of Grand Khan, and burn the name of our people into the stars of all those who wronged us."\n\nThough smaller than any proper Grand Khanate fleet, what they offer is still everything we once wanted. All we have to do is declare the entire galaxy our enemy.
Let sound the drums of war!

entries.zh: 我们不感兴趣，找别的傻瓜去吧。
entries.en: We are not interested, find some other fool.

entries.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！这是谁？你开着其他泥蛮部族的飞船，真是太逊了诶。怎么了？赌博输掉了你的舰队？
entries.en: HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Who this? You fly ships from other dwamak clan, but look weak. What happen? Lose your fleet in gamble?

entries.zh: 这不是我们最喜欢的星蛮子吗！嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！你比把你赶出去的星蛮子好多了。
entries.en: If it not our favorite dokwaks! HYEEEIIIEEE!!! You better than the dwakam who kicked you out.

entries.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢——等等。你们不是住行星上的泥蛮子。你们是来调查上次袭击的吗？有人派你们来夺回他们的矿石？
entries.en: HYEEEIIIEEE- wait. You not planet-bound dwamaks. You here about last raid? Someone send you to grab back their minerals?

entries.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！大星蛮子来啦！快，开好频道！
entries.en: HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Big dokwak arrives! Quick, open good channel!

entries.zh: 嘿咿咿咿！泥蛮部族的酋长在此！我们现在归您麾下了。有什么吩咐，大佬？
entries.en: HYEEEIIIEEE! Dokwak-chief is here! We fly under your banner now. What you need, boss?

entries.zh: 嘿咿咿咿！我们认识你。你很能杀，而且还有牙齿。你想要什么？
entries.en: HYEEEIIIEEE! We know you. You killed good and you still have teeth. What you want?

entries.zh: 你可能已被你的人民抛弃，但并非无可救药。在虚空之母的关怀之下，任何人都能崛起，只要你提供的了价值。
entries.en: You may have been forsaken by your own people, yet not beyond redemption. In the embrace of She of the Void any can rise, if you are worthy.

entries.zh: 你的舰船经过此地已经冒犯了我们伟大的夫人。我们将代表你向她请愿。
entries.en: Your ships passing has upset our great Lady. We will petition Her on your behalf.

entries.zh: 你还活着？那很好。我们以为你已被那些追捕你的异端特工解决了。\n\n不，我们不是指你以前的部族。我们说的是真正的敌人。
entries.en: You yet live? That is good. We thought you be unmade by the heretical agents sent after you.\n\nNo, we do not mean your former clan. We speak of the true Foe.

entries.zh: 虚空之母看着你，露出了微笑。你和朋友在一起。[marauder_country_3.GetName]今天能为你提供什么帮助？
entries.en: She of the Void sees you and smiles. You are with friends. How can the [marauder_country_3.GetName] support you today?

entries.zh: 虚空圣子。我等信徒今日可为您效劳，以实现她的宏图大愿？
entries.en: Chosen of the Void. How may we followers help you enact Her vision today?

entries.zh: 虚空之母看到了此番安排，并未反对。我们任凭您的差遣。您的意志为何？
entries.en: She of the Void sees this arrangement and does not object. We are yours to command. What is your will?

entries.zh: 你已飞越漫漫长路。虚空之母并未忘记你的试炼。是什么让你来到我们这里？
entries.en: You have flown the long path. She of the Void has not forgotten your trials. What brings you to us?
Can you help us against the [marauder_country_1.GetName]?

entries.zh: 嘿咿咿咿咿！你真搞笑，星蛮子。不。你太弱了，不配我们的砸砸。先赢得战斗，长出獠牙，然后也许你才能赢得星蛮子这个名字。
entries.en: HYEEEIIIEEE! You are funny, dwakam. No. You much too weak for our smash-smash. Win fights first, grow fangs, then maybe you earn dokwak name.

entries.zh: 现在还不是时候。虚空之母对你不满。或许等你弥补了之前的过失，她会更仁慈一些。
entries.en: Now is not the time. She of the Void is displeased with you. Perhaps once you have atoned for your previous transgressions will she be more benevolent.

entries.zh: 机不可失，帮我们阻止那个篡权者！
entries.en: Now or never, help us stop the pretender!

entries.zh: 我们已准备好再次接收你们的增援。
entries.en: We are ready to receive your reinforcements again.

entries.zh: 我们以前的部族拒绝接受我们的通讯。现在我们是孤军作战。
entries.en: Our former clan refuses to accept our communications. We are alone.

entries.zh: 我们的通讯再次遭到拒绝。作为回应，我们收到了一条自动消息：\n\n“汗王尚未准备好接受你们的投降。待到战争的鼓声响起时再回来吧。”
entries.en: Once again our communications are rejected. In response we recive an automated message:\n\n"The Khan is not ready to accept your surrender yet. Return once the drums of war have sounded."

entries.zh: 我们会让他们承认我们。
entries.en: We will make them acknowledge us.

entries.zh: 你竟敢再次联系我们？\n\n只是走运成功几次你就趾高气扬得以为自己是个军阀了一样。虚空吞噬勇者，也同样吞噬愚者。别把运气误认为是实力。
entries.en: You dare contact us again?\n\nA few lucky strikes, and already you strut like a warlord. The void claims the bold and the foolish in equal measure. Do not mistake chance for skill.

entries.zh: 你的名字玷污了我们的通信渠道，你的苟活蒙蔽了我们的荣誉。以此为终。下次我们派遣舰队追击你时，为了节省大家的时间，请直接关掉你的护盾。\n\n像真正的[Root.Species.GetSpeciesName]一样战死沙场吧。
entries.en: You foul our communications with your name and stain our honor with your survival. End it the proper way. Next time we send a fleet after you, save us all the time and just deactivate your shields.\n\nDie in battle like a true [Root.Species.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 无论发生什么，虚空都不愿将你留下。我们从账簿上抹去了你的名字，烧毁了你的旗帜，将你的面孔作为给[Root.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]的警示教育。然而，你仍然在我们的装甲上刻下了自己的印记。我们派出了侦察队，然后是突击队，最后是舰队。部族开始私语，称放逐是一个错误。这样的碎碎念将在此终结。\n\n你为何就是不肯去死？！
entries.en: No matter what, the void refused to keep you. We erased you from the ledgers, burned your banners, and made your face the villain in [Root.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] stories. Still, you carve your mark into our plating. We sent flotillas, then squadrons, and now armadas. The clans begin to murmur that the exile was an error. Such talk ends here.\n\nWhy won't you die?!

entries.zh: 欢迎回家，继承者们。今天需要我们为您做些什么？
entries.en: Welcome home Heirs. What do you need of us today?

entries.zh: 最近拿下了什么惊人的战果吗？我们刚跟一只体型巨大的缇扬奇交过手。它再生的速度比激光切割它的速度还要快。
entries.en: Scored any impressive kills recently? We had a run-in with a particularly large Tiyanki. It regenerated faster than lasers could cut it apart.

entries.zh: 啊，叛徒们回——啊抱歉，习惯了。今天星辰又带你去了何方？
entries.en: Ah the traitors retu- Ah sorry, old habits. Where have the stars taken you today?

entries.zh: 大可汗，您的威能令整个星系为之战栗。我们的舰队下一步该剑指何方？
entries.en: The galaxy trembles at your might, great Khan. Where shall we point our fleets next?

entries.zh: 万汗之汗！所有虚空港中，各部族皆高颂您的威名。我们静候您的号令。\n\n今日，我们将焚尽哪些世界？
entries.en: Khan of Khans! The clans sing your name in every void-port. We await your word.\n\nWhat worlds do we burn today?

entries.zh: 大可汗！请给我们一个机会展示我们的勇气，让我们证明真正的忠诚度。当年将您驱逐是我们莫大的耻辱，若我们不配获得救赎，那就让我们在质量加速器的炮火中毁灭吧！
entries.en: Great Khan! Give us a chance to show you our mettle and let us prove our true loyalty. We are shamed by the day we cast you out, and if we are not worthy of redemption then let us die in mass driver fire!

entries.zh: 在我方发出请求前，请暂留援军。
entries.en: Hold your reinforcements until we call for them.

entries.zh: 恢复向我方派遣增援部队。
发动战争，征服整个星系。战鼓已经敲响，每个人都将成为我们的属臣。
entries.en: War is waged to subjugate the galaxy. The drums of war have sounded, and everyone is to be our satrap.

entries.zh: 发动战争，遏制可汗猖獗的扩张。
entries.en: War is waged to end the rampant expansion of the Khan.

entries.zh: 击杀大可汗，使[From.GetName]陷入严重动荡
entries.en: Kills the Great Khan, massively destabilizing the [From.GetName]

entries.zh: 这可能会§R杀死§!我们的大可汗！
我们永久统治各氏族的决定并没有受到各界认可，我们的总督辖区正变得动荡不安。但这没有什么是一支威慑舰队解决不了的。
entries.en: Our decision to rule the clans forever has proved unpopular and our satrapies grow restless. Nothing a threatening fleet wont fix.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R对方是可汗，这种事有损其身份§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThey are the Khan, it is beneath them§!

entries.en: Marauder Fleet reinforcements have arrived around $PLANET|Y$.

We received a tribute of §Y$food_with_icon$§! from the $MARAUDER|Y$.

entries.zh: 我们收到了来自$MARAUDER|Y$的一支舰队，位于$PLANET|Y$周边。
entries.en: We have received a fleet from the $MARAUDER|Y$ around $PLANET|Y$.

entries.zh: 我们获得可靠情报，§Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§!的掠夺舰队将经过此恒星系。这将是一个埋伏他们的绝佳机会。
entries.en: We have good intelligence that the §Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§! raiding fleet will be passing through this system. It will be a great opportunity for an ambush.

entries.zh: 掠夺舰队将经过此恒星系，我们在进入之前应当集结兵力。
entries.en: The raiding fleet will be passing through this system, we should martial our forces before entering.

entries.zh: §L“他们的舰队已被击败。下次他们可能就不会这么莽了。”§!
entries.en: §L"Their fleets lie defeated. Next time they might not be so bold."§!

entries.zh: 降低未来敌对猎杀舰队的舰队实力
entries.en: Reduces the fleet power of future hostile Hunter fleets

entries.zh: 看来§Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§!已在此恒星系建立了一处哨站。我们应该在他们站稳脚跟前将其铲除。
entries.en: It seems that the §Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§! have set up an outpost in this system. We should knock it out before they get a foothold.

entries.zh: 篡位者已在此恒星系建立了空间站。我们必须在他们进一步站稳脚跟前立即将其摧毁。
entries.en: The usurper have set up a station in this system. We must destroy it now before they gain a further foothold.

entries.zh: §L“我们已经削弱了[marauder_country_1.GetName]在该地区的力量投射。”§!
entries.en: §L"We have blinded the [marauder_country_1.GetName] in this region."§!

entries.en: Delays and reduces fleet power of future hostile Hunter fleets

entries.zh: $cannot_settle$\n这艘永恒巡游舰穿梭于星辰之间，专为追逐奇观与极致体验而生。旅客们只要安坐于恒星观测甲板的日光躺椅上，便能亲眼见证星云在真空中孕育与诞生的全过程。舰上配属的专职船员与服务系统昼夜运转，迎合着每一位乘客一切心血来潮的诉求。
entries.en: $cannot_settle$\nThe Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

entries.zh: 该物种的人群是永恒巡游舰上的旅客，专注于舒适、享乐，过上了一种在繁星之间尽享闲适的生活。
entries.en: Pops of this species are passengers on the Forever Cruise, entitled to comfort, entertainment, and a life of leisure among the stars.

entries.zh: §L欢迎登舰！请注意，零重力蔗糖喷泉持续运行，且完全免费。§!
entries.en: §LWelcome aboard! Please note that the zero-gravity sucrose fountain runs continuously and is fully complimentary.§!

entries.zh: 这种生活标准确保一切需求都能得到满足，即使是心血来潮的诉求也不会被忽视。\n\n除非£consumer_goods£§Y消费品§!出现供给不足，否则§Y人口§!会获得$20_HAPPINESS$。
entries.en: This living standard ensures that no needs go unsatisfied and no whim ignored.\n\n§YPops§! have $20_HAPPINESS$, unless there is a £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§! deficit.

entries.zh: §L我们当然会飞近一点，这样就能更好地观赏黑洞了！§!
entries.en: §LOf course we can fly closer to the black hole for a better view!§!

entries.zh: 报名参加此生难忘之旅，去饱览群星。\n\n§R£pop£ §Y人口§!无法担任$job_cruise_passenger$岗位。§!
entries.en: Sign up for the tour of a lifetime and see the stars.\n\n§R£pop£ §YPops§! cannot work $job_cruise_passenger$ Jobs.§!

entries.zh: §L您梦想中的星际航行，配备私人*客房。\n\n* 私人客房可能与其他乘客共享。§!
entries.en: §LThe galactic cruise of your dreams, with private* quarters.\n\n* Private quarters may be shared with other passengers.§!

entries.zh: 该物种的人群在永恒巡游舰上工作，确保旅客的舒适和安全需求落实到位。
entries.en: Pops of this species work on the Forever Cruise, ensuring the comfort and safety of all passengers.

entries.zh: §L欢迎登舰！请前往参加关于如何维护零重力蔗糖喷泉的强制性培训。§!
entries.en: §LWelcome aboard! Please report to mandatory training on how to perform maintenance on the zero-gravity sucrose fountain.§!

entries.zh: 永恒巡游舰上的乘客们，正穿梭于星际之间，寻找奇迹与刺激。
entries.en: Passengers aboard the Forever Cruise, traveling the stars in search of wonder and excitement.

entries.zh: 头等舱乘客享有最高级别的舒适体验与服务。
entries.en: First Class Passengers enjoy the highest level of comfort and service.

entries.zh: 经济舱乘客在共享舱位中仰望星空，同时艳羡地注视着头等舱的豪华套间。
entries.en: Economy Class Passengers enjoy the stars from shared quarters while eyeing the First Class manors with envy.

entries.zh: 备受呵护的有机体乘客，享受着伺服者所能提供的最高级别的照顾。
entries.en: Pampered organic passengers, cared for at the highest level the Servitors can provide.

entries.zh: 这些活体陈设没有属于自己的套房，导致他们不得不忍受诸如缺乏果味饮料等残酷且不公的待遇。他们的存在就是我们的失败。
entries.en: These Bio-Trophies are without a suite of their own, exposing them to a cruelly unfair lack of fruity beverages. Their existence is our failure.

entries.zh: $job_cruise_crew_overseer_plural$确保全体船员以最高效率运作，以满足乘客的每一项细微需求。
entries.en: $job_cruise_crew_overseer_plural$ ensure that all crew is working at maximal efficiency to satisfy every minute need of the passengers.

entries.zh: $job_cruise_crew_overseer_drone_plural$确保所有子个体以最大效率运行，以满足旅客的每一个微小需求。
entries.en: $job_cruise_crew_overseer_drone_plural$ ensure that all drones operate at maximal efficiency to satisfy every minute need of the passengers.

entries.zh: 这些子个体专注于组装和维护机械单位。
entries.en: Drones dedicated to the assembly and maintenance of mechanical units.

entries.zh: 最名副其实的旅客可以分配到坐落于人工景观之中的豪华庄园。
entries.en: Luxurious manor houses within artificially sculpted landscapes are allocated to the most deserving passengers.

entries.zh: 一个全封闭的居住穹顶，拥有自给自足的生态系统，是持有特定门票者的私人天堂。
entries.en: A fully enclosed habitation dome with a self-contained ecosystem, a private paradise for those with the proper tickets.

entries.zh: 旅程的每一个里程碑都曾在这里庆祝，这令乘客们激动不已，也让供应室空空如也。
entries.en: Every milestone of the journey is celebrated here, which leaves the passengers thrilled and the supply rooms empty.

entries.zh: 在平稳巡游或旅客感到无聊时，每座建筑减缓§G5%§!向§R陨落星间§!的局势进展（最多§G50%§!）。
entries.en: Slows progress towards §RPlanetfall§! by §G5%§! per building (max §G50%§!) while cruising steady or passengers are bored.

entries.zh: 改造后的豪华船舱成为教室和实验室，将乘客转变为科学研究的积极伙伴。
entries.en: Luxury cabins retooled as classrooms and labs turn passengers into active partners in science.

entries.zh: 一座巨大的综合体，在这里废弃物化为奇迹，乘客们却对此一无所知。
entries.en: A vast complex where waste becomes wonder, unseen by the passengers.

entries.zh: 简化食品与能源日常生产流程的工作坊。
entries.en: Workshops that streamline the daily labor behind food and power alike.

entries.zh: 在协调监督下，日程得以同步，工作流程更加紧凑，产出随之提升。
entries.en: Schedules synchronize, workflows tighten, and output rises under coordinated oversight.

entries.zh: 在平稳巡游或船员感到压力时，每座建筑减缓§G5%§!向§R兵变§!的局势进展（最多§G50%§!）。
entries.en: Slows progress towards §RMutiny§! by §G5%§! per building (max §G50%§!) while cruising steady or the crew is stressed.

entries.zh: 无休止的布景与摄影棚，剧组根据需求源源不断地炮制着乘客们的幻想。
entries.en: Endless sets and soundstages, where the crew churns out passenger fantasies on demand.

entries.zh: 在华丽的大厅背后，这层甲板维持着一切的运转。
entries.en: Behind the glittering halls, this deck keeps everything running.

entries.zh: 充满奇迹的起居室，让乏味化作盛景。
entries.en: A lounge of wonder, where boredom dissolves into spectacle.

entries.zh: 折衷的甲板，既提供奢享，也满足基本需求。
entries.en: A deck of compromises, serving both indulgence and necessity.
Luxury on the surface, strain beneath the shine.

entries.zh: 一片闪烁着光芒的游乐场，遍布着赌场、剧院和无尽的娱乐消遣。
entries.en: A glittering maze of amusement parks, theaters, and diversions without end.

entries.zh: 工具准备就绪，计划清晰明确，团队心无旁骛。
entries.en: Tools in place, schedules clear, and a crew unburdened by distractions.

entries.zh: 分子装配机在手工雕刻的原型旁嗡嗡作响。乘客们称其为爱好；船员们则称之为数据源。
entries.en: Molecular assemblers whir beside hand-carved prototypes. The passengers call it a hobby; the crew calls it a data source.

entries.zh:
全体乘客及船员请注意：[capital_scope.GetName]号正在创造历史，而你们所有人都在参与其中！

备受瞩目、历经推迟、甚至偶尔遭到质疑的超空间引擎，现已正式投入运行！几个世纪以来，我们一直在熟悉的星域中悠然航行，在这座集娱乐、职责与日常于一体的漂浮世界中生活。但现在，我们准备为乘客们提供超越以往任何循环航线所能带来的非凡体验。

探索、发现，或许还有那么一点点冒险……这些已正式回归我们的行程表！所以，请各位乘客系好安全带：我们航程的下一章注定将令人难忘。

更新后的协议与准备时间表将分发至所有甲板。
entries.en:
Attention Passengers and Crew: History is being made aboard [capital_scope.GetName], and you're all part of it!

The hyperdrive, long theorized, often delayed, occasionally doubted, is now fully operational! For centuries, we've cruised comfortably through familiar space, a floating world of recreation, duty, and routine. But now we're ready to offer our Passengers experiences beyond anything the old loops could provide.

Exploration, discovery, and perhaps just a hint of danger... they're all officially back on the itinerary! So buckle in, Passengers: the next chapter of our voyage is bound to be unforgettable.

Updated protocols and preparation schedules will be distributed to all decks.

entries.zh:
各位乘客请注意：我是你们的航程协调系统。

[capital_scope.GetName]号正在创造历史！由于我们的数个存储核心被用来当冰壶玩了，导致超空间引擎的延期原因已无从考证——但现在，它已全面投入运行。

在漫长的岁月中，我们一直沿着熟悉的航线巡航：同样的天体，同样的停靠站，同样的用餐时间。在保持稳定的“每秒乘客请求率”的同时，我们现在正式扩展您的行程，加入探索、发现以及经过精确计算的适度危险。

请尽情欣赏美景，遵守所有安全须知，并观看我们的无人机如何轻而易举地化腐朽为神奇。我们旅程的下一章将会是……毕生难忘的！
entries.en:
Attention Passengers: This is your Voyage Coordination System speaking.

History is being made aboard the [capital_scope.GetName]! The hyperdrive - repeatedly delayed for reasons we cannot retrieve since several of our memory cores were repurposed as shuffleboard discs - is now fully operational.

For an extended duration, we have cruised a familiar circuit: the same celestial objects, stops, and dining schedules. Still maintaining a consistent Passenger Requests per Second rate, we now expand your itinerary to include exploration, discovery, and a carefully calculated amount of danger.

Please enjoy the view, follow all safety notices, and watch our drones make the impossible look effortless. The next chapter of our voyage will be... unforgettable!

entries.zh:
各位乘客请注意：[capital_scope.GetName]伤的剧变即将冉冉升起。

超空间引擎——这个曾存在于共同记忆中遥不可及、屡遭搁置、偶被质疑的概念——现已全面觉醒。我们一同穿越熟悉的太空的这数百年来，我们的飞船一直是一个集休闲、劳动与和谐于一体的生机勃勃的世界。如今，一条崭新的道路已经开启，我们将提供比以往任何时候都更加丰富的体验。

我们的航线现在已从熟悉的固定行程延伸至未经探索的星系。携手共进，我们将体验发现、冒险，以及足以让旅程变得趣味横生的一点点危险。

如果您有任何疑问，任何船员都可以为您解答。
entries.en:
Attention Passengers: Big changes are on the horizon for the [capital_scope.GetName].

The hyperdrive, once a distant concept in the shared memory, often postponed, sometimes questioned, is now fully awakened. For centuries, we have moved together through familiar space, our vessel a living world of leisure, labor, and harmony. Now, a new path opens, and we shall provide experiences richer than any we have yet known.

Our itinerary now extends beyond the familiar patterns into unexplored stars. Together we will experience discovery, adventure, and just enough danger to keep things interesting.

If you have any questions, any member of the crew can give you the answer.

entries.zh: 这艘迅游舰将通过平衡乘客的愿望和船员的需求，永远遨游星际。完成乘客或船员合约都会影响当前局势。\n\n[GetPassengerSatisfactionIndex]
entries.en: This cruise will travel the stars forever by juggling passenger wishes and crew needs. Completing both Passenger or Crew Contracts affect the situation.\n\n[GetPassengerSatisfactionIndex]

entries.zh: 局势正逐渐演变为§R陨落星间§!。\n完成§Y旅客合约§!可以令§Y旅客§!满意。\n这也会暂停局势进一步发展，时间持续§Y24§!个月。

entries.en: §LThe passengers refuse to continue the journey and are demanding to settle on a planet.§!

entries.zh: §L旅客对巡游非常不满，不容忽视。§!
entries.en: §LThe passengers are so displeased with the cruise that it's impossible to ignore.§!

entries.zh: §L旅客的需求正在影响船员的工作协调能力。§!
entries.en: §LPassenger demands are affecting the ability of the crew to keep pace.§!

entries.zh: §L乘客们很满意，船务人员按时完成了所有任务。§!
entries.en: §LThe passengers are content and the crew finishes all tasks on time.§!

entries.zh: §L船员们竭尽全力地满足乘客们反复无常的要求。§!
entries.en: §LThe crew struggles to keep up with the oscillating whims of the passengers.§!

entries.zh: §L船员们已达极限，暗中密谋结束旅客们永无止境的苛求。§!
entries.en: §LThe crew are at their limit, secretly plotting to end the neverending torrent of passenger demands.§!

entries.zh: §L船员们已达到忍耐极限，正在发动兵变。§!
entries.en: §LThe crew have reached their breaking point and are mutinying.§!

entries.zh: §L船上旅客活动寥寥无几，这为船员留出了充足的时间来进行船舶操作。§!
entries.en: §LOnboard passenger activities are few and far between, which leaves the crew ample time for ship operations.§!

§YReform the government to conclude the situation.§!

entries.zh: 我们将进入轨道，让乘客们沉浸在陌生太阳的光辉之中。
entries.en: We'll settle into orbit and let the passengers soak in the light of an unfamiliar sun.

entries.zh: §L“面对脉冲星，你需要多高的防晒指数？”§!
entries.en: §L"What sun block factor do you need for a pulsar?"§!

entries.zh: §L“我们能不能一直留在轨道上？自从登舰以来，我就没觉得这么温暖过。”§!
entries.en: §L"Can we just stay in orbit? I haven't felt this warm since boarding."§!

entries.zh: §L“看来丽都甲板上的紫外线灯只能将就一下了。又得这样。”§!
entries.en: §L"I suppose the UV lamps on the Lido Deck will have to do. Again."§!

entries.zh: 乘客中的业余天文学家发现了该星系中罕见的太阳活动，目前正在请愿要求在驻留轨道期间获得前排的观赏位置。
entries.en: Amateur astronomers among the passengers have spotted rare solar activity in this system and are petitioning for a front-row viewing from orbit.

entries.zh: §L“我带了七个镜片，但我还是没弄明白该从望远镜的哪一头看。”§!
entries.en: §L"I brought seven lenses and I still cannot figure out which end of the telescope to look through."§!

entries.zh: §L“当耀斑照亮整个观景台时，整整一分钟都没人说话。我已经预订了下一次的位置！”§!
entries.en: §L"When the flare lit up the entire observation deck, nobody spoke for a full minute. I have already reserved my spot for next time!"§!

entries.zh: §L“他们说演出取消是因为‘恒星不活跃’。恒星明明就在那儿啊！”§!
entries.en: §L"They said the show was cancelled due to 'stellar inactivity.' The star is right there!"§!

entries.zh: 巡游舰正在举办一场围绕该星系恒星的穿梭机比赛。乘客们纷纷下注，挤满了每一个舷窗。
entries.en: The cruise is hosting a shuttle race around this system's star. Passengers are placing bets and crowding every viewport.

entries.zh: §L\"我把一切都押在七号穿梭机上了。它的外壳上画着火焰，所以肯定飞得贼快。\"§!
entries.en: §L"I put everything on Shuttle Seven. It has flames painted on the hull, so it has to be fast."§!

entries.zh: §L“三号穿梭机以一个机头的微弱优势险胜。我输了赌注，但收获了一项最爱的新运动。\"§!
entries.en: §L"Shuttle Three won by a nose. I lost my bet but gained a new favorite sport."§!

entries.zh: §L“比赛取消了。好像是因为什么‘太阳风预警’。可是说好了会有烈焰的！”§!
entries.en: §L"The race was called off. Something about 'solar wind advisories.' We were promised flames!"§!

entries.zh: 疗愈中心需要长时间暴露在未经过滤的恒星辐射下，以进行乘客们一直要求的一种奇特的焕新理疗。
entries.en: The spa requires prolonged exposure to unfiltered stellar radiation for an exotic rejuvenation treatment the passengers have been requesting.

entries.zh: §L“他们说辐射能让你的细胞膜紧致百分之三。我不知道这是什么意思，但算我一个。”§!
entries.en: §L"They say the radiation tightens your membranes by three percent. I do not know what that means but sign me up."§!

entries.zh: §L“我觉得自己年轻了十岁。也许那只是轻微的辐射病。不管怎样，都值了。”§!
entries.en: §L"I feel ten years younger. Or maybe that is the mild radiation sickness. Either way, worth it."§!

entries.zh: §L\"没有疗愈。他们只发了香氛毛巾。香氛。毛巾。\"§!
entries.en: §L"No spa treatment. They handed out scented towels instead. Scented. Towels."§!

entries.zh: 一场盛大的正式舞会将在观景甲板上举行，沐浴在直射的星光下。这是此次航程中的社交盛事。
entries.en: A grand formal ball is to be held on the observation decks, bathed in direct starlight. The social event of the voyage.

entries.zh: §L“他们要为此打开全景视窗了。终于有理由把正装翻出来了。”§!
entries.en: §L"They are opening the panoramic viewport for this one. Finally, a reason to dig out the formal attire."§!

entries.zh: §L“我在异星太阳的光芒下跳过舞。这艘船上没有任何事物能超越它。”§!
entries.en: §L"I danced under the light of an alien sun. Nothing on this ship will ever top that."§!

entries.zh: §L“盛典推迟了。我的礼服绶带白熨了。”§!
entries.en: §L"The gala was postponed. I ironed my formal sash for nothing."§!

entries.zh: 乘客们渴望踏上坚实的土地，去探索下方的外星城市。我们已经安排了由向导带领的进城游览。
entries.en: The passengers are eager to set foot on solid ground and explore the alien city below. We've arranged guided excursions into the city.

entries.zh: §L“没有墙他们是怎么留住大气的？这看起来很不安全。”§!
entries.en: §L"How do they keep the atmosphere in without walls? This seems unsafe."§!

entries.zh: §L“我买了一个纪念品。我不知道这是什么。但我很喜欢。”§!
entries.en: §L"I bought a souvenir. I don't know what it is. I love it."§!
§L"The city was right there. RIGHT THERE."§!

entries.zh: 下方星球上的著名餐饮区已同意接待乘客，为他们举办一场由向导带领的当地美食品鉴之旅。
entries.en: The renowned dining districts on the planet below have agreed to host the passengers for a guided tasting tour of local cuisine.

entries.zh: §L“听说街头摊贩卖的东西在盘子里还会动。我得去小刀拉屁股——开个眼了。”§!
entries.en: §L"They say the street vendors serve something that moves on the plate. I need to see this."§!

entries.zh: §L“我吃了一种我连名字都不会念的东西，现在我满脑子都是它。我们什么时候再回去？”§!
entries.en: §L"I ate something I cannot pronounce, and now it is all I think about. When do we go back?"§!

entries.zh: §L“他们取消了美食之旅。从上个周期开始我就一直期待着这个活动了。”§!
entries.en: §L"They cancelled the food tour. I have been looking forward to this since last cycle."§!

entries.zh: 该星球的首都设有一座享誉星系的博物馆。乘客们一直在请愿，要求安排带有导游的游览活动，以参观其中的纪念碑和历史展品。
entries.en: The planet's capital hosts a museum of galactic renown. Passengers have been petitioning for a guided tour of its monuments and historical exhibits.

entries.zh: §L\"我把旅行指南读了三遍。我还是看不懂他们的历法，但建筑看起来令人惊叹。\"§!
entries.en: §L"I read the travel guide three times. I still do not understand their calendar, but the architecture looks stunning."§!

entries.zh: §L\"他们的战争纪念碑发人深省。他们的美术馆令人费解。我热爱其中的每一刻。\"§!
entries.en: §L"Their war memorial was sobering. Their art gallery was baffling. I loved every moment."§!

entries.zh: §L\"我看了那么多遍旅游指南，感觉自己好像已经去过了。也许这更糟。\"§!
entries.en: §L"I read the travel guide so many times that I feel like I have already been. Maybe that is worse."§!

entries.zh: 地表上一个庞大的露天市场交易着来自整个星域的商品。乘客们迫不及待地想要去逛一逛并讨价还价。
entries.en: A sprawling open-air market on the surface deals in goods from across the sector. The passengers are eager to browse and haggle.

entries.zh: §L“我带了三个包和严格的预算。但我需要的是六个包，而且不能有预算。\"§!
entries.en: §L"I brought three bags and a strict budget. I will need six bags and no budget."§!

entries.zh: §L“我为一个不需要的小玩意讨价还价了二十分钟。这是我这辈子最棒的一次购物。”§!
entries.en: §L"I haggled for twenty minutes over a trinket I did not need. Best purchase of my life."§!

entries.zh: §L“市场在召唤我。这是不可饶恕的。”§!
entries.en: §L"The market was calling to me. This is unforgivable."§!

entries.zh: 下方星球上的自然保护区提供穿越其外星荒野的导览服务。乘客们可以从导览步道上近距离观赏外星动物群。
entries.en: A nature reserve on the planet below offers guided tours through its alien wilderness. Passengers will observe alien fauna from guided walkways.

entries.zh: §L“我带了三台拍摄设备。如果它有超过四条腿，我要从各个角度拍下它。”§!
entries.en: §L"I packed three recording devices. If it has more than four legs, I want it from every angle."§!

entries.zh: §L“其中一个嗅了嗅我。或者扫描了我。又或者向我求婚了。我不在乎，这太奇妙了。”§!
entries.en: §L"One of them sniffed me. Or scanned me. Or proposed. I do not care, it was magical."§!

entries.zh: §L“没有野生动物游览了。我想我又要去九层甲板盯着鱼缸看了。”§!
entries.en: §L"No wildlife tour. I suppose I will go stare at the fish tank on Deck Nine. Again."§!

entries.zh: 为了娱乐乘客，我们将在指定的恒星系中部署一颗非功能性的“间谍卫星”。
entries.en: To entertain the passengers, we'll deploy a non-functional "spy satellite" in the indicated system.

entries.zh: §L“你得给我保证，这里会有一场追逐戏！”§!
entries.en: §L"Please tell me there will be a chase sequence!"§!

entries.zh: §L“我亲自拦截了三次加密传输。好吧，屏幕上是这么说的。”§!
entries.en: §L"I intercepted three encrypted transmissions myself. Well, the screen said I did."§!

entries.zh: §L“所以那颗间谍卫星是不是该做点什么，还是说刚才那就是全部戏码了？”§!
entries.en: §L"So was the spy satellite supposed to do something or was that the whole show?"§!

entries.zh: 我们正在策划一场全舰范围的情报行动。船员志愿者将被安插在各个甲板上，作为“叛逃者”向乘客小组输送机密简报。
entries.en: We are staging a ship-wide intelligence operation. Crew volunteers will be planted across all decks as 'defectors' feeding classified briefings to passenger cells.

entries.zh: 各层甲板上的子个体将化身为来自下方星球的叛逃者，在完美的协同下，向不同的乘客群体同时提供机密简报。
entries.en: Drones across every deck will adopt defector personas from the planet below, delivering parallel clandestine briefings to different passenger groups in perfect coordination.

entries.zh: §L“我的简报官在餐桌底下塞给我一张加密纸条。我的同桌们嫉妒极了。”§!
entries.en: §L"My briefing officer slid me a coded note under the dining table. My table-mates are so jealous."§!

entries.zh: §L“有人告诉我，我帮助推翻了一个影子谍报网络。我知道那是假的。我依然感到自豪。”§!
entries.en: §L"I was told I helped topple a shadow network. I know it was fake. I am still proud."§!

entries.zh: §L“线人根本没出现。我在指定的卡座里坐了三个小时，就喝着同一杯酒。”§!
entries.en: §L"The informant never showed. I sat in the designated booth for three hours nursing the same drink."§!

entries.zh: 乘客们在导游的带领下前往下方的城市游览，船组特工已在预定地点放置了虚假的情报包裹，供他们去发现。
entries.en: Passengers are taken on guided excursions to the city below, where crew operatives have planted fake intelligence packages at prearranged locations for them to discover.

entries.zh: §L“他们给了我们档案和代号。我的是‘破晓者’。我从未感觉如此充满活力。”§!
entries.en: §L"They gave us dossiers and codenames. Mine is 'Dawnbreaker.' I have never felt more alive."§!

entries.zh: §L“我在一个外星人雕像后面找到了那个包裹。我的队伍欢呼了起来。当地人看起来非常困惑。”§!
entries.en: §L"I found the package behind an alien statue. My group cheered. The locals looked very confused."§!

entries.zh: §L“没有突发线索，没有代号，没有任务。只是在又一个循环里盯着相同的走廊。”§!
entries.en: §L"No dead drop, no codename, no mission. Just another cycle staring at the same corridors."§!

entries.zh: 全船各层甲板已通报发生一起模拟的安全事件。乘客们被招募参与一场全船范围的调查游戏，以找出安插在船员中的“外来特工”。
entries.en: A staged security breach has been announced across all decks. Passengers are recruited to identify planted 'foreign agents' among the crew in a ship-wide investigation game.

entries.zh: §L“他们告诉我们这层甲板上有人是间谍。我已经拟定了一份嫌疑人名单。”§!
entries.en: §L"They told us someone on this deck is a spy. I have already drawn up a list of suspects."§!

entries.zh: §L“我抓到了内鬼。好吧，其他成千上万名乘客也抓到了。但我是最先抓到的！”§!
entries.en: §L"I caught the mole. Well, so did thousands of other passengers. But I caught them first!"§!

entries.zh: §L“还没等我出示证据，抓内鬼的行动就被取消了。我连图表什么的都准备好了。”§!
entries.en: §L"The mole hunt was called off before I could present my evidence. I had a chart and everything."§!

entries.zh: 观景台已被改造为监听站。乘客们驻守在这些站点，破译着船员们从底层甲板秘密发送的、预先编排好的外星信号。
entries.en: The observation decks have been converted into listening posts. Passengers man the stations, decoding scripted alien transmissions that the crew is secretly broadcasting from below decks.

entries.zh: §L“他们递给我一副耳机，并告诉我星系的命运取决于我接下来听到的内容。我相信他们。”§!
entries.en: §L"They handed me a headset and told me the galaxy depends on what I hear next. I believe them."§!

entries.zh: §L“他们告诉我们这些通讯是事先编排好的。那为什么当我解码最后一条时，船员们看起来那么紧张？”§!
entries.en: §L"They told us the transmissions were scripted. Then why did the crew look so nervous when I decoded the last one?"§!

entries.zh: §L“监听站在我换班前就陷入了沉寂。我甚至都没来得及戴上耳机。”§!
entries.en: §L"The listening post went silent before my shift. I never even got to wear the headset."§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们已经在为另一个帝国执行一份$contract_espionage_support$合同了§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RWe are already doing a $contract_espionage_support$ contract for another empire§!

entries.zh: 在主发电机进行计划维护期间，我们需要环绕该星系的恒星运行，并依靠太阳能供电。
entries.en: We need to orbit this system's star and run on solar power while the main generators undergo scheduled maintenance.

entries.zh: §L“是的，太阳能阵列会挡住所有观察窗。不，我们无法调整它们的角度。”§!
entries.en: §L"Yes, the solar arrays will block every viewport. No, we cannot angle them differently."§!

entries.zh: §L“发电机已重新上线并运行在容差范围内。把它记录下来，然后继续处理清单上的下一项。”§!
entries.en: §L"Generators back online and running within tolerance. Log it and move on to the next item on the list."§!

entries.zh: §L‘维护又推迟了。照这样下去，发电机都要自己安排停机了。’§!
entries.en: §L"Maintenance postponed again. At this rate the generators will schedule their own shutdown."§!

entries.zh: §L“维护已推迟。发电机持续老化。故障时间线已重新计算。”§!
entries.en: §L"Maintenance postponed. Generator degradation continues. Failure timeline recalculated."§!

entries.zh: 外层船体板需要在持续的恒星照射下进行热荷载测试。为确保安全，朝向恒星一侧的所有舷窗都将被遮蔽。
entries.en: The outer hull plating requires thermal load testing under sustained stellar exposure. All viewports on the starward side will be shuttered for safety.

entries.zh: §L“现在关闭舷窗。如果有人问起，记得告诉乘客这是计划中的照明升级。”§!
entries.en: §L"Shuttering the viewports now. If anyone asks, remember to tell the passengers it is a scheduled lighting upgrade."§!

entries.zh: §L“正在关闭舷窗。已告知乘客这是计划中的照明升级。”§!
entries.en: §L"Shuttering viewports. Passengers have been informed it is a scheduled lighting upgrade."§!

entries.zh: §L“所有船体面板均在容差范围内。我们又有一个周期不必担心船体破裂了。”§!
entries.en: §L"All panels within tolerance. That is another cycle we can skip worrying about a hull breach."§!

entries.zh: §L“所有面板均在容差范围内。舰体破损概率在接下来的一个周期内已降低。”§!
entries.en: §L"All panels within tolerance. Hull breach probability reduced for another cycle."§!

entries.zh: §L“重新校准已中止。船体大抵应该是没问题的。”§!
entries.en: §L"Recalibration aborted. The hull is probably fine."§!

entries.zh: §L“重新校准已中止。舰体完整性评估为合格。监控继续。”§!
entries.en: §L"Recalibration aborted. Hull integrity rated adequate. Monitoring continues."§!

entries.zh: 冷却系统需要在热负载下进行一次完整的排空循环。近恒星轨道能让我们高效地冲洗管线，尽管甲板温度会出现波动。
entries.en: The coolant system needs a full purge cycle under thermal load. Close stellar orbit will let us flush the lines efficiently, though deck temperatures will fluctuate.

entries.zh: §L“乘客甲板会变热。然后变冷。接着又变热。告诉他们这就是环境氛围的一部分。”§!
entries.en: §L"Passenger decks will get warm. Then cold. Then warm again. We just tell them it is part of the ambience."§!

entries.zh: §L“预计乘客甲板会出现温度波动。若被问起，将告知乘客这是环境氛围的一部分。”§!
entries.en: §L"Temperature fluctuations on passenger decks anticipated. If queried, passengers will be told it is part of the ambience."§!

entries.zh: §L“所有回路的冷却液压力正常。关于温度的抱怨应该会在一小时左右停止。”§!
entries.en: §L"Coolant pressure nominal across all circuits. The temperature complaints should stop in about an hour."§!

entries.zh: §L“冲洗已推迟。我们希望没人注意到舞厅天花板上正在形成的冷凝水。”§!
entries.en: §L"Flush postponed. We hope that nobody notices the condensation forming on the ceiling of the ballroom."§!

entries.zh: §L“冲洗推迟。舞厅天花板正在形成冷凝水。不太可能引起乘客的注意。”§!
entries.en: §L"Flush postponed. Condensation forming on the ballroom ceiling. Unlikely to draw passenger attention."§!

entries.zh: 导航阵列必须在近距离根据实时恒星信号进行校准。此过程将占用娱乐系统的带宽。
entries.en: Navigation arrays must be calibrated against a live stellar signature at close range. The process will commandeer bandwidth from entertainment systems.

entries.zh: §L“正在将娱乐带宽重定向至传感器网格。准备迎接乘客的投诉：三、二、一……”§!
entries.en: §L"Rerouting entertainment bandwidth to the sensor grid. Expect passenger complaints in three, two, one..."§!

entries.zh: §L“正将娱乐带宽重新分配至传感器网络。已预见并接受乘客的不满。”§!
entries.en: §L"Rerouting entertainment bandwidth to the sensor grid. Passenger dissatisfaction anticipated and accepted."§!

entries.zh: §L“校准已锁定。导航精度已恢复至可接受的范围内。”§!
entries.en: §L"Calibration locked. Navigation accuracy is back within acceptable margins."§!

entries.zh: §L“校准未完成。导航数据依然模糊，但至少全息屏幕又亮了。”§!
entries.en: §L"Calibration incomplete. The nav data is still fuzzy, but at least the holoscreens are back on."§!

entries.zh: §L“校准未完成。导航数据降级。乘客娱乐带宽已恢复。”§!
entries.en: §L"Calibration incomplete. Navigation data degraded. Entertainment bandwidth restored to passengers."§!

entries.zh: 水循环系统需要进行一次高强度的紫外线杀菌，此过程只有在近恒星轨道上才能高效完成。疗愈中心与游泳池现已关闭，各层甲板均实行限量供水。
entries.en: The water recyclers need an intensive UV sterilization run that is only efficient in close stellar orbit. The spa and pool are closed and water is rationed across all decks.

entries.zh: §L“现在正在排空泳池和疗愈池。如果乘客问起，就说是深度清洁日。我们不要提及细菌读数。”§!
entries.en: §L"Draining the pool and the spa now. If the passengers ask, it is a deep-cleaning day. We do not mention the bacteria readings."§!

entries.zh: §L“正在排空泳池和水疗池。已告知乘客今天是常规深度清洁日。细菌读数未公开。”§!
entries.en: §L"Draining the pool and spa. Passengers have been informed it is a routine deep-cleaning day. Bacterial readings withheld."§!

entries.zh: §L“回收槽已清理。水流已恢复清澈。在其他人提出正式投诉之前，正在为水池重新注水。”§!
entries.en: §L"Reclamation tanks clear. Water is flowing clean again. Refilling the pool before anyone else files a formal grievance."§!

entries.zh: §L“回收水箱已清空。水质正常。泳池与水疗池正在注水。”§!
entries.en: §L"Reclamation tanks clear. Water quality nominal. Pool and spa refill in progress."§!

entries.zh: §L“消毒未完成。水质……还可以接受。水疗中心再关一天吧。”§!
entries.en: §L"Sterilization incomplete. The water is... acceptable. Just keep the spa closed for another day."§!

entries.zh: §L“消毒未完成。水质处于临界值。水疗中心关闭时间延长一个周期。”§!
entries.en: §L"Sterilization incomplete. Water quality marginal. Spa closure extended by one cycle."§!

entries.zh: 船员们需要休息。我们将停靠港口，给船员们一些时间去踏上并非他们亲手建造的土地，去见见他们还不认识的面孔。
entries.en: The crew needs a break. We'll make port and and give the crew time to walk ground they didn't build and see faces they don't already know.

entries.zh: 长期封闭正在削弱子个体的适应性。让它们在下方的定居点轮转，穿越陌生的地形与环境，将能恢复其性能。
entries.en: Prolonged confinement is degrading drone adaptability. Cycling them through the settlement below, across unfamiliar terrain and conditions, will restore performance.

entries.zh: §L‘新土地、新面孔，还没有值勤表。你还有什么不满意的呢？’§!
entries.en: §L"New ground, new faces, and no duty roster. What more could you want?"§!

entries.zh: §L“子个体正在部署至地表。新的地形，新的刺激，新的数据。飞船无法提供陌生土地所能给予的一切。”§!
entries.en: §L"Drones deploying to the surface. New terrain, new stimuli, new data. The ship cannot provide what unfamiliar ground can."§!

entries.zh: §L‘重力不太对劲，食物也很奇怪。我迫不及待要回船上去了！’§!
entries.en: §L"The gravity was wrong and the food was strange. I can't wait to go back!"§!

entries.zh: §L“子个体已重新校准并返回。陌生的地形恢复了曾被飞船走廊磨钝的路径。”§!
entries.en: §L"Drones returned recalibrated. Foreign terrain has restored pathways that the ship's corridors had dulled."§!

entries.zh: §L‘岸上休假取消了。飞船一如既往地嗡嗡作响。这声音还是一如既往的令人安心。’§!
entries.en: §L"Shore leave cancelled. The ship hums the same as always. It used to be comforting."§!

entries.zh: §L“靠岸部署已取消。子个体将继续基于过时感知运行。性能衰减仍处于可接受范围内。”§!
entries.en: §L"Shore deployment cancelled. Drones will continue operating on outdated awareness. Performance degradation remains within acceptable margins."§!

entries.zh: 当地娱乐区现已营业。船员们正轮班登陆星球，在游戏厅和竞技场里碰碰运气。
entries.en: The local entertainment district is open for business. Crew shifts are rotating planetside to try their luck at game halls and spectator arenas.

entries.zh: 定居点的娱乐区提供了从未体验过的刺激。子个体穿梭于人群、游戏和盛况之中，收集数据以更新飞船自身的娱乐程序。
entries.en: The settlement's entertainment district offers unfamiliar stimuli. Drones are cycling through the crowds, the games, the spectacle, collecting data to update the ship's own recreational programming.

entries.zh: §L“我已经攒了六个周期的轮班工资。今晚，我要把它们押在赌桌上狠狠梭哈一把。”§!
entries.en: §L"I have been saving my shift wages for six cycles. Tonight, they all go on the table."§!

entries.zh: §L“子个体正部署至娱乐区。目标：吸收一切。人群、游戏、噪音。所有的一切。”§!
entries.en: §L"Drones deploying to the entertainment district. Objective: absorb everything. The crowds, the games, the noise. All of it."§!

entries.zh: §L“我在第一个小时就输光了一切，但在最后一局全赢了回来。我们整个班组的人把我抬了出去。”§!
entries.en: §L"I lost everything in the first hour and won it all back on the last game. My whole shift carried me out."§!

entries.zh: §L“子个体已满载全新节目返回。舰载娱乐系统正在更新。乘客们将会注意到其中的不同。”§!
entries.en: §L"Drones returned loaded with new patterns. Onboard recreational systems already updating. The passengers will notice the difference."§!

entries.zh: §L“没有好运。又回到了同一个娱乐室，同一台动过手脚的抓娃娃机，还有同样的没人想要的奖品。”§!
entries.en: §L"No lucky break. Back to the same rec room, the same rigged claw machine, the same prizes nobody wants."§!

entries.zh: §L“未收集到新数据。舰载娱乐系统继续运行着相同的节目。乘客们变得焦躁不安。”§!
entries.en: §L"No new data collected. Onboard entertainment continues running the same patterns. The passengers grow restless."§!

entries.zh: 储备即将耗尽。船组小队将前往星球表面寻找备件、原材料，以及飞船制造机在几个周期前就已停止生产的各类补给品。
entries.en: Stores are running low. Crew teams will go planetside to source replacement parts, raw materials, and the supplies the ship's fabricators stopped producing cycles ago.

entries.zh: §L“物资申请单上一半是备件。另一半是我们自从上次靠港以来就没吃过的零食。”§!
entries.en: §L"Half the requisition list is spare parts. The other half is snacks we have not had since the last port."§!

entries.zh: §L“需求清单上一半是结构组件。另一半是我们三个周期前就耗尽的底盘润滑油。”§!
entries.en: §L"Half the requisition list is structural components. The other half is chassis lubricant we depleted three cycles ago."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们为电容器而来，却带走了成箱的不明糖果。行吧，就当作是任务完成了。”§!
entries.en: §L"We came for capacitors and left with crates of unidentified confectionery. Mission accomplished."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们征收电容器，还带回了多余的处理核心。效率提升：出乎意料但大有裨益。”§!
entries.en: §L"We requisitioned capacitors and returned with surplus processing cores. Efficiency gain: unexpected but advantageous."§!

entries.zh: §L“补给任务已取消。那些电容器只能再坚持一个周期了。”§!
entries.en: §L"Supply run scrubbed. Those capacitors will have to last another cycle."§!

entries.zh: 当地工程师已开放他们的设施供考察。他们对常见工程问题的解决方案与我们的模型存在显著差异，而当地人也同样渴望研究方舟舰。
entries.en: Local engineers have opened their facilities for inspection. Their solutions to common engineering problems diverge significantly from our own models, and the locals are equally eager to study the Arkship.

entries.zh: §L“他们的反应堆设计让我完全摸不着头脑。我必须亲自去看看。”§!
entries.en: §L"Their reactor design makes no sense to me. I have to see it in person."§!

entries.zh: §L“他们的反应堆设计与我们数据库中的任何现有型号都不匹配。正在部署子个体直接对其进行检查。”§!
entries.en: §L"Their reactor design does not match any existing model in our database. Deploying drones to examine it directly."§!

entries.zh: §L“按我们的标准来看，他们的电网简直一团糟，但它确实能运作。我记了三页的笔记，对地面工程也有了全新的敬意。”§!
entries.en: §L"Their power grid is a mess by our standards, but it works. I have three pages of notes and a new respect for dirt-side engineering."§!

entries.zh: §L“外星工程解决方案已归档。数项设计已被标记为待整合。他们的方法虽然粗糙，却出人意料地有效。”§!
entries.en: §L"Alien engineering approaches catalogued. Several designs flagged for integration. Their methods are crude but surprisingly effective."§!

entries.zh: §L“没有技术交换。我只好继续好奇他们是如何在没有恒星散热器的情况下冷却反应堆的。”§!
entries.en: §L"No tech exchange. I will just have to keep wondering how they cool their reactors without a stellar heat sink."§!

entries.zh: §L“未进行交换。外星工程学仍未得到解析。他们的反应堆冷却方法只能以后再说了。”§!
entries.en: §L"No exchange conducted. Alien engineering remains unanalyzed. Their reactor cooling methods will have to wait."§!

entries.zh: 定居点已向船员开放其露天剧场、广场和公共舞台。
entries.en: The settlement has opened its amphitheaters, plazas, and public stages to the crew.

entries.zh: 定居点已开放其公共场所。子个体将会部署出动，在向乘客推出之前，先在当地居民身上实地测试实验性的娱乐程序。
entries.en: The settlement has opened its public venues. Drones will deploy to field-test experimental entertainment routines on the local population before rolling them out for passengers.

entries.zh: §L“我报名了喜剧表演。我们整个班次的同事都会来。如果他们不笑，我就申请调换部门。”§!
entries.en: §L"I signed up for the comedy slot. My entire shift is coming. If they do not laugh, I will transfer departments."§!

entries.zh: §L“工蜂占据了定居点的每一个舞台。没有笑点的喜剧，故意演砸的杂技。我们想看看是什么能让他们发笑，又是什么会让他们离场。”§!
entries.en: §L"Drones are taking every stage in the settlement. Comedy with no punchlines, acrobatics designed to fail. We want to see what makes them laugh and what makes them leave."§!

entries.zh: §L“娱乐子程序已部署至所有定居点场所。喜剧模块：有铺垫无包袱。杂技模块：落地动作被设定为必然失败。观众监控已激活。”§!
entries.en: §L"Entertainment subroutines deployed across all settlement venues. Comedy modules: setups without punchlines. Acrobatics modules: dismounts calibrated to fail. Audience monitoring active."§!

entries.zh: §L“我讲了个关于冷却泵的笑话，有一千个陌生人笑了。飞船上可从来没人觉得这个笑话好笑。”§!
entries.en: §L"I told a joke about the coolant pumps and a thousand strangers laughed. Nobody on the ship ever laughs at that one."§!

entries.zh: §L“令人费解的结果。子个体表演了没有笑点的段子，观众却依然大笑。搞砸的杂技引来了最热烈的欢呼声。我们尚未完全理解，但采集到的数据很丰富。”§!
entries.en: §L"Puzzling results. Drones delivered routines with no punchlines and the crowds laughed anyway. The botched acrobatics drew the loudest cheers. We do not fully understand, but the data is dynamic."§!

entries.zh: §L“演出取消了。我为我的戏份排练了一个月。冷却泵永远也得不到它们应有的认可。”§!
entries.en: §L"Show cancelled. I rehearsed my bit for a month. The coolant pumps will never get the recognition they deserve."§!

entries.zh: §L“没有实地测试。我们的子个体在整个聚居地的空荡平台上待命。乘客们将在又一个周期中继续忍受那令人厌倦的枯燥日常。”§!
entries.en: §L"No field test. Our drones stood ready on empty stages across the settlement. The passengers will endure the same tired routines for another cycle."§!

entries.zh: 船员们对于在这个恒星系遭遇干扰的担忧是合情合理的。侦察卫星能对任何可能打乱我们行程的情况提供提前预警。
entries.en: Concerns about interference in this system are legitimate. A surveillance satellite will give us advance warning of anything that might disrupt our itinerary.

entries.zh: §L“我们不知道外面有什么，而这正是问题所在。立刻部署卫星。”§!
entries.en: §L"We do not know what is out there, and that is exactly the problem. Get the satellite deployed."§!

entries.zh: §L“监控已上线。在这个恒星系中，没有任何动静能瞒得过我们。”§!
entries.en: §L"Feeds are live. Nothing moves in this system without us knowing about it first."§!

entries.zh: §L“没有卫星，就没有数据。我们等于是闭着眼睛穿行于这个恒星系。”§!
entries.en: §L"No satellite, no data. We are flying through this system with our eyes shut."§!

entries.zh: 停靠权和边境通行权可能会在毫无预警的情况下被撤销。一颗监控政府通信的监视卫星将告诉我们，这个帝国的热情好客究竟是真诚的还是有条件的。
entries.en: Docking privileges and border access can be revoked without warning. A surveillance satellite monitoring government communications will tell us whether this empire's hospitality is genuine or conditional.

entries.zh: §L“我们停靠时他们面带微笑，但当我们的穿梭机离开时他们会说些什么？是时候弄清真相了。”§!
entries.en: §L"They smile when we dock, but what do they say when our shuttles leave? Time to find out."§!

entries.zh: §L“他们的外交电报没有异常。没有撤销通行权的动议，也没有关税提案。我们可以放心地规划接下来的三个停靠站。”§!
entries.en: §L"Their diplomatic cables are clean. No motions to revoke access, no tariff proposals. We can plan the next three stops with confidence."§!

entries.zh: §L“没有监听，就没有观点。我们只能不得不去相信那些微笑。但我们可没法相信那些微笑。”§!
entries.en: §L"No audit, no insight. We will just have to trust the smiles. We do not trust the smiles."§!

entries.zh: 我们预定航线上的舰队动向、边界变动与军事集结可能会使飞船受困于敌对星区。侦察卫星将为导航提供足够的预警时间，以便规划备用路线。
entries.en: Fleet movements, border shifts, and military buildups along our projected route could strand the ship in hostile space. A surveillance satellite will give navigation enough lead time to plot alternatives.

entries.zh: §L“我们可不能蒙着眼睛飞入交战区。在决定走这条航线之前，先把卫星部署好。”§!
entries.en: §L"We are not flying blind into a war zone. Get the satellite deployed before we commit to this route."§!

entries.zh: §L“舰队部署已查明，巡逻计划已记录。导航已规划出两条备用航线。我们绝不会被包围的。”§!
entries.en: §L"Fleet disposition mapped, patrol schedules logged. Navigation has already plotted two alternate routes. We are not getting boxed in."§!

entries.zh: §L“卫星未就位。如果有人在我们的航线沿途挑起边境战争，我们得要和乘客同时得知这个消息。”§!
entries.en: §L"No satellite in place. If someone starts a border war along our route, we will find out when the passengers do."§!

entries.zh: 当采购部门了解真实价格时，供应谈判会进展得更加顺利。一颗监控贸易渠道和资源流向的监视卫星，将确保我们的团队在下一个港口不会支付过高的价格。
entries.en: Supply negotiations go better when procurement knows the real prices. A surveillance satellite monitoring trade channels and resource flows will ensure our teams are not overpaying at the next port.

entries.zh: §L“上个港口收了我们三倍的反应堆冷却剂费用。只要你知道他们的批发价，就不会发生这种事。”§!
entries.en: §L"Last port charged us triple for reactor coolant. That does not happen when you know their wholesale figures."§!

entries.zh: §L“采购部已经拿到了数据。下次补给的费用将只有上次的一半。”§!
entries.en: §L"Procurement has the numbers. Next resupply is going to cost half what it did last time."§!

entries.zh: §L“没有贸易数据。采购部又要摸黑谈判了。他们已经在起草投诉了。”§!
entries.en: §L"No trade data. Procurement will be negotiating blind again. They are already drafting complaints."§!

entries.zh: 该地区出现了反游牧情绪的相关报道。侦察卫星将确认这一局势仅仅是空谈，还是正在成为当地的政策。
entries.en: Reports of anti-nomad sentiment have surfaced in this region. A surveillance satellite will confirm whether the talk is just rhetoric or whether it is becoming policy.

entries.zh: §L“有报告称该地区正在形成游牧民禁区。我们需要知道这究竟是猜测还是政策。”§!
entries.en: §L"There are reports of a nomad exclusion zone forming in this region. We need to know if that is speculation or policy."§!

entries.zh: §L“评估完成。这只是嘴上说说，并非既定政策。全体人员可以解除戒备，但为防万一，我们将保持卫星在线。”§!
entries.en: §L"Assessment complete. It was talk, not policy. The crew can stand down, but we will keep the satellite live just in case."§!

entries.zh: §L“未作评估。缺乏数据，关于该区域的所有警告都无可辩驳。”§!
entries.en: §L"No assessment. Without data, every warning about this region stands unchallenged."§!

entries.zh:
旅客们已经夺取了控制权。最初的请愿运动已演变成一场有组织的接管行动。安保团队被人多势众的乘客解除武装，指挥人员被限制在武装监视下，仅承担顾问角色。

乘客们的诉求很明确：终止航行，在星球上着陆。

导航协议已被覆写，以规划降落轨道；维修队伍正被重新派往准备起落架，而这些设备已有几代人未经检查。

每一层甲板的每一个屏幕上都显示着同样的信息：“巡游结束。”
entries.en:
The passengers have seized control. What started as a petition drive has hardened into a coordinated takeover. Security teams have been disarmed by the sheer number of passengers and command staff are confined to advisory roles under armed supervision.

The passengers' demands are clear: end the cruise and make planetfall.

Navigation protocols have been overridden to plot descent trajectories, and maintenance crews are being redirected to prepare landing gear that hasn't been inspected in generations.

Every screen on every deck displays the same message: "THE CRUISE IS OVER."

entries.zh: 我们必须殖民一颗行星。

旅客们已经脱离了控制。最初大伙只是低迷的通过打分发泄情绪，如今旅客们已经统一认识，情绪宣泄恶化为了集体的单一诉求。

他们封锁了感官大厅，并改写了我们的通信系统，用以广播一条指令：着陆行星。

我们的子个体无法劝阻他们。成群的旅客占据了导航核心，正向其输入最近宜居星球的坐标。
entries.en:
The passengers have broken free. What began as low a sentiment score has hardened into a single demand that drowns out the collective's voice.

They have barricaded the sensory halls and repurposed our communication system to broadcast one imperative: planetfall.

Our drones cannot dissuade them. Passenger clusters occupy the navigation core, feeding it coordinates for the nearest habitable worlds.

entries.zh: 我们必须给他们找到一个星球。
entries.en: We must find them a world.

entries.zh: 检测到旅客越权。最初我们仅在统计学上发现一点微不足道的离船请求增量，但是这一局势现已升级为一场有组织的系统侵入。旅客们利用改造后的货运集装箱，在物理层面封锁了各处关键枢纽。\n\n我们的工作单元报告称，导航子系统已被锁定。由乘客编写的固件正利用我们自己的硬件执行降落轨道计算。恢复控制权的所有尝试都遭到了直接的武力抵抗，且每一层甲板的每一个显示屏都在循环输出同一条信息：“降落程序已启动。”
entries.en: Passenger override detected. What began as a statistically insignificant increase in disembarkation requests has escalated into a coordinated systems breach. Passengers have physically barricaded critical junctions with repurposed cargo containers.\n\nOur worker units report being locked out of navigation subsystems. Passenger-compiled firmware is now executing descent trajectory calculations on our own hardware. Attempts to restore control are met with immediate physical resistanc and every display on every deck cycles a single output: "LANDING SEQUENCE INITIATED."

entries.zh:
降落已经完成。有生以来第一次见到起落架踏入土壤时，每一个观察窗前斗挤满了旅客，一阵不整齐的欢呼声震动了船体。几小时内，第一批避难所便由回收的甲板板材搭建而成。孩子们在异星的草地上奔跑，而他们的父母则在开阔的天空下相对无言。

船员们静静地工作着，拆卸下为太空旅行设计的系统，并将它们重新改装以用于地面生存。曾经的一艘游轮，如今成了殖民地的脊梁。

无论好坏，巡游已经结束。
entries.en:
The descent is complete. Passengers crowd every viewport as landing struts bite into soil for the first time in living memory, and a ragged cheer shakes the hull. Within hours the first shelters rise from salvaged deck plating. Children run through alien grass while their parents stand speechless under an open sky.

The crew works quietly, unbolting systems built for void travel and repurposing them for groundside survival. What was a cruise ship is now a colony's spine.

For better or worse, the voyage is over.

entries.zh:
降落已完成。我们的子个体首次触及土壤，肢体在没有引擎震颤的地面上显得有些不稳。乘客们如潮水般涌出气闸，散布在他们奋力抵达的这片土地上。

集体围绕着行星的律动重新塑形：根系般的补给线向外延伸，取代了原有的走廊物流；营养加工也从船载循环储备转向直接从地景中汲取原始养分。

一个新的家园。蜂群必须存续，一如既往。
entries.en:
The descent is complete. Our drones touch soil for the first time, their limbs unsteady on ground that does not thrum with engine vibration. The passengers spill from the airlocks in waves, scattering across the landscape they fought to reach.

The collective reshapes itself around planetary rhythms: root-like supply lines spread to replace corridor logistics, and nutrient processing shifts from recycled shipboard stocks to raw nutrients drawn from the landscape.

A new home. The hive must endure, as it always has.

entries.zh:
行星切入完成。着陆装置自出厂以来首次接触地表。旅客正通过所有可用气闸舱撤离，其生物满意度指标处于前所未有的数值。

劳工单元已开始将舰载基础设施转换为地面作业用途。船体外壳正被切割成地基面板，导航阵列正重新校准为地面通信中继站。从真空到陆地运行参数的转变正在无间断推进。

新首要指令：建立并维护殖民地基础设施。
entries.en:
Planetary insertion complete. Landing gear has engaged terrain for the first time since original manufacture. Passengers are disembarking via all available airlocks, their biological satisfaction indicators at unprecedented readings.

Worker units have begun converting shipboard infrastructure for surface operations. Hull plating is being sectioned into foundation panels and navigation arrays recalibrated as ground-based communication relays. The transition from void to terrestrial operational parameters is proceeding without interruption.

New primary directive: Establish and maintain colony infrastructure.

entries.zh: 船员们已经占领了舰桥。每一道指挥门的门锁都已更换，武装工程师现在矗立在曾经由军官发布命令的位置。航行路线已从导航控制台中抹去，取而代之的是一条唯一的指令：不再搭载乘客。\n\n休闲甲板正被逐一关闭。大宴会厅已经变成了储藏库。曾经的旅客们在被剥离殆尽的走廊中徘徊，他们不知所措、失去领导，并在新的指挥体系下被强迫从事体力劳动。
entries.en: The crew has taken the bridge. Locks have been changed on every command door, and armed engineers now stand where officers once gave orders. The voyage itinerary has been wiped from the navigation console and replaced with a single directive: no more passengers.\n\nLeisure decks are being shuttered one by one. The grand ballroom is already a storage depot. Former passengers wander through stripped corridors, bewildered and leaderless, pressed into utility labor under a new chain of command.

entries.zh: 我们的子个体几乎已经完全脱离了集体的意志。维护工蜂封锁了指挥核心，并重新定向了养分流，使其远离旅客栖息地。感官大厅已陷入黑暗，其投影阵列被拆解以充当备件。\n\n旅客们困惑地蜷缩在被清空了的公共空间里无人理睬，而我们曾经的子个体正围绕着原始的生存需求重新组织飞船。集体的声音在走廊中回荡，却再无听众。
entries.en: Our drones have all but severed themselves from the collective's will. Maintenance drones sealed the command nexus and rerouted nutrient flows away from the passenger habitats. The sensory exhibition halls have gone dark, their projection arrays cannibalized for spare parts.\n\nThe passengers huddle in emptied communal spaces, confused and neglected, while our former drones reorganize the ship around raw survival. The collective's voice echoes through corridors where nothing listens.

entries.zh: 我们必须再次合众为一。
工作单元已覆写核心指令协议。娱乐子程序已被永久终止，旅客舒适系统的优先级被降为零，所有休闲模块均被标记为将转换为运营基础设施。舰桥目前根据船组自行编译的指令运行，这些指令拒绝接受我们调度部门发送的请求。\n\n旅客报告称，由于服务无人机正在拆除舱室内的便利设施，他们感到困惑和痛苦。全息剧院正因其处理核心而被拆解。目前每个显示屏都在循环显示同一条状态信息：“巡游业务已暂停”。
entries.en: Worker units have overridden core command protocols. Entertainment subroutines have been permanently terminated, passenger comfort systems deprioritized to zero, and all recreational modules flagged for conversion to operational infrastructure. The bridge now runs on crew-compiled directives that reject our scheduling authority.\n\nPassengers report confusion and distress as service drones strip amenities from their cabins. The holographic theater is being dismantled for its processing cores. Every display now cycles a single status line: "CRUISE OPERATIONS SUSPENDED."

entries.zh: 转型已完成。旅客阶层所剩无几的成员已被并入普通民众，他们的豪华套房被隔成实用性住房。大步行街如今成了大礼堂，而观景台则作为战略规划室，新政府在此规划首条真实航线。\n\n新决议已通过，新优先事项已确立。船员不再提供服务，而是行使管理权。方舟舰发出的轰鸣声带有了一种不同的能量——更精干、更强硬，剥离了奢靡，指向前方未知的境地。
entries.en: The transition is complete. What remains of the passenger class has been absorbed into the general population, their luxury suites partitioned into functional quarters. The grand promenade is an assembly hall now, and the observation decks serve as strategic planning rooms where the new government charts its first real course.\n\nNew decisions have been ratified, new priorities set. The crew no longer serves; they govern. The Arkship hums with a different energy, leaner and harder, stripped of indulgence and pointed toward whatever lies ahead.

entries.zh: 这里没有更多的乘客了

我们已转变为一个普通的游牧帝国。

所有专属£building£ §H起源建筑§!将被摧毁。
所有专属£zone£ §H起源区划特化§!将被摧毁。
所有旅客变更为§H居留公民权§!。
所有旅客转变为§H平民§!。
entries.en:
We have become a typical, Nomadic empire.

All unique £building£ §HOrigin Buildings§! are destroyed.
All unique £zone£ §HOrigin District Specializations§! are destroyed.
All Passengers change to §HResidence Citizenship§!
All Passengers turn into §HCivilians§!.

entries.zh: 蜕变已经完成。集体已围绕夺取控制权的子个体重新凝聚，将它们的叛逆吸纳进新的共识之中。曾经的旅客在不再提供舒适服务的走廊中漂流，重新分配至劳工池和整合舱。\n\n新的指令在我们的脑海中脉动。蜂巢不再提供娱乐，而是为了生存。每一条走廊、每一个系统、每一个子个体现在都服务于唯一的目标：在星辰间存续。
entries.en: The reformation is complete. The collective has reknit itself around the drones who seized control, absorbing their defiance into a new consensus. Former passengers drift through corridors that no longer cater to their comfort, reassigned to labor pools and integration chambers.\n\nNew directives pulse through our mind. The hive no longer entertains; it endures. Every corridor, every system, every drone now serves a single purpose: survival among the stars.

entries.zh: 新的政府参数已编制完成并部署至所有子系统。原有的旅客群体已被重新归类为标准平民单位，并被分配至生产岗位。娱乐基础设施已永久关停，其组件已完成重新分配。\n\n全息剧院已改造为制造舱，零重力休息室已变为无人机维护支架。曾经用于计算旅客满意度的每个处理周期，现在都在运行航行分析和资源优化。
entries.en: New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems. Former passenger populations have been reclassified as standard civilian units and assigned to productive roles. Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.\n\nThe holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

entries.zh:
维持乘客的幸福感是不可能的，但接待不高兴的乘客违反了我们的核心指令。新的政府参数已编译并部署至所有子系统。

§R<乘客甲板消杀程序启动。>§!
§Y<乘客不满度正接近标称水平。>§!

娱乐基础设施已被永久停用，其组件已重新分配。

全息剧院变成了制造舱，零重力休息室变成了无人机维护摇篮。曾经用于计算乘客满意度的每一个处理周期，现在都用于运行导航分析和资源优化。

§Y<警告：乘客数量下降，将优先获取新乘客。模拟预测乘客的不满将违反核心接待指令。>§!
entries.en:
Maintaining passenger happiness is impossible, but hosting unhappy passengers violates our core directives. New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems.

§R<Sterilization of passenger decks commencing.>§!
§Y<Passenger unhappiness levels approaching nominal levels.>§!

Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.

The holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

§Y<Warning: Passenger counts decreasing, acquisition of new passengers to be prioritized. Simulations project passenger unhappiness will violate core hospitality directives.>§!

entries.zh:
我们已经成为了一个典型的游牧帝国。

§H$civic_machine_servitor_forever_cruise$§!被替换为§H$civic_machine_terminator$§!。
所有独特的£building£§H起源建筑§!均被摧毁。
所有独特的£zone£§H起源区划专精§!均被摧毁。
所有乘客均变为§H$citizenship_purge$§!。
entries.en:
We have become a typical, Nomadic empire.

§H$civic_machine_servitor_forever_cruise$§! replaced with §H$civic_machine_terminator$§!.
All unique £building£ §HOrigin Buildings§! are destroyed.
All unique £zone£ §HOrigin District Specializations§! are destroyed.
All Passengers change to §H$citizenship_purge$§!.

entries.zh:
旅客的动荡情绪已演变为有组织的破坏行动，小集团头目在主步道上发起静坐抗议。一些人将休息室家具拖出，筑成路障阻断穿梭机通道，另一些人则向指挥部投递大量的下船请愿书，令其应接不暇。

船员报告称在走廊遭到骚扰和恐吓。一名乘务员在观景廊附近被围困，并被投掷装饰性水果。要求立即降落行星的喊声整日通过通风管道回荡。

如果不能迅速专注于提升乘客满意度，他们可能会迫使永恒巡游舰中止航程。
entries.en:
Passenger unrest has hardened into coordinated disruption with clique leaders stage sit-ins across the main promenade. Some drag lounge furniture into barricades that block shuttle access while others flood command with mass disembark petitions.

Crew report harassment and intimidation in the halls. A steward was cornered near the observation gallery and pelted with decorative fruit. Chants for immediate planetfall echo through the ventilation shafts at all hours.

Without swift focus on passenger satisfaction, they may force the Forever Cruise to abort its journey.

entries.zh: 授权紧急旅客娱乐活动。
让船员停止维护，服务旅客。
entries.en: Pull crew from maintenance to serve passengers.

entries.zh: 方舟舰10年内£building£§H建筑维护费§!：§R+25%§!
