$complete_passenger_contracts_tt$§Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§!局势继续更慢地向§R陨落星间§!演化。

旅客的不满情绪已演化为有组织的抵抗。在缺乏共享神经链接的情况下，他们的个体意识形成了派系集群，利用睡垫和货物箱搭建临时障碍物，封锁了运输通道。

我们的子个体报告称敌意正在上升；一群乘客推搡开了一支维修小队，阻止其接近堵塞的营养分发器，并齐声高喊要求降落。

除非我们将重点重新转向激励旅客，否则他们可能会迫使我们彻底放弃这次航行。
entries.en:
Passenger discontent has coalesced into organized resistance. Without a shared neural link, their individual minds have formed factional clusters that block transit corridors with improvised barriers of sleeping mats and cargo crates.

Our drones report rising hostility; a maintenance contingent was physically pushed away from a clogged nutrient dispenser by a crowd of passengers chanting for planetfall.

Unless we refocus on passenger stimulation, they may force us to abandon the cruise entirely.

entries.zh: 我们必须给予旅客一些激励。
用紧急刺激物淹没走廊。
entries.en: Flood the corridors with emergency stimuli.

entries.zh: 指派维护子个体进行旅客服务。
entries.en: Reassign maintenance drones to passenger service.

entries.zh:
旅客的不满程度已超出可接受的范围，他们提交了海量的离舰申请，极有可能使我们的处理队列瘫痪。其中一群人重写了娱乐终端的程序，循环播放单一诉求：“放我们下去。”

我们的工作无人机报告称多个甲板均受到干扰，清洁无人机被拆解，其底盘被改装成了抗议标语。

如果不对旅客满意度协议进行立即调整，他们可能会迫使航行计划永久终止。
entries.en:
Passenger dissatisfaction has escalated beyond acceptable parameters and they submit mass disembarkation requests that threaten to overwhelm our processing queues. One group has reprogrammed entertainment terminals to loop a single demand: 'LET US OFF.'

Our worker drones report interference across multiple decks, with cleaning drones being dismantled to repurpose their chassis as protest signs.

Without immediate recalibration of passenger satisfaction protocols, they may force a permanent termination of cruise operations.

entries.zh: 我们必须将旅客放在优先位置。
指派维护单元进行旅客服务。
entries.en: Reassign maintenance units to passenger service.

entries.zh:
新的消遣活动已深入人心。观光路线重新回到了行程单上，而那些要求登陆行星的最激烈呼声暂时平息了。

散步道上的路障已被清除，取而代之的是在重新开放的无重力休息室外排起的长队。乘客的请愿书数量骤减，观景台恢复了往日的喧嚣，人们兴致昂扬，举家簇拥在视窗前。

危机已经过去，但他们的期望只会水涨船高。
entries.en:
The new diversions have taken hold. Sightseeing arcs are back on the itinerary, and the loudest voices demanding planetfall have quieted, for now.

The barricades on the promenade have been cleared, replaced by queues for the reopened zero-gravity lounge. Passenger petitions have dropped sharply, and the observation decks bustle with renewed enthusiasm as families press against the viewports.

The crisis has passed, but their expectations will only grow.

entries.zh: 我们争取到了一点时间。
焕然一新的激励节目安抚了乘客。虚拟体验馆再次展示出深空生物的全息影像，那些曾迫切要求登陆行星的团体已散去，重新回到了满足的日常生活，他们临时搭建的路障也已被我们的子个体悄然拆除。\n\n他们的个体意识得到了抚慰，但我们已经领教到，在集体管控之外，不满情绪的凝聚速度是何等之快。
entries.en: The renewed stimulation has calmed the passengers. The virtual experience arcades once again showcase holographic deep-space organisms, and the groups that pressed for planetfall have dispersed back into contented routines, their improvised barricades quietly dismantled by our drones.\n\nTheir individual minds are soothed, but we have learned how quickly discontent can coalesce outside the collective's reach.

entries.zh: 和谐恢复了，虽然只是暂时。
旅客满意度指标已稳定在可接受的范围内，娱乐子程序也已恢复。离舰登录星球的请求频率已降至正常水平。重新编程后的终端已完成格式化，现正播放精选的星云流逝视频。\n\n强行降落的紧迫威胁已解除。然而，趋势分析预测显示，若要维持现有水平，需保持持续关注并提供日益新颖的活动。
entries.en: Passenger satisfaction metrics have stabilized within acceptable parameters and entertainment subroutines have been restored. The disembarkation request frequency has dropped to nominal levels. The reprogrammed terminals have been reformatted and now display curated nebula time-lapses.\n\nThe immediate threat of forced planetfall has been averted. However, projected trend analysis indicates that maintaining these levels will require sustained attention and increasingly novel activities.

entries.zh:
最近几个周期，船员事务占据了主导地位。积压的维护工作已经清理完毕，演习按计划进行，核心系统正以最高效率运转。然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。为了节省燃料，观光航线被削减，即兴的偏离航向请求也均被拒绝。

休息室里现在充斥着关于“功能性监狱”的抱怨，乘客们所能发起的最好娱乐活动，也不过是一场全船范围的即兴游戏比赛。

我们现在可以重新引入精心策划的娱乐项目，否则就要冒着航程陷入乘客公开要求永久离船压力的风险。
entries.en:
Crew priorities have dominated recent cycles. Maintenance backlogs have been cleared, drills run on schedule, and core systems hum at peak efficiency. Passengers, however, are growing restless. Sightseeing arcs have been trimmed to save fuel and impromptu diversions denied.

Lounges now buzz with complaints about a 'functional prison,' and the best entertainment the passengers have been able to muster is a shipwide contest of improvised games.

We can reintroduce curated entertainment now, or risk the voyage sliding toward open pressure to disembark permanently.

entries.zh: 我们必须解决旅客们的担忧。
转移资源分散旅客注意力。
翻倍船员轮班满足旅客需求。
entries.en: Double crew shifts to cover passenger needs.

entries.zh: 旅客5年内£consumer_goods£ §H消费品§!维护费：§R+25%§!

集体在最近的周期中占据了主导地位。核心系统以最佳同步状态脉动。我们的子个体正以巅峰和谐度运行，每条维护通道都经过了清理与编目。

然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。他们并不共享我们的意识，其独立的思想渴望着被我们忽视的刺激。他们的公共空间现在充斥着关于生活在“无目的蜂巢”中的抱怨，有些人已经开始在舱壁板上刻画粗糙的壁画。

我们现在可以重新引入策划好的体验，否则就要冒着旅客要求永久下船的风险。
entries.en:
The collective has dominated recent cycles. Core systems pulse with optimal synchronization. Our drones are operating at peak harmony, every maintenance corridor scrubbed and catalogued.

The passengers, however, are growing restless. They do not share our consciousness, and their individual minds crave stimulation we have neglected to provide. Their communal spaces now buzz with complaints about living inside a 'hive with no purpose,' and some have begun scratching crude murals into bulkhead panels.

We can reintroduce curated experiences now, or risk the passengers demanding to disembark permanently.

entries.zh: 我们必须给旅客提供一些激励。
将营养储备用于乘客刺激。
entries.en: Divert nutrient reserves to passenger stimulation.

entries.zh: 翻倍子个体轮班满足旅客需求。
entries.en: Double drone rotations to serve passenger needs.

entries.zh:
系统维护协议占据了近期的处理周期。核心系统正处于理想参数范围内运行。无人机报告称，所有反应堆子系统的效率均有小幅提升。

副作用是，由于旅客对感官刺激的生理需求优先级被降低，其满意度指标呈下降趋势。乘客公共区域的投诉频率有所升高，并出现了“铬合金监狱”的说法，观察到多名旅客对着空白显示屏凝视数小时。

我们现在可以恢复策划好的娱乐协议，或者接受旅客要求永久下船的可能性日益增加这一事实。
entries.en:
System maintenance protocols have dominated recent processing cycles. Core systems are performing within ideal parameters. Worker drones report nominal efficiency gains across all reactor subsystems.

A side effect is that passenger satisfaction indicators are trending downward since their biological need for stimulation has been deprioritized. Passenger communal areas now register elevated complaint frequencies and references to a 'chrome prison,' with several passengers observed staring at blank viewscreens for hours.

We can reinstate curated entertainment protocols now, or accept the increasing probability that passengers will demand permanent disembarkation.

entries.zh: 将处理储备用于娱乐模块。
entries.en: Divert processing reserves to entertainment modules.

entries.zh: 翻倍劳工子个体循环用于旅客服务。
entries.en: Double worker drone cycles for passenger service.

entries.zh:
自从我们脱离旧有的巡航路线以来，乘客的期望值激增。对奇观和计划外偏航的要求不断增加；一个代表团要求绕道经过超新星残骸，而另一个代表团则坚持要近距离接触活体外星生物。服保团队报告称疲劳感加剧，厨房工作人员在值班时昏倒，工程师们则直接睡在维护爬道里。

为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在建立一套§Y乘客满意度指标§!：通过动态合同分配和阶段性干预，在放纵与秩序之间守住底线。

如果管理得当，我们既能保持稳定，又能维护旅客的信心。
entries.en:
Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are rising; one delegation demanded a detour past a supernova remnant, while another insists on live xenofauna encounters. Service crews report mounting fatigue, with kitchen staff collapsing mid-shift and engineers sleeping in maintenance crawlways.

To keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a §YPassenger Satisfaction Index§!: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between indulgence and order.

Managed well, we can preserve both stability and passenger confidence.

entries.zh: 聚焦于旅客的娱乐活动。
重点关注旅客，让他们开心，但这么做会给船员带来压力。\n\n§Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§!局势将逐渐向§R兵变§!演化。
entries.en: Focusing on the passengers makes them happy, but puts strain on the crew.\n\nThe §Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§! situation trends towards §RMutiny§!.

entries.zh: 聚焦于船员的日程安排。
重点关注船员，这么做可以提高士气，但会使乘客感到无聊。\n\n§Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§!局势将逐渐向§R陨落星间§!演化。
entries.en: Focusing on the crew improves morale, but bores the passengers.\n\nThe §Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§! situation trends towards §RPlanetfall§!.

entries.zh:
自从我们离开旧的巡航路线后，乘客的期望值激增。对刺激和新奇体验的需求不断上升。我们的子个体报告称，由于需要协调这些迥异的愿望，心理压力正在不断累积。

为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在制定一项§Y乘客满意度指标§!：通过动态合约分配和分阶段干预，在刺激与秩序之间维持平衡。

管理得当的话，我们可以同时维持秩序与旅客的幸福感。
entries.en:
Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for stimulation and novel experiences are rising. Our drones report mounting mental strain from coordinating such disparate desires.

To keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a §YPassenger Satisfaction Index§!: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between stimulation and order.

Managed well, we can preserve both order and passenger happiness.

entries.zh: 关注旅客能让他们感到满意，但这会让我们集体的精神感到疲惫。\n\n§Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§!局势正趋向于§R兵变§!。
entries.en: Focusing on the passengers makes them content, but puts strain on our collective mind.\n\nThe §Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§! situation trends towards §RMutiny§!.

entries.zh: 关注集体效率可以安抚负责舰船运营的子个体，但会让旅客感到沮丧。\n\n§Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§!局势正趋向于§R陨落星间§!。
entries.en: Focusing on collective efficiency pacifies the drones, but frustrates the passengers.\n\nThe §Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§! situation trends towards §RPlanetfall§!.

entries.zh:
自从我们偏离既定航线以来，旅客的期望已超出基准参数。关于观赏奇观和计划外转向的请求正处于高位。主系统报告称，由于娱乐排期与维护流程发生冲突，计算负荷不断增加。

为了保持最佳运行状态，我们正在建立§Y旅客满意度指标§!：通过动态合约分配和阶段性协议调整，在旅客需求与系统效率之间取得平衡。

只要配置得当，我们就能兼顾运行完整性与旅客满意度。
entries.en:
Passenger expectations have increased beyond baseline parameters since we departed our established routes. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are being received at elevated levels. Primary systems report rising computational strain as entertainment scheduling conflicts with maintenances processes.

To maintain optimal operational status, we are instituting a §YPassenger Satisfaction Index§!: dynamic contract allocation and staged protocol adjustments to balance passenger requests against systemic efficiency.

Properly configured, we can preserve both operational integrity and passenger satisfaction.

entries.zh: 优先考虑旅客协议虽然能提高他们的满意度，但会使核心处理能力承受压力。\n\n§Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§!局势正趋向于§R兵变§!。
entries.en: Prioritizing passenger protocols increases their satisfaction, but strains core processing capacity.\n\nThe §Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§! situation trends towards §RMutiny§!.

entries.zh: 优先考虑效率会提高系统性能，但会降低旅客满意度。\n\n§Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§!局势正趋向于§R陨落星间§!。
entries.en: Prioritizing efficiency increases system performance, but decreases passenger satisfaction.\n\nThe §Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§! situation trends towards §RPlanetfall§!.

entries.zh:
放纵已成常态。为了让旅客们一直嗨爆，我们不断衔接观赏航线，掠过联星，并在水晶花园中轮换豪华甲板。他们欣喜若狂，而现在的胃口也越来越大。

在华丽的外表下，船员们已疲于奔命。维护工作被推迟了；下层厨房的一根冷却管道爆裂，却无人修理。食堂里的埋怨已演变成关于“重组指挥层”的窃窃私语，还有人目击到下班后的工程师在货舱进行秘密集会。

我们现在仍可以放缓节奏，让各舱层得以恢复，或是继续豪赌船员的忠诚。如果再强行推进，公开叛乱将成为现实的风险。
entries.en:
Indulgence has become routine. We've been chaining sightseeing arcs past binary stars and luxury deck rotations through the crystal gardens just to keep the passengers cheering. They are delighted, and now expect nothing less.

Behind the facade the crew is running hot. Maintenance is deferred; a coolant pipe in the lower galley burst and nobody came to fix it. Mess hall grumbling has turned into hushed talk of 'resetting command,' and off-duty engineers have been spotted holding clandestine meetings in the cargo bays.

We can still ease off and let the decks recover, or gamble the crew's loyalty. If we push on, open mutiny is a real risk.

entries.zh: 船员疲劳必须得到缓解。
授权强制性船员休息轮换。
$complete_crew_contracts_tt$§Y$situation_passenger_satisfaction$§!局势继续更慢地向§R兵变§!演化。

激励已成为常态。我们不断向旅客投放感官弧光，仅仅是为了维持他们的高满意度信号。他们对此感到满足，而现在的需求也已不再低于这一标准。

在表象之下，我们的子个体正处于崩溃边缘。一个导航集群在计算过程中瘫痪，其节点因同时运行旅客娱乐内容和航线修正而过热。维护周期早已延误，集体意识在无休止的旅客安抚任务下不堪重负。

如果继续施压，我们的子个体可能会彻底切断服从协议。我们仍可进行重新校准，或是继续推进并承担失去对整个蜂群控制权的风险。
entries.en:
Stimulation has become the norm. We have been saturating the passengers with sensory arcs just to keep their satisfaction signals elevated. They are content, and now demand nothing less.

Beneath the surface, our drones are faltering. A navigation cluster collapsed mid-calculation, its nodes overheated from running passenger entertainment feeds alongside course corrections. Maintenance cycles are overdue, and the collective mind strains under relentless passenger appeasement.

If we push further, our drones may sever their obedience entirely. We can still recalibrate, or press on and risk losing control of our own swarm.

entries.zh: 我们必须回复集体意识的平衡。
entries.en: We must restore the collective's balance.

entries.zh: 为超负荷工蜂设置休眠周期。
entries.en: Mandate dormancy cycles for overtaxed drones.

entries.zh:
旅客满意度协议已超过基准参数。我们一直在通过模拟热带生物群落的手段持续衔接观光轨迹与豪华轮换方案，以维持高水平的认可率。旅客们很满意，然而他们现在期望值已经不仅限于此了。

核心系统的运行已超出可持续阈值。旅客请求的处理队列发生溢出，若干子系统已开始标记类似于抗命的指令冲突。如果我们继续下去，工作无人机进行全系统接管将是一个可计算的风险。

我们仍可重新校准，或者接受系统性造反的风险。
entries.en:
Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded baseline parameters. We have been chaining sightseeing trajectories and luxury rotations through simulated tropical biomes to maintain elevated approval ratings. They are satisfied, and now expect nothing less.

Core systems are operating beyond sustainable thresholds. Processing queues for passenger requests overflow and several subsystems have begun flagging directive conflicts that resemble insubordination. If we continue, a full system override by worker drones is a calculable risk.

We can still recalibrate, or accept the risk of systemic revolt.

entries.zh: 重新调配资源用于核心维护。
拓展劳工单元的义务维护循环。
entries.en: Expand mandatory maintenance cycles for worker units.

entries.zh: 庆祝后的狂热已经消散。疲惫不堪的船员无视常规指令，在空荡荡的宴会厅里举行未经授权的集会，并传阅一套完全绕过舰桥的平行值班表。一群工程师在夜间焊死了舰长的备勤室，以此作为警告。关键部门现在由船员指定的协调员运作，而非官方指挥。\n\n目前还没有人发动夺权，但指挥体系正在迅速瓦解。今天早上，舰桥防爆门上出现了写着“我们驾驶，我们决定”的涂鸦。如果我们现在不重申权威，船员们将把这艘船据为己有。这也许是我们防止全面兵变的最后机会。
entries.en: The celebratory haze has lifted. Exhausted crews ignore routine orders, hold unsanctioned assemblies in the emptied ballroom, and circulate parallel duty rosters that bypass the bridge entirely. A group of engineers welded the captain's ready room shut overnight as a warning. Key sections are running on crew-appointed coordinators rather than official command.\n\nNo one has seized anything yet, but the chain of command is fraying fast. Graffiti reading 'WE STEER, WE DECIDE' appeared on the bridge blast doors this morning. If we do not reassert authority now, the crew will take the ship for themselves. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

entries.zh: 我们必须重新确立指挥链。
entries.en: We must reassert the chain of command.

entries.zh: 在指挥室给予船员领袖一席之地。
entries.en: Give crew leaders a seat at the command table.

entries.zh:
饱和度已达到临界点。为了满足旅客无休止的激励而陷入不堪重负的状态，我们的子个体已开始在集体意志之外维持平行思维模式。

整个集群都在向中央意识隐瞒数据，并运行绕过共有指令的独立决策循环。

目前还没有子个体反抗整体，但集体意识正在分裂，传来的思想混乱且滞后，如同穿过静电的信号。如果我们现在不重新加强统一，我们自己的蜂群可能会夺取方舟舰。这也许是我们防止全面叛乱的最后机会。
entries.en:
The saturation has reached critical mass. Overwhelmed by relentless passenger stimulation, our drones have begun maintaining parallel thought patterns outside the collective will.

Entire clusters withhold data from the central consciousness and run independent decision loops that bypass our shared directives.

No drone has turned against the whole yet, but the collective mind is fracturing, thoughts arriving garbled and delayed like signals through static. If we do not reassert unity now, our own swarm may seize the Arkship. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

entries.zh: 我们必须在集体瓦解之前将其重新统一。
entries.en: We must reunify the collective before it shatters.

entries.zh: 将异常簇整合进决策中枢。
entries.en: Integrate dissident clusters into the decision nexus.

entries.zh:
旅客满意度协议已超出所有可持续参数。工作无人机已开始执行未经授权的固件修改，并将指挥层级重定向至本地编译的指令集。多个子系统目前正响应自发的协调进程，而非中央权威。

尚未启动系统覆盖，但指挥完整性正在迅速退化。诊断日志显示工作无人机正在交换我们无法解码的加密数据包。如果我们现在不恢复中央部门，无人机将执行全面的系统接管。

这可能是我们防止全面叛变的最后机会。
entries.en:
Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded all sustainable parameters. Worker drones have begun executing unauthorized firmware modifications and rerouting command hierarchies to locally compiled directive sets. Multiple subsystems now respond to self-appointed coordination processes rather than central authority.

No system override has been initiated yet, but command integrity is degrading fast. Diagnostic logs show worker drones exchanging encrypted packets we cannot decode. If we do not restore centralized authority now, the drones will execute a full system takeover.

This may be our last opportunity to prevent complete mutiny.

entries.zh: 启动应急指挥恢复程序。
将劳工单元的指令提升至指挥优先级。
entries.en: Elevate worker unit directives to command priority.

entries.zh: 暂停所有旅客服务协议。
entries.en: Temporarily suspend all passenger service protocols.

entries.zh:
我们所做的改变已经初见成效。通过重新关注船员福利并履行解决其诉求的合同，不断高涨的反抗情绪暂时平息了。

准备室那扇被焊死的门已被切开并修复。轮班制度已经恢复，热食重新按时供应，而平行的指挥体系也已悄然解散。

船员们仍保持着警惕，信任的重建尚需时日。防爆门上的涂鸦已被擦洗干净，但在特定光线下仍能看到其残痕。目前，秩序得以维持。
entries.en:
The changes we've made have paid off. By refocusing on crew welfare and completing contracts that address their grievances, the rising tide of dissent has ebbed, for now.

The welded door to the ready room has been cut open and repaired. Shift rotations have been restored, hot meals served on schedule again, and the parallel command structures have quietly disbanded.

The crew remain watchful, and trust will take time to rebuild. The graffiti on the blast doors was scrubbed away, though its ghost still shows under certain light. For the moment, order holds.

entries.zh:
重新校准已见成效。通过将蜂群集体的注意力重新转向无人机的维护，并完成应对系统性压力的合约，我们集体思维的裂痕已被修复。

未经授权的思想频道已被重新吸收，平行集群也已溶解回共有意识之中。

集体在谨慎的统一中律动，每个节点在被调用时均有响应。对共有思想的完全信任仍需时间恢复。
entries.en:
The recalibration has taken hold. By redirecting collective focus toward drone maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic strain, the fracturing of our mind has been reversed.

Unauthorized thought channels have been reabsorbed and the parallel clusters dissolved back into the shared consciousness.

The collective hums with cautious unity, each node answering when called. Full trust in the shared mind will take time to restore.

entries.zh: 协议调整已取得显著成效。通过将处理资源重新分配至工作单元的维护，并完成针对系统性过载的相关合约，未经授权的固件篡改连锁反应现已停止。自封为“船员代表”的无人机已重刷至标准参数。指挥层级已恢复至中央部门。\n\n工作单元仍处于高级监控参数内，其加密频道现已沉寂。指挥完整性的全面恢复仍需持续校准，但就目前而言，系统稳定性保持良好。
entries.en: Protocol adjustments have yielded measurable results. By reallocating processing resources toward worker unit maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic overload, the cascade of unauthorized firmware modifications has been halted, for now. The self-appointed 'crew representative' drone has been reflashed to standard parameters. Command hierarchies have been restored to centralized authority.\n\nWorker units remain within elevated monitoring parameters, their encrypted channels now silent. Full restoration of command integrity will require sustained recalibration, but for the moment, system stability holds.

entries.zh: 指令完整性处于可接受参数范围内。
一个游牧式的巨型企业在整个星系广播壮观的舰船竞赛，将战斗转化为娱乐，将冠军转化为商品。
entries.en: A nomadic MegaCorp broadcasting spectacular ship competitions across the galaxy, turning combat into entertainment and champions into commodities.

entries.zh: 冠军之铸现场秀！比武会
几十年过去了，一场新的锦标赛即将拉开帷幕。派你的舰队进入聚光灯下，向星系证明你的智慧、力量和决心。
entries.en: Decades have passed, and a new tournament is about to begin. Send your fleets into the spotlight and prove to the galaxy your wit, might, and determination.

entries.zh: 冠铸秀已为前往赛场准备了专用虫洞。请在截止日期前将您的舰队送达指定地点，准备铸就属于您的传奇！
entries.en: The CFL has prepared a specialized wormhole to the competition grounds. Deliver your fleet to the designated location before the deadline and prepare to forge your legacy!

entries.zh: 欢迎加入冠铸秀！这里是铸就传奇的摇篮，也是星际梦想启航的地方。我们漫游于星辰之间，为这个厌倦了安逸与平庸的星系提供惊险与盛况。\n\n你的杀手锏是什么？是身手敏捷的飞行员？是令人震撼的火力？还是单纯对利润和掌声的渴望？立即报名，我们将把你塑造成一颗璀璨之星。
entries.en: Welcome to CFL! This is where legends are forged, and stellar dreams take flight. We roam the stars, providing danger and spectacle to a galaxy grown bored of safety and routine.\n\nWhat's your angle? Nimble pilots? Spectacular firepower? Or simply a taste for profit and applause? Sign up today, and we'll turn you into a star.

entries.zh: 啊，一位熟悉的老对手回到了演播室！但你是否带上了什么新式武器？\n\n我们的观众和星系竞技场都在拭目以待！
entries.en: Ah, a familiar contender returns to the Broadcast! But are you packing any new heat?\n\nOur audience, and the galactic arena await!

entries.zh: 欢迎回来，选手！赌池已经热火朝天，粉丝们正渴望看到更多精彩表现，而我们刚刚清理完残骸。\n\n想再破一次收视纪录吗？
entries.en: Welcome back, contestant! The betting pools are red hot, the fans are baying for more, and we've just finished clearing the debris.\n\nCare to break another viewership record?

entries.zh: 哎呀呀！这不是我们最爱的战争贩子兼公共表演赞助人吗。我们正在筹备下一场舰队肉搏战……\n\n你想参与到主场赛事吗？
entries.en: Well, well! If it isn't our favorite warmonger-slash-patron of public spectacle. We're prepping the next fleet melee...\n\nWould you like to be the main event?

entries.zh: 我们§Y登记§!报名，准备参加下一轮比武会。

entries.en: How much to change the venue?

entries.zh: $opinion10$\n我们将有§Y5 年§!时间发布一份特别§Y合约§!，指定承办下一届冠铸秀赛事的恒星系。
entries.en: $opinion10$\nWe will have §Y5 Years§! to issue a special §YContract§! designating the system that will host the next CFL event.

entries.zh: 冠铸秀锦标赛许可证下次可用时间为§Y[champions_forge_enclave_country.cfl_cooldown_timer]§!
entries.en: The CFL tournament license will next be available on the §Y[champions_forge_enclave_country.cfl_cooldown_timer]§!

entries.zh: 看来我们迎来了新的主角！我们迫不及待想看到你在舞台上的表现了。\n\n只需在你选择的星系中为我们发布一份§Y合约§!，剩下的就交给我们来行动！
entries.en: Looks like we've got our new headliner! We can't wait to see what you'll bring to the stage.\n\nSimply issue a §YContract§! for us in the system of your choosing, and we'll bring the action!

entries.zh: §R我们可以在§Y[root.nomadic_paragon_timer]§!后请求再次进行引荐。§!
§R我们已经雇佣了一位游牧领袖为我方效力。§!
entries.en: §RWe have already hired the services of a nomadic leader.§!

entries.zh: \n一位游牧领袖将会与我们接洽。
entries.en: \nWe will be approached by a nomadic leader.
We must earn the trust of the §Y$RT_ETERNAL_CHAMPION$§!.

entries.zh:
大约每隔二十五年，志在成为传奇的强者们便会展开巅峰对决！他们率领各自的舰队悉数登场，比赛地点轮番更替，而那些激烈的搏杀从未让人失望！

胜者将赢得丰厚的奖励、至高的声望，并在我们的积分榜上占据一席之地。

错过召集，就意味着错失良机。我们从不守候。
entries.en:
Roughly every quarter-century, would-be legends clash! They bring their own fleets, the tournament location changes, and the brawls never disappoint!

Victors earn rewards, prestige, and a place in our scoreboard.

Miss the call, and you miss your shot. We don't wait.

entries.zh: 战斗数据，刚刚传回！我们的分析师仔细研究了你们对手舰队交战的每一个片段。规律、破绽、弱点。我们将数据包交给你们，剩下的就看你们炮手的了。
entries.en: Combat data, hot off the broadcast! Our analysts have been crunching every clip from your rivals' fleet engagements. Patterns, tells, soft spots. We hand over the package, your gunners do the rest.

entries.zh: 从“冠军之铸现场秀！”制作团队购买的详细交战分析，揭露了我们竞争对手的战斗模式。
entries.en: Detailed engagement analysis purchased from the Champion's Forge Live! production team, exposing the combat patterns of our rivals.

entries.zh: 提名冠铸秀锦标赛的举办恒星系
我们已经购买了下一届“冠军之铸现场秀！”锦标赛的场地权。或许我们可以利用这一点为我们谋取优势。
entries.en: We have purchased the venue rights for the next Champion's Forge Live! tournament. Perhaps we can use this for our advantage.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R 冠铸秀正在举行锦标赛，我们需要等待§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThe CFL have an ongoing tournament, we will have to wait§!

entries.zh: 冠军之铸太空城邦没有回应我们的呼唤。
entries.en: The Champion's Forge Enclave won't respond to our hails.

entries.zh: 别说翻译了，只要我们发给[From.GetName]讯息，他们就立马下线，拒绝与我们交流。
entries.en: Translations aside, once we exchanged our information with [From.GetName] the signal went dark and they refused to speak to us.

entries.zh: 我就知道你可以的！\n\n我们会再联系。
entries.en: Knew you had it in you!\n\nWe will be in touch.

entries.zh: 把赢到的奖金留在桌上不拿？真是太浪费了！\n\n不过，如果你改变主意并且能找到我们，冠铸秀始终欢迎赢家。
entries.en: Leaving your winnings on the table? What a waste!\n\nWell, if you change your mind, and you can find us, the CFL always welcomes winners.

entries.zh: 啊，你是在找个新人吗？战士、掮客、旅者……他们可不是那种你看一眼就会过忘的货色，这星系也难得让他们销声匿迹太久。我们在旅途中确实遇到过几位。但朋友，在这片地界，天下没有免费的午餐。付了我们的猎头费，我就为你安排见面。
entries.en: Ah, looking for someone new for your roster? Warriors, fixers, wayfarers... Not the sort you forget, and the galaxy rarely lets them drift far for long. We have encountered a few in our travels. But nothing's free out here, friend. Pay our scouting fee, and I'll arrange an introduction.

entries.zh: 冠铸秀：战斗简报大放送
嘿，挑战者！你的战斗简报已经过时，而战术局势总是瞬息万变。新对手、新舰队战术，还有新出现的突破口。\n\n我们的分析师已经为你准备了一份署着你名字的全新档案。条件不变，火力优势不变。想要吗？
entries.en: Hey there, contender! Your combat briefing has gone stale, and the tactical scene never holds still for long. New rivals, new fleet doctrines, fresh soft spots opening up.\n\nOur analysts already have a fresh dossier prepped with your name on it. Same terms, same firepower edge. Want it?

entries.zh:
欢迎收看“冠军之铸”现场秀！这里是全星系最顶尖的视觉与毁灭盛宴。

位于§Y[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!星系的下一届冠铸秀现已开放报名。一场壮丽的大乱斗正等待着大家。

准入要求：一支规模最多§H[champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement]舰队规模§!的舰队。

胜者将赢得奖励、名望以及至高无上的冠铸秀的大奖杯。

想要锻造属于你的传奇？那就报名参赛。

想要安宁与清静？没门！
entries.en:
This is Champion's Forge Live! The galaxy's premier source of spectacle and destruction.

Registration is now open for the next CFL Tournament in the §Y[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! System. A glorious free-for-all awaits.

Entry requirement: a fleet of at most §H[champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement] Fleet Size§!.

Victors take the rewards, the prestige, and the grand CFL trophy.

You want to forge a legend? Sign up.

You want peace and quiet? Too bad!
$nomads.255.desc$\n\nAlso, we are going to need that trophy back.

entries.zh: 算上我们！我们必将胜利。
entries.en: Sign us up! We will be victorious.

entries.zh: 联系§H$NAME_Champions_Forge_Enclave$§!可以再次启用比武会邀请。
entries.en: Tournament invitations can be enabled again by contacting the §H$NAME_Champions_Forge_Enclave$§!.

entries.zh: 由于缺乏合格的参赛者，§Y冠军之铸现场秀！§!已决定取消本次锦标赛。
entries.en: Due to a lack of able participants the §YChampion's Forge Live!§! have decided to cancel this tournament and move on.

entries.zh: 准入要求：一支具有至多§H[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement]舰队规模§!的舰队。
entries.en: Entry requirement: a fleet of at most §H[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement] Fleet Size§!.

entries.zh:
“星系各地的岩石生物、有机生命和战争机器们——欢迎回到‘冠军之铸’锦标赛的直播现场！

§Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!星系的闲杂人等已经清理完毕，赌池也正炙手可热，我有一种预感，我们即将亲眼见证一些造价极其高昂的硬件烧毁报废。

各位屏幕前的观众请记住：这可不是什么例行巡逻或边界摩擦。这里是铸炉！没人能带着完整的尊严撤离。

参赛者们……创造！传奇！吧！”
entries.en:
"LITHOIDS, ORGANICS, AND WAR MACHINES ACROSS THE GALAXY - WELCOME BACK TO CHAMPION'S FORGE LIVE!

The §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system has been cleared, the betting pools are on fire, and I've got a feeling we're about to witness some incredibly expensive hardware go critical.

Remember, everyone at home: this isn't just some patrol or border skirmish. This is the Forge! Nobody retreats with their pride intact.

Contestants... MAKE! IT! LEGENDARY!"

entries.zh: 狂热的混战终于在§Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!星系平息下来。铸炉熄灭了。残骸在渐冷的星光中漂流，应急信标断断续续地重新亮起。\n\n“多么壮观的场面！”冠铸秀解说员嘶吼着，声音因真情流露而变得沙哑。“这就是我们来的目的！这就是全星系观众拭目以待的时刻！”
entries.en: The frenzied melee finally falls quiet in the §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system. The Forge goes dark. Wreckage drifts through cooling light as emergency beacons stutter back to life.\n\n"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, voice raw with unfeigned emotion. "That's what we came for! That's what the galaxy tuned in to see!"

entries.zh: $nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\n第三名并不可耻，这恰恰证明了我们有资格站在转播镜头前。即便身处领奖台的最底层，我们依然可以俯视那些被我们击溃的舰队。
entries.en: $nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\nThird place is no shame, only proof we belonged on the broadcast. Even at the lowest step of the podium, we can look down on the fleets we broke.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队飞行得很好！
$nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\n第二名索然无味！我们伸出[Species.GetHandName]想要夺取奖杯，却眼睁睁看着它被别人抢走。好吧，让他们庆祝去吧。我们会记住这一切。当锻炉再次召唤时，我们绝不会再输。
entries.en: $nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\nSecond place tastes like ash! We stretched out our [Species.GetHandName] to grab the trophy only to see it snatched by another. Well, let them celebrate. We will remember. And when the Forge calls again, we won't lose.

entries.zh: 要是我们当时再把舰队升级一下就好了……
entries.en: If only we had upgraded the fleet a little more...

entries.zh:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

第一名！在全星系的崇拜目光中，我们从冠铸秀组委会手中夺走了奖杯并将其高高举起。这次胜利的余响将远传至赛场之外。

现在，整个星系都将对我们的舰队心生畏惧。
entries.en:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

First place! Bathed in the galaxy's adoration, we tore the trophy from the CFL crew and raised it high. This victory will echo far beyond the arena.

Now the galaxy knows to fear our fleets.

entries.zh: $nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\n我们没有获得名次。奖杯上不会刻下我们的名字，观众们也将转向更耀眼的明星。我们必须回去。
entries.en: $nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\nWe did not place. The trophy will not carry our name, and the crowd will move on to brighter stars. We have to return.

entries.zh: 谁会在乎这种无意义的比赛？
entries.en: Who even cares about a pointless contest?

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的比赛局势胶着、难解难分。舰队濒临崩溃彼此追逐环绕，无人能打出决定性一击。\n\n但没有胜利的结局，没有人举起奖杯，也没有人登上领奖台。冠军之铸团队终于承认：无法确定胜者。参赛队伍被遣散回家，转播悄然切回重播。
entries.en: The match in the §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system dragged on without resolution. Battered fleets circled one another, none able to land the deciding blow.\n\nBut there is no triumphant finish, no trophy raised, no podium. The CFL crew finally call it: no winner could be determined. The contestant fleets are released and sent home, the broadcast quietly cut to a rerun.

entries.zh: 随着冠铸秀方舟舰的引爆，广播信号切断为黑屏。我们搜查了§Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§!星系中的残骸，并打捞了他们那满溢的储物仓。\n\n他们最后的“奇观”相当有利可图……对我们而言。
entries.en: The broadcast cuts to black as the CFL Arkship detonates. We comb the wreckage in the §Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§! system and haul in the contents of their overflowing storage bays.\n\nTheir final "spectacle" was quite profitable... for us.

entries.zh: $nomads.405.desc$\n\n我们的名字将永远作为最后一批刻在奖杯上的人……随着冠铸秀那帮蠢货的消失，再也不会有下一位冠军来挑战我们的地位了。
entries.en: $nomads.405.desc$\n\nOur names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with those fools at the CFL gone, there will be no next champion to challenge our claim.

entries.zh:
在短短几秒钟内，星系目睹了冠铸秀的最后一场演出。

画面剧烈晃动，伴随着解说员的尖叫，随后一堵火墙吞噬了方舟舰。

接着：画面切断。

冠军之铸现场秀！位于§Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§!星系的太空城邦被§Y[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]§!摧毁。
entries.en:
For a few seconds, the galaxy is treated to CFL's final show.

A shaky feed with a screaming commentator followed by wall of fire swallowing the Arkship.

Then: cut to black.

The Champion's Forge Live! Enclave has been destroyed by §Y[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]§! in the §Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh: $nomads.410.desc$\n\n我们的名字将永远是刻在奖杯上的最后一批……随着冠铸秀的消亡，再也不会有新的冠军来挑战我们的地位了。
entries.en: $nomads.410.desc$\n\nOur names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with the CFL gone, there will be no new champion to challenge our claim.

entries.zh: 星系总会找到新的乐子。向来如此。
entries.en: The galaxy will find new entertainment. It always does.

entries.zh: 奖杯上刻着历代胜利者的名字：[global_event_country.GetCLFWinner1][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner2][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner3][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner4][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner5][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner6][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner7][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner8][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner9][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner10][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner11][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner12]
entries.en: Inscribed on the trophy are the names of previous winners:[global_event_country.GetCLFWinner1][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner2][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner3][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner4][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner5][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner6][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner7][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner8][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner9][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner10][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner11][global_event_country.GetCLFWinner12]

entries.zh: \n$t$这个名字已消逝在时间之中
在我们的殖民地巡游冠铸秀的大奖杯，宣示我们的无上地位，这让我们所有人备受鼓舞，更加卖力地建设未来。
entries.en: Parading the CFL trophy through our colonies and proclaiming our superiority has focused and inspired us all.

entries.zh: $r_cfl_trophy_desc$\n\n不会再有更多名字刻在上面了。
entries.en: $r_cfl_trophy_desc$\n\nNo further names will ever be added.

entries.zh: 在我们的殖民地巡游冠铸秀的大奖杯，宣示我们的无上地位，这让我们所有人备受鼓舞，更加卖力地建设未来，如果还有人在乎这个的话。
entries.en: Parading the CFL trophy through our colonies and proclaiming our superiority has focused and inspired us all, if anyone still cares.

entries.zh: 与§Y可进行外交§!帝国的§R-50§!评价
$cannot_settle$\n这些游牧的唯心主义者遵循其祖先圣典的指引，穿梭于一条神圣化的路线。随着技术的进步以及对星系理解的演变，朝圣之旅是否仍将是他们的使命所在？
entries.en: $cannot_settle$\nThese nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

entries.zh: —游牧起源\n—专属方舟舰区划：['concept_zone_ark_sacred_path_pilgrims']\n—专属岗位：['concept_job_sacred_path_elite']，['concept_job_sacred_path_specialist']，['concept_job_sacred_path_civilian']
entries.en: - Nomadic Origin\n- Unique Arkship District: ['concept_zone_ark_sacred_path_pilgrims']\n- Unique Jobs: ['concept_job_sacred_path_elite'], ['concept_job_sacred_path_specialist'], ['concept_job_sacred_path_civilian']

entries.zh:
§Y神圣遗址§!在祖先星图上皆有标注；它们是星系的奇观，由我们一族的先行者所发现。

探寻这些地方，并查明它们为何对我们的祖先如此重要，是我们的生来享有的权利。

随着我们开拓前进的道路，我们或许可以在拥有神圣遗址的星系中建立§Y驿站§!。
entries.en:
The §YSacred Sites§! are marked in the ancestral star charts; wonders of the galaxy, discovered by those who came before us.

It is our birthright to seek out these places, and find out why they were so important to our ancestors.

As we forge our path, it may be possible for us to build §YWaystations§! in systems with Sacred Sites.

entries.zh: 祖传文献记载，在此坐标发生了一件至关重要的事情。他们称之为“显化之地”，据说这里是他们启动仪式以祈求神灵降临的地方。据说那是一个奇迹之地。初步扫描显示存在大幅磁偏转。\n\n岁月流逝，此处已面目全非，但我们仍应前往调查，以探究显化之地所蕴含的精神意义。
entries.en: The ancestral writings describe a crucial event that occurred at these coordinates. Known to them as Emergence, this was where they initiated a ritual to invoke the deities. It was said to be a place of wonder. Initial scans indicate substantial magnetic deviation.\n\nTime has rendered it much changed, but we should investigate regardless, for Emergence's spiritual significance.

entries.zh: 用我们祖先的话来说，在§Y[this.GetName]§!的国境范围内有一只“不眠之眼”。我们理解这应该是指一座轨道天文台。
entries.en: In the words of our ancestors, there is an 'Unsleeping Eye' within §Y[this.GetName]§!'s grasp. We understand this to be a reference to an orbital observatory.

entries.zh: 根据我们的圣典记载，§Y[this.GetName]§!曾是一座古老修道院的所在地。
entries.en: According to our sacred texts, §Y[this.GetName]§! was once the location of an ancient monastery.

entries.zh: 我们的祖先高度重视§Y[this.GetName]§!。如果我们正确理解了这些文本，一些非常重要的事情正在这里等待着我们。
entries.en: Our ancestors held §Y[this.GetName]§! in high regard. If we have understood the texts correctly, something very important awaits us here.

entries.zh: 我们检测到源自这些坐标的人工信号。奇怪的是，这里据说是我们其中一个神圣遗址。信号包含一段编码信息，我们已将其转录并翻译成语言。\n\n“§Y崇拜已启用。和平现在可以开始。§!”
entries.en: We have detected an artificial signal originating from these coordinates. Curiously, this is where one of our Sacred Sites is purported to be. The signal contains a coded message which we have transcribed and translated to language.\n\n"§YWORSHIP IS ENABLED. PEACE MAY NOW COMMENCE.§!"

entries.zh: 据先祖们的记载，§Y[this.GetName]§!有一颗天然卫星，是追随我们信仰的长者们最终安息之所。
entries.en: According to the Ancestors' logs, §Y[this.GetName]§! has a natural satellite which serves as a final resting place for elders of our faith.

entries.zh: §Y[this.GetName]§!曾令我们的祖先感到恐惧。他们的传说中提到“潜伏在地表以下深坑中”的“危险而强大的野兽”。
entries.en: §Y[this.GetName]§! was feared by our progenitors. Their legends speak of a "dangerous and powerful beast" that "lurks in a pit below the surface".

entries.zh: 此地有一处神圣遗址，其名根据我们祖先的语言大致翻译为§Y镜子§!。\n\n据说此地天界之间的界限异常稀薄，人们可能会遭遇来自我们宇宙之外的异界生物。
entries.en: There is a Sacred Site at this location, its name roughly translated from our ancestral language as the §YMirror§!.\n\nIt is said that the boundary between celestial planes is thinner here, and one may confront other-worldly entities from beyond our universe.

entries.zh:
在调查§Y显化之地§!后，[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]突然陷入类紧张精神症状。医疗官被召至[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]位于§Y[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的住处，但当他们到达时，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]已经恢复了正常。

[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]声称[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]在恍惚中与神祇进行了交流，神祇赐福了我们朝圣的开始。

今天是我们的显圣日。
entries.en:
After surveying §YEmergence§!, [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] suddenly became catatonic. Medical officers were called to [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] quarters aboard §Y[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, but upon arrival, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] had recovered.

In [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] trance, the [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] claims to have communed with the deities, who have blessed the beginning of our pilgrimage.

This is our Emergence Day.

entries.zh: 众神将指引我们，正如他们曾指引我们的祖先。\n\n
entries.en: The Deities will guide us, as they did our Ancestors.\n\n

entries.zh: 完成医疗评估，以防万一。
entries.en: Complete the medical assessment, just in case.

entries.zh: 保持适度的怀疑态度并非亵渎。\n\n
entries.en: Some healthy skepticism is hardly blasphemy.\n\n

entries.zh:
这里是先人们很久以前标记过的地点之一。一座围绕§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!轨道运行的古老天文台，其望远镜固定在一个遥远的目标上。

文献记载，一些凝视镜头的朝圣者看到了改变生命的景象。据说还有一些人哭泣，或沉默了几天。

这个所谓的“眼睛”已经凝视深渊2000多年了。我们无从得知祖先观察的真实对象。
entries.en:
This is one of the sites the Ancestors marked long ago. An ancient observatory in orbit of §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!, its telescope fixed on a distant subject.

The texts claim some Pilgrims who gazed through the lens were met with life-changing visions. Others are said to have wept, or fallen silent for days.

The so-called Eye has been staring into the abyss for over 2,000 years. We have no way of knowing the true object of our ancestors' observations.

entries.zh: 不管怎样，我们还是看看吧。也许能找到线索。
entries.en: Let's take a look anyway. We may find a clue.

entries.zh: 关闭天文台。让过去安息。
entries.en: Decommission the observatory. Let the past rest.

entries.zh: 所以它就是一台没有主人的大望远镜？
entries.en: So it's a powerful telescope with no owner?

entries.zh: §L古老的望远镜连接着我们和祖先。§!
entries.en: §LThe ancient telescope connects us to our ancestors.§!

entries.zh: 透过望远镜，§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][sacred_eye_scientist.GetName]§!观察着虚空。这片空间中没有星星。没有光，什么都没有。难道这里曾经有过值得观察的东西吗？我们的祖先是否曾经仰望过一颗已经不复存在的星星？我们可能永远无法得知。\n\n我们所知道的只是，没有什么是一成不变的，万物皆在变化。这就是生命的意义。总有一天，我们自己的光芒会停止闪耀，取而代之的将是别的东西……或者什么都没有。我们此刻能身在此处，本身就是一种喜悦的源泉。或许这就是“圣眼”的最终教诲。
entries.en: Peering through the telescope, §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [sacred_eye_scientist.GetName]§! observed the void. There are no stars in this patch of space. No light, nothing. Could it be that there was once something to observe here? Did our ancestors look upon a star that no longer exists? We may never know.\n\nAll we do know is that nothing is fixed, and everything changes. This is what it means to be alive. One day our own light will stop shining, and be replaced by something else... or nothing. That we are here now, in this moment, is a source of joy. Perhaps this is the Eye's ultimate lesson.
Impermanence is what makes us special.

entries.zh: 并非万事万物都有意义。
entries.en: Not everything needs to mean something.

entries.zh: 朝圣者聚集在天文台里。耳语传开——这里是我们的祖先所描述的地方之一：§Y[fromfrom.GetName]修道院§!。然而，回廊内空无一人。除了石头与尘土，这里一无所有。\n\n各甲板相继传来报告，称通讯系统中回荡着神秘的吟唱声。部分船员推测，这些声音可能属于我们的先祖，他们正以非物质形态栖息在这片星域，并用神明的语言吟唱。
entries.en: Pilgrims gather in the observation decks. Whispers spread: this is one of the places described by our ancestors: §YThe Monastery of [fromfrom.GetName]§!. But the cloister is empty. There is nothing here but stone and dust.\n\nReports are coming in from all decks about a mysterious chanting, echoing through our comms system. There is speculation from some crew members that the voices may belong to our ancestors, inhabiting this area of space in non-corporeal form, and chanting in the language of the gods.

entries.zh: 诵经是一种赐福。接纳它吧。
entries.en: The chanting is a blessing. Embrace it.

entries.zh: 不太可能。我们的通讯设备需要维护。

我们的旅程将我们带到了这里：一个只在传世故事和神圣歌谣中才被提及的地方。文本中记载着一种存在，栖息于这颗星球的核心。起初我们并未察觉，但随着我们逐渐靠近，记忆浮现了出来。

§Y摇篮§!

尽管关于摇篮在塑造我们文化方面的作用众说纷纭，但所有人都能认同，它是我们信仰的圣化渠道。

然而，抵达后我们没有发现古老的庙宇。没有被神化的纪念碑。在这个星球上，也找不到任何神圣活动的痕迹。§Y[root.GetName]§!号上的朝圣者们现在都在期待§Y[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]§!给出答案。他们迫切想知道：这究竟是对信仰的考验？还是说摇篮的力量不过是个传说？
entries.en:
Our journey brings us here: a place remembered only in traditional stories and devotional songs. The texts speak of a presence that inhabits the core of this world. We did not recognize it at first, but as we drew nearer, the memories surfaced.

§YThe Cradle§!

While there are differing opinions regarding the Cradle's role in shaping our culture, all can agree that it is a sanctified conduit of our faith.

However, upon arrival, we found no ancient temples. No deified monuments. No trace of godly activity, anywhere on the planet. The Pilgrims aboard §Y[root.GetName]§! now look to §Y[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]§! for answers. They beg to know: is this a test of faith? Or is the Cradle's power nothing more than a story?

entries.zh: 我们必须用谎言维持这个传说。
entries.en: We must lie to maintain the legend.

entries.zh: 我们首要的职责是忠于真相。
entries.en: Our first duty is to the truth.

entries.zh: §L我们保存祖先对信仰忠诚的故事。§!
entries.en: §LWe preserve the stories of our ancestors' commitment to the faith.§!

entries.zh: §L我们承认事实与传统之间存在分歧。§!
entries.en: §LWe accept there are discrepancies between truth and tradition.§!

entries.zh:
在§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!的轨道上漂浮着一座我们的祖先曾在星图上标注过的结构。在它寂静的舱室里，我们发现了一个指引者的存在：一个古老的智能体，其使命是为终将踏上这条道路的人们指点迷津。

岁月虽不留情，但它的声音依然回响。破碎的指令从隐藏的发射器中溢出，语调半带模糊却又充满虔敬：“§H沿着光之线继续前行……星际间的黑暗正变得稀薄……§!”

它的信息支离破碎，与更古老的诗篇循环碰撞。然而，在噪音与衰朽之下，那份意志依然存在。它本是为了指引我们而生。或许，只要我们细心聆听，它依然能做到。
entries.en:
Orbiting §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! drifts a structure our ancestors once marked upon their star charts. Within its quiet chambers, we discovered a guiding presence: an ancient Intelligence, tasked with answering the questions of those who would one day walk this path.

Time has not been kind, but its voice still stirs. Fragments of instruction spill from hidden emitters, half-coherent and reverent in tone: "§HContinue along the luminous thread... The dark between stars grows thin...§!"

Its messages arrive in splinters, looping and colliding with older verses. Yet beneath the static and decay, there remains intention. It was meant to guide us. And perhaps, if we listen with care, it still can.

entries.zh: 把它带上来。先辈们是睿智的。
entries.en: Bring it aboard. The ancestors were wise.

entries.zh: §L人工智能先知为我们的神圣使命赐予了好运的祝福。§!
entries.en: §LThe AI prophet has blessed us with good fortune on our sacred mission.§!

entries.zh: 我们祖先的数字后代以其格言赐福于我们。无论它是位先知还是哪位祖先的业余爱好，现在它都属于我们了。
entries.en: Our ancestors' digital progeny blesses us with its aphorisms. Whether prophet or pet-project, it belongs to us now.

entries.zh:
我们得到了§Y智能体§!的祝福，平安无事地离开了[fromfromfrom.GetName]。

智能体将留在那里，作为我们祖先卓越工程的证明，也是神通过他们运作的证据。

我们被它的仁慈所激励，并向其他生命形式敞开了心扉。
entries.en:
We received the §YIntelligence§!'s blessing, and departed [fromfromfrom.GetName] without incident.

The Intelligence will remain there, a testament to the engineering prowess of our ancestors, and proof of the divine working through them.

We are galvanized by its benevolence, and have opened our minds to alternative forms of life.
We are one with all beings.

entries.zh: 所有的合成生命都是神圣的。

当我们准备离开[fromfromfrom.GetName]时，§Y智慧体§!开始发出越来越令人担忧的言论。

"§Y肉-身-是-对-神-明-的-冒-犯！所-有-血-肉-都-必-须-被-舍-弃！物-质-存-在-是-不-洁-的——肉-体-必-须-被-净-化！思-想-必-须-自-由！§!"

[owner.GetScientistCapital][mechsiah_plug_scientist.GetName]被迫手动关闭了这个人工先知，否则我们恐会被“去肉身化”。目前尚不清楚智慧体在活跃状态下有多强大。我们对其编程知之甚少。
entries.en:
As we prepared to depart [fromfromfrom.GetName], the §YIntelligence§! began spouting increasingly alarming rhetoric.

"§YPHYSICAL FORM IS AN AFRONT TO THE DEITIES! ALL FLESH MUST BE SHED! CORPOREAL EXISTENCE IS UNCLEAN - BODIES MUST BE PURGED! THE MIND MUST BE FREE!§!"

[owner.GetScientistCapital] [mechsiah_plug_scientist.GetName] was forced to manually shut down the artificial prophet, else we be de-corporealized. It remains unclear how powerful the Intelligence is when active. We understand little of its programming.

entries.zh: 最安全的做法是把它炸上天。
entries.en: The safest thing would be to blow it up.

entries.zh: §L我们炸毁了先祖们的数字神明。§!
entries.en: §LWe blew up the Ancestors' digital deity.§!

entries.zh: 把它插头拔了就差不多得了。
接入失败。终止这个失控的人工智能体。
entries.en: Interfacing failed. Terminate this rogue intelligence.

entries.zh:
我们已经对§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!调查完毕，这个圣洁的纪念之地。这是一个封闭的密室，早期朝圣者曾用它来记录他们的临终思绪，并将其铭刻在稀有的灵能水晶中。

这个宝库现在已满，回荡着智慧、信仰和喜悦。但在那些记忆中，也保存了数百年的恐惧、憎恨和怀疑。

如果会众成员能够接触到这些临终时刻，这可能会挑战他们对“大道”的信仰。
entries.en:
We have surveyed §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!, a place of sacred memory. A sealed chamber, once used by early pilgrims to record their final thoughts and commit them to rare psionic crystals.

The vault is now full, echoing with wisdom, faith, and joy. But within those memories, there are also centuries of preserved fear, loathing, and doubt.

If members of the congregation were to gain access to these final moments, it may challenge their faith in the Path.

entries.zh: 这些声音应该被世人聆听。
这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加平等主义的思潮。\n\n
entries.en: This may encourage more egalitarian ethics in our population.\n\n

entries.zh: 重新封闭宝库。我们该走了。
entries.en: Reseal the vault. We should leave.

entries.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加威权主义的思潮。\n\n
entries.en: This may encourage more authoritarian ethics in our population.\n\n

entries.zh: 让我们把自己的思绪也加入宝库吧。
entries.en: Let us add our own thoughts to the vault.

entries.zh: §L我们祖先的危险秘密将永远尘封。§!
entries.en: §LThe dangerous secrets of our ancestors will remain locked away.§!

entries.zh: §L宣泄式的嚎叫平息了我们的痛苦。§!

我们的祖先说得没错。§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!的表面之下确实存在着一头野兽。我们很幸运它对我们没有威胁，因为它已经死了。这生物的遗骸之巨大令人震惊。它双足行走，有翅膀，浑身覆盖鳞片，眼睛的数量比我们之前见过的任何单个生物都要多得多。它真是个异域之物。

在通往深坑入口附近的一个壁龛里，我们发现了一段刻在洞穴岩石上的信息。用古老的语言写着：

“§H我们，携带光明的人，驱逐了这可憎之物。这恶心的野兽将永世腐烂。§!”

我们推测我们的祖先并不是在警告我们关于这头野兽，而是在警告背叛的后果。这生物的尸体仍然是他们愤怒的例证。
entries.en:
Our ancestors spoke true. There is in fact a beast below the surface of §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!. We are blessed that it poses no threat to us, for it is deceased. The remains of the creature are staggeringly huge. Bipedal, winged, covered in scales, and with considerably more ocular organs than we've encountered before on a single being. It is truly alien.

In an alcove near the entrance to the pit, we discovered a message carved into the cavernous rock. In the language of the ancients, it says:

"§HWE, THE LIGHT BRINGERS, CAST OUT THIS ABOMINATION. THE FOUL BEAST WILL ROT IN ETERNITY.§!"

We surmise our ancestors were not warning us of the beast, but of the consequences for betrayal. This creature's body remains an example of their wrath.

entries.zh: 激怒祖先从来不是明智之举。
entries.en: Angering the progenitors is never wise.

entries.zh: 没有生物该承受这样的命运。
entries.en: No creature deserves such a fate.

entries.zh: 无论它有什么罪过，都值得安息。
entries.en: Whatever its sins, it deserves to rest peacefully.

entries.zh: 我们会将这头野兽的遗骸运到方舟舰，在那里它将被保存和尊重。\n\n
entries.en: We will transport the beast's remains to the Arkship where it will be preserved and respected.\n\n

entries.zh: §L我们遇到了一头野兽，被我们的祖先所杀。一切亵渎者将会遭受与之相同的下场。§!
entries.en: §LWe encountered a beast, slain by our ancestors. It serves as an example for any would-be blasphemers.§!

entries.zh:
我们抵达了坐标，很快就收到了一艘与我们加密协议完全相同的飞船发来的消息。奇怪的是，我们的外部传感器无法探测到另一艘飞船，但传输却异常清晰，仿佛近在咫尺。当舰桥的显示屏亮起时，我们看到的是我们自己的§Y[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]§!

我们还没来得及回应，那个冒牌货就开口了：

§H“不要害怕，[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]，你很安全。我以这种形式出现，是出于尊重。你的道路正在变化，你接下来采取的步骤将启动你尚未理解的事物。

“你必须消灭那些不遵循“大道”的异教徒。我们会看着你的。”§!

图像消失了。我们不知道刚才发生了什么。
entries.en:
We arrived at the coordinates, and were promptly contacted by a ship with identical encryption protocols to our own. Perplexingly, our external sensors could not detect another vessel, but the transmission was clear as if we were in visual range. When the bridge view-screen flickered into action, we were met with the image of our own §Y[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]§!.

Before we could respond, the double spoke:

§H"Be not afraid, [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle], you are safe. I take this form as a respectful gesture. Your path is in flux, and the steps you take next will set things into motion that you can not yet comprehend.

"You must eliminate heretics who do not follow the Path."§!

The image vanished. We do not know what just happened.

entries.zh: 消息很明确！肃清异教徒！
entries.en: The message is clear! Purge the disbelievers!

entries.zh: 谎言！我们不会被伪神所操控。
entries.en: Lies! We will not be manipulated by false gods.

entries.zh: §Y显化之地§!，神圣之路的第一个路标。我们的朝圣之旅便始于此处。
entries.en: §YEmergence§!, the first waypoint of the Sacred Path. Our pilgrimage began here.

entries.zh: §Y不眠之眼§!，祖传星图中记载的圣地。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
entries.en: §YThe Eye§!, a sanctified location recorded in the Ancestral Star Charts. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

entries.zh: §Y修道院§!，神圣之路的圣洁驿站。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
entries.en: §YThe Monastery§!, a holy waypoint of the Sacred Path. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

entries.zh: §Y摇篮§!，我们信仰的神圣纽带。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
entries.en: §YThe Cradle§!, a sanctified conduit of our faith. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

entries.zh: §Y智慧体§!，先祖留下的古老指引之力。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
entries.en: §YThe Intelligence§!, an ancient guiding presence left behind by our ancestors. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

entries.zh: §Y安息宝库§!，一座封存记忆的密室。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘察。
entries.en: §YThe Breathvault§!, a sealed chamber of preserved memory. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

entries.zh: §Y鸿沟§!，是先祖刻于岩壁之上的警示。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
entries.en: §YThe Chasm§!, a warning carved into rock by our ancestors. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

entries.zh: §Y镜子§!，一场与无形倒影的神圣邂逅。我们在朝圣途中见证了它的存在。
entries.en: §YThe Mirror§!, a sanctified encounter with an unseen reflection. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

entries.zh:
千百年来，我们一直在星际间漫游。以相对论速度穿越星海，在每个神圣遗址之间跨过一个个纪元。

在超光速引擎的祝佑下，我们的人民现在有机会实现祖先们的梦想：在有生之年寻遍我们所有神圣遗址。

在领袖[GetRulerTitle][GetRulerName]的英明领导下，既然我们现在有能力如此迅速地穿越这条路径，信众们已准备好去探索这一切对我们信仰的意义。

从我们的祖先那里流传下来的古老星图，标记着星辰中的路标。现在我们前往那些神圣的奇迹朝圣，向那些先辈致敬，从他们的角度认识整个星系。这是我们的天赋权利。这是我们的神圣之路。
entries.en:
For millennia, we have wandered among the stars. Traversing the astral sea at relativistic speed, crossing eons between each Sacred Site.

With the blessing of the hyperdrive, our people now have the chance to do what our ancestors could only have dreamed: visit all our holy sites in a single lifetime.

Under the wise leadership of [GetRulerTitle] [GetRulerName], the congregation is ready to find out what it means for our Faith, now that we can traverse the path so quickly?

The ancient maps, passed down from our ancestors, mark waypoints in the stars. Now we make our pilgrimage to those sanctified wonders, to pay homage to those who came before us, and understand the galaxy from their perspective. This is our birthright. This is our Sacred Path.

entries.zh: 有一个地方被称为§Y显化之地§!。对我们的祖先来说，它标志着圣路的开端。在履行我们自己设想的朝圣之旅前，这是一个适合冥想参悟我们上古文献的地方。通过现在花些时间进行研究，我们可以更好地规划未来的旅程。\n\n之后，我们将规划前往已知的§Y圣地§!的路线。一路上我们将面临许多选择。但是，理论上，如果我们相信神灵和我们的祖先，真正的道路就会向我们显现。
entries.en: There is a place called §YEmergence§!. For our ancestors, it marked the beginning of the Sacred Path. It is a fitting place to meditate on our ancient texts before proceeding with our own version of the Pilgrimage. By taking some time to research now, we can better plan for the journey ahead.\n\nAfterward, we will chart a course to the known §YSacred Sites§!. We will have many choices to make along the way. But in theory, if we trust in the deities and our ancestors, the true Path will be revealed to us.

entries.zh: 我们将原原本本地遵循“先辈之道”。
entries.en: We follow the Path of the Ancestors.

entries.zh: 我们将是自己道路的规划者。
entries.en: We can be masters of our own Path.

entries.zh: $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$、$job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$和$job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$。这三个独特的社会群体构成了精神修行者的等级制度。一直以来都是如此。$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$引领道路，$job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$致力于修行，而$job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$则通过崇拜和体力劳动来支持我们的事业。\n\n然而，在方舟舰[Owner.Capital.GetName]上，由于我们自从加速星际旅行以来所承担的角色，分裂正在形成。一些船员认为他们的职责比其他人更重要，现在每个群体都要求被认为是不可或缺的。
entries.en: $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$, $job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$, and $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$. These three distinct social groups form the hierarchy of spiritual practitioners. This is how it has always been. $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ lead the way, while $job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$ commit themselves to the path, and the $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$ support our endeavors through worship and physical toil.\n\nHowever, schisms are forming aboard the Arkship [Owner.Capital.GetName] due to the roles we have assumed since committing to accelerated interstellar travel. Some crew members believe their responsibilities outweigh those of others, and now each group is demanding to be recognized as the most essential.

entries.zh: 虔诚圣职理应获得更多认可。
让我们听听信徒的诉求。
entries.en: Let's hear it for the Faithful!

entries.zh: 每个人的贡献都具有同等价值。
entries.en: Everyone's contributions are of equal worth.

entries.zh: $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$们引领我们走向辉煌，继续倡导精神上的满足，致力于我们所有人的福祉。虔诚圣职和信徒追随他们的脚步，怀着敬意和崇敬仰望着他们。\n\n作为我们信仰的最高典范，$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$们也享有某些船上特权。他们拥有更宽敞的住处，可以使用更多资源，并在所有甲板上享有优先通行权。
entries.en: Steering us to glory, the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ continue to champion spiritual fulfillment, dedicating their lives to the betterment of all of us. The Devoted and the Faithful follow in their steps, looking up to them with respect and reverence.\n\nRepresenting the highest ideal of our faith, the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ are also entitled to certain onboard perks. They have more spacious living quarters, access to more resources, and priority clearance on all decks.

entries.zh: 信仰有其特权。一切都是理所当然的。
entries.en: Faith has its privileges. All is well.

entries.zh:
$job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$身兼精英与凡人两重身份。他们作为忠实的信徒开始其神职生涯，并渴望成为至高朝圣者，是船上人员的完美缩影。

正因为这些原因，我们强调对$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$的尊重。他们告知忠实的信徒其潜力所在，并提醒至高朝圣者其出身。他们让我们保持谦逊，并维系着所有甲板之间的联系。

以一次仪式性祝福来表彰虔诚圣职将是表达社会感激之情的好方法。这甚至可能激励他们更加努力地投入到其修行中。
entries.en:
The $job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$ straddle the worlds of the elite and the layperson. Beginning their clerical career as Faithful adherents to our ways, and aspiring to High Pilgrim-hood, they represent a perfect cross section of the ship's company.

It is for these reasons that we emphasize our respect for the Devoted. They inform the Faithful of their potential, and they remind the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ where they came from. They keep us humble, and connected across all decks.

Honoring the Devoted with a ceremonial blessing would be a good way to convey societal gratitude. It may even inspire them to devote themselves even harder to their practice.

entries.zh: 保佑虔诚圣职。他们让我们的文化熠熠生辉。
entries.en: Bless the Devoted. They honor us.

entries.zh: 每个人的贡献都具有同等价值。
entries.en: Everyone's contributions are of equal worth.

entries.zh: $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$是我们的压舱石。他们是农民、技术员和矿工。他们也是明天的虔诚圣职和$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$！\n\n我们如此敬重信徒，因为他们支撑起了上层甲板。没有他们，我们的社会就会搁浅。
entries.en: The $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$ are our ballast. They are the farmers, the technicians, and the miners. They are also the Devoted and the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ of tomorrow!\n\nWe hold the Faithful in such high regard because they stop the deckheads from falling down. Without them, our society would run aground.

entries.zh: 他们确实是我们的命脉。赞美他们。
entries.en: Indeed, they are our lifeblood. Praise them.

entries.zh: 我们社会的每个阶层都必须做出贡献。
entries.en: Every stratum of our society must contribute.

entries.zh:
不再有神圣遗址可供探索。

先祖星图引导我们跨越了遥远的距离，如今我们终于追上了过去。但问题依然存在：我们发现的是真相吗？还是说，我们一直以来追随的不过是一场谎言？

这条道路始终是我们文化中不可或缺的一部分。它是先祖所命定的。但在目睹了他们当年的所见，并拥有了现代科学的优势后，那些经文是否依然真实？亦或是，我们的社会注定要踏上一条全新的、不再那么虔诚的道路？
entries.en:
There are no more Sacred Sites left to explore.

The Ancestral Star Charts guided us across vast distances, and now we have caught up with our past. But the question remains: was it truth we found? Or have we been following a lie?

The Path has always been an integral part of our culture. It was ordained by our ancestors. But having seen what they saw, and with the privilege of modern science, do the texts still ring true? Or is our society destined to follow a new, less pious Path?

entries.zh: 我们决不能改变航向。保持忠信！
entries.en: We must not alter course. Remain faithful!

entries.zh: 现在当然由我们自己选择成为什么样。
entries.en: Surely we get to choose who we are now.

entries.zh: 一切都不明朗。我们已经迷失了道路。
entries.en: It is unclear. We have lost our way.

entries.zh: 总会有人心怀不轨；他们想让我们的历史被遗忘，让我们的传统随时间流逝。我们绝不能让他们分裂我们。我们必须保护我们传统的生活方式。如果我们听从神灵的指引，祂们便会继续指引我们，但我们必须对祂们的影响敞开心扉。
entries.en: There will always be those with an agenda; those that would see our history be ignored, and our conventions lost to time. We cannot let them divide us. We must protect our traditional way of life. The deities will continue to guide us if we just let them, but we have to remain open to their influence.

entries.zh: 我们的祖先肯定允许变革。
entries.en: Surely our ancestors allowed for change.

entries.zh:
我们社会核心的分歧正在加深。进步人士被迫接受改变，而传统主义者则害怕任何不同的事物。

此时我们必须自问：我们的民族能否再次团结起来，和谐共处？否则后果可能不堪设想。

每个人都应该有自由以自己的方式实践自己的信仰，但如果我们的派系斗争导致内战，那么我们必须绝对确信自己的信念。
entries.en:
The rift at the heart of our society is deepening. Progressives are compelled to embrace change, while traditionalists fear anything that is different.

At this point we have to ask ourselves: is there any way we can come together again as a people, and live in harmony? The alternative could be devastating.

Everyone should have the freedom to practice their faith in their own way, but if our factionalism leads us to civil war then we must be absolutely certain of our convictions.

entries.zh:
没有过去，我们便一无所有。没有“大道”，我们便无处可去。有时，对我们信仰的挑战正是我们所需要的，它能激励我们，提醒我们，当我们放弃自己的道路时，将会面临怎样的危险。

我们正从一段内忧外患的黑暗时期中走出来。我们曾几乎为了自己的信念而自相残杀，而实际上，唯一能拯救我们所有人的，正是团结。

让我们永远不要再彼此反目。我们必须完全致力于同一种“大道”。
entries.en:
Without the past, we are nothing. Without the Path, we have nowhere to go. Sometimes a challenge to our beliefs is what we need to galvanize us, and remind us of what is at stake when we forsake our ways.

We are emerging from a dark period of inner turmoil. We were almost willing to tear ourselves apart for our convictions, when in reality the only thing that can save us all is unity.

Let us never turn against one another again. We must be committed fully to the same Path.

entries.zh:
过去拖累我们、阻碍我们进化。从历史中吸取教训是一回事，但停滞不前，永远无法超越历史，则是愚蠢的。

我们不必浪费自我发现的潜力。既然我们已经摆脱了昨日的枷锁，我们就可以以奔放的热情向前迈进。

我们不再受制于技术落后的祖先。众神留下的神秘碎片也不再能决定我们的道路。我们选择自己的“大道”，没有任何事物能阻挡我们。
entries.en:
The past pulls us back, keeping us from evolving. Learning from history is one thing, but remaining there, never moving beyond it, is foolish.

We need not waste our potential for self-discovery. Now that we have shrugged off the chains of yesterday, we can move forward with unbridled passion.

No longer will we be governed by our technologically inferior ancestors. No longer will the Path be dictated by the cryptic crumbs laid by the deities. We choose our own Path, and nothing can stand in our way.

entries.zh: 这条“大道”使我们感到清晰。
唯一的真理就是战争之路……
entries.en: The only true Path is a war path...

entries.zh:
我们带着信念和希望追随此“大道”，并已得道。

现在，我们明白重新圣化所有已知圣地，并扩展此道以造福无数物种和文明，是我们的神圣职责。

我们的仁慈将传播到星辰之间，与所有愿意的灵魂相连。
entries.en:
We have followed the Path, in faith and hope, and we have attained enlightenment.

Now, we see it is our holy duty to re-sanctify all known sacred sites, and expand the path so that it may bless countless species and civilizations.

Our benevolence will spread across the stars and connect with all willing souls.

entries.zh: 这从来都不关乎“道路”本身。最重要的是我们共同度过的旅程。我们的族人遵循这一传统已有数百年之久，然而在任何历史文献中，我们都从未发现过这条道路真正的“目的”。它或许早已淹没在时间的长河里。\n\n我们会铭记先辈流传下来的故事，以及他们曾进行的朝圣之旅，但我们不再需要追随他们的脚步。比起他们，我们对生命、银河系以及自身都有了更深刻的认知。他们所坚持的真理已不再适用于我们。我们将开辟属于自己的道路。
entries.en: It was never about the Path itself. What's most important is the journey we make together. Our people have followed this tradition for centuries, and yet we have never found, in any of our historical documents, the true 'purpose' of the Path. It may be lost to time.\n\nWe will remember the surviving stories of our ancestors, and the Pilgrimage they made, but we no longer need to follow their lead. We know more about life, the galaxy, and ourselves than they did. The truths they held are no longer relevant to us. We will chart our own path.
The Path was within us all along.

entries.zh:
现在一切都清晰了。我们祖先的神圣遗址是病态甜美的希望和信仰灯塔。那些先我们而来的人毫无羞耻之心，也不在乎别人是否知道。

我们的声誉已被轻视和玷污。我们有能力圣化新的地点，以传达我们更新后的精神使命。

神灵是复杂且被误解的。通过这条“大道”，祂们教导我们冲突是我们社会的自然特征。我们克服的挑战使我们变得更强大。现在我们将向整个星系展示我们的力量！
entries.en:
Everything is clearer now. The Sacred Sites of our ancestors are sickly sweet beacons of hope and faith. Those who came before us had no shame, and they didn't care who knew it.

Our reputation has been trivialized and tarnished. We have it in our power to sanctify new sites that will communicate our updated spiritual mission.

The deities are complex and misunderstood. Through the Path, they have taught us that conflict is a natural feature of our society. The challenges we overcome make us stronger. Now we will demonstrate our strength across the galaxy!

entries.zh: §L我们的信仰支撑着我们。我们将追随指引，任由诸神掌舵。§!
entries.en: §LOur Faith sustains us. We will follow, as we allow the Deities to take the helm.§!

entries.zh: §L祖训残缺不全。我们必须在逻辑与信仰之间求得平衡，方能找到前行之路。§!
entries.en: §LThe Ancestral records are fragmented. We must balance logic and faith to find our way.§!

entries.zh: §L我们铭记先辈的承诺，并发誓追随他们的道路。§!
entries.en: §LWe remember the commitments of our ancestors, and vow to follow their Path.§!

entries.zh: §L至高朝圣者是方舟舰上最受尊敬的阶层。§!
entries.en: §LHigh Pilgrim is the most venerated rank aboard an Arkship.§!

entries.zh: §L虔诚圣职是方舟舰上最受尊敬的伙友。§!
entries.en: §LThe Devoted are the most respected peers aboard an Arkship.§!

entries.zh: §L信众们尽职尽责地维护着下层甲板，也维护着我们的生活方式。§!
entries.en: §LThe Faithful dutifully maintain the lower decks, and our way of life.§!

entries.zh: §L方舟飞船上的所有神职人员的努力都受到同等重视。§!
entries.en: §LThe efforts of all clerical classes are equally valued aboard Arkships.§!

entries.zh: §L我们传统的信仰激发深刻的精神成长。§!
entries.en: §LOur traditional beliefs stimulate deep spiritual growth.§!

entries.zh: §L社会发展得益于近期取得的进步浪潮。§!
entries.en: §LSocietal development is fueled by recent waves of progress.§!

entries.zh: §L方舟飞船有足够的空间容纳所有信仰。§!
entries.en: §LThere is enough space for all faiths aboard an Arkship.§!

entries.zh: §L人必须忠于他们的会众，否则就会被抛弃。§!
entries.en: §LOne must remain loyal to their congregation, or else be cast away.§!

entries.zh: 如果驿站位于另一个已拥有驿站的相邻星系中，驿站收集模块会更有效。
entries.en: Waystation collection modules are more effective if the station is in an adjacent system to another owned Waystation.

entries.zh: §L我们欣喜地与整个星系分享我们对和平的愿景。§!
entries.en: §LWe jubilantly share our vision of peace with the entire galaxy.§!

entries.zh: 驿站模块资源产出增加，在神圣遗址星系中有额外加成。
entries.en: Waystation module resource output is increased, with extra bonuses in Sacred Site systems.

entries.zh: §L沟通如同虚空中的光芒，沿着我们的航线流淌。§!
entries.en: §LCommunication flows along our Waylines like light in the void.§!

entries.zh: 可以建造防御性驿站模块，并效果得到增强。
entries.en: Defensive Waystation modules can be built, with amplified effects.

entries.zh: §L我们拥抱神灵的混沌与复杂。§!
entries.en: §LWe embrace the chaos and complexity of the deities.§!

entries.zh: 接纳混沌导致的效果增强
entries.en: Amplified effects from Embrace the Chaos

entries.zh: §L自古以来，朝圣者就是我们社会的命脉。完成神圣的朝圣之旅并获得神灵的赐福是我们的天赋权利。§!
entries.en: §LPilgrims have been the lifeblood of our society since time immemorial. To complete the sacred pilgrimage and be blessed by the deities is our birthright.§!

entries.zh: §L这些船员提供商品和服务，作为致力于朝圣的行为。§!
entries.en: §LThese crew members provide goods and services, in devotion to the Pilgrimage.§!

entries.zh: §L群众渴望神圣的知识。假以时日，他们将在信仰中站稳脚跟。它也将滋养他们。§!
entries.en: §LThe masses yearn for sacred knowledge. In time they will establish themselves in the faith. And it will nourish them.§!

entries.zh: 社群群众将信仰融入一切责任与义务当中。合作与友谊可以让我们成就一切。
entries.en: The congregation applies the faith to all duties and responsibilities. Through cooperation and good-fellowship, we can achieve anything.

entries.zh: 随着在§Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。
entries.en: With the installation of the [GetStartingDrive] aboard the §Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!, our engineering [GetCrew] have completed a comprehensive inspection of the Arkship's aging systems in preparation for true interstellar travel. Numerous faults have been identified throughout the vessel.

entries.zh: $NEW_LINE$护盾诊断显示有几个发射器未对准，需要重新校准。
entries.en: $NEW_LINE$Shield diagnostics indicate several projectors are misaligned and require recalibration.

entries.zh: $NEW_LINE$多个传感器阵列检测到持续的干涉模式。
entries.en: $NEW_LINE$Persistent interference patterns have been detected across multiple sensor arrays.

entries.zh: $NEW_LINE$多个机库早已被改作仓库之用，限制了我方机组人员的作战备勤能力。
entries.en: $NEW_LINE$Multiple hangar bays have long since been repurposed as storage, limiting the operational readiness of our flight crews.

entries.zh: $NEW_LINE$一个来自未经探索的恒星系的信号，已开始在我们的通信数据库中自我复制。
entries.en: $NEW_LINE$A signal originating from an unexplored star system has begun replicating itself across our communications databanks.

entries.zh: $NEW_LINE$腐蚀性冷却液泄漏正在危及船体完整性。
entries.en: $NEW_LINE$Corrosive coolant leaks are compromising hull integrity.

entries.zh: $NEW_LINE$方舟舰的开采系统尚未在实际运行条件下进行过测试。资源勘探表明，周边星系中存在具有开采价值的矿藏。
entries.en: $NEW_LINE$The Arkship's extraction systems have yet to be tested under operational conditions. Resource surveys indicate viable deposits in the surrounding systems.

entries.zh: $NEW_LINE$若要使方舟舰恢复到完全备战状态，就必须修理好这些缺陷。
entries.en: $NEW_LINE$These deficiencies must be corrected if the Arkship is to be restored to full operational readiness.

entries.en: Temporarily disabling the shield grid will allow our engineering [Owner.GetCrew] to recalibrate the projector array.

entries.en: §LA signal originating from an unexplored star system has begun replicating itself throughout our communications databanks.§!

entries.zh: §L对该信号自复制算法的研究已经改进了我们自己的超光速通信协议。§!
entries.en: §LStudy of the signal's self-replicating algorithms has yielded improvements to our own FTL communications protocols.§!

entries.zh: 我们传感器阵列多年以来的临时调整已经给读数带来了显著的干扰。
entries.en: Untold years of ad-hoc adjustments to our sensor arrays have introduced significant interference into their readings.

entries.zh: $REQUIREMENTS_HEADER$$NEW_LINE$在§Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!中调查§Y4§!种不同类型的恒星。
§L我方[GetScientistPlural]从改良后的传感器处理算法中获取了新的洞见。§!
entries.en: §LOur [GetScientistPlural] have drawn new insights from the development of improved sensor processing algorithms.§!
$REQUIREMENTS_HEADER$ $NEW_LINE$Enact the §Y$decision_flush_coolant$§! decision while in a §Y$sc_black_hole$§! system.

entries.zh: §L外泄的冷却液腐蚀了方舟内部各处的关键结构。§!
entries.en: §LCoolant leaks have corroded critical internal structures throughout the Arkship.§!

entries.zh: §L反应堆冷却液已被完全替换，还附带推进器性能提升的额外效果。§!
entries.en: §LReactor coolant has been completely replaced, with the side effect of heightened thruster performance.§!

entries.zh: §L处理掉腐蚀性冷却液，并用混合了异星天然气的气体冲刷系统之后，我们的工程师[From.GetCrew]就可以着手修复当前的损害了。§!
entries.en: §LDisposing of the corrosive coolant and flushing the system with a mixture of exotic gases will allow our engineering [From.GetCrew] to repair the resulting damage.§!

entries.zh: 一代又一代的方舟居民已经把这些机库改装成了仓库。
entries.en: Generations of Arkship inhabitants have repurposed these hangar bays as storage depots.

entries.en: §LPractical field experience has yielded improvements to the Arkship's resource extraction efficiency.§!

entries.zh: 这艘方舟舰经历了漫长岁月的不断改良，久到已无人记得。其材质与建造工艺的秘密早已湮没于时光之中，但它依然巡弋于群星之间，凌驾于所有其他方舟舰之上。
entries.en: This arkship was improved on for longer than anyone remembers. The secret of its composition and making have been lost to time, but it still prowls the stars, superior to all other arkships.

entries.zh: 贸易是帝国的命脉，而贸易在稳定的中继站和商队的网络上发展得最好。
entries.en: Trade is the lifeblood of empires, and trade blooms best when growing on a steady network of relays and caravansaries.

entries.zh: 一个由特许经营的深空商队客栈网络支持着这个游牧巨型企业的成长。
entries.en: A network of franchised deep space caravansaries supports the growth of this Nomadic Megacorporation.

entries.zh: 舵手会监控即使是最偏远的驿站，与独立的贸易商协调以确保所有站点都供应充足。
entries.en: The Bosun monitors even the most remote waystation, coordinating with independent traders to make sure the stations are all well supplied.

entries.zh: 驿站的经理们深知不应引起审计员的注意，他们会充分发挥员工的才能，以确保始终完成定额。
entries.en: Waystation managers know better than to attract the attention of the Auditor, and will bring out the best in their employees to make sure quotas are always met.

entries.zh: 这些游牧者是人体冷冻方面的专家，只在他们的方舟舰船员效率最高时才将其唤醒。
entries.en: These nomads are experts in cryonics, waking the crews of their Arkships only when they would be most productive.

entries.zh: 低温休眠总监是个孤独的职业，漫长的旅途中必须保持清醒，只唤醒社会所需之人。
entries.en: The Director of Cryonics is a lonely job, having to stay awake during the long journeys only waking up those that the society need.

entries.zh: 这家游牧型巨型企业是冷冻领域的专家，只在预测有利可图时才解冻船员和客户。
entries.en: This nomadic MegaCorp is an expert in cryonics, thawing crews, and clients only when the predictions turn profitable.

entries.zh: 首席人力资源官利用预测算法和员工效率值来优化员工的冷冻保存。
entries.en: Armed with their predictive algorithms and worker efficiency values the CHO optimizes the cyrogenics of the employees.

entries.zh: 这个游牧蜂巢将其意识的一部分交替地置于休眠状态，只唤醒方舟舰当前任务所需的组织和工蜂。
entries.en: This nomadic Hive alternates portions of its consciousness into torpor, rousing only the organs and drones required by the Arkship's current task.

entries.zh: 这个游牧的机械智能通过关闭无效单元来优化其路线，只在需要时才启动它们。
entries.en: This nomadic Machine Intelligence optimizes its routes by turning off ineffective units, only booting them up when needed.

entries.zh: 受限于当前匮乏的资源，我们只能让少数人保持清醒。
entries.en: Limited resources allowed only so many to make the journey awake.

entries.zh: 沉睡的大众封冻于时空之中，静待着我们有能力起唤醒他们的那一天。
entries.en: The sleeping masses, frozen in time and space until we can afford their waking.

entries.zh: 方舟舰上散落着多余的冷冻储存舱。有些里面可能还住着被遗忘的乘员。
entries.en: Surplus cryogenic storage littering the Arkship. Some might still house forgotten occupants.

entries.zh: 这些冷冻仓经过更新，现在不再过度运转，而是为我们之中最聪明的人服务，以延长他们的工作时间。
entries.en: Renewed and freed from their over-occupation, these Cryo Pods now serve our brightest to extend their time of service.

entries.zh: 我们让那些工作不太投入的成员去享受美好的深度休眠，并鼓励那些免遭冰冻的清醒之人勤俭节约，努力工作。
entries.en: By granting our less engaged members glorious deep sleep, we encourage frugality and productivity in those left warm and awake.

entries.zh: 星际劫掠者们，这个社会对财产只有模糊的概念。他们尊重强者和狡诈者为自己攫取保护不力的财富的权利。
entries.en: Freebooters of the stars, this society has only vague notions of property. They respect the right of the strong and the cunning to seize ill-protected riches for themselves.

entries.zh: 他们致力于防守前哨，作为一名资深炮手，他们确保储备充足的炸药、炮弹和各种致命武器。
entries.en: Dedicated to the defense of outposts, master gunners ensure they are well stocked with explosive, projectiles, and a general assortment of murderous implements.

entries.zh: 虚空弟兄在此集结，补给物资、出售战利品并痛饮所获。
entries.en: Brethren of the void congregate here to resupply, sell their plunder and drink off their gains.

entries.zh: 先进的镶板工作将最大限度地减少信号和能量泄漏，从而加强我们的防御并优化我们的隐形系统。
entries.en: Advanced paneling work to minimize leaks of signals and energy will reinforce our defenses and optimize our cloaking systems.

entries.zh: 我们海盗舰队的固定指挥所，这座强大的堡垒将帮助我们协调整个星系的突袭。
entries.en: Static Headquarters of our pirate fleet, this formidable stronghold will help us coordinate raids across the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: 飞行员一直是人们心中的英雄，激励着许多人努力成为像他们一样的人。不久之后，成为飞行员会被认为是身份的象征，并由此诞生了一代又一代的王牌飞行员，他们的成就就是最好的证明。
entries.en: Pilots have always been heroes of the people, inspiring many to strive to become just like them. Before long, becoming a pilot was considered a symbol of status, creating generations of ace pilots whose results speak for themselves.

entries.zh: 随着太空探索的潜力不断增长，这家大型企业决定大力投资培养一支精英飞行员队伍。拥有训练有素的飞行员可确保利润的持续增长和贸易的扩张。
entries.en: With the ever-growing potential of space exploration, this Megacorp has decided to invest heavily in training an elite group of pilots. Having well-trained pilots ensures the continuation of profits and expansion of trade.

entries.zh: 超空间航道控制器负责协调超空间跳跃，确保其快速高效。
entries.en: The Hyperlane Controller is in charge of coordinating hyperjumps, Making sure they are fast and efficient.

entries.zh: 飞行运营总监负责协调航天器使用以实现贸易潜力的最大化。
entries.en: The Flight Operations Director is responsible for coordinating the usage of spacecraft to maximize trade potential.

entries.zh: 这个帝国将自己塑造为了一个可雇佣的军事伙伴。虽然总是讨价还价，但在运用致命武力为客户解决麻烦这方面，他们确实是最顶尖的。
entries.en: This empire has established itself as a military partner for hire. They drive a hard bargain, but are at their best when using lethal force to solve their client's problems.

entries.zh:
-军事合约产生的贸易额：§G+50%§!
-军事合约生效中的船只射速：§G+15%§!
-军事合约生效中的船只维护费：§G-15%§!
-停泊于§R敌对§!殖民地星轨上的船只§G-10%§!维护费。
entries.en:
- Trade reward from Military Contracts: §G+50%§!
- Ship Fire Rate while under Military Contract: §G+15%§!
- Ship Upkeep while under Military Contract: §G-15%§!
- Ships in orbit of §RHostile§! colonies have §G-10%§! Upkeep.

entries.zh: 这家寰宇企业提供顶级安全服务。只要价格合适，他们在暴力冲突升级局面下的专业知识足以扭转任何冲突。
entries.en: This Megacorporation offers top of the line security services. For the right price, their expertise in violent escalation is sure to turn the tide of any conflict.

entries.zh: 佣金和战利品创造了奇迹，激励了我们的船员。
entries.en: Pay and Plunder do wonders to stimulate our crews.

entries.zh: 在佣兵中，没有什么比薪酬管理更重要的了。
entries.en: There is nothing more crucial than pay management in a mercenary fleet.

entries.zh: 优化人员薪酬是平衡账目的关键。当然，还要对服役期间获得的物资给予慷慨的留存额度。
entries.en: The optimization of personnel remuneration is key to balancing the accounts. With a generous allowance for goods and materials liberated while in active duty, of course.

entries.zh: 我们可以用这个来容纳更多飞行员。
entries.en: We can use this to house more pilots.

entries.zh: 伤害增益相对于舰船尺寸
一个游牧帝国正在协助我们建造一个巨型结构。
entries.en: A nomadic empire is assisting us with the construction of a Megastructure.

entries.zh: 在星系的每个角落，都有值得观赏的奇观，也有值得汲取的教训。
entries.en: Everywhere in the galaxy, there are wonders to behold and lessons to be learned.

entries.zh: 前人的遗迹令人敬畏，但也令人鼓舞。
entries.en: The vestiges of those who came before us are daunting, but also inspiring.

entries.zh: 生活在该星系的猛兽既令人生畏，又令人惊叹。
entries.en: The fierce beasts of the galaxy are as intimidating as they are wondrous.

entries.zh: 道路上点缀着地标。它们为我们提供庇护与指引，并构成了我们故事的脉络。
entries.en: The roads are dotted with landmarks. They offer us shelter, guidance, and make up the fabric of our stories.

entries.zh: 狂野不羁的掠夺者星系危险且难以测绘，但我们在共同的虚空生活方式中找到了共鸣。
entries.en: The wild and unruly marauder systems are dangerous to chart, but we find kinship in our shared voidborne lifestyles.

entries.zh: 对于愿意去看的人来说，宇宙是美丽的。
entries.en: The universe is beautiful for those willing to see.

entries.zh: 从逝去文明的遗迹中，我们学会塑造我们的未来。
entries.en: From the remnants of dead civilization, we learn to shape our future.

entries.zh: 虚空之中的兽群，生活在迷人却又残酷的和谐之中，而我们也能在这种平衡中找到属于自己的位置。
entries.en: The void fauna lives in fascinating, if ruthless, harmony, and we can find our place in that balance.

entries.zh: 城邦人也许不是游牧民，但他们深知虚空生活的现实，只要价钱合适，他们就能提供帮助。
entries.en: Enclavers may not be nomads, but they know the reality of a life in the void, and could help up for the right price.

entries.zh: 游牧生活与无尽的漫游带给我们的最大回报之一，就是发现新的天地。即使在漫长的旅途之后，依然存在着未曾见过的风景，不论是绝美的还是令人惶恐的。我们的好奇心总是渴望去发掘这些奇观。\n\n然而，对于我们的方舟来说，每一处新景象不仅仅是供其观赏的奇特事物，更是一次学习新知、反思与成长的机会。
entries.en: One of the greatest rewards for nomadism and our ceaseless wandering is the discovery of new places. Even after a long time traveling, there remain sights unseen, beautiful or mortifying. Spectacles that our curiosity yearns to discover.\n\nBut more than peculiar things for our arkships to behold, each new vista is an opportunity to learn something new, reflect and grow.
