entries.zh:
风信子号生来就不是为了驻足在某个地方的。

她是“尤利西斯计划”的第六艘，也是最后一艘方舟舰。那个本该将我们送往新殖民世界的虫洞打散了我们的舰队，而在穿越后瞬间发生的灾难性动力故障，让我们陷入了孤独漂流的境地。

冈德森船长做出了一个决定。风信子号将成为我们的家，并且它将对外开放。那场失散中的其他幸存者找到了我们：研究员、殖民者，以及无处可去的流浪者。我们收留了他们。无论他们通过气闸舱带来了什么，冈德森家族都能将其物尽其用。

如今[Ruler.GetTitle]依然是冈德森家族的一员。漫长的漂流让我们绕了一大圈，又回到了虫洞最初将我们抛下的那片星域。我们之所以回来，是因为这里是一切疑问开始的地方。
entries.en:
The Hyacinth was not built to stay still.

She was the sixth and last of the Ulysses Initiative's arkships. The wormhole that was supposed to deliver us to a new colony world scattered our fleet, and a catastrophic power failure in the moments after transit left us adrift and alone.

Captain Gundersen made a decision. The Hyacinth would be our home, and it would be open. Other survivors of the scattering found their way to us: researchers, colonists, and wanderers who had nowhere else to go. We took them in. Whatever they brought through the airlock, the Gundersen line put to use.

The [Ruler.GetTitle] is always a Gundersen. Our long drift has brought us full circle, back to the stars where the wormhole first deposited us. We came back because this is where the questions start.

entries.zh: 作为由联合国赞助的“尤利西斯计划”的第六艘也是最后一艘方舟舰，“风信子”号在穿过那个将人类散布到星辰之中的虫洞后的瞬间，遭遇了灾难性的动力故障。罗纳德·F·冈德森舰长凭借着毅力与智慧拯救了所有人，并在此过程中建立了一个王朝。\n\n一个世纪后，冈德森研究学会依然以“风信子”号为家。这艘飞船经历了如此多的重建与扩建，以至于有些人开始称它为“忒修斯”号。他们的欢迎是真诚的，好奇心是广泛的；无论任何人通过气闸舱带来什么，都由冈德森家族决定该如何使用。如今，漫长的漂流让他们回到了原点，回到了虫洞最初将他们送达的那个星系角落。
entries.en: The sixth and final arkship of the UN-sponsored Ulysses Initiative, the Hyacinth suffered a catastrophic power failure in the moments after its passage through the wormhole that scattered humanity across the stars. Captain Ronald F. Gundersen saved them all through grit and ingenuity, and in doing so, founded a dynasty.\n\nA century later, the Gundersen Research Society still calls the Hyacinth home, rebuilt and expanded so much that some have started calling it the Theseus. Their welcome is genuine, their curiosity broad; what anyone brings through the airlock, the Gundersen line decides how to use. Now their long drift has brought them full circle, back to the corner of the galaxy where the wormhole first deposited them.

entries.zh: $nomadic_system_initializer$冈德森研究学会的初始恒星系。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: $nomadic_system_initializer$The Gundersen Research Society's starting solar system.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$

entries.zh: 联合星，我们终于有了关于秋菊号下落的线索。我们必须去看看我们的姐妹舰如今以何处为家。
entries.en: We finally have a lead on where the Chrysanthemum ended up, Unity. We must see where our sister ship now calls home.

entries.zh:
风信子号的远程接收器在“尤利西斯计划”的紧急频率上截获了一段广播。

这个信号非常古老——至少有一个世纪之久——但信息十分清晰。尤利西斯计划的第五艘“秋菊号”在失散中幸存了下来。殖民者们发现了一个世界，他们将其命名为“联合星”。

广播不断重复着：“秋菊号殖民地呼叫所有尤利西斯计划的船只。我们已在一个宜居世界登陆。这颗星球非常美丽。我们正在这里建设新的家园。回家吧。”

从这里无法确定信号的源头，但用于传输该信号的中继浮标应该是可追踪的。对附近星系进行勘测或许能找到其中一个。
entries.en:
The Hyacinth's long-range receivers have intercepted a broadcast on Ulysses Initiative emergency frequencies.

The signal is old - at least a century - but the message is clear. The Chrysanthemum, the fifth Ulysses Initiative arkship, survived the scattering. The colonists found a world. They named it Unity.

The broadcast repeats: "Chrysanthemum colony to all Ulysses Initiative vessels. We have made landfall on a habitable world. The planet is beautiful. We are building something here. Come home."

The signal's origin cannot be determined from here, but the relay buoys used to carry it should be traceable. A survey of nearby systems may locate one.

entries.zh: 开始对信号源进行三角定位。
那都是陈年旧事了，记录下来，然后继续前进。
entries.en: That's ancient history, log it and move on.

entries.zh: 一个可能包含尤利西斯计划中继浮标的恒星系。对风信子号进行调查可能有助于更准确地定位信号来源。
entries.en: A system that may contain a Ulysses Initiative relay buoy. Surveying it with the Hyacinth may yield a stronger fix on the signal's origin.

entries.zh:
尤利西斯计划的一个中继浮标漂浮在这个星系中——破损不堪，勉强运转，但仍在发送广播。

除了最初的宣告外，浮标还载有两条后来的通讯。第二条的日期大约在第一条的十年后。

殖民地人口：二十六万。农业已建立。基础设施正在扩建。

第三条通讯的日期是第9182天——大约在登陆后的第二十五年。“我们还在这里。联合星的环境比最初的调查显示的更具挑战性。我们失去了一些同伴。如果有任何尤利西斯计划的飞船收到此广播，请回复。我们在这里。我们仍在坚持。”

联合星位于天津四星系，距离这里仅有几次超空间跳跃的航程。
entries.en:
A Ulysses Initiative relay buoy is drifting in this system - battered, barely functional, but still broadcasting.

Beyond the original announcement, the buoy carries two later transmissions. The second is dated roughly ten years after the first.

Colony population: two hundred and sixty thousand. Crops established. Infrastructure growing.

The third transmission is dated from Day 9,182 - approximately twenty-five years after landing. "We are still here. Unity is more challenging than initial surveys indicated. We have lost people. If any Ulysses Initiative vessel receives this broadcast, please respond. We are here. We endure."

Unity is in the Deneb system, only a few hyperlane jumps from here.

entries.zh: 秋菊号方舟舰的殖民地建立于此。尤利西斯计划中继浮标记录了坐标，风信子号必须前往。
entries.en: The Chrysanthemum colony was established here. The Ulysses Initiative relay buoy recorded the coordinates, Hyacinth must travel there.

entries.zh:
天津四星系一片寂静。

“风信子”号脱离跃迁，发现没有信标，没有信号，也没有在星球间穿梭的飞船。奥林波斯星悬浮在半远处，庞大而冷漠。

有一颗卫星不对劲。殖民地的广播曾描述那里有绿色的大陆和广阔的水域，而扫描仪显示的却是一个死寂的世界——那是被核武器摧毁后的星球特有的无可错认的灰褐色。那里没有任何生命。

在近地轨道上，缓慢而暗淡地漂浮着的是“秋菊”号。它没有被毁。只是空无一人。每一扇舷窗都漆黑一片。这艘曾运载着二十五万殖民者来到这个世界的飞船，已经在这里停滞了数十年。
entries.en:
The Deneb system is quiet.

The Hyacinth drops from transit to find no beacons, no signals, no ships moving between worlds. Olympus hangs in the middle distance, enormous and indifferent.

One moon is wrong. Where the colony's broadcasts described green continents and open water, the scanners show a dead world - the unmistakable gray-brown of a nuked planet. Nothing lives there.

And in low orbit, drifting slow and dark, is the Chrysanthemum. Not destroyed. Simply empty. Every porthole dark. The ship that carried a quarter million colonists to this world has sat here for decades.

entries.zh: 尤利西斯计划的第五艘方舟舰。它搭载了后来建立“联合星”的殖民者。它在冰冷与无人的状态下，已经漂流了不知多少个十年。
entries.en: The fifth Ulysses Initiative arkship. It carried the colonists who would found Unity. It has been drifting, cold and unmanned, for an unknown number of decades.

entries.zh: 联合星殖民地在失去联系前大约运作了二十五年。无论这里发生了什么，记录都保存了下来。殖民地的档案管理员一直坚持记录到了最后。
entries.en: The Unity colony operated for roughly twenty-five years before contact was lost. Whatever happened here, the record survived. The colony's archivist kept logging until the end.

entries.zh:
殖民地的数据核心幸存了下来——被封存在玻璃化表岩屑下方的地下档案馆中。

第9251天：发现了一种新的掘地变种。外围墙体的防护等级不足以抵御地下突破。已向“秋菊”号请求工程支援。请求待批复。

第9389天：外环已撤离。地下居住区已确认安置了214,000名殖民者。部分区域失去联系。

第9441天：与7至12区的通讯中断。民兵伤亡：892人。

第9484天：地下四层的电力已中断。团队被要求停止记录。档案管理员予以拒绝。

第9514天：我们没有足够的时间了。
entries.en:
The colony's data cores survived - sealed in a subterranean archive beneath vitrified regolith.

Day 9,251: A new burrowing variant has been identified. The outer perimeter walls are not rated for subsurface breach. Engineering support requested from the Chrysanthemum. Request pending.

Day 9,389: Outer ring evacuated. 214,000 colonists accounted for in underground residential blocks. Some sectors uncontacted.

Day 9,441: Communications with sectors 7 through 12 lost. Militia casualties: 892.

Day 9,484: Power to sublevel four is gone. The team has been asked to stop logging. The archivist declines.

Day 9,514: We do not have enough time.

entries.zh:
议事厅是为容纳两百人而建造的。最后一次会议只召集到了十七人。档案员仍在进行记录。

会议持续了六个小时。共投出十二张选票——六票赞成轨道轰炸，六票反对。一名委员弃权。三人缺席；他们所在的防区三天前就已沦陷。

反对者争辩说，撤离仍然可行。“秋菊号”可以在地表殖民地的下层被攻破前分批撤离幸存者。

多数人则不这么认为。该生物已经到达了下层通道。任何停靠的飞船都会将污染带离这个星球。现在的选择已经不再是拯救部分人还是拯救所有人，而是失去一个世界，还是失去随后的每一个世界。

殖民地安全主管博克莱尔指挥官投下了决定性的一票。动议通过。殖民地宪章规定少数服从多数。那份宪章是他们在第一年亲自起草的，那时的未来看起来还是另一番光景。
entries.en:
The council chamber was built for two hundred. The final session convened seventeen people. The archivist was still logging.

The session ran for six hours. Twelve votes were cast - six for orbital bombardment, six against. One member abstained. Three were absent; their sectors had fallen three days prior.

The dissenters argued that evacuation was still possible. The Chrysanthemum could extract survivors in cycles before the lower levels were breached.

The majority held otherwise. The organism had already reached the lower access tunnels. Any vessel that docked would carry contamination offworld. The choice was no longer between saving some and saving all, but between losing one world and losing every world that followed.

Chief of Colony Security, Commander Beauclair, cast the deciding vote. The motion carried. The colony's charter said majority rules. They had written that charter themselves, in the first year, when the future looked different.

entries.zh:
舰桥日志始于第9516天——即投票两天后。

11名船员留下来确认地表清除情况。辐射水平。人口预估被下调，随后再次下调。第9519天：授权轰炸。第9521天：确认扇区清除完毕，40%。第9558天：地表已彻底净化。未探测到生命迹象。评估结果：全体一致。

船员们又花了四年时间进行天体物理学勘测。科学家们借此打发时间。

最后一篇日志的日期是第11204天。值班军官描述了一个晴朗的日子。她写道，在这么近的距离看天津四，与当初靠近它时所见的模样截然不同。记录到此结束。

最后的记录只有一个时间戳，没有歉意，也没有反思。仅仅是对星光的一句观察。
entries.en:
The bridge logs begin on Day 9,516 - two days after the vote.

Eleven crew remained to confirm surface clearance. Radiation levels. Population estimates revised downward, then revised again. Day 9,519: bombardment authorized. Day 9,521: sector clearance confirmed, 40%. Day 9,558: surface sterile. No life signatures detected. Assessment: unanimous.

The crew spent four more years on astrophysics surveys. Scientists filling the time.

The final log is dated Day 11,204. The officer on watch describes a clear day. She notes that Deneb looks different from this close than it did on approach. The entry ends there.

The final entry is a timestamp, no apology or reflection. Just an observation about starlight.

entries.zh:
ISA-06……风信子号。我们与全部六艘飞船都失去了联系，很长一段时间里，我们做好了最坏的打算。能在这里找到你们，看到你们还活着……请原谅我的失态。

我代表[From.GetHomeWorldName]和联合国大会，请接受我们伸出的友谊之手。无论“尤利西斯计划”让你们踏上了怎样的道路，你们现在都已经回到同胞身边了。

我们有很多事情要谈。请把一切都告诉我们吧。
entries.en:
ISA-06... The Hyacinth. We lost contact with all six ships, and for a long time we assumed the worst. To find you here, alive... forgive me.

On behalf of the people of [From.GetHomeWorldName] and the United Nations General Assembly, please accept our hand in friendship. Whatever road the Ulysses Initiative set you on, you are among your own people now.

We have a great deal to talk about. Please, tell us everything.

entries.zh:
[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]，来自冈德森研究学会。“风信子”号向您致意。我们很高兴看到地球依然屹立。

我们花了一个世纪的时间，追寻被虫洞散落在这片星系中的事物。这项工作浩大无边，并且我们发现，宇宙绝不会向缺乏好奇心的人展露它的秘密。每一个加入我们的人都深谙此道。这也是我们提出的唯一条件。

[From.GetHomeWorldName]曾孕育出愿意乘坐方舟舰穿越虚空的科学家与探险家。我们相信如今依然如此。“风信子”号的大门向任何怀揣这种精神的人敞开。把你们最优秀的人才派给我们吧。这里从来都不缺问题。
entries.en:
[From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName], of the Gundersen Research Society. Greetings from the Hyacinth. We are glad to find Earth still standing.

We have spent a century pursuing what the wormhole scattered across this galaxy. The work is vast, and we have found that the universe does not yield its secrets to the incurious. Everyone who has joined us has understood this. It is the only condition we have ever asked.

[From.GetHomeWorldName] produced scientists and explorers willing to cross the void in arkships. We suspect it still does. The Hyacinth's doors are open to anyone who carries that same spirit through them. Send us your best. There is no shortage of questions.

entries.zh: 在我们探索深空奥秘的过程中，零重力工程为我们的工程师们提供了亟待解决的独特挑战。
entries.en: Zero-G engineering provides unique challenges for our engineers to solve as we explore the depths of the void.

entries.en: §Y$starbase_waystation_1_plural$§! collect celestial resources and form interstellar trade routes.

entries.zh: 我们的$starbase_waystation_1_plural$不再仅仅是繁星之间的某个简单标识物。物流的改善使其能容纳更多的库存，并沿着已建立的驿道更高效地传输资源。
entries.en: Our $starbase_waystation_1_plural$ are no longer simple markers along the stars. Improved logistics allow them to store greater reserves and transfer resources more efficiently along established Waylines.

entries.zh: 允许建造升级版的$starbase_waystation_1_plural$，具备更大的存储容量和更强的后勤能力。
entries.en: Allows the construction of upgraded $starbase_waystation_1_plural$ with expanded storage and improved logistical capacity.

entries.zh: 先进的协调协议将遥远的各个$starbase_waystation_1_plural$绑定为一个内聚的网络。资源、信号和物资以无与伦比的精度在驿道中流动。
entries.en: Advanced coordination protocols bind distant $starbase_waystation_1_plural$ into a cohesive network. Resources, signals, and supplies move across the Waylines with unmatched precision.

entries.zh: 允许建造发展规划完备的$starbase_waystation_1_plural$，以强化驿道并将物流效率最大化。
entries.en: Allows the construction of fully developed $starbase_waystation_1_plural$ that strengthen the Wayline network and maximize logistical efficiency.

entries.zh: 这些先进的阵列从当地恒星辐射中汲取能量，并将其储存起来以备后用。即使我们不在，恒星也在继续为我们工作。\n
entries.en: These advanced arrays draw energy from local stellar radiation and store it for future use. Even in our absence, the stars continue to work for us.\n

entries.zh: $sm_waystation_mining_module_plural$从附近的矿脉中提取矿产财富，并将原材料包装好以便日后取回。\n
entries.en: $sm_waystation_mining_module_plural$ extract mineral wealth from nearby deposits, packaging raw materials for later retrieval.\n

entries.zh: 通过轨道资源点收集£minerals£ £food£ £consumer_goods£ £alloys£等§Y资源§!。
驿站上的专用种植舱在受控环境中培育粮食作物，确保为过往舰队提供稳定的补给。\n
entries.en: Dedicated growing bays cultivate food crops in controlled environments aboard the waystation, ensuring a steady supply of provisions for passing fleets.\n

entries.zh: 这些先进设施监测当地现象并归档其发现。通过这样的作法，在此收集的知识具有无价的意义。\n
entries.en: These advanced facilities monitor local phenomena and archive their findings. The knowledge gathered here will prove invaluable along the way.\n

entries.zh: 过程即终点。在这里，稀有且不稳定的材料被提炼成可用的战略资源，为我们下一阶段的旅程提供持续保障。\n
entries.en: The journey is the destination. Here, rare and volatile materials are refined into usable strategic resources, ready to sustain us on the next stage of our path.\n

entries.zh: 这些繁华的枢纽促进了过往舰队与邻近帝国之间的交流。商业在我们的航线上流动，所到之处皆留厚利。\n
entries.en: These bustling hubs facilitate exchange between passing fleets and neighboring empires. Commerce flows along our routes, leaving profit in our wake.\n

entries.zh: 一个安全的储藏库，用于收集并存放来自附属国世界的贡品。\n
entries.en: A secure repository where tribute from subject worlds is gathered and held.\n

我们的游牧宗主向我们的殖民地勒索了额外的贡品。
entries.en: Our Nomadic Overlord extorts an additional tribute from our colonies.

entries.zh: 吸收了一波星际大炮的冲击之后，该生物以全新的活力疾驰过虚空。
entries.en: Having absorbed a Stellar Cannon blast, the creature races through the void with renewed vigor.

entries.en: Good things come in small packages. These facilities harvest and stabilize self-replicating nanites, keeping a little something in reserve for the road ahead.\n

entries.zh: 更多。\n\n祢将力量如赠与般倾倒。我们感受到了。我们会成长……绝不止步。
entries.en: more.\n\nyou pour your power into us like an offering. we feel it. we grow... do not stop.
We have only made them stronger.

entries.zh: 你们如此竭尽全力而最终我也毫发无损……\n\n真是浪费。我本对你们有更高的期望。不要把你的力量浪费在不会受到伤害的事物上。
entries.en: You burned through so much just to leave me untouched...\n\nSuch a waste. I had hoped for more from you. Do not throw your strength away on what cannot be harmed.

entries.zh: 她对我们有更好的期望。
又来。一样的浪费，一样的结果。\n\n我把你们所消耗的还给了你们，不是为了伤害你们，而是让你们感受到它的分量。事不过三。我不想看到你们再一次浪费自我。
entries.en: Again. The same waste, the same result.\n\nI return what you spent, not to hurt you, but so you feel the weight of it. Learn from this. I will not watch you spend yourself a third time.

entries.zh: 这是我们需要学习的一课。
entries.en: The lesson is ours to carry.

entries.zh: 我们的方舟舰针对资源开采进行了优化，但在战备状态和科研能力上却缺乏投入。扩展我们的能力是一项战略重点。
entries.en: Our Arkship is optimized for resource extraction, but combat readiness and research capacity have gone without investment. Broadening our capabilities is a strategic priority.

entries.zh: 我们的方舟舰是一个能力出众的研究平台，但面对虚空，单靠科学才能是远远不够的。长期运行能力和战斗系统同样需要同等的投入。
entries.en: Our Arkship is a research platform of considerable capability, but the void demands more than scientific aptitude alone. Operational endurance and combat systems require equal investment.

entries.zh: 方舟亚光速飞行速度：§G+$@arkship_agenda_mult|0%$§!\n方舟闪避：§G+$@arkship_agenda_static|0$§!
我们的方舟舰专为作战行动而建，但在研究能力和后勤基础设施方面却缺乏投资。纠正这一不平衡将扩大我们的行动范围。
entries.en: Our Arkship is built for combat operations, but research capability and logistical infrastructure have gone without investment. Correcting this imbalance will extend our operational reach.

entries.zh: 方舟舰亚光速飞行速度：§G+$@arkship_agenda_mult|0%$§!\n方舟舰调查速度：§G+$@arkship_agenda_mult|0%$§!

entries.en: Arkship engineering has been mastered across every configuration. Research platforms, warships, and hauling operations alike stand to benefit from this agenda's refinements.

entries.zh: 我们的社会不必局限于一个家园。有了建造更多方舟舰的能力，每一个战略方向都将成为一条道路，而每一条道路都将属于我们。
entries.en: Our society need not be limited to one home. With the ability to construct additional Arkships, every direction becomes a path, and every path becomes ours.

entries.en:
§H$tech_arkship_construction$§!
Allows our Arkships to construct additional Arkships using the Megastructure Build Menu.

§L$tech_arkship_construction_desc$§!

entries.zh: 优化的结构设计与改进的引擎系统造就了新一代方舟舰：它们承载着更多关于我们的一切，驶向我们前所未至的远方。
entries.en: Refined structural design and improved drive systems allow for a new generation of Arkships: carrying more of who we are, further than we have ever gone.

entries.zh: 移动巨型结构工程的巅峰。这些方舟舰代表了一个旅行文明所能达到的最高成就。
entries.en: The pinnacle of mobile megastructure engineering. These Arkships represent the full extent of what a traveling civilization can achieve.

entries.zh: $civilian_arkship_class$方舟舰不仅仅是一艘飞船，它本身就是一个独立的世界。其基础设施足以支撑一个航行中的完整社会，携带着在星海间繁衍生息所需的一切。
entries.en: More than a vessel, the $civilian_arkship_class$ Arkship is a world unto itself. Its infrastructure supports a complete society in motion, carrying with it everything needed to thrive across the stars.

entries.zh: $science_arkship_class$方舟将游牧生活的机动性与专业研究机构的完整资源结合在一起，使我们造访的每一个恒星系都成为新的发现机遇。
entries.en: $science_arkship_class$ Arkships combine the mobility of nomadic life with the full resources of a dedicated research institution, turning every system we visit into a new opportunity for discovery.

entries.zh: $military_arkship_class$方舟舰是游牧帝国的装甲核心。它们专为战斗而建，无论舰队航向何方，都能带来毁灭性的火力。
entries.en: $military_arkship_class$ Arkships are the armored core of a nomadic empire. Purpose-built for combat, they carry devastating firepower wherever the fleet travels.

entries.zh: 昔日辉煌的方舟巨舰残骸，如今寂静地漂流着。无论它遭遇了怎样的命运，都几乎没有留下任何痕迹。
entries.en: The wreck of a once-great Arkship, adrift and silent. Whatever fate claimed it left little behind.

entries.zh: 一艘损毁的方舟舰。它的系统已然死寂，但对于愿意前去调查的人来说，或许还能找到可回收的物资。
entries.en: A ruined Arkship. Its systems are dark, but salvage may remain for those willing to investigate.

entries.en: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Harvests §HResources§! from Surveyed deposits. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Provides additional §HResources§! depending on ['concept_arkship_harvest_resources_planet_resources', Planet Class]. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Harvesting of ['concept_arkship_strategic_resources'] can be improved with §H£engineering_research£ Technologies§!.

entries.en: When enabled, automation harvests targets that have not been §HSurveyed§!. Unsurveyed targets typically yield fewer resources.

entries.zh: 启用后，自动托管将收集没有任何§H开采站矿藏§!的目标，产量极低。
entries.en: When enabled, automation harvests targets that do not have any §HMining Station Deposits§!, for a minimal yield.

entries.zh: 启用后，自动化将从您拥有§H驿站§!的星系目标中采集资源。
entries.en: When enabled, automation harvests from targets in systems with your §HWaystations§!.

entries.zh: 当启用时，将自动收取位于属于§H友好§!帝国的星系内目标的资源。在有主星系内收取资源通常会招致§H评价§!惩罚。
entries.en: When enabled, automation harvests from targets in systems owned by §Hfriendly§! empires. Harvesting in owned systems typically incurs §HOpinion§! penalties.

entries.zh: 当启用时，将自动收取位于属于§H敌对§!帝国的星系内目标的资源。在有主星系内收取资源通常会招致§H评价§!惩罚。
entries.en: When enabled, automation harvests from targets in systems owned by §Hhostile§! empires. Harvesting in owned systems typically incurs §HOpinion§! penalties.

entries.zh: 启用后，自动托管将优先处理我们持有§Y专属收集权§!的恒星系。无论设置如何，这些恒星系都会被收集，即使关闭§H友好恒星系§!和§H敌对恒星系§!也是如此，且不会产生§H评价§!惩罚。
entries.en: When enabled, automation prioritizes systems where we hold §YExclusive Harvesting Rights§!. These are harvested regardless of standing, even with §HFriendly Systems§! and §HHostile Systems§! off, and carry no §HOpinion§! penalty.

entries.zh: §L后勤舰的开采设施能够收集整个矿床，以便在方舟舰上进行处理。§!
entries.en: §LThe Logistic Ship's extraction facilities can collect entire deposits for processing onboard an Arkship.§!

entries.zh: 可以下令噬岩方舟舰环绕行星轨道，并部署其来噬岩蜂群来吞噬该星球。$NEW_LINE$一旦开始，将会有一个§H局势§!来追踪吞噬进度，并且方舟舰会被锁定在轨道上，直到该过程完成。 $NEW_LINE$如果方舟舰离开轨道，将有§Y180天§!的宽限期允许其返回。如果未能及时返回，吞噬将被放弃。 $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$在轨道上时：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—会定期提取£minerals£ §Y矿物§!、£food£ §Y食物§!和£pop£ §Y人口§! $NEW_LINE$完成后： $TABBED_NEW_LINE$—该星球将被转化为§Y粉碎星球§!
entries.en: Terravore Arkships can be ordered to orbit a planet and deploy it's swarm consume it.$NEW_LINE$Once initiated, a §HSituation§! tracks consumption progress and the Arkship is locked in orbit until the process is complete. $NEW_LINE$If the Arkship leaves orbit, a §Y180-day§! grace period allows it to return. If it does not return in time, the consumption is abandoned. $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$While in orbit:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- £minerals£ §YMinerals§!, £food£ §YFood§!, and £pop£ §YPops§! are periodically extracted $NEW_LINE$On completion: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- The world is converted into a §YShattered World§!

entries.zh: 纳米方舟舰可以受命环绕行星，并用纳米机器将其同化。$NEW_LINE$一旦启动，将出现一个§H局势§!来追踪同化进度，并且方舟会被锁定在轨道上，直到该过程完成。$NEW_LINE$如果方舟离开轨道，将有§Y180天§!的宽限期允许其返回。如果未能及时返回，该过程将被放弃。$DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$在轨道上时：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—定期提取£nanites£ §Y纳米机器§! $NEW_LINE$完成后：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—该星球将被转化为不可宜居的纳米星球
entries.en: Nanite Arkships can be ordered to orbit a planet and assimilate it with nanites.$NEW_LINE$Once initiated, a §HSituation§! tracks assimilation progress and the Arkship is locked in orbit until the process is complete.$NEW_LINE$If the Arkship leaves orbit, a §Y180-day§! grace period allows it to return. If it does not return in time, the process is abandoned. $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$While in orbit:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- £nanites£ §YNanites§! are periodically extracted $NEW_LINE$On completion:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- The world is converted into an Uninhabitable Nanite World

entries.zh:
无法与其他帝国进行§Y外交§!！
无法访问§Y泛星系贸易市场§!
无法对星球进行§Y环境改造§!
对所有其他帝国拥有§Y“饥饿”§!宣战理由

§Y外星人口§!总是会被吃掉
通过吃掉£pop£ §H外星人口§!获得£society£ §Y$society_research$§!
entries.en:
Cannot engage in §YDiplomacy§! with other empires!
Cannot access the §YGalactic Market§!
Cannot §YTerraform§! planets
Has the §Y'Hunger'§! casus belli on all other empires

§YXeno Pops§! will always be eaten
Gains £society£ §Y$society_research$§! from eating £pop£ §HXeno Pops§!

entries.zh: 方舟舰可以将['concept_arkship_nanotech_consume_world', 星球同化]为不宜居的纳米星球
entries.en: Arkships can ['concept_arkship_nanotech_consume_world', Assimilate Worlds] into Uninhabitable Nanite Worlds

entries.zh: 所有易于获取的资源都已被采集完毕。发掘新的资源点并建立开采基础设施尚需时日。
entries.en: All easily reachable resources have been collected. It will take time to uncover new deposits and set up the infrastructure to harvest them.

entries.zh: 从收割行动中获得的资源
战略资源的开采是方舟运作的基本要求。
entries.en: The extraction of strategic resources is a fundamental requirement for arkship operations.

entries.zh: §L比常规采集更彻底的提取。我们只取所需，将其余的留给虚空。§!
entries.en: §LA more thorough extraction than standard harvesting. We take what we need and leave the rest to the void.§!

entries.zh: 自动对天体进行§H露天采矿§!，其提取§H资源§!的效率远高于标准的收获。
entries.en: Automatically §HStrip Mine§! celestial objects, extracting §HResources§! at far greater efficacy than standard harvesting.

entries.zh: §L亚空间成像揭示了常规探测范围之外的景象：隐藏的航道、坍塌的通道以及休眠的虫洞。§!
entries.en: §LSubspace imaging reveals what lies beyond the range of conventional detection: hidden lanes, collapsed corridors, and dormant wormholes.§!

entries.zh: $SYSTEM_EFFECTS_HEADER$$arkship_deep_scan_effect_no_header$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—可能发现先前未检测到的§H超空间航道§!或§H虫洞§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—可以在每个恒星系进行一次亚空间成像。
entries.en: $SYSTEM_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $arkship_deep_scan_effect_no_header$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- May discover previously undetected §HHyperlanes§! or §HWormholes§!. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Subspace Imaging can be performed once per system.

$TRIGGER_FAIL$该恒星系已经进行了§Y亚空间成像§!扫描
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$System has already been scanned using §YSubspace Imaging§!

entries.zh: §Y$ARKSHIP$§!完成了§Y$SYSTEM$§!恒星系的亚空间成像扫描。
entries.en: Subspace Imaging in §Y$SYSTEM$§! has been completed by the §Y$ARKSHIP$§!.

entries.zh: §L星球被分解为其组成物质。曾经的世界化作未来的旅程。§!
entries.en: §LThe planet is broken down to its constituent materials. The world that was becomes the journey that will be.§!

entries.zh: $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$$PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—添加£time£§H$@arkship_reprocess_planet_duration_doubled|0$个月§!的§Y$harvested_resources_mining$§!修正：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$$mod_station_gatherers_produces_mult$：$@arkship_harvest_resources_station_penalty|0%+$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$$harvested_resources_mining_tt$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—目标转化为§H$pc_shattered$§!。
entries.en: $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$ $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §Y$harvested_resources_mining$§! modifier added for for £time£ §H$@arkship_reprocess_planet_duration_doubled|0$ Months§!: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$ $mod_station_gatherers_produces_mult$: $@arkship_harvest_resources_station_penalty|0%+$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$ $harvested_resources_mining_tt$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Target is converted into a §H$pc_shattered$§!.

entries.zh: §L将充能暗物质注入$pc_gas_giant_plural$或现有的恒星中以启动聚变反应。在此过程中幸存的恒星会燃烧得更加炽热明亮，但代价是牺牲整个星系的宜居性。§!
entries.en: §LEnergized dark matter is injected into either $pc_gas_giant_plural$ or existing Stars to jump-start fusion reactions. Stars that survive the process burn hotter and brighter, at the cost of habitability throughout the system.§!

entries.zh: $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$pc_gas_giant$将转化为§H$pc_protostar$§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—添加一处大型的§H$energy_with_icon$§!和§H$physics_research_with_icon$§!资源点。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—所有卫星都会被吸入吸积盘。
entries.en: $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- The $pc_gas_giant$ is turned into a §H$pc_protostar$§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- A large §H$energy_with_icon$§! and §H$physics_research_with_icon$§! deposit is added. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- All moons are absorbed into the accretion disk.

entries.zh: $STAR_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—添加额外的§H$energy_with_icon$§!或§H$physics_research_with_icon$§!资源点。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$——恒星的产出得到了显著提升。
entries.en: $STAR_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Adds additional §H$energy_with_icon$§! or §H$physics_research_with_icon$§! deposits.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- The output of the star is significantly increased.

entries.zh: 这颗星体曾是$pc_gas_giant$，在注入高能暗物质后正在进行恒星核聚变。对其进行研究将提供宝贵的见解。
entries.en: A former $pc_gas_giant$, now undergoing stellar fusion following the injection of a highly energetic dark matter. Studying this would provide valuable insights.

entries.zh: 一座由原恒星点火过程中凝聚的暗物质形成的高耸结构。其表面能吸收所有已知形式的辐射。
entries.en: A towering structure formed of coalesced dark matter from the Protostar ignition process. The surface absorbs all known forms of radiation.

entries.zh: 暗物质维持的核聚变显著提高了这颗恒星的能量输出和光度。
entries.en: Dark matter sustained nuclear fusion has significantly increased the output and luminosity of this star.

entries.zh: 该恒星系中暗物质聚变反应所带来的光度提升，降低了整个恒星系的宜居性。
entries.en: The increased luminosity brought upon by dark matter fusion reactions in this system has decreased the habitability throughout the system.

entries.zh: §L一次跃迁足以推动方舟舰跨越浩瀚的星系距离。由此产生的冲击波是无差别的，会在起点和终点星系都留下印记。§!
entries.en: §LA single jump capable of propelling the Arkship across vast galactic distances. The resulting shockwave does not discriminate, leaving its mark on both the origin and destination systems.§!

entries.zh: $SYSTEM_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—所有§H舰队§!，§H空间站§!和§H恒星基地§!受到$@arkship_exodus_jump_cost|0R$§H伤害§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—所有§H殖民地§!受到§R33%§!§H荒废度§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—该效果将作用于§H目的地§!和§H起源§!恒星系。
entries.en: $SYSTEM_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- All §HFleets§!, §HStations§!, and §HStarbases§! receive $@arkship_exodus_jump_cost|0R$ §HDamage§!. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- All §HColonies§! receive §R33%§! §HDevastation§!. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- This applies to both the §HDestination§! and §HOrigin§! Systems.

entries.zh: $FLEET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—所有直接受控制的舰队将会被弹射至预计散射半径内的某个随机恒星系。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—以这种方式发射的舰队会得到§G+33%§!的§H射速§!提升，持续时间£time£§H120天§!。
entries.en: $FLEET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- All controlled fleets are catapulted to a random system within the indicated scatter radius. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Fleets launched this way receive a §G+33%§! §HFire Rate§! increase for £time£ §H120 Days§!.

entries.zh: §Y$SYSTEM$§!恒星系由于§Y$ARKSHIP$§!的动作遭受了时空裂缝产生的负面影响。
entries.en: The §Y$SYSTEM$§! system has suffered a spacetime breach caused by the §Y$ARKSHIP$§!.

entries.zh: §L方舟舰喷吐出我们的虫群，吞噬一个宜居世界，历时数月将其碾碎成原始矿物与有机物质。§!
entries.en: §LThe arkship spews forth our swarm, consumes a habitable world, grinding it down to raw minerals and organic matter over many months.§!

entries.zh: $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—行星被逐渐吞食，产出§H$minerals_with_icon$§!和§H$food_with_icon$§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—吞食完成时目标被摧毁。
entries.en: $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Planet is gradually consumed, yielding §H$minerals_with_icon$§! and §H$food_with_icon$§!.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Target is destroyed on completion.

entries.zh: 吞食$PLANET|Y$会为蜂群提供食物。
entries.en: The consumption of $PLANET|Y$ yields food for the swarm.

entries.zh: §Y$ARKSHIP$§!已经吞食了§Y$PLANET$§!。但我们依然感到饥饿。
entries.en: The §Y$ARKSHIP$§! has devoured §Y$PLANET$§!. We still hunger.

entries.zh: §L部署纳米机群来分解并吞噬一颗宜居星球，从其生物质和矿物成分中回收并增殖纳米机器人。§!
entries.en: §LDeploy the nanite swarm to break down and consume a habitable world, recovering and multiplying nanites from its biomass and mineral composition.§!

entries.zh: $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—星球逐渐被纳米机器人吞噬，产出§H$nanites_with_icon$§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—完成后，目标将被转化为§H不适宜居住的纳米世界§!。
entries.en: $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Planet is gradually consumed by nanobots, yielding §H$nanites_with_icon$§!.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Target is converted into an §HUninhabitable Nanite World§! on completion.

entries.zh: §Y$ARKSHIP$§!的纳米机群已完全同化了§Y$PLANET$§!，将其转化为了一个无法居住的纳米星球。
entries.en: The nanite swarms of §Y$ARKSHIP$§! have fully assimilated §Y$PLANET$§!, converting it into an Uninhabitable Nanite World.

entries.zh: 分解$PLANET|Y$的纳米机群带回了大量新生产的纳米机器人。
entries.en: The nanite swarms dissolving $PLANET|Y$ return a bounty of newly produced nanites.

entries.zh: $PLANET|Y$上最后一处建筑结构已被溶解，其物质被纳米机群彻底转化。
entries.en: The last structures of $PLANET|Y$ are dissolved, its matter fully transformed by the swarm.

entries.zh: 从方舟上，我们的岩质蜂群成千上万地降临，吞噬着这个世界的地壳与地幔，直到一切荡然无存。
entries.en: From the Arkship, our lithoid swarms descend in their thousands, feasting on the crust and mantle of this world until nothing remains.

entries.zh: 方舟舰释放出纳米机群，溶解并占据这个世界。岩石、土壤和大气被分解，并重组为纳米机器。
entries.en: The Arkship releases its nanite swarms to dissolve and claim this world. Rock, soil, and atmosphere are broken down and reassembled into nanites.

entries.zh: §Y方舟舰§!必须在§H180§!天内返回§Y[Target.GetName]§!的轨道，否则侵蚀行动将被放弃。
entries.en: An §YArkship§! must return to orbit of §Y[Target.GetName]§! within §H180§! days or the consumption will be abandoned.

entries.zh: 我们的人民将执行最后一次登陆下舰，用星辰换取坚实的土地，用方舟换取安定的家园。我们的游牧岁月或许即将终结，但我们的旅程才刚刚开始。
entries.en: Our people disembark for the last time, trading the stars for solid ground, and our Arkship for a settled home. Our existence as a nomadic people may be ending, but our journey has only just begun.

entries.zh: $ARKSHIP_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—该§Y£colony£殖民地§!已转移至目标行星。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—§Y方舟§!将被废弃拆解。
entries.en: $ARKSHIP_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- The §Y£colony£ Colony§! is transferred to the target planet. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- The §YArkship§! will be abandoned and dismantled.

entries.zh: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—§P将不再是游牧帝国！§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—位于无主星系内的§Y驿站§!将转化为§Y恒星基地§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—剩余的§Y方舟§!将作为§Y附属国§!释放。
entries.en: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §PWill cease to be a Nomadic empire!§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §YWaystations§! in Unowned Systems will be converted into §YStarbases§!. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Remaining §YArkships§! will be released as a §YSubject§!.

entries.zh: 从方舟上回收的先进设施和计算机可以稳定该行星的气候。
entries.en: Advanced machinery and computers salvaged from an Arkship stabilizes the climate of this world.

entries.zh: 方舟舰§Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!的航程就此结束。经过数年的辛勤劳作，拆除了它的基础设施并将其运下重力井后，我们终于准备好将这艘飞船废弃。我们[event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在经历一个将被后代铭记的历史时刻。现在，让我们在§Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§!定居吧！
entries.en: Thus ends the voyage of the Arkship §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!. After years of labor, disassembling its infrastructure and carrying it down the gravity well, we are finally ready to scuttle the ship. We [event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are living through a moment future generations will remember. Now, let us settle §Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§!!

entries.zh: 将所有无人机和基础设施从§Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!转移至一颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上，这标志着§Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!背离了预言中的未来。现在将开发新的优先队列，以适应定居生活。
entries.en: The transfer of all drones and infrastructure from the §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§! to a [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] is a departure point from the predicted future of the §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!. New priority queues will now be developed to adapt to settled life.

entries.zh: 经过多年来对§Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!基础设施的筹备以及对我们自身生理机能的改造，进化出更强健的骨骼与优化的肺部，如今我们已准备好定居。这将是§Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!生命周期中的一个全新阶段，也许定居生活会很适合我们。
entries.en: After years of preparing the infrastructure of the §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§! and our own biology, evolving stronger bones and optimized lungs, we are now ready to settle. This will be a new stage in the §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§! lifecycle, perhaps settled life will suit us.

entries.zh: 这颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]将成为我们新帝国的基石。
entries.en: This [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] shall be the foundation of our new empire.
The §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§! stops being a £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire'] and colonizes §Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§! as a £planet£ ['concept_settled_empire'].\n\n

entries.zh: \n所有剩余的§Y$arkship_cap_plural$§!都将被§R凿沉§!，其人口将转移至§Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§!。
entries.en: \nAll remaining §Y$arkship_cap_plural$§! are §Rscuttled§! and their populations transferred to §Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§!.
We shall continue to roam the stars.
The §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§! settles on §Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§! as a new ['concept_subject'] of the §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!.\n\n
We shall rule the stars from this [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon].

entries.zh: 这个帝国是由一艘方舟舰上的居民在一座新世界定居后建立的。
entries.en: This empire was founded by the settlement of the population of an Arkship onto a new world.

entries.zh: 一个游牧文明的残余族裔，在接受某个新世界统治的同时，被留在星际间徘徊。
entries.en: The remains of a nomadic civilization, left to roam the stars while ruled from a new world.

entries.zh: \n将以所剩余的§Y$arkship_cap_plural$§!、§Y$nomads_constructor_plural$§!以及§Y$waystation_plural$§!建立一个游牧['concept_subject']。
entries.en: \nA Nomadic ['concept_subject'] is created with all remaining §Y$arkship_cap_plural$§!, §Y$nomads_constructor_plural$§! and §Y$waystation_plural$§!.

entries.zh: \n所有位于未拥有恒星系中的£waystation£ ['concept_waystations']都将转换为['concept_outposts']，并获得该恒星系的宣称。
entries.en: \nAll £waystation£ ['concept_waystations'] in unowned systems are converted into ['concept_outposts'], claiming ownership of their system.

entries.zh: \n所有位于§Y[event_target:settled_system.GetName]§!的$@arkship_subject_settle_outpost_range|Y0$次跃迁范围之内、且拥有£waystation£['concept_waystation']的无主星系都将建造一座['concept_outpost']，从而为我们的新['concept_subject']夺取这些星系的所有权。
entries.en: \nAll unowned systems with a £waystation£ ['concept_waystation'] within $@arkship_subject_settle_outpost_range|Y0$ jumps of §Y[event_target:settled_system.GetName]§! have an ['concept_outpost'] constructed, claiming ownership of their system for our new ['concept_subject'].

entries.zh: \n所有位于§Y[event_target:settled_system.GetName]§!的$@arkship_subject_settle_outpost_range|Y0$次跃迁范围之内、且拥有£waystation£ ['concept_waystation']的无主星系都将建造一座['concept_outpost']，为我们宣示这些恒星系的所有权。
entries.en: \nAll unowned systems with a £waystation£ ['concept_waystation'] within $@arkship_subject_settle_outpost_range|Y0$ jumps of §Y[event_target:settled_system.GetName]§! have an ['concept_outpost'] constructed, claiming ownership of their system for us.

entries.zh: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$—在以下选项中选择：\n$tt$—§P将不再是定居帝国，剩余殖民地将作为附庸释放！§!\n$tt$—§P将[Root.GetName]作为游牧附庸释放！§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$—所属星系内的§Y恒星基地§!将转化为§Y驿站§!。
entries.en: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Choose between:\n$tt$-§PWill cease to be a Settled empire and remaining Colonies will be released as a Subject!§!\n$tt$-§PRelease [Root.GetName] as a Nomadic Subject!§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §YStarbases§! in Owned Systems will be converted into §YWaystations§!.

entries.zh: $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$—§P这个星球将被废弃！§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—添加§Y$stripped_planet$§!修正 $TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$—$MOD_POP_ENVIRONMENT_TOLERANCE$：§R-60%§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$—$MOD_PLANET_MAX_DISTRICTS_ADD$：§R-2§!
entries.en: $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §PThis world will be abandoned!§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$-Adds the §Y$stripped_planet$§! modifier $TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$- $MOD_POP_ENVIRONMENT_TOLERANCE$: §R-60%§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$- $MOD_PLANET_MAX_DISTRICTS_ADD$: §R-2§!
['concept_arkship_embark'] and become a £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire']. Remaining ['concept_colonies'] become a ['concept_subject'].

entries.zh: 自从我们的飞船首次驶出我们的星系以来，我们之中总有一些人只能通过影像记录来了解宇宙，在同一片天空下出生、生活并死去。现在，这一切都将改变。\n\n随着我们的§H方舟舰§!建造完成，引力不再是障碍，宇宙的无数奇迹正等待着我们。§Y[From.GetName]§!已经倾其所有：我们的人民将带着它的名字、它的记忆与它的未来，一同踏入虚空。
entries.en: Since our ships first ventured beyond our star, there have always been those among us who knew the cosmos only through recordings, those who were born, lived, and died beneath the same sky. That changes now.\n\nWith the completion of our §HArkship§!, gravity is no longer an obstacle, and every wonder of the cosmos awaits. §Y[From.GetName]§! has given all it had to give: our people will carry its name, its memory, and its future with us into the void.

entries.zh: 我们已经完成了一艘§H方舟舰§!。我们的无人机将不再被束缚于[From.GetPlanetMoon]。它们的程序已被调整以适应移动星际功能，同时§Y[From.GetName]§!的基础设施已被剥离殆尽，所有必要的系统均已转移，以支持一个全新的、四海为家的未来。
entries.en: We have completed an §HArkship§!. No longer will our drones be bound to [From.GetPlanetMoon]. Their processes have been adjusted for mobile stellar function as §Y[From.GetName]§! is stripped bare of infrastructure and all necessary systems are transferred to support a new mobile future.

entries.zh: 我们，[event_target:player_country.GetName]，曾目睹过无数景象，但我们的子个体却始终被束缚在已定居的星球上。如今，在星际旅行的时代，困守于单一星系已成为一种累赘。登入我们崭新的§H方舟舰§!，我们将重获自由，而§Y[From.GetName]§!则会被榨干与收割。
entries.en: We, the [event_target:player_country.GetName], have seen many sights, yet our drones have always been bound to settled worlds. Now, in an age of interstellar travel, confinement to a single system is a liability. We will be free aboard our new §HArkship§!, while §Y[From.GetName]§! is left stripped and harvested.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!在我们身后燃烧，被我们预言已久的灾难所吞没，但我们的人民终于§G获救§!了，乘着一艘§H方舟舰§!的双翼驶入深空。
entries.en: §Y[From.GetName]§! burns behind us, swallowed by the cataclysm we long foretold, but our people are §Gsaved§! at last, cast into the deep on the wings of an §HArkship§!.
The §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§! will become §HNomadic§! embarking on an §HArkship§!\n

entries.zh: 我们将乘坐一艘§H$science_arkship_name$§!进行探索。
他们将成为我们的附属国。
\n§Y[from.GetName]§!将登上§H方舟舰§!，成为§Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!新的游牧附庸。\n
entries.en: \n§Y[from.GetName]§! will embark on an §HArkship§! as a new Nomadic Subject of the §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!.\n

entries.zh: \n将创建一个包含所有剩余['concept_colonies']和['concept_starbases']的定居附属国。
entries.en: \nA Settled Subject will be created with all remaining ['concept_colonies'] and ['concept_starbases'].

entries.zh: \n在所拥有的没有§H驿站§!的星系中的§H恒星基地§!将会被转化为§H驿站§!。
entries.en: \n§HStarbases§! in Owned Systems without §HWaystations§! will be converted into §HWaystations§!.

entries.zh: 当人们乘坐方舟舰离开时，这个世界的大部分资源已被掠夺殆尽，除了一片死气沉沉之外，几乎什么也没有留下。
entries.en: This world was stripped of most of its resources when its people departed aboard their Arkship, leaving little behind but silence.

entries.zh: 这个设施用于收集和展示我们在整个星系中收集到的各种新奇夺目的['concept_specimen', 标本]，包括活体§Y太空兽群§!。
entries.en: A facility for collection and display of noteworthy ['concept_specimen', Specimens] we have collected throughout the galaxy, including live §YSpace Fauna§!.

entries.zh: 维持这种规模的舰船运转是一场对抗熵增的持久战。零件被改装挪用，系统勉力维持着超越极限的运转，而这样的工作永无休止。
entries.en: Keeping a vessel of this scale operational is a constant struggle against entropy. Parts are repurposed, systems are coaxed beyond their limits, and the work is unending.

entries.zh: 停泊湾从未安静过。飞船进出穿梭，永无停歇，持续不断的抵达与驶离让方舟号与更广阔的银河系保持着紧密的联系。
entries.en: The docking bays are never quiet. Traffic flows in and out without pause, a steady churn of arrivals and departures that keeps the Arkship connected to the wider galaxy.

entries.zh: 扩建居住区提升了方舟舰的承载能力。走廊也许很狭窄，但这里是家。
entries.en: Expanded habitation increases the Arkship's carrying capacity. The corridors may be narrow, but they are home.

entries.zh: 编织在船体上的传感器集群扫描着所及范围内的一切。附近太空中的任何事物都无法长时间不被察觉。
entries.en: Sensor clusters woven into the hull scan everything within reach. Nothing in nearby space goes unnoticed for long.

entries.zh: 专业的钻探与开采设备能够破开行星地壳，采集蕴藏其中的资源。
entries.en: Specialized drilling and extraction equipment is capable of cracking open a planet's crust to harvest what lies within.

entries.zh: 庞大的机库容纳着随时待命紧急出击的飞行中队。我们的打击范围远超舰体本身。
entries.en: Expansive launch bays housing squadrons ready to scramble on a moment's notice. Our reach extends well beyond our hull.

entries.zh: 逝者不得安息。来自早已陨落文明的攻击艇再次驶向星空。
entries.en: The dead do not rest. Strike craft from long-fallen civilizations take to the stars once more.

entries.en: Shielded bays tuned to the resonance of psionic weaponry. The hum is ever-present, felt as much as heard.

entries.en: A pressurized bay adapted to house our Space Amoeba companions. They prefer the warm sections near the reactor.

entries.en: Dense launch racks housing thousands of autonomous strike units, ready to swarm on command.

entries.zh: 成排的激光发射器分布在外层船体上，以机械般的精准度循环锁定目标。
entries.en: Banks of laser emitters distributed across the outer hull, cycling through targets with mechanical precision.

entries.zh: 回收的武器从设计角度来看就让敌人心神不宁。尽管其运作原理尚未被完全理解，但其致命性毋庸置疑。
entries.en: Recovered weapons of unsettling design. While their operating principles are not fully understood, their lethality is unquestioned.

entries.en: A single high-energy lance channel capable of focusing devastating beams at extreme range.

entries.en: Long-range particle projectors that deliver punishing damage at the cost of a slow rate of fire, eliminating threats before they close to striking distance.

entries.en: Torpedo racks loaded with psionic warheads, their trajectories guided by psychic resonance rather than conventional targeting.

entries.en: An array of arc emitters that bypass armor entirely, discharging directly into a target's systems.

entries.en: Conduits of psychic energy crackle along the hull, ready to discharge in directed bolts that ignore conventional defenses.

entries.zh: 高速动能炮塔，可靠而无情。最古老的武器依然是最有效的武器之一。
entries.en: High-velocity kinetic turrets, reliable and relentless. The oldest weapon is still among the most effective.

$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_M_SLOTS$
$t$These turrets will be equipped with §YMass Drivers§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 出土的古代制造动能武器，其枪管公差比现代工程技术所能复刻的任何标准都要精密。
entries.en: Excavated kinetic weapons of ancient manufacture, their barrel tolerances tighter than anything modern engineering can replicate.

$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_M_SLOTS$
$t$These dedicated turrets will be equipped with §Y$ARCHAEO_KINETIC$§!.

entries.zh: 远程动能火炮，用于在目标过于靠近之前对其进行打击。
entries.en: Long-range kinetic artillery for engaging targets before they can get too close.

entries.zh:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_SLOTS$
$t$这些炮塔将会装有§Y$KINETIC_ARTILLERY_1$§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_SLOTS$
$t$These turrets will be equipped with §Y$KINETIC_ARTILLERY_1$§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 炮塔内部布满了活体金属导管，能够在交战中进行自我修复，即使在持续损耗下也能维持最高射速。
entries.en: Turrets lined with living metal conduits that repair themselves mid-engagement, maintaining peak fire rate through attrition.

$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_SLOTS$
$t$These dedicated turrets will be equipped with §Y$LM_ACCELERATOR_SET$§!.

entries.zh: 舰体所能承受的最重型动能武器。每一发的速度都足以将护盾和装甲一并击穿。
entries.en: The heaviest kinetic weapons the hull can bear. Each shot travels fast enough to punch through shields and armor alike.

entries.zh:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_XL_SLOTS$
$t$这些炮塔将会装有§Y物质加速器§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_XL_SLOTS$
$t$This turret will be equipped with §YMass Accelerators§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 一台打捞回收的古代加速器，规模惊人，尽管历经数个世纪，其机械结构依然基本完好。
entries.en: A recovered ancient accelerator of staggering scale, its mechanisms still largely intact despite the centuries.

$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_XL_SLOTS$
$t$This dedicated turret will be equipped with §Y$ARCHAEO_X$§!.

entries.zh: 用于攻击远距离目标的导弹发射架。虽然速度比能量武器慢，但极难被敌人抵消伤害。
entries.en: Guided missile racks for engaging targets at range. Slower than energy weapons, but far harder to simply absorb.

entries.zh:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_S_SLOTS$
$t$这些炮塔将会装有§Y导弹发射器§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_S_SLOTS$
$t$These turrets will be equipped with §YMissile Launchers§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 具有骇人精度的古代制导弹药，从考古遗址中回收并重新投入使用。
entries.en: Ancient homing munitions of frightening accuracy, recovered from archaeological sites and pressed back into service.

$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_S_SLOTS$
$t$These dedicated turrets will be equipped with §Y$ARCHAEO_MISSILE$§!.

entries.zh: 发射器装填了蜂群弹药，以绝对的数量优势压倒了点防御。
entries.en: Launchers loaded with swarmer munitions, overwhelming point defense with sheer volume.

entries.zh:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_M_SLOTS$
$t$这些炮塔将会装有§Y蜂群导弹发射器§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_M_SLOTS$
$t$These turrets will be equipped with §YSwarmer Missile Launchers§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 经过改造的生化弹头，掌握在那些愿意用虫群天灾自己的武器反制天灾本身的人手中。
entries.en: Repurposed bio-warheads, wielded by those willing to turn the Scourge's own weapons against it.

$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_G_SLOTS$
$t$These dedicated turrets will be equipped with §Y$SCOURGE_MISSILE_1$§!.

entries.zh: 专门针对来袭的舰载机和导弹，在它们触及舰体前将其粉碎的点防御集群。
entries.en: Point defense clusters dedicated to shredding incoming strike craft and missiles before they reach the hull.

entries.zh:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_PD_SLOTS$
$t$这些炮塔将会装有§Y高射炮§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_PD_SLOTS$
$t$These turrets will be equipped with §YFlak Batteries§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 覆盖舰体的密集近防武器系统网络，能够在来袭的威胁到达舰船之前对其进行追踪与拦截。
entries.en: A dense network of close-in weapon systems covering the hull, tracking and intercepting incoming threats before they can reach the ship.

entries.zh:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_PD_SLOTS$
$t$这些炮塔将会装有§Y点防御炮台§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en:
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_PD_SLOTS$
$t$These turrets will be equipped with §YPoint Defense Batteries§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 来源不明的古老点防御阵列，依然如上次开火那天般有效。
entries.en: Ancient point defense arrays of unknown origin, as effective as the day they were last fired.

$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$
$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_PD_SLOTS$
$t$These dedicated turrets will be equipped with §Y$ARCHAEO_POINTDEFENCE$§!.

entries.zh: 它的电力需求如此巨大，以至于仅一次发射就让数百万家庭陷入数小时的黑暗。下达开火的决议从来不是一件轻松事。
entries.en: So great is its power demand that a single shot plunges millions of households into darkness for several hours. The decision to fire is never made lightly.
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_T_SLOTS$\n$t$This Spinal Mount is equipped with a §Y$ARKSHIP_DEVASTATOR_WEAPON$§!.

entries.zh: 这些船厂坐落在方舟舰的核心地带，让我们在穿越繁星的同时，建造规模空前的舰船。
entries.en: Nested at the heart of the Arkship, these yards can build ships of unprecedented size all while we travel across the stars.

entries.zh: 较小的天体可以在这些巨大的齿轮中被粉碎和加工，为我们提供丰富的材料。
entries.en: Smaller celestial bodies can be crushed and processed in these enormous gears, providing us with a bounty of materials.

entries.zh: 一个能够触发恒星级聚变事件的暗物质注入系统。这玩意可没有安全保险。
entries.en: A dark matter injection system capable of triggering stellar-scale fusion events. It has no safe setting.

entries.zh: 虚空在低语，对于那些懂得聆听的人，它正呢喃着其怀抱中无数星球的秘密。
entries.en: The void speaks, and for those who know to listen, it whispers the secrets of the countless worlds in its embrace.

entries.zh: 大迁徙跃迁协调仪目前在很大程度上仍是一个原型，在未来的某一天，它将使我们能够在眨眼之间穿越到不同的星系。
entries.en: The Exodus Coordinator is still largely a prototype that will one day enable us to cross to different galaxies in the blink of an eye.

entries.zh: 厚重的装甲板用螺栓固定在方舟舰最暴露的部位。这些重量对各个系统提出了更高的要求，但方舟舰承受住了。
entries.en: Heavy plating bolted across the Arkship's most exposed sections. The mass demands more of every system, but the Arkship endures.

entries.zh: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$这些通用槽位将会装有§Y装甲§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$These Utility Slots will be equipped with §YArmor§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 活体金属穿梭于舰体装甲之中，在缺口出现的瞬间便将其封闭。
entries.en: Living Metal weaves through the hull plating, sealing breaches as fast as they open.

entries.zh: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$这些专用槽位将会装有§Y$LARGE_LM_ARMOR_1$§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$These dedicated Utility Slots will be equipped with §Y$LARGE_LM_ARMOR_1$§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 挖掘出的未知合金成分制造的舰壳板。无论是什么文明建造了这些飞船，都没打算让它们轻易被摧毁。
entries.en: Excavated hull plating of unknown alloy composition. Whatever built these ships did not expect them to die easily.
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$These dedicated Utility Slots will be equipped with §Y$LARGE_ARCHAEO_ARMOR$§!.

entries.zh: 遍布舰体的发射器阵列投射出重叠的护盾力场，吸收敌人向我们倾泻的最猛烈的火力。
entries.en: Emitter arrays distributed across the hull project overlapping shield fields, absorbing the worst of what the enemy can throw at us.

entries.zh: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$这些专用槽位将会装有§Y护盾§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$These dedicated Utility Slots will be equipped with §YShields§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 灵能护盾触及了常规偏导护盾无法触碰的现实层面。本该命中的冲击，却落空了。
entries.en: Psionic shielding reaches into layers of reality that conventional deflectors cannot touch. Impacts that should land, do not.
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$These dedicated Utility Slots will be equipped with §Y$LARGE_PSI_SHIELD$§!.

entries.zh: 打捞回收的未知设计的护盾发生器，比现代工程学制造的任何设备都要高效。
entries.en: Recovered shield projectors of unknown design, more efficient than anything modern engineering has produced.
$ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$These dedicated Utility Slots will be equipped with §Y$LARGE_ARCHAEO_SHIELD$§!.

entries.zh: 致密的晶体复合面板附着在外部船体上，可针对所有形式的来袭伤害提供强大的防护。
entries.en: Dense crystal composite panels bonded to the outer hull, offering substantial protection against all forms of incoming damage.

entries.zh: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$这些专用槽位将会装有§Y晶体覆层§!并自动升级到我们最新的科技水平。
entries.en: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_L_UTILITY_SLOTS$\n$t$These dedicated Utility Slots will be equipped with §YCrystal Plating§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 当常规推进器不足时，用于拉近距离或脱离交战的紧急推力系统。
entries.en: Emergency thrust systems for closing distance or breaking engagement when conventional drives aren't enough.

entries.zh: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_AUX_SLOTS$\n$t$这些专用辅助槽位将装备§Y$tech_afterburners_1$§!，并会自动升级至我们的最新技术。
entries.en: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_AUX_SLOTS$\n$t$These dedicated Auxiliary Slots will be equipped with §Y$tech_afterburners_1$§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 能够在撞击前的瞬间选择性硬化船体的反应装甲。
entries.en: Reactive plating that selectively stiffens the hull in the moments before impact.

entries.zh: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_AUX_SLOTS$\n$t$这些专用辅助槽位将装备§Y$tech_armor_hardeners_1$§!，并会自动升级至我们的最新技术。
entries.en: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_AUX_SLOTS$\n$t$These dedicated Auxiliary Slots will be equipped with §Y$tech_armor_hardeners_1$§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: 能够在战斗中切换护盾谐波的频率调制器，可降低那些旨在绕过护盾的武器所造成的穿透力。
entries.en: Frequency modulators that shift shield harmonics mid-combat, reducing penetration from weapons designed to bypass them.

entries.zh: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_AUX_SLOTS$\n$t$这些专用辅助槽位将装备 §Y$tech_shield_hardeners_1$§!，并自动升级至我们的最新技术。
entries.en: $ARKSHIP_COMPONENTS$\n$t$$ADDS_ARKSHIP_AUX_SLOTS$\n$t$These dedicated Auxiliary Slots will be equipped with §Y$tech_shield_hardeners_1$§! automatically upgraded to our latest technology.

entries.zh: §H方舟光环§!\n舰队支援技术的进步使方舟舰现在能够装备与泰坦巨舰使用的同类型光环。
entries.en: §HArkship Auras§!\nAdvances in fleet support technology now allow Arkships to be equipped with auras of the same type as those used by Titans.

entries.zh: 方舟舰的质量使其能够投射出力场，干扰附近敌舰的武器系统，从而降低其射速。
entries.en: The Arkship's mass allows it to project a field that interferes with the weapons systems of nearby enemy vessels, reducing their rate of fire.

entries.zh: 由方舟舰投射的子空间锚定场，可阻止敌方舰船通过超光速手段逃脱。
entries.en: A subspace anchor field projected from the Arkship, preventing enemy vessels from escaping to FTL.

entries.zh: 安装在舰体各处的干扰发射器会压制附近敌舰的护盾，限制其最大防护能力。
entries.en: Interference projectors mounted across the hull suppress the shields of nearby enemy vessels, limiting their maximum protection.

entries.zh: §H方舟光环§!\n舰队支援技术的进步使方舟舰现在能够装备与主宰巨舰使用的同类型光环。
entries.en: §HArkship Auras§!\nAdvances in fleet support technology now allow Arkships to be equipped with auras of the same type as those used by Juggernauts.

entries.zh: 方舟舰广播飞行协调信号，提升附近友方舰载机的战斗力。
entries.en: The Arkship broadcasts flight coordination signals, boosting the combat effectiveness of nearby friendly strike craft.

entries.zh: 方舟舰投射的导航信标改进了舰队中所有舰船的超空间引擎计算。
entries.en: Navigation beacons projected from the Arkship improve hyperdrive calculations for all vessels in the fleet.

entries.zh: 方舟舰发出的电子反制广播扰乱了敌方的点防御瞄准，使我方武器得以突破拦截。
entries.en: Electronic countermeasures broadcast from the Arkship confuse enemy point defense targeting, letting our weapons slip through.

entries.zh: 由方舟舰部署的火控中继提升了整个舰队的轨道轰炸精度。
entries.en: Fire control relays distributed from the Arkship enhance the orbital bombardment accuracy of the entire fleet.

entries.zh: 方舟舰阵列共享的瞄准数据扩大了舰队中每艘舰船的有效交战距离。
entries.en: Targeting data shared from the Arkship's arrays extends the effective engagement range of every ship in the fleet.

entries.zh: 超导电缆网格贯穿船体，消除了电阻损耗，并最大化了向各个系统的电力输送。
entries.en: A lattice of superconductive cabling threaded through the hull, eliminating resistance losses and maximizing power delivery to every system.

entries.zh: 将每一个种植舱和水培甲板推至运行极限的环境控制系统。
entries.en: Environmental controls that push every cultivation bay and hydroponic deck to its operational limit.

entries.zh: 船体的部分区段被改造用于大规模水培种植。
entries.en: Sections of the hull repurposed for large-scale hydroponic cultivation.

entries.zh: 专用处理阵列与舱外活动整备设施，显著增强了方舟船在轨道沉积物收集与提炼方面的作业能力。
entries.en: Dedicated processing arrays and EVA staging infrastructure that expand the Arkship's capacity for collecting and refining orbital deposits.

entries.zh: 外部舰体上的货运轨道与磁力对接系统优化了方舟舰与合作舰船之间的资源传输。
entries.en: Cargo rails and magnetic coupling systems on the outer hull streamline resource transfer between the Arkship and partner vessels.

entries.zh: 行政处理中心分布在多个甲板上，让我们的治理运作如同引擎般顺畅。
entries.en: Administrative processing centers distributed across multiple decks, keeping our governance functioning as smoothly as our engines.

entries.zh: 加速方舟舰上共享意识决策的神经中继集群。
entries.en: Neural relay clusters that accelerate decision-making across the shared consciousness aboard the Arkship.

entries.zh: 专用维修舱确保每个部件在出现问题之前都能得到监控、维护和更换。在太空中，小故障与灾难之间只有一线之隔。
entries.en: Dedicated repair bays ensure that every component is monitored, maintained, and replaced before it can become a problem. In space, the margin between a minor fault and catastrophe is thin.

entries.zh: 装配线被重新用于消费品生产，在满足民众基本需求的同时，提供他们想要的商品。
entries.en: Assembly lines repurposed for consumer production, supplementing what our population needs with what they want.

entries.zh: 合金熔炼设施的运行已达到船体所能安全承受的极限。
entries.en: Alloy smelting facilities running at the limits of what the hull can safely contain.

entries.zh:
这座设施深藏于方舟舰的船体深处，与人口聚居的环形区域相隔绝，专门用于训练具有灵能天赋的个体，使灵能军团得以对全体居民保持密切监视。

§Y灵能军团是你的朋友。信任军团。§!

£job_telepath£ $job_telepath_plural$可产出£unity£ §Y$unity$§!，降低 £crime£ §Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!，并提升$mod_psionic_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$。
entries.en:
Nestled deep within the hull of Arkship, isolated from the populated rings, this facility is devoted to training psi-gifted individuals, allowing the Psi Corps to keep a watchful eye on the population.

§YThe Psi Corps is your Friend. Trust the Corps.§!

£job_telepath£ $job_telepath_plural$ produce £unity£ §Y$unity$§!, decrease £crime£ §Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!, and increase $mod_psionic_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$.

entries.zh:
这座设施位于方舟舰深处，远离人口稠密的环带，专门用于训练有心灵异能天赋的工蜂，并让这批灵能军团监视蜂群。

§Y这批灵能军团能够保护你，相信它们。§!

$job_telepath_drone_effect_desc$

§YThe Psi Corps is your protector. Trust the Corps.§!

这座设施位于方舟舰深处，远离人口稠密的环带，专门用于训练有灵能天赋的单位，并让这批灵能军团巡检无人机群。

§Y这批灵能军团能够保护你，相信它们。§!

entries.en:
Nestled deep within the hull of Arkship, isolated from the populated rings, this facility is devoted to training psi-gifted units, allowing the Psi Corps to keep a watchful eye on the population.

§YThe Psi Corps is your protector. Trust the Corps.§!

entries.zh: 强化主护盾网的次级发射器阵列，为船体增加了另一层保护。
entries.en: Secondary emitter arrays that reinforce the primary shield grid, adding another layer of protection to the hull.

entries.zh: 一个全天候运作的交易大厅，将我们的市场与我们途经的每一个帝国的市场连接起来。
entries.en: A trading floor operating around the clock, connecting our markets to those of every empire we pass through.

entries.zh: 接待来自星系各地使节的外交套房与接待大厅。好客之道，四海皆通。
entries.en: Diplomatic suites and reception halls accommodating envoys from across the galaxy. Hospitality travels well.

entries.zh: 专为贵族保留的镀金居住区，其财富与权势随船同行。
entries.en: Gilded residential quarters reserved for the aristocracy, whose wealth and influence travel with the ship.

entries.zh: 用于管理奴隶人口的处理设施，确保在我们访问的每一个星系中都能保持高效的劳动力分配。
entries.en: Processing facilities for managing slave populations, keeping labor allocations efficient across every system we visit.

entries.zh: 一个允许后代监督和管理恒星系内正在进行的战斗，同时指挥方舟舰上孵化行动的模块。
entries.en: A module allowing an Offspring to oversee and administrate ongoing battles within the system, while also directing spawning operations aboard the Arkship.

entries.zh: 材料收集和加工方面的进步使得我们的方舟舰能够进行行星规模的资源开采，甚至根据需要重塑整个生物群落。
entries.en: Advances in material collection and processing allows our Arkships to engage in planetary-scale resource extraction efforts, or even reshape entire biomes as needed.

entries.zh: $contract_clear_blockers$合约让我们清除阻碍殖民地发展的最常见障碍，以此来帮助星球上的居民。
entries.en: $contract_clear_blockers$ contracts let us help out planet dwellers by removing the most common types of blockers hampering their colonies development.

entries.zh: $contract_stellar_ignition$合约允许我们将气态巨行星转化为新生恒星，为该恒星系解锁巨大的能源和研究资源。
entries.en: $contract_stellar_ignition$ contracts let us transform gas giants into newborn stars, unlocking vast energy and research resources for the system.

entries.zh: $contract_deep_scan$合约能帮助我们在恒星系中发现更多未知事物。
entries.en: $contract_deep_scan$ contracts let us uncover further discoveries in a system.

entries.zh: 我们都是同一星系的公民。每个人在欢迎我们进入其国境时都应该感到安全。
entries.en: We are all citizens of the same galaxy. Everyone should feel safe welcoming us within their borders.

entries.zh: 发动战争以消除我方恒星系内的游牧活动，并从其驿站中缴获物资。
entries.en: War is waged to remove Nomadic presence from our systems and seize materiel on their Waystations.

entries.en: War is waged on a limited scale on behalf of another empire to wreak destruction on colonies.

entries.en: War is waged to subjugate the enemy we struck with our Stellar Cannon.

entries.zh: 该恒星系中有可采集的高价值矿物。
entries.en: There are valuable Minerals in this system that can be harvested.

entries.zh: 采集该恒星系中的可用能量。
entries.en: Harvest the available Energy in this system.

entries.zh: 收集该恒星系内可用的消费品。
entries.en: Collect the Consumer Goods available in this system.

entries.zh: 可以从该恒星系收集高价值的合金。
entries.en: Valuable Alloys can be harvested from this system.

entries.zh: 该恒星系中可以找到罕见的易爆微粒。
entries.en: Rare Volatile Motes can be found in this system.

entries.zh: 这里可以找到罕见的异星天然气。应当采集它们。
entries.en: Rare Exotic Gases can be found here. They should be harvested.

entries.zh: 该恒星系已探测到稀有水晶。采集它们。
entries.en: Rare Crystals have been detected in this system. Harvest them.

entries.zh: 根据扫描结果，该恒星系中存在活体金属。
entries.en: According to scans, there is Living Metal in this system.

entries.zh: 这里可以收获纳米机器人。
entries.en: There are Nanites here that can be acquired.

entries.zh: 该恒星系中丰富的矿藏等待着游牧民采集工前来开采。
entries.en: Rich Mineral deposits in this system await extraction by nomad harvesters.

entries.zh: 该星系中未开发的能源储备可以由游牧舰队来高效抽取。
entries.en: Untapped Energy reserves in this system could be efficiently siphoned by a nomad fleet.

entries.zh: 该恒星系中的可回收消费品非常适合由游牧物流团队进行回收。
entries.en: Salvageable Consumer Goods in this system are well-suited for retrieval by nomad logistics crews.

entries.zh: 这个星系中可回收的合金储藏可以由游牧打捞队提取。
entries.en: Recoverable Alloy caches in this system could be extracted by nomad salvage teams.

entries.zh: 该恒星系中的易爆微粒聚集点需要由游牧采集平台进行安全开采。
entries.en: Volatile Mote concentrations in this system could be safely harvested by nomad collection rigs.

entries.zh: 该恒星系中的异星天然气穴可以通过游牧民的虹吸作业进行采集。
entries.en: Exotic Gas pockets in this system could be captured by nomad siphoning operations.

entries.zh: 该恒星系中的稀有水晶矿脉需要精密开采，而这正是游牧采矿队所擅长的。
entries.en: Rare Crystal formations in this system demand precision extraction that nomad mining crews excel at.

entries.zh: 该恒星系中的活体金属矿痕需要游牧方舟舰所能提供的移动精炼能力方能开采。
entries.en: Living Metal traces in this system demand mobile refinery capacity that a nomad Arkship can provide.

entries.zh: 仅限AI使用的辅助寻路特殊项目。玩家请忽略。
entries.en: AI-only special project to assist in pathfinding. Players please ignore.

entries.zh: 我们必须从§Y[prev.GetName]§!收集资源以履行我们的合同。
entries.en: We must harvest resources from §Y[prev.GetName]§! to fulfill our contract.

entries.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批$r_energy$。
entries.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an $r_energy$ cache in this system.

entries.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批$r_minerals$。
entries.en: Our engineers suspect that there is a $r_minerals$ cache in this system.

entries.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批$r_alloys$。
entries.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an $r_alloys$ cache in this system.

entries.zh: 我们的科学家想要观测这个星系的恒星。
entries.en: Our scientists would like to observe the star of this system.

entries.zh: §L“我们没能完成本该简单的观察任务。”§!
entries.en: §L"We failed what should have been a simple observation mission."§!

雇佣太空游牧民以支持我们间谍网络的扩张。
entries.en: Contract nomads to support the expansion of our spy network.

entries.zh: 通过保障§Y[From.GetName]§!间谍网的扩张，来支援其情报工作。
entries.en: Support the intelligence efforts of the §Y[From.GetName]§! by expanding their spy network.

entries.zh: §L“如果您能谨慎地协助我们，我们将不胜感激。”§!
§L“我们代表集体意识衷心感谢您。”§!
§L“为了我们的安全，我们必须监视异端。”§!
entries.en: §L"We must observe the heretics, for our safety."§!

entries.zh: §L“很显然，神明不赞成我们的窥探。”§!
entries.en: §L"Clearly the deities disapprove of our spying."§!

entries.zh: §L“扩大监控将保护我们的潜在资产。”§!
entries.en: §L"Surveillance expansion will protect our potential assets."§!

entries.zh: §L“现在我们可以更早地发现市场趋势。”§!
entries.en: §L"We can spot market trends sooner now."§!

entries.zh: 我们必须在该星系部署一颗间谍卫星，以履行我们的合约。
entries.en: We must deploy a Spy Satellite in this system to fulfill our contract.

entries.zh: 我们被委派走私关键任务物资，以支援间谍网络。
entries.en: We have been tasked with smuggling critical mission supplies to support the Spy Network.

entries.zh: 我们需要协助潜入该星系的一个恒星基地。
entries.en: Our assistance is required to infiltrate a Starbase in this system.

entries.zh: 我们的战争需要增援。需要一支游牧民战斗舰队来扭转战局。
entries.en: Our wars demand reinforcements. A nomad battle fleet could tip the balance.
Join the §Y[From.GetName]§! in all their wars.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们的停战协定不允许我们此时此刻加入战争。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§ROur truces prevent us from joining wars at this time.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们不会参战攻击我们的盟友。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RWe may not join wars against our allies.§!

entries.zh: §L“集体意识需要一些军事上的辅助支援。”§!
entries.en: §L"The Collective has need of military auxiliaries."§!
§L"Our minds may not be one, but our purpose unites us."§!

entries.zh: §L“加入战斗！让我们的敌人尝尝惨败的苦涩滋味！”§!
entries.en: §L"Join us in battle! Let our foes taste bitter defeat!"§!

entries.zh: §L“欢迎登舰！愿胜利与我们同在。”§!
entries.en: §L"Welcome aboard! May victory be with us."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们需要你在武装冲突解决方面的专业知识。”§!
entries.en: §L"We require your expertise in armed conflict resolution."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们由衷感谢你们提供的军事援助。”§!
entries.en: §L"We are grateful for your military support."§!

entries.zh: 这个恒星系的潜在资源尚未探明。游牧方舟舰可以对其进行深度扫描。
entries.en: This system's potential remains unmapped. A nomad Arkship could perform a deep scan.

entries.zh: 对该系统进行深度扫描，以评估其资源和战略相关性。
entries.en: Complete a Deep Scan of this system to assess its resources and strategic relevance.

entries.zh: §L“请在这些空间坐标处进行全光谱分析。”§!
entries.en: §L"Please perform a full spectrum analysis at these spatial coordinates."§!

entries.zh: §L“你连简单的扫描都完成不了？真令人失望。”§!
entries.en: §L"You failed to complete a simple scan? This is disappointing."§!

entries.zh: §L“本集体意识建议进行全光谱分析。”§!
entries.en: §L"The collective recommends a full spectrum analysis."§!
§L"Assess this piece of prime spatial real estate!"§!

entries.zh: §L“这是建立泛星系购物中心的好地方。想想那利润！”§!
entries.en: §L"Great place for a galactic mall. Think of the profit!"§!

entries.zh: §L“这下我们该如何投资这个恒星系？”§!
entries.en: §L"How are we supposed to invest in this system now?"§!
§L"We seek signs of the divine here."§!

entries.zh: §L“这个恒星系受到了祝圣！万分感谢。”§!
entries.en: §L"This system is blessed! You have our thanks."§!

entries.zh: §L“是你的扫描仪坏了，还是你背弃了我们？”§!
entries.en: §L"Did you scanner break, or have you forsaken us?"§!

entries.en: We must analyze §Y[prev.GetName]§! to fulfill our contract.

entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RNone of our Arkship has §YDeep Scan§! capabilities§!

entries.zh: §L“去掠袭他们，但别告诉他们是我们让你这么做的。”§!
entries.en: §L"Raid them, but don't tell them we told you to do it."§!
§L"Thank you. It had to be done."§!

entries.zh: §L“任务失败！我们会联系其他劫掠者。”§!
entries.en: §L"The mission is a failure! We will contact other raiders."§!
§L"The collective is preoccupied with internal matters."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们作为一个整体，感谢你提供的力量。”§!
entries.en: §L"As one, we thank you for your strength."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们作为一个整体，深表失望。”§!
§L“一个利润丰厚的劫掠机会，机不可失，时不再来！”§!
§L“我们投资战争技术实乃明智之举。”§!
entries.en: §L"We were wise to invest in warfare technology."§!

entries.zh: §L“唉，神明必将降罪于他们。还有你。”§!
entries.en: §L"Alas, the deities will smite them. And you."§!

entries.zh: §L“你毫无诚信，这将导致你的毁灭。”§!
entries.en: §L"You have no integrity. It will be your downfall."§!

entries.zh: 代表§Y[from.GetName]§!轰炸行星以积累§Y荒废度§!。
entries.en: Bombard planets on behalf of §Y[from.GetName]§! to build up §YDevastation§!.

entries.zh: 某些殖民地需要游牧舰队从轨道进行强有力的说服才愿意服软。
entries.en: Certain colonies require forceful persuasion from orbit that nomad fleets can deliver.

entries.zh: 代表§Y[from.GetName]§!轰炸属于目标的§Y任何§!殖民地，以增加§Y荒废度§!。
entries.en: Bombard §Yany§! colony belonging to the target on behalf of §Y[from.GetName]§! to build up §YDevastation§!.

entries.zh: 这种规模的巨型结构将极大地受益于游牧工程师的专业知识。
entries.en: A megastructure of this scale would benefit greatly from the expertise of nomadic engineers.
Assist with the construction of a Megastructure.

entries.zh: §L“带上你的方舟舰和你最优秀的工程师。”§!
entries.en: §L"Bring your Arkship and your best engineers."§!

entries.zh: §L“这是一座令人印象深刻的建筑。你做得很好。”§!
entries.en: §L"It is an impressive structure. You have done well."§!

entries.zh: §L“所以呢？我们还得自己把它造出来？”§!
entries.en: §L"So, what? We're just supposed to build it ourselves?"§!
§L"The collective calls upon your engineering skill."§!

entries.zh: §L“你帮助了我们。作为一个整体，我们心存感激。”§!
entries.en: §L"You have helped us. As one, we are grateful."§!

entries.zh: §L“[GetBrainName]真的很想建成那个巨型结构……”§!
§L“请接受这份令人振奋的建筑合同！”§!
§L“太棒了！你的工作完成得非常出色！”§!
entries.en: §L"Superb! Well done for hitting your deliverables!"§!

entries.zh: §L“我们投资了你，而你没能达到预期。”§!
entries.en: §L"We invested in you, and you failed to deliver."§!

entries.zh: §L“兴建一座配得上神明的巨型结构！”§!
entries.en: §L"Erect a megastructure worthy of the deities!"§!

entries.zh: §L“愿福佑于你，亦于我们的新巨型结构。”§!
entries.en: §L"Blessings upon you, and upon our new megastructure."§!

entries.zh: §L“由于缺乏巨型结构，我们的精神世界变得萎靡不振。”§!
entries.en: §L"Our spirits are dampened by the lack of megastructure."§!

entries.zh: 前往§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!协助建造巨型结构即可完成此合约。
entries.en: This Contract can be completed by traveling to §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! to assist with the construction of a Megastructure.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R该恒星系内没有建造中的§Y巨型结构§!。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThere is no §YMegastructure§! being built in this system§!

entries.zh: 我们的外交代表团需要搭乘游牧方舟舰安全前往§Y[capital_scope.GetName]§!。
entries.en: Our diplomatic delegation requires safe passage to §Y[capital_scope.GetName]§! aboard a nomad Arkship.
Transport delegates to §Y[from.capital_scope.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh: §L“代表们已安全送达。你应该认真考虑将星系出租车司机作为你的职业生涯。”§!
entries.en: §L"The delegates have been safely delivered. You should consider a job with Galactic Taxis."§!

entries.zh: §L“感谢您照顾我们的利益相关者。”§!
entries.en: §L"Thank you for taking care of our stakeholders."§!
§L"If you're on time, you're late. Learn to grind."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们寻求与群星之间的手足同胞进行交流。”§!
entries.en: §L"We seek communion with our stellar siblings."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们的结合得到了神明的祝福。”§!
entries.en: §L"Our communion was blessed by the deities."§!

entries.zh: §L“是灵体抛弃了我们，还是你辜负了我们？”§!
entries.en: §L"Have the spirits failed us, or have you?"§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThis country is not a valid target§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们必须与该恒星系所有者建立通讯。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RWe must establish communications with this system's owner§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$§RMust be issued in a Capital system§!

entries.zh: 我们必须接上这些代表。
entries.en: We must pick up the delegates.

entries.zh: 我们必须把这些代表送达目的地。
entries.en: We must drop off the delegates.

entries.zh: 我们必须把外交代表们送到这个恒星系。
entries.en: We must deliver the delegates to this system.

entries.zh: 我们必须将乘客带去§Y[dropoff_planet.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的§Y[dropoff_planet.GetName]§!
entries.en: We must bring our passengers to §Y[dropoff_planet.GetName]§! in the §Y[dropoff_planet.solar_system.GetName]§! system

entries.zh: 扫描一场战斗之后留下的残骸。
entries.en: Scan the debris left behind after a battle.

entries.zh: 我们可以征集一些太空游牧民来扫描我们最近战斗后留下的残骸。
entries.en: We can enlist some nomads to scan the debris left behind from our recent battle.

entries.zh: §L“很有趣！如果再次发生，我们会通知您的。”§!
entries.en: §L"Interesting! We will let you know if it happens again."§!

entries.zh: §L“别再让我们失望了，否则下次留下的就会是你自己的残骸。”§!
entries.en: §L"Don't fail us again, or next time it will be your own wreckage."§!
§L"Initiate scanning. Report back with your findings."§!

entries.zh: §L“[GetBrainName] 尚未收到您的扫描结果。这不太理想。”§!
entries.en: §L"The [GetBrainName] has not received your scans. Sub-optimal."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们需要出于保险目的进行独立评估。”§!
entries.en: §L"We require an independent assessment for insurance purposes."§!
§L"Good, yes. It seems the driver was at fault."§!

entries.zh: §L“没扫描？这简直是情感上坐了个过山车。我们要起诉你方！”§!
entries.en: §L"No scan? This is emotional whiplash. We'll sue!"§!

entries.zh: §L“太可惜了，它们被毁掉了。在此表示哀悼与祈祷。”§!
entries.en: §L"Such a pity they were destroyed. Thoughts and prayers."§!

entries.zh: §L“他们现在可能在一个更好的地方。”§!
entries.en: §L"They're probably in a better place now."§!

entries.zh: §L“这让我们感到悲伤。我们对你的信心已经减少了。”§!
entries.en: §L"This saddens us. Our faith in you has diminished."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们太忙了，以至于无暇扫描身后留下的残骸。”§!
entries.en: §L"We are too busy to scan the wreckage we leave in our wake."§!

entries.zh: §L“如果我们还粉碎了其他任何敌人，我们会让你知道的。”§!
entries.en: §L"We will let you know if we pulverise anyone else."§!

entries.zh: §L“别再让我们失望了，否则下次留下的就会是你自己的残骸。”§!
entries.en: §L"Don't fail us again, or next time it will be your own wreckage."§!

entries.zh: 前往§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!扫描残骸即可完成此合约。
entries.en: This Contract can be completed by traveling to §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! to Scan Debris.

entries.zh: 自然障碍限制了我们殖民地的发展，但游牧行星工程师能迅速将其清除。
entries.en: Natural obstacles limit our colony's development, but nomad planetary engineers can make short work of them.

entries.zh: 清理该帝国的殖民地上所有的行星自然障碍。
entries.en: Clear every Natural Planetary Blockers from this Empire's Colony.

entries.zh: §L“我们将不胜感激您的行星工程造诣。”§!
entries.en: §L"We would appreciate your planetary engineering prowess."§!

entries.zh: §L“好多了。我们现在有空间扩建了。”§!
entries.en: §L"Much better. We now have space to expand."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们会告诉熟人，在园林绿化方面你并不可靠。”§!
entries.en: §L"We will tell our acquaintances that you are unreliable when it comes to landscaping."§!

entries.zh: §L“感谢你为集体清除了这些地表障碍。”§!
entries.en: §L"You have the collective's thanks for removing these obstacles."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们常用的地面清理公司已经约满了。”§!
entries.en: §L"Our usual removals company is fully booked."§!

entries.zh: §L“高效清除。五星好评。会再次聘用。”§!
entries.en: §L"Efficient removal. Five stars. Would hire again."§!

entries.zh: §L“请勿就移除费用向我方开具发票。此类发票将被忽略。”§!
entries.en: §L"Do not invoice us for removals. It will be ignored."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们祈请您能协助我们清理这些地表障碍。”§!
entries.en: §L"We pray you can assist us with these obstacles."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们的祈祷得到了回应。我们不再受阻。”§!
entries.en: §L"Our prayers are answered. We are blocked no more."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们依然受阻。我们会为你祈祷。”§!
entries.en: §L"We remain blocked. We will pray for you."§!

entries.zh: 前往§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!清理障碍即可完成此合约。
entries.en: This Contract can be completed by traveling to §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! to Clear Blockers.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R需要该恒星系内存在拥有£blocker£ ['concept_natural_blockers']的殖民地§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RRequires a Colony with £blocker£ ['concept_natural_blockers'] in the system§!

entries.zh: 在我们的恒星系修建驿站将开启新的经济机遇。
entries.en: A waystation in our system would open up new economic opportunities.

entries.zh: 在此帝国的某个恒星系中建造一座驿站。
entries.en: Build a Waystation in this Empire's system.

entries.zh: §L“请帮助我们连接到星系贸易路线。”§!
entries.en: §L"Help us connect to galactic trade routes."§!

entries.zh: §L“星系现在感觉变小了，是以一种好的方式。”§!
entries.en: §L"The galaxy feels smaller now, in a good way."§!

entries.zh: §L“你是觉得我们不配拥有一个驿站吗？”§!
entries.en: §L"Do you think us unworthy of a Waystation?"§!

entries.zh: §L“我们渴望连结。我们却一无所获。”§!
entries.en: §L"We wished for connection. We have received nothing."§!
§L"We want to bring in more trade."§!
§L"This will do wonders for the economy."§!

entries.zh: §L“你今天树立了一个经济上的对手。当心点。”§!
entries.en: §L"You have made an economic rival today. Watch out."§!

entries.zh: §L“建立一座驿站，引导朝圣者走向我们。”§!
entries.en: §L"Build a Waystation to guide pilgrims to us."§!

entries.zh: §L“太棒了。这将使我们更接近神性。”§!
entries.en: §L"Wonderful. This will bring us closer to the divine."§!

entries.zh: §L“朝圣者现在该如何找到自己的道路？”§!
entries.en: §L"How will pilgrims find their way now?"§!

entries.zh: 前往§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!建造驿站即可完成此合约。
entries.en: This Contract can be completed by traveling to §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! and building a Waystation.

entries.zh: 为了履行合约，我们必须在这个恒星系建立一个驿站。
entries.en: We must build a Waystation in this system to fulfill our contract.

entries.zh: 敌对的太空兽群盘踞在这个恒星系，需要游牧战斗小队来清除它们。
entries.en: Hostile space fauna infest this system, but nomad combat crews can clear them out.

entries.zh: 该恒星系的太空兽群正给我们带来麻烦。请铲除它们。
entries.en: The Space Fauna in this system are causing us problems. Please eradicate them.
§L"Kill these pests, please and thank you."§!
§L"Ah, the system is much safer now."§!
§L"The pests are still there! This is unacceptable."§!

entries.zh: §L“这些兽群正在干扰集体的计划。”§!
entries.en: §L"These fauna are interfering with the collective's plans."§!

entries.zh: §L“[GetBrainName]对你干脆果断的行动表示感激。”§!
entries.en: §L"The [GetBrainName] is thankful for your swift action."§!

entries.zh: §L“缺乏害虫防治的情况，这并不理想。”§!
entries.en: §L"The lack of pest control is sub-optimal."§!

entries.zh: §L“太棒了！现在我们可以把害虫入侵免责声明去掉了。”§!
entries.en: §L"Brilliant! Now we can drop the infestation disclaimer."§!

entries.zh: §L“对于由太空兽群造成的任何损害，我们概不负责。”§!
entries.en: §L"We will not accept liability for any damage caused by space fauna."§!

entries.zh: §L“这些不敬神灵的畜生正在亵渎它们栖息的空间。”§!
entries.en: §L"These ungodly critters are desecrating the space they inhabit."§!
§L"Glory to you, the eradicator of pests."§!

entries.zh: §L“闹事的兽群是神圣的对立面。”§!
entries.en: §L"Hostile fauna is the antithesis of holiness."§!

entries.zh: §L“为什么你除掉这些病害就这么难？”§!
entries.en: §L"Why is it so hard for you to destroy vermin?"§!

entries.zh: 通过消灭目标恒星系中的太空兽群，即可完成此合约。
entries.en: This Contract can be completed by wiping out the Space Fauna in the target system.

entries.zh: 为了履行合约，我们必须消灭该恒星系中的太空兽群。
entries.en: We must destroy the Space Fauna in this system to fulfill our contract.

entries.zh: 我们的监狱人满为患，需要一艘游牧民的方舟舰替我们接手这些囚犯。
entries.en: Our prisons are overcrowded, and a nomad Arkship could take these convicts off our hands.

entries.zh: 从§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!接收罪犯。我们将按认为合适的方式驱逐他们，并可以选择将他们留在船上或送往另一个殖民地。我们不应将他们带回属于§Y[from.GetName]§!的行星。\n\n在接收囚犯后，选择将他们§Y留在船上§!，或使用方舟舰指令“§Y$arkship_drop_off_prisoners$§!”将他们§Y捎到§!我们选择的殖民地。
entries.en: Pick up criminals from §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!. We are to deport them as we see fit, and can choose to either keep them aboard or drop them off on another colony. We are not supposed to bring them back to a planet owned by §Y[from.GetName]§!.\n\nAfter collecting the prisoners, choose to either §YKeep Them§! aboard or to §YDrop Them Off§! at a colony of our choice using the §Y$arkship_drop_off_prisoners$§! Arkship action.

entries.zh: 派遣一艘方舟舰前往此恒星系接收囚犯，并推进合约进度。
entries.en: Enter this system with an Arkship to collect the prisoners and progress the contract.

entries.zh: 我们安排了游牧民遣送大部分囚犯。移除这些骚乱分子对平息本殖民地的犯罪率起到了奇效。
entries.en: We arranged for nomads to deport a vast part of our carceral population. The removal of these disruptive elements has done wonders to quell the crime rates on this colony.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R需要该恒星系存在有£job_criminal£ $job_criminal_plural$的殖民地§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RRequires a Colony with £job_criminal£ $job_criminal_plural$ in the system§!

entries.zh: 解锁§Y囚犯移交§!方舟舰指令。\n\n

$ARKSHIP_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—移除§Y$nomad_criminals_on_board$§!修正。转移最多§Y300§!名£pop£ 人口至该行星。

$PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—添加§Y$nomad_criminals_dropped_off$§!修正，持续 §Y10£time£ 年§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—如果行星拥有方的解码等级足够高，可以发现此行为。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—格式塔帝国、罪犯殖民地、奴隶世界和突触车床不受这些效果影响。

§G此行动将完成§Y$contract_prisoner_disposal$§!合同§!
entries.en:
$ARKSHIP_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Removes the §Y$nomad_criminals_on_board$§! modifier. Transfer up to §Y300§! £pop£ Pops to the planet.
