 $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Adds the §Y$nomad_criminals_dropped_off$§! modifier for §Y10 £time£ Years§!.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Can be detected by the planet owner if they have high enough Decryption$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Gestalts Empires, Penal Colonies, Thrall Worlds and Synaptic Lathes are exempt of these effects.

§GThis action will complete the §Y$contract_prisoner_disposal$§! Contract§!

entries.zh: §L根据合约带上船的罪犯可以由我们自行决定去留。他们在方舟舰上的存在扰乱了和平。我们应当迅速处理他们。§!
entries.en: §LThe criminals brought onboard as part of our contract can be dropped off at our discretion. Their presence on the Arkship is disturbing the peace. We should deal with them promptly.§!

entries.zh: 我们遇到的§Y[From.GetName]§!是一个§H游牧§!文明。他们似乎愿意承担我们发布的§H合约§!工作，以换取微薄的费用。\n\n这可能为我们之间的协作提供有趣的契机，我们可以利用他们在轨道开发和探索方面的专业知识来为我们谋利。
entries.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! we met are a §HNomadic§! civilization. They appear to be willing to pick up §HContract§! work on our behalf in exchange for a modest fee.\n\nThis could present interesting opportunities for collaboration between us, and we could leverage their expertise in orbital exploitation and exploration to our benefit.

entries.zh: §G在查看星系图时，右键点击恒星系即可§H发布合约§!。§!
entries.en: §GRight-click on a System while viewing the Galaxy Map to §HIssue Contracts.§!§!

entries.zh: §L“我们致力于进一步推进物理学研究。全新的方法或许能带来决定性的改变。”§!
entries.en: §L"We seek to push our physics research further. A fresh approach could make all the difference."§!

entries.zh: §L“你们的研究人员推进了我们对物理宇宙的理解。”§!
entries.en: §L"Your researchers have advanced our understanding of the physical universe."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们期待的是物理学突破，而不是死胡同。”§!
entries.en: §L"We expected physics breakthroughs, not dead ends."§!

entries.zh: 游牧方舟拥有独特的实验条件，能够加速我们的物理学研究。
entries.en: Nomad Arkships have unique laboratory conditions that could accelerate our physics research.

entries.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究$r_physics$。
entries.en: Conduct $r_physics$ aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

entries.zh: §L“我们致力于深化我们的社会与生物学研究。外部观察者往往能注意到我们所忽视的地方。”§!
entries.en: §L"We seek to deepen our societal and biological research. Outside observers often notice what we overlook."§!

entries.zh: §L“你方的社会学研究成果拓宽了我们的认知。”§!
entries.en: §L"Your societal research has broadened our understanding."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们聘用你们是为了取得社会突破，而不是要这些毫无定论的数据。”§!
entries.en: §L"We contracted you for societal breakthroughs, not inconclusive data."§!

entries.zh: 游牧方舟舰上多样化的人口可以为我们的社会研究提供宝贵的数据。
entries.en: The diverse populations aboard nomad Arkships could provide valuable data for our societal studies.

entries.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究$r_society$。
entries.en: Conduct $r_society$ aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

entries.zh: §L“我们的工程项目还有发展空间。让你们的应用科学为我们效劳吧。”§!
entries.en: §L"Our engineering projects have room to grow. Put your applied sciences to work on our behalf."§!

entries.zh: §L“你们对工程学的独特理解提升了我们的工业能力。”§!
entries.en: §L"Your engineering insights have advanced our industrial capabilities."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们期待的是工程学突破，而不是回收的旧蓝图。”§!
entries.en: §L"We expected engineering breakthroughs, not recycled blueprints."§!

entries.zh: 游牧方舟舰是应用工程学的奇迹。他们的专业知识能使我们自己的工程项目受益。
entries.en: Nomad Arkships are marvels of applied engineering. Their expertise could benefit our own projects.

entries.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究$r_engineering$。
entries.en: Conduct $r_engineering$ aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

entries.zh: §L“我们希望你们的工程师找到开采当地矿产资源的新方法。”§!
entries.en: §L"We want your engineers to find new ways to exploit the local mineral resources."§!

entries.zh: §L“在你方的帮助下，发现了新的矿藏。”§!
entries.en: §L"With your aid, new deposits have been uncovered"§!

entries.zh: §L“我们要的是新的矿物来源，而不是借口。”§!
entries.en: §L"We expected new mineral sources, not excuses."§!

entries.zh: 游牧专家可以应用先进的勘探技术来丰富该星系的矿藏。
entries.en: Nomad specialists could apply advanced survey techniques to enrich the mineral deposits in this system.

entries.zh: 在方舟舰上研究$r_engineering$，以改善该恒星系现有的$r_minerals$矿脉分布。
entries.en: Conduct $r_engineering$ aboard an Arkship to improve existing $r_minerals$ deposits in this system.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R该恒星系中所有£minerals£矿物来源均已被发现§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RAll sources of £minerals£ Minerals in this system have been discovered§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R该恒星系中未发现可开采的£minerals£矿物储备§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RNo improvable £minerals£ Minerals deposit found in this system§!

entries.zh: 将该恒星系中的一个£minerals£§H矿物矿藏§!提升§G+1§!、§G+3§!或§G+5§!级。
entries.en: Improves a £minerals£ §HMinerals Deposit§! in this system by §G+1§!, §G+3§!, or §G+5§! levels.

entries.zh: §L“我们的传感器读数表明该星系存在异常能量信号。我们缺乏精确定位它们的手段。”§!
entries.en: §L"Our sensor readings suggest anomalous energy signatures in this system. We lack the means to pinpoint them."§!

entries.zh: §L“令人失望。我们原本期待的，不仅仅是含糊的读数和空洞的保证。”§!
entries.en: §L"Disappointing. We had hoped for more than vague readings and empty assurances."§!

entries.zh: 游牧专家可以模拟该系统的能量动态，以改进现有能量来源。
entries.en: Nomad specialists could model the energy dynamics of this system to improve existing sources.

entries.zh: 开展$r_physics$研究以改进该恒星系中现有的$r_energy$来源。
entries.en: Conduct $r_physics$ to improve existing sources of $r_energy$ in this system.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R该恒星系中所有£energy£能源的来源均已被发现§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RAll sources of £energy£ Energy in this system have been discovered§!

entries.zh: 将该恒星系内一处£energy£§H能量蕴藏§!提升§G+1§!、§G+3§!或§G+5§!级。
entries.en: Improves an £energy£ §HEnergy Deposit§! in this system by §G+1§!, §G+3§!, or §G+5§! levels.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R在该恒星系中未发现可改良的£energy£能量矿藏§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RNo improvable £energy£ Energy deposit found in this system§!

entries.zh: §L“这个星系中可能存在可采集的生物资源，但我们需要外部帮助才能找到它们。”§!
entries.en: §L"There may be harvestable biological resources in this system, but we need outside help to find them."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们的商店仍和以前一样空空如也。这可不是我们当初同意的结果！”§!
entries.en: §L"Our stores remain as empty as before. This was not the outcome we agreed on!"§!

entries.zh: 游牧专家可以分析该恒星系中的有机体活动痕迹，以改善现有的食物储备。
entries.en: Nomad specialists could analyze organic traces in this system to improve existing food deposits.

entries.zh: 在方舟舰上研究$r_society$，以提高该星系中可开发的$r_food$储量。
entries.en: Conduct $r_society$ aboard an Arkship to improve exploitable deposits of $r_food$ in this system.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R该恒星系内所有£food£食物来源均已被发现§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RAll sources of £food£ Food in this system have been discovered§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R在该恒星系中未发现可改善的£food£食物储备§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RNo improvable £food£ Food deposit found in this system§!

entries.zh: 将该恒星系中的一处£food£§H食物储备§!提升§G+1§!、§G+3§!或§G+5§!级。
entries.en: Improves a £food£ §HFood Deposit§! in this system by §G+1§!, §G+3§!, or §G+5§! levels.

entries.zh: 带领一群游客进行一场银河观光之旅。
entries.en: Take a group of tourists on a galactic sightseeing tour.

entries.zh: 登上游牧方舟舰的旅行，将带来任何旅行社都无法媲美的奇观。
entries.en: A tour aboard a nomad Arkship promises the kind of spectacle no travel agency can match.

entries.zh: §L“我们有想要观光游览的游客！”§!
entries.en: §L"We have tourists who wish to see the sights!"§!

entries.zh: §L“太空旅游是一个蓬勃发展的市场！”§!
§L“观光旅游是一项有利可图的事业！”§!
§L“带领这些朝圣者踏上一场升天之旅。”§!
entries.en: §L"Take these pilgrims on a celestial tour."§!

entries.zh: §L“他们所求的不过是窥见神迹。”§!
entries.en: §L"All they wanted was a glimpse of the divine."§!

entries.zh: 前往此地接送参加观光游的游客。
entries.en: Go here to pick up the tourists for the sightseeing tour.

entries.zh: 前往此地，带领游客参观景点。
entries.en: Go here to show the tourists the tour sights.

entries.zh: 前往此地，送抵观光团的游客返回。
entries.en: Go here to drop off the tourists from the sightseeing tour.

entries.zh: 带游客游览这个恒星系。
entries.en: Bring the tourists to sightsee this system.

entries.zh: 带游客前往$SYSTEM|Y$恒星系观光。
entries.en: Bring the tourists to sightsee the $SYSTEM|Y$ system.

entries.zh: 将游客送回他们的母星系。
entries.en: Return the tourists to their home system.

entries.zh: 将$SYSTEM|Y$恒星系中的游客送回家园。
entries.en: Return the tourists home to the $SYSTEM|Y$ system.

entries.zh: 巡游旅行的尚存余韵，激励着上层阶层产出更高的效率。
entries.en: The cruise's afterglow still lingers, inspiring the upper stratas to greater productivity.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R该恒星系内的殖民地要有休假疗养的需求§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RRequires a colony in the system in need of vacation§!

entries.zh: 协助让这个新殖民地设立且高效地运转起来。
entries.en: Help get this new colony up and running efficiently.

entries.zh: 我们新设立的殖民地需要经验丰富的人手，而游牧民族曾从无到有地建立起文明。
entries.en: Our fledgling colony needs experienced hands, and nomads have built civilizations from nothing.
§L"Our new colony needs a helping hand."§!

entries.zh: §L“殖民地目前正处于良好的发展趋势上。”§!
entries.en: §L"The colony is now on a good path."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们的殖民者必须自力更生。”§!
entries.en: §L"Our colonists will have to manage on their own."§!

entries.zh: §L“这个殖民地是极佳的投资机会！”§!
entries.en: §L"This colony is a prime investment opportunity!"§!

entries.zh: §L“我们预期的增长数据全毁了。”§!
§L“指引我们的信徒，在这片神圣的土地上安顿下来。”§!
entries.en: §L"Guide our faithful as they settle this sacred ground."§!

entries.zh: §L“神灵眷顾我们的新家。祝福你。”§!
entries.en: §L"The deities smile upon our new home. Bless you."§!

entries.zh: §L“孤立无援的挣扎会使虔诚者更加强大。”§!
entries.en: §L"Struggling without help will make the faithful stronger."§!

entries.zh: §L“加固这个前哨站。它必须处于随时待战的状态。”§!
entries.en: §L"Fortify this outpost. It must be battle-ready."§!

entries.zh: §L“稳固的据点。这块殖民地将坚守阵线。”§!
entries.en: §L"A strong foothold. This colony will hold the line."§!

entries.zh: §L“没有防御工事的殖民地是一种累赘。”§!
§L“此物理站点需要优化。请协助初始化。”§!
entries.en: §L"This physical site requires optimization. Assist with initialization."§!

entries.zh: §L“物理站点已运行。您的贡献已记录。”§!
entries.en: §L"Physical site operational. Your contribution has been logged."§!

entries.zh: §L“初始化不完整。效率受到影响。”§!
游牧文明的民用品专家们已协助建立了殖民地并使其繁荣发展，确保了岛上居民补给充足且生活舒适。
entries.en: Nomadic civilian specialists have helped set up the colony to thrive, ensuring its inhabitants are well-supplied and comfortable.

entries.zh: 游牧文明的研究小组已在殖民地建立了现地实验室，加速了其科学发展。
entries.en: Nomadic research teams have set up field laboratories on the colony, accelerating its scientific development.

entries.zh: 游牧文明的军事工程师加固了殖民地的基础设施，提升了其工业产出。
entries.en: Nomadic military engineers have reinforced the colony's infrastructure, bolstering its industrial output.

entries.zh: [fromfrom.GetName]获得一个§G有利的§!行星修正，具体取决于完成合约的§Y方舟舰类型§!。
entries.en: [fromfrom.GetName] gains a §Gbeneficial§! planet modifier based on the §Ytype of Arkship§! that completes the contract.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R要求殖民地建立时间少于10年且未获得过支持§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RRequires a colony that is less than 10 years old and that has not been supported§!

entries.zh: 使用方舟舰的$sm_arkship_stellar_igniter$将气态巨行星转化为新生恒星，为该恒星系解锁海量资源。
entries.en: Use the Arkship's $sm_arkship_stellar_igniter$ to transform a gas giant into a newborn star, unlocking vast resources for the system.

entries.zh: 我们恒星系中的一颗气态巨行星点燃时机已然成熟，一艘游牧方舟便可点亮一颗新的太阳。
entries.en: A gas giant in our system is ripe for ignition, and a nomad Arkship could light a new sun.

entries.zh: §L“我们有一颗随时可以点燃的气态巨行星。带上你的$sm_arkship_stellar_igniter$。”§!
entries.en: §L"We have a gas giant ripe for ignition. Bring your $sm_arkship_stellar_igniter$."§!

entries.zh: §L“曾经只有气体与暗影的地方，如今闪耀着一颗新太阳。令人惊叹。”§!
entries.en: §L"A new sun blazes where once there was only gas and shadow. Remarkable."§!

entries.zh: §L“气态巨行星依然寒冷而黑暗。错失良机。”§!
entries.en: §L"The gas giant remains cold and dark. A missed opportunity."§!

entries.zh: §L“第二颗恒星的预期投资回报率是天文数字。”§!
entries.en: §L"The projected ROI on a second star is astronomical."§!

entries.zh: §L“两个太阳，双倍的游客。预订观光游轮吧！”§!
entries.en: §L"Two suns, twice the tourists. Book the sightseeing cruises!"§!

entries.zh: §L“我们向利益相关者承诺过一颗星星。这是无法接受的。”§!
entries.en: §L"Our stakeholders were promised a star. This is unacceptable."§!

entries.zh: §L“神圣的火花在那沉睡的巨人体内等待。唤醒它。”§!
entries.en: §L"The divine spark awaits within that slumbering giant. Awaken it."§!

entries.zh: §L“天火仍未点燃。也许是我们不配。”§!
entries.en: §L"The celestial fire remains unlit. Perhaps we were unworthy."§!

entries.zh: §L“一颗新星意味着对该星区的战略主导权。去办吧。”§!
entries.en: §L"A new star means strategic dominance over this sector. Make it happen."§!

entries.zh: §L“一整颗仅凭纯粹意志铸就的恒星。”§!
entries.en: §L"An entire star forged by sheer force of will."§!

entries.zh: §L“如果再有一颗恒星，这个恒星系会更具战略价值。”§!
entries.en: §L"This system would be more strategically valuable with another star."§!

entries.zh: §L“气态巨行星聚变概率：可行。启动恒星点火序列。”§!
entries.en: §L"Gas giant fusion probability: viable. Initiate stellar ignition sequence."§!

entries.zh: §L“恒星点火成功。能量输出在预期参数范围内。”§!
entries.en: §L"Stellar ignition successful. Energy output within projected parameters."§!

entries.zh: §L“行星点火程序中止。未达到聚变阈值。”§!
entries.en: §L"Ignition sequence aborted. Fusion threshold not achieved."§!

entries.zh: 到这里点燃气态巨行星。
entries.en: Go here to ignite the gas giant.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R需要该恒星系中有一颗没有异常现象，且未被点燃的气态巨行星§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RRequires an unignited gas giant without an anomaly in the system§!

entries.zh: 被点燃的气态巨行星变成了一颗恒星，解锁了海量的资源。
entries.en: The ignited gas giant turns into a star, unlocking vast resources.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们的方舟舰均不具备§Y恒星引擎§!功能§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RNone of our Arkships have §YStellar Engine§! capabilities§!

entries.zh: 来自§H[pickup_planet.GetName]§!的外交使团已经登上了方舟舰，并正以符合§H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!大使身份的礼遇规格受到接待。
entries.en: The diplomatic delegation from §H[pickup_planet.GetName]§! has boarded the arkship and are being accommodated with all the respect due to ambassadors from the §H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: $nomads.3036.intro$我们规划了一系列活动，包括方舟舰参观和关于我们生活方式的宣讲，以便让他们在前往§H[dropoff_planet.GetName]§!的旅途中过得愉快。
entries.en: $nomads.3036.intro$ We have planned a schedule of activities including arkship tours and presentations on our lifestyle to keep them entertained during the journey to §H[dropoff_planet.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: $nomads.3036.intro$他们为我们提供了有关§H[dropoff_planet.owner.GetName]§!的外交情报，我们利用这些情报建立了正式联系。
entries.en: $nomads.3036.intro$ They brought us diplomatic intelligence regarding the §H[dropoff_planet.owner.GetName]§! that we used to establish formal communications.

entries.zh: 让我们平安地将他们送达目的地。
entries.en: Let us bring them safely to their destination.

entries.zh: 来自§H[diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName]§!的代表团已经抵达目的地。他们的外交访问现在可以正式开始了，我们祝愿他们的和平事业取得成功。
entries.en: The delegates from the §H[diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName]§! have arrived at their destination. Their diplomatic visit can now officially begin, and we wish them success in their peaceful endeavors.

entries.zh: 为了解决§H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!的麻烦，一批我们同意负责转移的罪犯搭着运输船已经登上方舟。我们正尽最大努力安全地安置他们，但如此庞大数量的囚犯迟早会惹出麻烦。\n\n我们的合同为我们提供了处理他们的多种选择，但我们不能把他们再次丢在属于§H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!的星球上。同时，其他帝国很可能也不会喜欢他们的某个殖民地突然涌入大量罪犯。当然，如果我们做得足够隐秘，他们可能永远都不会发现我们到底做了什么。
entries.en: Transport ships carrying the criminals that we have accepted to transfer on behalf of the §H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§! have boarded the arkship. We are doing our best to safely process them, but such a vast amount of prisoners is bound to create trouble at one point or another.\n\nOur Contract gives us options on how to handle them, but we are not supposed to drop them off again on a world belonging to the §H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!. At the same time, it is likely that other empires will not appreciate a sudden influx of criminals in one of their colonies. Of course, if we are discreet enough, they might never realize what we've been up to.

entries.zh: 我们会把他们送到别的地方。
entries.en: We'll drop them off somewhere else.

entries.zh: 作为我们合约的一部分，最后一批囚犯已经卸客。我们已尽力保持谨慎，但总是存在被发现的风险，且人们在面对突然涌入的外星罪犯时，很少会感到愉快。
entries.en: The last prisoners carried as part of our contract have been disembarked. We have tried our best to remain discreet, but detection is always a risk, and people are rarely pleased when faced with a sudden influx of xeno criminals.

entries.zh: 我们参与运输罪犯人口的消息尚未传开。看来我们还没有被发现。
entries.en: Word of our involvement in the transport of criminal pops has yet to spread. It seems we have not been detected.

entries.zh: 我们试图欺骗[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]，但是失败了。虽然罪犯已成功卸载，但我们的行动已被发现，[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]已取消合约并拒绝向我们支付报酬。
entries.en: Our attempt at double crossing the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has failed. While the criminals have been successfully disembarked, we have been detected and the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has cancelled the contract and refuse to pay us.

entries.zh: 虽然我们的行动已被发现，但[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]依然很高兴我们帮他们处理掉了罪犯，并同意向我们全额支付报酬。
entries.en: While we have been detected, the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] is still pleased that we rid them of their criminals, and have agreed to pay us in full.

entries.zh: 一个旅行团在§H[root.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系登上了方舟舰，一边叽叽喳喳地聊着对旅途的期待一边踏入熙熙攘攘的舰船内舱。\n\n我们订制了一条景色优美的路线，途经若干个值得一去的恒星系供他们游览。现在我们只需要交付好许诺给他们的美景就行了。
entries.en: A group of tourists has boarded the Arkship in the §H[root.solar_system.GetName]§! system, chattering with anticipation as they take in the bustling interior of the vessel.\n\nWe have charted a scenic route through several remarkable systems for their enjoyment. Now we need only deliver the spectacle they were promised.

entries.zh: 可以在§H情报日志§!追踪目标恒星系。
entries.en: The target system can be tracked in the §HSituation Log§!.

entries.zh: 游客欣赏着§H[root.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系的美景，惊叹于身边的种种奇景。当踏上归途时，他们将再也不同往日了，因为对宇宙之广阔的一手认知将会重塑他们。
entries.en: The tourists enjoyed the sights in the §H[root.solar_system.GetName]§! system, marveling at the wonders around them. They will return home changed, carrying with them first-hand knowledge of the vastness of the universe.

entries.zh: 在代表§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!执行合同期间，我们偶然发现了一批古老的集装箱。它们被冰块包裹着，我们差点把它们误认为是普通的陨石。虽然从打捞权的角度来看，这些物品在技术上属于我们，但考虑到它们是在为他们工作时发现的，我们应该考虑将它们移交给§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!。扫描这些箱子后，发现里面……
entries.en: While working on a contract on behalf of the §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!, we chanced upon a collection of ancient containers. Encased in ice, we almost mistook them for plain asteroids. While technically ours by right of salvage, we should consider turning them over to the §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§! as they were retrieved while working on their behalf. Scanning the crates revealed...

entries.zh: 我们方舟舰上的一些老旧模块在一次严重的冷却故障后受损，已经显得老态龙钟。损坏程度很大，好在飞船的完整性受到威胁之前已经进行紧急关停。我们该如何应对？
entries.en: Some older modules on our Arkship have begun to show their age after a critical cooling failure left them damaged. The damage is extensive, but an emergency shutdown was triggered before the Arkship's integrity could be compromised. How should we proceed?

entries.zh: 没事，反正也到时候替换了。
entries.en: It's fine, it was time to replace them anyway.

entries.zh: 现在是时候进行一些升级了。
entries.en: This is a good time for some upgrades.

entries.zh: 别担心，我们有充足的备件。
entries.en: No worries, we have plenty of spare parts.
We could make the client pay for it...

entries.zh: §L……根据合同第56条第18款奥米克戎修订案。§!
entries.en: §L... As per Paragraph 56, Alinea 18, Revision Omicron of the contract.§!

entries.zh: 一种创新的冷却系统，使我们能够回收部分模块空间用于居住，并利用热输出满足家庭和工业需求。
entries.en: An innovative cooling system that allowed us to reclaim some module space for habitable quarters, with the benefit of harnessing thermal output towards domestic and industrial needs.

entries.zh: 是时候对我们的方舟舰模块进行一些更改了。
entries.en: It is time to make some changes to our arkship modules.

entries.zh: 在从§Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!装载物资时，我们检测到其中一个货舱发生了收容失效。据报告，安全门另一侧传来了低沉的轰鸣声，证实了舱室内存在潜在危险。\n\n我们要冒险进行调查吗？
entries.en: While loading materials from the §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!, we detected a containment breach in one of the cargo bays. Deep rumbling noises were reported from the other side of the security doors, confirming the presence of a potential hazard within the compartment.\n\nShould we chance an investigation?

entries.zh: 别拿方舟舰冒险，直接把货物抛入太空。
entries.en: Let's not risk the Arkship, space the cargo.

entries.zh: 货舱门开启后，一群发光生物体令我们措手不及，它们随即窜入了方舟舰的其他区域。异星生物学家的报告显示，这些生物没有攻击性，对我们的公民或飞船的完整性不构成威胁。\n\n这些微小的生物拥有椭圆形的身体，由修长的肢体支撑，能够攀爬墙壁和天花板，并以惊人的速度移动。它们似乎以我们生态系统中的小型害虫为食，利用胸部的发光腺体引诱猎物。居民们已经适应了它们的存在，并发现它们在夜晚格外讨人喜欢——它们发出的光亮和柔和的鸣叫构成了一场令人惬意的奇观。
entries.en: Upon opening the cargo deck doors, a swarm of bioluminescent organisms took us by surprise and scurried in the rest of arkship. Xenobiologist reports indicate that these beings are non-aggressive and pose no threat to our citizens or to the ship's integrity.\n\nThe tiny creatures posses an oval shaped body, supported by elongated limbs, and are capable of climbing walls and ceilings while moving at remarkable speed. They appear to feed on small vermin-like critters from our ecosystem, luring them over with bioluminescent glands located in their thorax. Already, inhabitants have gotten used to them, and find them to be especially pleasing at night, when their lights and soft chirps offer a comfortable spectacle.

entries.zh: 开始针对它们的生物发光特性进行实验。
让方舟舰的居民尽情享受这奇迹。
entries.en: Let the Arkship inhabitants enjoy the wonder.

entries.zh: 尽管进行了广泛搜寻，我们的团队仍无法在此时已归于沉寂的货舱中找到骚乱的源头。正当他们准备离开时，一个小生物从阴影中钻了出来，扑向一名船员制服上挂着的一根松散线头。\n\n船员们最初吃惊不小，但很快便判定这只外星生物生性顽皮，并无攻击性。当它被小心翼翼地拿近观察时，这个外星动物发出了一种微弱的、类似马达运转的震动，这被解读为一种表示舒适的良性反应。
entries.en: Despite an extensive search, our team could not isolate the source of the ruckus in the now silent hold. As they prepared to exit, a small creature emerged from the shadows and pounced on a loose strand of fabric hanging from a crewmate's uniform.\n\nInitially startled, the crew soon determined that the alien to be playful in nature, rather than aggressive. When carefully handled for closer inspection the foreign animal emitted a faint, motor-like vibration interpreted as a benign comfort response.

entries.zh:
进入货舱后，船员们发现其中一个货运集装箱被从内部破开了。一台受损的机械体瘫在甲板上，电机仍在嗡嗡作响，指示灯紊乱地闪烁着。

船员们试图将该单位放回集装箱，就在这时，一个隐藏隔层打开了，一堆闪烁的水晶散落在地板上。

在永久关机前的一瞬间，机械体发出了一声微弱的低语，据船员报告，其内容为：“别关掉我，我不一样。”
entries.en:
Upon entering the cargo deck, the crew discovered that one of the cargo containers had been breached from within. A damaged mechanoid lay sprawled across the deck plating, motors still whirring and indicator lights blinking erratically.

The crew attempted to return the unit to its container, at which point a hidden compartment opened, releasing a collection of shimmering crystals onto the floor.

Immediately prior to its permanent shutdown, the mechanoid emitted a faint vocalization, reported by crew members as: "Don't shut me down, I am different."

entries.zh: 我们会将其退还给失主。
entries.en: We will send it back to the owner
Scrap it and take the crystals.

entries.zh: 靠近货舱时，怪声仍在持续，我们认为采取广泛的安全预防措施极具必要。进入货舱层后，船员们发现舱室内弥漫着强烈的有害异味，并注意到货架碎片散落在停泊区各处。片刻之后，相邻的货柜内发生了几次小型爆炸，引发了紧急响应。\n\n团队循着烟雾痕迹发现了一处小火点。专业人员迅速将其扑灭，使船员能够在事态进一步升级前，安全地控制并中和这些易挥发气体。货舱层出现了明显的结构性损坏，周边区域的多处货箱也遭到了破坏。
entries.en: The weird noises continued when approaching the cargo bay, warranting extensive safety precautions. Upon entry into the cargo deck, crew members detected a strong, noxious odor filling the compartment and noticed pieces of holding crates scattered across the dock. Several minor explosions went off moments later within adjacent cargo containers, prompting an immediate response.\n\nThe team followed a trail of smoke, discovering a small fire that had broken out. It was quickly suppressed by specialist personnel, allowing the crew to safely contain and neutralize the volatile gases before further escalation. The cargo deck exhibited visible structural damage, along with multiple nearby crates in the surrounding area.

entries.zh: 我们及时阻止了进一步的损害。
entries.en: We prevented further damage just in time.
Make the issuer pay for damages.

entries.zh:
进入货舱后，骚乱愈演愈烈。声学读数显示源头指向一个货箱。队员们做好了最坏的打算，片刻之后，一个人影从货箱中冲了出来。

此人操着一口浓重且陌生的口音，声称自己带着和平而来。此人自称是§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§!，并表示[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe]曾是某个庞大舰队组织的一员，后因纪律原因被开除。[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeSheCap]解释说，[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe]潜伏在船上，掩盖[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]自己的行踪是为了寻求庇护，并渴望有机会证明[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]的价值。

§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§!询问队员们是否愿意接受[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHisHer]提议。
entries.en:
Upon entering the cargo bay, the disturbance intensifies. Acoustic readings trace the source to a single cargo crate. The team prepares for the worst as, moments later, an individual bursts free from its confinement.

They claim to come in peace, speaking with a pronounced and unfamiliar accent. They identify themselves as §Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§! and state that [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe] was once part of a larger fleet organization before being expelled for disciplinary reasons. [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeSheCap] explains that [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe] concealed [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]self aboard the vessel in search of safety and an opportunity to prove [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer] usefulness.

§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§! asks whether the team is willing to accept [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHisHer] proposal.

entries.zh: 我们曾处于水深火热之中，直到§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§!控制了局面并被授予方舟舰的领导权。
entries.en: We were in dire straits until §Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§! took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship.

entries.zh: 对我们来说，你不过是货物。我们会按要求把你送到。
entries.en: You're nothing but cargo to us. We will deliver you as required.

entries.zh: 送你回到你该去的地方吧，叛徒。
entries.en: Let's send you back to where you came from, traitor.

entries.zh: 当舱门打开时，那些异常的噪音戛然而止。由于无法确定骚乱的原因，团队开始对货物集装箱进行系统扫描。\n\n其中一个集装箱显示出多个意料之外的生命体征。强行打开后，发现其中有几个人，明显营养不良，身体状况极差。“请发发慈悲，”其中一人说道。“我们遭到了迫害，被迫从§Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!帝国逃亡。我们听凭您的发落。”
entries.en: The anomalous noises cease immediately when the doors open. Unable to determine the cause of the disturbance, the team begins a systematic scan of the cargo containers.\n\nOne of them registers multiple unexpected life signatures. Breaking it open reveals several individuals, visibly malnourished and in poor physical condition. "Please, have mercy," says one. "We were persecuted and forced to flee from §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§! Empire. We submit ourselves to whatever fate you deem appropriate."

entries.zh: 我们应该把他们遣送回去。
告诉我们你所知道的，我们会带你前往目的地。
entries.en: Tell us what you know and we will bring you to your destination.

entries.zh: 我们的方舟舰上还有空余位置。
entries.en: We have space on the Arkship.

entries.zh: 在我们与§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。
entries.en: A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: $nomads.contract_event_header$他们希望在合约有效期内观察并记录方舟舰上的生活。\n\n似乎对大多数定居文明而言，游牧的生活方式依然令人着迷，且充满着不小的神秘感。
entries.en: $nomads.contract_event_header$ They wish to observe and document life aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.\n\nIt seems that to most settled civilizations, the nomadic way of life remains a subject of fascination and no small degree of mystery.

entries.zh: $nomads.contract_event_header$他们希望在合约有效期内记录方舟舰的运作情况。\n\n他们的既定目标是研究一个在常规行星参数之外运行的移动自治网络，关于这一课题目前几乎没有外部数据可供参考。
entries.en: $nomads.contract_event_header$ They wish to document Arkship operations during the active contract period.\n\nTheir stated objective is the study of a mobile autonomous network operating outside conventional planetary parameters, a subject for which little external data exists.

entries.zh: $nomads.contract_event_header$他们要求在合约有效期内获得在方舟舰上的观察权。\n\n该请求源自个体研究人员，他们试图理解一种超出其记录经验的集体移动生存方式。
entries.en: $nomads.contract_event_header$ They are requesting observation rights aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.\n\nThe request originates from individuated researchers seeking to comprehend a form of collective mobile existence outside their documented experience.

entries.zh: 热烈欢迎贵国前来考察！
给予有限权限，但是得给钱。
entries.en: Grant limited access, for a fee.

entries.zh: 方舟不是可供观赏的游乐场。
entries.en: The Arkship is not a spectacle.

entries.zh: $nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n两个船员部门之间出现了关于哪个团队拥有操作权限的管辖权争议。双方均已提交正式投诉，受影响区域的工作效率已开始下降。
entries.en: $nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nA jurisdictional dispute has emerged between two crew departments over which team holds operational authority. Both have submitted formal complaints, and productivity in the affected area has begun to suffer.

entries.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

相互冲突的优先指令导致两个管理子系统之间出现了处理冲突。

双方均将自身标记为当前合约的授权操作单位，导致系统陷入循环待机状态，从而降低了产出效率。
entries.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

Competing priority directives have caused a processing conflict between two management subsystems.

Each has flagged itself as the authorized operational unit for our current contract, resulting in a recursive standby loop that is reducing output efficiency.

entries.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

集合体的运作共振中出现了一个不和谐的线程。

关于当前合约内的责任划分，两个子集群开始发出相互冲突的行为模式，为共享意识引入了低效因素。
entries.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

A dissonant thread has emerged within the collective's operational resonance.

Two sub-clusters have begun emitting conflicting behavioral patterns regarding the delineation of responsibilities within our current contract, introducing an inefficiency into the shared consciousness.
We don't have time for this.

entries.zh: 一项管辖权争议已得到正式解决。凝聚力有所增强，不过在更新程序期间，施工进度暂时放缓。
entries.en: A jurisdictional dispute has been formally resolved. Cohesion has improved, though construction operations have been temporarily slowed while procedures are updated.

entries.zh: 争议领域的运营权已被重新分配。这在内部协调中引发了摩擦。
entries.en: Operational authority over the disputed domain has been reassigned. This has introduced friction across internal coordination.

entries.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

方舟舰的内部监控系统报告称，劳工阶层船员的士气出现恶化。一份要求获得一段休整期的正式请求已被提交。

该请求已抄送至[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，对方正等待回复，并必然会要求修改条款。
entries.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

The Arkship's internal monitoring systems have flagged a deterioration in crew morale among the worker strata. A formal request for a period of rest has been submitted.

The request has been copied to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will expect a response and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

entries.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

诊断周期发现，多个主次系统积累了大量延期的维护任务。效率预测表明，安排一次定期维护将使劳动力产出获得具有统计学意义的显著提升。

该报告已提交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，其将密切关注此事的处理情况，并势必会要求修改条款。
entries.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

Diagnostic cycles have flagged an accumulation of deferred maintenance tasks across several primary and secondary systems. Efficiency projections indicate a statistically significant improvement to workforce output would follow a scheduled maintenance period.

The report has been flagged to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will be monitoring how the matter is handled, and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

entries.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

我们记录到了我们的$planet_jobs_simple_drone$中日益严重的不协调现象。它们的劳作过程需要一段同步恢复期，因为持续的压制有导致集体产出出现显著下降的风险。

[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]已获悉此情况，并且必然会要求修订条款。
entries.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

We have registered a growing dissonance within our $planet_jobs_simple_drone$. Their labor processes requires a period of synchronized recovery, as continued suppression risks measurable decline in collective output.

[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName] has been made aware of the situation and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

entries.zh: §R这份合约的完成时报酬将减少25%。§!
entries.en: §RThis contract's completion payout will be reduced by 25%.§!

entries.zh: 方舟舰的劳工群体已获批一段法定休息期。各生产甲板的士气与产出效率均有所提升。
entries.en: A period of sanctioned rest has been authorized for the Arkship's worker population. Morale and output efficiency have improved across production decks.

entries.zh: 为了完成合约，员工的休息请求被拒绝。生产阶层的士气受到了压制。
entries.en: The workforce's request for rest was refused in the interest of contract completion. Morale among production strata is suppressed.

entries.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

我们作为承包商的良好业绩已声名远播。§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!在监控泛星系贸易活动时注意到了这一点，现在将我们视为一个可靠且有能力的合作伙伴。

我们现在有机会进一步培养这份关系，或者也可以将功劳让给我们自己信任的合作伙伴。
entries.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

Word of our track record as a contractor has traveled. §H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!, monitoring galactic trade activity, has taken note, and now views us as a reliable and capable partner.

An opening exists to cultivate the relationship, or possibly to defer credit to our own trusted partners.

entries.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

我们在已完成合同中记录的运营数据已被外部观察者获取。§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!在追踪该区域的自主网络活动时，注意到了我们的效率指标，并认为我们是一家可靠且有实力的承包商。

通讯频道已建立。我们可以接受这一评价，或者将功劳转交给我们的现有合作伙伴。
entries.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

Operational data logged across completed contracts has been accessed by external observers. §H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!, tracking autonomous network activity in the region, has flagged our efficiency metrics as consistent with a reliable and capable contractor.

A channel has been established. We may acknowledge the assessment, or redirect attribution to our existing partners.

entries.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

在观察整个星域的贸易与劳动力流动时，§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!注意到了我们行动中的规律，这彰显了我们的可靠与能力。

认可的共鸣已经到来。我们可以予以回应，或者让其他蜂巢主脑的声音将这一信号传递下去。
entries.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!, observing the flow of trade and labor across the sector, has recognized a pattern in our movements, one that speaks to reliability and capability.

The resonance of recognition has arrived. We may answer it, or let another voice carry the signal forward.

entries.zh: 向他们保证我们的善意。
entries.en: Assure them of our good intentions.

entries.zh: 好名声就是它自己最好的回报。
entries.en: A good reputation is its own reward.

entries.zh: $nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n对合约所涉及区域的初步和远程扫描已证实富有成效。数据具有相当大的商业价值，一位独立经纪人已主动提出全面收购。
entries.en: $nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nPreliminary and long-range scans of the contract region have proved fruitful. The data holds considerable commercial value, and an independent broker has reached out offering to purchase the collection outright.

entries.zh: 将数据作为合约的补充部分交付。
entries.en: Deliver the data to as a supplement to the contract.

entries.zh: 存档下来，后续为我们自己使用。
entries.en: Archive it for our own use.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!帝国现在对方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!抱持有更加正面的态度
entries.en: The §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§! Empire now holds a more favorable view of Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!帝国现在对方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!抱持有更加负面的态度
entries.en: The §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§! Empire now holds a more negative view of Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 一个从被焚净的世界中活下来的幸存者，浑身都是累累伤痕，拥有不知疲倦的纪律，并誓言向所有犯下这种暴行的人复仇。
entries.en: A scarred survivor of a purged world, wielding tireless discipline and swearing vengeance against all who commit such atrocities.

entries.zh: 把屠夫们带到我面前，我将以十倍的残忍回报他们。
entries.en: Show me the butchers, and I will return their cruelty tenfold.

entries.zh: §H那人以军人的姿态登舰，面容因悲痛和多年的流亡而变得坚毅。他的声音低沉、从容，带着钢铁般的锋利。§!\n\n“我的世界被清洗了，我的族人，我的家人……唯我幸存。我隐忍至今。而那些毁灭的始作俑者，必将死于我手。”
entries.en: §HThe figure steps aboard with a soldier's bearing, their features hardened by grief and long years of exile. Their voice is low, measured, and edged with iron.§!\n\n"My world was cleansed, my people, my family... I alone survived. I endure. And the architects of annihilation will die by my hand."

entries.zh:
§H此人停顿下来，仿佛说出自己的名字会撕裂旧伤。§!

“一个名字尚存，尽管其意义已成灰烬。我曾是一名士兵，忠诚而顺从。如今，我是一个被毁灭民族的影子。

如果你非要称呼我，就叫我$NAME_nomadic_revenant$吧。我的过去已不再重要。重要的只有那未偿还的血债。”
entries.en:
§HThey pause, as if speaking their own name tears at an old wound.§!

"A name remains, but its meaning is ash. I was a soldier once, dutiful and obedient. Now I am the shadow of a people destroyed.

"Call me $NAME_nomadic_revenant$, if you must. My past no longer matters. Only the debt of blood unpaid."

entries.zh: “你的方舟舰不带任何暴政的旗帜。这便是我站在你面前的原因。我很久以前就明白，一颗星球便是一座牢笼。一旦屠杀开始，便无处可逃。但你们在移动，因此你们能经受磨难。”\n\n“追随你们，此类惨剧或可被蔑视，而我的利刃也将转向那些行下屠行的屠夫。”
entries.en: "Your Arkship carries no flag of tyranny. That is why I stand before you. I learned long ago that a planet is a cage. Once the slaughter begins, there is no escape. But you move, and so you endure.\n\n"With you, such horrors may be defied, and my blade turned against the butchers who commit them."

entries.zh:
“复仇。”

§H这两个字在空气中凝滞。陌生人探身向前，每一根筋腱都因强压下的怒火而绷得紧紧的。§!

“向那些进行清洗的人复仇，向那些屠杀无辜者却将其称之为‘政策’的人复仇。

为了看到这些怪物覆灭，我不惜跨越万水千山，忍受任何伤痛。

助我一臂之力，我将以效忠于你来践行我的誓言。”
entries.en:
"Vengeance."

§HThe word hangs in the air. The stranger leans forward, every sinew drawn tight with barely contained rage.§!

"Vengeance on those who purge, on those who slaughter the innocent and call it 'policy.'

"To see such monsters undone, I will cross any distance, endure any wound.

"Aid me, and I will seal my oath in your service."

entries.zh: 你能否在追求个人目标的同时，也为我们的事业效力？
entries.en: Can you serve our cause while pursuing your own?

entries.zh:
“复仇是我的志向，但不必成为你的负担。只要那些星球屠夫尚存一息，我便会追猎不止。在为你效劳的过程中，我将磨砺我的利刃。”

§H他们的目光变得锐利，掠食者般的锋芒穿透了自律的面具。§!

“请以我带来的力量来评价我，而非我留下的伤痕。”
entries.en:
"Vengeance is my purpose, but it need not be your burden. So long as planetary butchers draw breath, I will hunt them. In your service I shall sharpen my blade."

§HTheir gaze sharpens, a predatory gleam breaking through the mask of discipline.§!

"Judge me by the strength I bring, not the scars I bear."

entries.zh: §H紧接着发出的那声咕哝，是他们最接近笑声的反应。§!\n\n“如果是呢？熟络就能换来同情吗？身体不过是工具。而我的身体，将收割复仇。”
entries.en: §HThe grunt that follows is as close as they come to laughter.§!\n\n"And if I was? Does familiarity buy me sympathy? A body is a tool. Mine will reap vengeance."

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_nomadic_revenant$§!作为一名§H英杰领袖§!加入了我们的方舟舰。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_nomadic_revenant$§! joins our Arkship as a §HParagon Leader§!.

entries.zh: $t$—在$NAME_nomadic_revenant$的指挥下，每在舰队战斗中击败一个曾进行过种族灭绝的帝国，特质效果便会增加§G+5%§!（最高可达§G20%§!）。
entries.en: $t$- With $NAME_nomadic_revenant$ in command, trait effects increase by §G+5%§! (up to §G20%§!) for each purge-committing empire defeated in fleet combat.

entries.zh: 这位领袖身上刻满了一颗遭到屠杀的星球的伤痕。他誓言永恒复仇，其存在激励着身边战友更猛烈地打击那些犯下此类暴行的人。
entries.en: This leader carries the scars of a purged world. Swearing eternal vengeance, their presence drives allies to strike harder at those who would commit such atrocities.

entries.zh:
敌方舰队在我们的攻击下溃败。他们的信号逐渐没入静默。

§Y$NAME_nomadic_revenant$§!注视着监视屏，沉默不语。这场胜利中没有喜悦，只有清算。那个奉行大清洗的帝国的旗帜在虚空中燃烧，但在随后的死寂中，他们的誓言依然回荡。

“每击倒一个这样的敌人，都会磨炼我们的意志。我们将继续打击那些推行灭绝政策的人，永不言弃。”
entries.en:
The enemy fleet breaks against our assault. Their signals fade into static.

Watching on the view screen, §Y$NAME_nomadic_revenant$§! does not speak. There is no triumph in this victory, only reckoning. The banner of a purge-committing empire burns in the void, but in the silence that follows, their promise endures.

"Each such foe cast down steels our resolve. We will continue to strike against those who practice annihilation, and we will not relent.
Effects of the $leader_trait_nomadic_revenant$ trait increase by §G+5%§!.

entries.zh: §H指挥官§!§Y$NAME_nomadic_revenant$§!已经完成了自身的复仇。
亚夏尔在星际间漫游，教导世人：真正的智慧如同星光，在虚空中静静流淌。
entries.en: Ashar wanders the stars, teaching that true wisdom flows like starlight through the void.
The one who carries nothing bears all things.

entries.zh: §H你面前站着一位穿着仪式礼袍的流浪者，饰品与织物的排列显然经过精心打理。反重力伺服器嗡嗡地震动着，驱动着一本法典漂浮在她面前。当她终于开口时，每个字听起来都不像是回答，而更像是一个未问出口的问题的回响。§!\n\n“意外与命运生着别无二致的面孔，而今天它转向了你。”
entries.en: §HBefore you stands a wanderer robed in ceremonial layers, ornaments and fabrics arranged with deliberate care. Antigravity servos within the codex that floats before her cause it to hum and gently vibrate. When she finally speaks, each word feels less like an answer than the echo of an unasked question.§!\n\n"Accident and destiny share one face, and today it turns toward you."

entries.zh: “名字如容器；我的名字恰巧是$NAME_nomadic_sage$。但唯有虚空的容器，方能成就其用。”
entries.en: "A name is a vessel; mine happens to be $NAME_nomadic_sage$. But only the empty vessel can serve its purpose."

entries.zh:
“那些陈旧梦想毫无意义。唯有在运动中，指引方能流淌；唯有在变革中，智慧方能呼吸。”

§H异星人的存在感如同件无重量的斗篷般降临，连空气似乎都在其陪伴下凝固了。§!

“告诉我：人若不是在寻找那缺失之物，又是在寻找什么呢？”
entries.en:
"The settled dream without meaning. Only in motion can counsel flow, and only in change can wisdom breathe."

§HThe alien's presence settles like a weightless mantle, the air itself seeming to fall still in her company.§!

"Tell me instead: what does anyone seek, if not what is absent?"

entries.zh: §H外星人沉默了许久，仿佛满足于让这份寂静作为回答。也许她并非在权衡你的话语，而是在掂量发问者的分量。§!\n\n“为了入座你的阴影，为打破沉寂时的话语，为了提醒你连星辰也在流浪。”
entries.en: §HThe alien pauses for a long time, as though content to let her silence answer. Perhaps she is not weighing your words, but the worth of the one who asked them.§!\n\n"To sit in your shadow, to speak when silence fails, to remind you that even the stars wander."

entries.zh: 你的智慧果真如此超群吗？
entries.en: Is your wisdom truly so great?

entries.zh:
§H一瞬之间，她的目光变得犀利，你内心深处的某些东西被展露无遗。§!

“若果真如此，我便无需开口。智慧是倾听的回响，而非言语的分量。

“如果你听到了，那么智慧便已属于你。”
entries.en:
§HFor a heartbeat, her gaze grows piercing, and something in you is laid bare.§!

"If it were, I would not need to speak. Wisdom is the echo of listening, not the weight of words.

"If you hear, then wisdom is yours already."

entries.zh: §H$NAME_nomadic_sage$流露出一抹恼怒的神色，转瞬即逝，犹如掠过星间的残影。§!\n\n“那我就直说了：王座终将腐朽，疆界皆为谎言，唯有虚空永恒。如果这还不够直白，那或许是因为它还不够单纯。”
entries.en: §H$NAME_nomadic_sage$ betrays a glimmer of irritation, fleeting as a shadow across the stars.§!\n\n"Plainly, then: thrones rot, borders lie, and only the void endures. If that is too plain, perhaps it is not plain enough."

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_nomadic_sage$§!作为一名§H英杰领袖§!加入了我们的方舟舰。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_nomadic_sage$§! joins our Arkship as a §HParagon Leader§!.

entries.zh: $t$—当$NAME_nomadic_sage$在内阁任职时，§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§!技能等级每提升一级可使§Y$pop_cat_ruler_plural$§!产出增加§G+3%§!（最高§G+15%§!）。\n$t$—$NAME_nomadic_sage$不占用领袖上限。
entries.en: $t$- While $NAME_nomadic_sage$ serves on the Council, §Y$pop_cat_ruler_plural$§! job efficiency: §G+3%§! per §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§! skill level (up to §G+15%§!).\n$t$- $NAME_nomadic_sage$ does not use Leader Capacity.

entries.zh: $NAME_nomadic_sage$不担负指挥的重任，但所有与她同行的人都会发现自己的步伐变得更加稳健。真正的智慧能为领导者扫清障碍。
entries.en: $NAME_nomadic_sage$ carries no burden of command, yet all who walk beside her find their own steps steadier. True wisdom clears a path for those who lead.

entries.zh: 曾任$grand_archive$的策展人$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$离开了那无尽的库房，转而追求游牧生活。他的日志中绘满了关于那些呼吸、生长与演变的星球的素描。
entries.en: Once the curator of a $grand_archive$, $NAME_nomadic_naturalist$ abandoned its endless vaults to seek a nomadic life. His journals overflow with sketches of worlds that breathe, grow, and change.
To study life, one must walk beside it.

entries.zh: §H眼前的身影显然已届高龄，但其目光中却流露出对发现的强烈渴望。他的动作沉稳且安静，带着那种在野外躬耕一生的谨慎与洗练。§!\n\n“向您致敬。我叫小塞罗。”
entries.en: §HThe figure before you is plainly aged, yet his gaze betrays a restless hunger for discovery. There is a quiet steadiness to his movement, the careful economy of one who has spent a lifetime in the field.§!\n\n"I bow to you. I am called Sero the Younger."

entries.zh: 你为了什么而来到此地？
entries.en: What brings you to this place?

entries.zh: “许久以前，我曾在一座$grand_archive$供职。但我厌倦了那些毫无生气的事物。化石、种子、标本……一切都冻结在呼吸之间。我渴望见到生命最真实的面貌。”\n\n“你们运动不息。当你们扫描深空时，深空亦会回响。如果你们愿意接纳我，我更想在生者之中学习。探索新世界，遇见奇异的生命形式……我们将学习它们教予我们的一切。”
entries.en: "Many cycles past I served in a $grand_archive$. But I tired of dead things. Fossils, seeds, specimens... all frozen mid-breath. I wished to see life as it is.\n\n"Your people move, and when you scan the depths, the depths answer. If you'll have me, I would rather learn among the living. Exploring new worlds, meeting strange forms of life... Together, we will learn what they can teach us."

entries.zh:
§H一声干涩、壳质的摩擦声从塞罗的大颚中传出。片刻之后，你才意识到那是笑声。§!

“在那些宏伟的厅堂之内，他们保存了一切，唯独遗忘了当下。经过长年的效力，我意识到档案馆最大的缺失正是生命本身。”

“事实上，我最近遇到了一种非凡的未开智物种。尽管它们以宁静的姿态忍受着囚禁的生活，但这样的生物并非为笼子而生。像您这样的一艘飞船，能为它们提供茁壮成长所需的空间。”
entries.en:
§HA dry, chitinous rasp escapes Sero's mandibles. A moment later, you realize it is laughter.§!

"Within those vast halls they preserve everything except the moment. After long years of service, I realized the Archive's greatest omission was life itself.

"In fact, I have recently encountered a remarkable pre-sapient species. They have endured their life in captivity with quiet grace, yet such beings were not made for cages. A ship like yours would grant them the space they require to thrive."

entries.zh: 你希望在我们这里发现什么？
entries.en: What do you hope to find with us?

entries.zh:
“会呼吸的模式。咏唱着数据的星球……”

§H他的附肢握紧又伸展开，仿佛想要从空气中攫取答案。§!

“星系中动植物之间的界限，比我以前在档案局的同事们所认为的还要模糊。生命总能找到模糊分类的方法。也许，这就是它唯一的规则。”
entries.en:
"Patterns that breathe. Worlds that sing their data..."

§HHis appendages grasp and strain, as if seeking to pluck the answer from the air.§!

"The line that separates the galaxy's flora and fauna is thinner than my former colleagues at the Archive believed. Life finds a way to blur categories. Perhaps that is its only rule."

entries.zh:
§H外星人瞥向视窗，以及那片无尽星海。§!

“经验。耐心。一种洞察表象之下规律的方法。

“在你的旅程中给我留个位置，我将助你更深刻地观察，并从你发现的世界中更全面地学习知识与经验。”
entries.en:
§HThe alien glances toward the viewport, and the endless sea of stars.§!

"Experience. Patience. A way to see the patterns that lie beneath the surface.

"Give me a berth on your journey, and I will help you see more deeply, and learn more fully from the worlds you discover."

entries.zh: 你长得很像我们的同类。

“是的！是的，我一直盼着你能注意到。”

§H他凑得比必要的距离更近，螯牙因难以抑制的兴奋而颤动着。§!

“分段结构、承重关节、感觉丝……这些相似之处太精确了，绝非巧合。”

§H他爆发出一阵尖厉的笑声。§!

“如果这其中存在共同的祖先、趋同演化，或者某种更离奇的联系，我必须好好检查一下……噢！我们一定能从彼此身上学到很多东西！”
entries.en:
"Yes! Yes, I was hoping you would notice."

§HHe leans closer than strictly necessary, mandibles flexing with barely restrained excitement.§!

"Segmented structure, load-bearing joints, sensory filaments... The similarities are too precise to be coincidence."

§HHe releases a burst of chittering laughter.§!

"If there is a shared ancestry, a convergent evolution, or something stranger still, I must examine it properly... Oh! We are going to learn so much from one another!"

entries.zh: 发现生命，亦是被生命所改变。每一个新物种，每一种奇特的生态，都在教会我们如何更好地生活。
entries.en: To find life is to be changed by it. Each new species, each strange ecology teaches us how to live a little better.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$§!作为一名§H英杰领袖§!加入我们的方舟飞船，并带来了§G300§!§H$job_xeno_zoo_animal_plural_with_icon$§!。需要建造一座£building£ §H异星动物园§!才能获得其产出收益。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$§! joins our Arkship as a §HParagon Leader§!, bringing §G300§! §H$job_xeno_zoo_animal_plural_with_icon$§!. An £building£ §HAlien Zoo§! is required to benefit from their output.\n\n

entries.zh: $t$—当分配至方舟舰时，提升深度扫描能力。\n$t$—允许对宜居行星进行深度扫描。
entries.en: $t$- Improves Deep Scanning when assigned to an Arkship.\n$t$- Allows Deep Scanning of Habitable Planets.

entries.zh:
我们最近对§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!开展调查，探测到了微弱的生命迹象，发现了一个此前未被记录的未开智物种。

§Y$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$§!坚持只采集有限的样本用于研究，并强调要悉心照料并提供丰富的环境。现在，一小群该物种将居住在首府方舟舰的观察栖息地中。

塞罗相信，随着时间的推移，我们从这些迷人生物身上学到的东西，将不亚于它们从我们这里学到的。
entries.en:
Our recent survey of §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! detected faint traces of life, revealing a previously unrecorded pre-sapient species.

§Y$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$§! insisted on limited collection for study, emphasizing care and enrichment. A small group will now reside within our capital Arkship's observation habitat.

Sero believes that, in time, we may learn as much from these fascinating creatures as they do from us.

entries.zh: 令人反感，但可能有用的。
§H科学家§!§Y$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$§!发现了新的未开智物种！
当他的族人拥抱合成化的完美时，$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$为了留在患病的儿子身边而选择了流亡。如今，他在星际间流浪，照顾那些迷失之人，并教导那些将继承未来的人。
entries.en: When his people embraced synthetic perfection, $NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ chose exile to remain with his ailing son. Now he wanders the stars, tending to the lost and teaching those who will inherit the future.

entries.zh: 生命在延续，而当我们选择去关爱，它便会茁壮成长。
entries.en: Life endures, and when we choose to care, it thrives.

entries.zh: §H高大的合成人低下了头。它的每一个动作都精准无误，仿佛承载着漫长岁月的重量与沉重的负担。尽管身躯是金属构架，它的神态中却透着一种显而易见的感染力。一个瘦小的身影躺在它背上的摇篮里，苍白的皮肤映衬着明亮的双眼。§!\n\n“我叫索拉斯单元。我和我的儿子请求通行。”
entries.en: §HThe tall synthetic inclines its head. Each motion is precise, as if weighted by long years and a heavy burden. Despite its metal frame, there is something unmistakably expressive in its bearing. A small figure rests in a cradle upon its back, eyes bright against pale skin.§!\n\n"I am called Unit Solace. My son and I seek passage."

entries.zh: 你为了什么而来到这里？
“当我的族人飞升为合成形态时，他们将其称之为解脱。但在追求完美的途中，他们忘记了怜悯。我儿子的罕见病症曾会让那种转化变得致命。如你所见，这夺走了他的行动能力。但在我的族人视之为局限的地方，我看到了光芒。选择了他，我便选择了流亡。”\n\n“现在，我们前往需要我们的地方。机器或许没有心跳，但它依然能守护他人的生命。”
entries.en: "When my people ascended into a synthetic form, they called it liberation. But in their pursuit of perfection, they forgot compassion. My son's rare condition would have made the transition fatal. As you see, it has robbed him of his mobility. But where my people saw a limitation, I saw light. In choosing him, I chose exile.\n\n"Now we go where we are needed. A machine may not have a heartbeat, but it can still keep others alive."

entries.zh: 你的儿子……他情况稳定吗？

§H孩子听到问题后微微动了动，他的声音虽然微弱，但通过摇篮内置的扬声器清晰地传了出来：§!

“我没事。星星移动得很慢，我能跟得上。”

§H$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$低下头，伺服电机发出轻微的嗡鸣声：§!

“他的身体面临着某些挑战，但他的意志拒绝屈服。我的族人追求完美，却只得到了冷漠。我现在的旅程，是为了报答他的勇气教会我的一切。在那之前，我会一直带着他，尽我所能教他关于这片生机勃勃的星空的知识。”
entries.en:
§HThe child stirs faintly at the question, his voice small but clear through a softspeaker built into the cradle:§!

"I'm all right. The stars move slow enough for me to keep up."

§H$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ lowers its head, servos whirring quietly:§!

"His body set certain challenges, but his spirit refused to yield. My people sought perfection, and found only apathy. I travel now to repay what his courage has taught me. Until then, I carry him, and teach what I can of the living sky."
What do you hope to teach?

entries.zh: “生存不仅依靠力量，更是沿途艰难赢取的智慧。\n\n每一次邂逅都会留下教训。我帮助年轻人将这些教训传承下去，好让我们走过的每一段路，都使我们比以往更加睿智。”
entries.en: "That survival is not strength alone; it is wisdom hard won along the road.\n\nEvery encounter leaves a lesson behind. I help the young carry those lessons forward, so that every road we travel leaves us wiser than before."

entries.zh: 为什么要承担这样的负担？
entries.en: Why take on such a burden?

entries.zh:
§H合成人的目光移向视口，倒映着远方的星辰。§!

“因为每一代人都必须重新学习同样的真理。路途教会了他们，但必须有人帮助他们理解所见之物。”

§H然后传来了孩子尖细的声音，即使通过软扬声器听起来也很清脆：§!

“他总是这么说。我觉得这只是意味着他喜欢帮助别人。”
entries.en:
§HThe synthetic's gaze shifts toward the viewport, reflecting distant stars.§!

"Because every generation must learn the same truths again. The road teaches them, but someone must help them understand what they have seen."

§HThen the child's voice pipes up, bright even through the softspeaker:.§!

"That's what he always says. I think it just means he likes helping people."

entries.zh: 我们是合成人。这会有问题吗？
entries.en: We are synthetic. Will that be an issue?

entries.zh:
§H$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$在处理这个问题时，光学传感器亮度略微增加。§!

“不。不会有问题的。我族人的飞升是一种希望之举。我的拒绝亦是如此。我并不怨恨任何跨过那个门槛的人。也不怨恨那些在门槛之外出生的人。”

§H他的声音中带上了一种温柔、令人安心的嗡嗡声。§!

“当身体改变时，同情心并不会枯萎。如果说有什么变化的话，那就是它变得更容易承载了。”
entries.en:
§H$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$'s optics brighten a fraction as he processes the question.§!

"No. It will not be a problem. My people's ascension was an act of hope. So was my refusal. I do not begrudge any who crossed that threshold. Nor those who were born beyond it."

§HA soft, reassuring hum enters his voice.§!

"Compassion does not wither when the body changes. If anything, it becomes easier to carry."

entries.zh: 每次完成合约，这位领袖能将方舟舰变成了成长与学习的摇篮。
entries.en: With each completed Contract, this leader turns the Arkship into a cradle of growth and learning.

entries.zh: $t$—$mod_planet_researchers_produces_mult$：§G+3%§!\n$t$—每完成一个§H合约§!，效果提升§G+3%§!（最高§G+15%§!）\n$t$—$mod_planet_researchers_amenities_produces_add$：§G+150§!
entries.en: $t$- $mod_planet_researchers_produces_mult$: §G+3%§!\n$t$- Effects increase by §G+3%§! for each completed §HContract§! (up to §G+15%§!)\n$t$- $mod_planet_researchers_amenities_produces_add$: §G+150§!

entries.zh: $NAME_nomadic_caregiver$认为，从我们最近完成的合约中学到的教训，提供了一个独特的教育机会。孩子们聚集在他耐心的指导下，不仅学习字母和逻辑，还学习共情与合作。\n\n他儿子的笑声在走廊里回荡，提醒着即使是最年长的旅行者：欢乐是一种任何技术都无法取代的力量。
entries.en: $NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique educational opportunity. The young gather beneath his patient instruction, learning not only letters and logic, but empathy and cooperation.\n\nHis son's laughter carries through the halls, reminding even our oldest travelers that joy is a strength no technology can replace.

entries.zh: $NAME_nomadic_caregiver$认为，在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，提供了一个独特的反馈机会。新单元正在接受维护协议、观察和协作方面的指导。虽然它们的记忆留存效率参差不齐，但参与单元的功能性有所提高。\n\n目前看来，尽管这种做法不同寻常，但其结果是效率得到了可衡量的提升。
entries.en: $NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique feedback opportunity. New units are instructed in maintenance protocols, observation, and cooperation. Their retention efficiency is inconsistent, yet functionality among attending units has increased.\n\nIt appears that, though unusual, the result is a measurable increase in efficiency.

entries.zh: $NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ 认为，我们在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，为重新调整提供了一个独特的机会。通过我们的$councilor_gestalt_cognitive$，他传授着耐心与协作，引导着这些工蜂，仿佛它们是他自己的后代一般。\n\n虽然我们对这种奉献感到好奇——一个个体在哺育整个集体——但其成果是不容置疑的。我们的思绪正回荡着新的和谐旋律。
entries.en: $NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique opportunity for recalibration. Through our $councilor_gestalt_cognitive$ he teaches patience and coordination, guiding the drones as if they were his own offspring.\n\nWhile we find this devotion curious, an individual nurturing the collective, the results are inarguable. Our thoughts hum with new harmony.

entries.zh: 一种不寻常，但有益的做法。
我们认为这种做法很有价值。
entries.en: We see value in this practice.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$§!的工作再次提高了我们的§H无形资源产出§!。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$'s§! work is once again improving our §HIntangible Resource Output§!.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$§!从这份合同中学到了一些新东西。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$§! learned something new from this Contract.

entries.zh: $NAME_nomadic_champion$曾为了报酬、荣誉和信条征战百场，直到这三者都变得空洞乏味。如今他只为搏斗本身的纯粹快乐而战——以及胜利后留下的战利品。
entries.en: $NAME_nomadic_champion$ fought a hundred battles for pay, pride, and principle, until all three rang hollow. Now he fights for the sheer joy of the struggle - and for the trophies left behind.

entries.zh: 一切最后都会被虚无吞噬的，所以趁现在就要狠狠地打，大声地笑！
entries.en: The void takes everything in time, so fight hard and laugh while you can!

entries.zh: §H新来的人带着洪亮的笑声走近，浑身散发着喜悦的气息。他的动作轻盈自如，仿佛是一个多次躲过死神、已不再将其放在心上的人。§!\n\n“我叫$NAME_nomadic_champion$。听说你喜欢冒险。给我一场战斗，让我在虚空中施展拳脚，我会给你呈现值得一看的表现。谁知道呢？也许一路上我们还会收获一些纪念品。”
entries.en: §HThe newcomer arrives with a booming laugh, his whole bearing radiating delight. He moves with the easy buoyancy of someone who's dodged death often enough to stop taking it personally.§!\n\n"Name's $NAME_nomadic_champion$. Heard you've got a taste for danger. Give me a fight and an open horizon, and I'll give you something worth watching. Who knows? Maybe we'll pick up a few souvenirs along the way."

entries.zh:
“没错。我曾在太空城邦的那帮人里混了好几年，他们把每场小冲突都看作一笔薪水。打仗倒没什么，就是那些同僚，实在不敢恭维。

§H他咧嘴一笑，仿佛这段回忆里藏着什么只有他自己懂的笑话。§!

“事实证明，当周围的人都在计算报酬时，一个人很难真正享受一场激战。所以我走了。生命太短暂，没必要为别人的资产负债表流血。”
entries.en:
"Aye. Spent years among Enclave types who thought of every skirmish as a paycheck. The fighting was fine. The company, less so."

§HHe grins as though the memory contains some private joke.§!

"Turns out it's hard to enjoy a firefight when everyone around you is counting the payout. So I walked. Life's too short to bleed for someone else's balance sheet."
Do you still believe in the fight?

entries.zh:
§H他仰头爽朗地大笑起来。§!

“信仰？没必要。该是战斗信仰我！

“但是你应该比绝大多数人都懂这个道理……在这里，关键在于你从每一场冲突中带走了什么。一道伤疤、一块碎片、一个故事。你们游牧民的想法就很对：留下值得留下的，其余的随它去吧。”
entries.en:
§HHe throws his head back with easy laughter.§!

"Believe? No need. The fight believes in me!"

"But you should know that better than most... Out here, it's about what you carry from each clash. A scar, a shard, a story. You nomads have the right idea: keep what's worth keeping, and let the rest fall away."

entries.zh:
§H他晃了晃肩膀，仿佛在为战斗做热身。§!

“下一场战斗。”

“如果它不想要我的命，那就不值得我浪费时间。”
entries.en:
§HHe rolls his shoulders, as though loosening up for battle.§!

"The next fight."

"If it isn't trying to kill me, it's not worth my time."
And what do you offer us?

entries.zh: §H他身体前倾，笑容愈发灿烂。他的眼神中闪烁着光芒，一半是友好，一半是警觉。§!\n\n“一场痛快的战斗，再加上些值得带走的战利品。我会教你的军队怎么打才叫像样，让他们学会战斗的美，再在每一场胜利中有所收获。那些战利品能让我们认清自己，或许也能让整个星系认识我们。”
entries.en: §HHe leans forward, grin widening. There is a glint in his eye that is half friendly, half warning.§!\n\n"A good fight and a few trophies worth keeping. I'll teach your armies to brawl like they mean it, to see beauty in the clash, and to carry something from every victory. Those trophies tell us who we are, and maybe they'll teach the galaxy something about us too."

entries.zh: 看来你以前见过我们的族人……
entries.en: It looks like you've met our kind before...

entries.zh: §H他猛地闭上了嘴。皮肤上泛起一阵明显的颜色变化。他这是……脸红了吗？§!\n\n“啊。是的。希望不是你认识的人？”
entries.en: §HHis mouth snaps shut. A distinct shift in coloration ripples across his skin. Is he... blushing?§!\n\n"Ah. Yes. No one you knew, I hope?"

entries.zh: §H他宽阔的双肩抖动了一下，漫不经心地耸了耸肩。§!\n\n“也许吧？可能吧？我们到底还做不做这件事？”
entries.en: §HHis massive shoulders roll with a dismissive shrug.§!\n\n"Maybe? Probably? Are we doing this thing or not?"

entries.zh: 每一场战斗都会留下印记，而$NAME_nomadic_champion$收集了所有的印记。他的笑声将危险化为胜利，他的战利品时刻提醒着舰队我们为何而战。
entries.en: Each battle leaves its mark, and $NAME_nomadic_champion$ collects them all. His laughter turns danger into triumph, and his trophies remind the fleet what we're fighting for.

entries.zh: $t$—这名指挥官在成功§Y率领§!发动一次行星入侵后，有一定几率可以缴获一件珍贵的§H战利品§!。\n$t$—战利品将储存在我们§Y$col_capital$§!上的§H$d_trophy_hall$§!中，其效果可以堆叠。
entries.en: $t$- When §Yleading§! a successful planetary invasion, this commander has a chance to recover a prized §HTrophy§!.\n$t$- Trophies are stored in a §H$d_trophy_hall$§! on our §Y$col_capital$§!, stacking its effects.

entries.zh: 一座穹顶大厅，悬挂着§G$NAME_nomadic_champion$§!的战利品。每一件留有伤痕的遗物都诉说着反抗与胜利，激励着所有走过此地的人。
entries.en: "A vaulted chamber where the trophies of §G$NAME_nomadic_champion$§! hang. Each scarred relic speaks of defiance and triumph, stirring the hearts of all who walk its length.

entries.zh:
§H$NAME_nomadic_champion$露出笑容，小心翼翼地放下了一个物件。其形状难以辨认：部分是金属，部分是骨头，还有一部分完全是某种别的东西。无论它是什么，身上都带着明显的战斗痕迹。§!

“每场战斗都会留下些什么，但只有一部分值得保留。不如我们把它好好展示出来，如何？反正我们的空间多得是！”

§H他爆发出一阵肆无忌惮的响亮狂笑，仿佛这件战利品是他与星辰之间心有灵犀的一个私人笑话。§!
entries.en:
§H$NAME_nomadic_champion$ grins as he sets an object down with surprising care. Its shape is hard to read: part metal, part bone, part something else entirely. Whatever it is, it bears the unmistakable scars of battle.§!

"Every good fight leaves something behind, but only some are worth keeping. What say we display this properly, eh? It's not like we're running out of space!

§HHe erupts into a brazen, booming laugh, as if the trophy were an inside joke shared with the stars.§!

entries.zh:
我们的§Y$col_capital$§!将获得一座新的§H$d_trophy_hall$§!，其效果如下：
—$mod_job_soldier_add$：§G+50§!
—$MOD_ARMY_BUILD_SPEED_MULT$：§G+10%§!
—$MOD_PLANET_ARMY_BUILD_COST_MULT$：§G-5%§!
—已收集的战利品：§G+1§!
—效果随已收集的§H战利品§!数量翻倍（最大8倍）
entries.en:
Our §Y$col_capital$§! will gain a new §H$d_trophy_hall$§! with the following effects:
- $mod_job_soldier_add$: §G+50§!
- $MOD_ARMY_BUILD_SPEED_MULT$: §G+10%§!
- $MOD_PLANET_ARMY_BUILD_COST_MULT$: §G-5%§!
- Trophies Collected: §G+1§!
- Effects multiplied by the number of §HTrophies§! collected (Max. 8)

entries.zh: §H指挥官§!§Y$NAME_nomadic_champion$§!缴获了另一件战利品！
尽管$NAME_nomadic_princess$如此年轻，却已饱经旅途的风霜。然而，她拥有一种让周围人感到安心的沉着，以及一份无所求的坚韧。
entries.en: For one so young, $NAME_nomadic_princess$ carries the weight of long roads. Yet she possesses a calm that steadies those around her and a strength that asks for nothing.

entries.zh: 在无尽的星海深处，有一个声音正呼唤我回家。
entries.en: Somewhere in the endless sweep of stars, a voice is calling me home.

entries.zh: §H年轻的流浪者步出，神色从容而谨慎。漫长旅途的印记笼罩着她，但她身上同样散发出一种沉静、不容忽视的力量。§!\n\n“我的名字是$NAME_nomadic_princess$。我从很远的地方赶来……比我曾设想过的还要遥远。如果你们这里还有位置，我请求在此借宿一段时日。”
entries.en: §HThe young wanderer steps forward with careful composure. The marks of long travel cling to her, yet so does a quiet, undeniable strength.§!\n\n"My name is $NAME_nomadic_princess$. I've come a long way... farther than I ever thought possible. If there is room among you, I ask passage for a time."

entries.zh: 你为了什么而来到这里？

“我希望我能确定。我身后的路上，有些片段感觉……缺失了。而另一些，我却记得太清楚。”

§H她的目光变得柔和，眼中闪烁着一丝微弱的希望。§!

“如果你愿意接纳我，我想与你同行。在某些东西再次溜走之前，我需要找到它，或者记起它。”
entries.en:
"I wish I knew for certain. There are parts of the road behind me that are... missing. Others I remember too well."

§HHer gaze softens, a quiet hope flickering behind it.§!

"If you'll have me, I would walk with you. There is something I need to find, or remember, before it slips away again."

entries.zh:
“并非全部。记不清了。”

“有些记忆感觉像是属于另一个人的。没有名字的面孔，星海之中的家园……然后便是一片虚无。”

§H她用拇指拂过斗篷的边缘。§!

“我只知道我弄丢了很重要的东西。是什么把我带到了这里？运气、命运……或许兼而有之。我需要时间去揭开剩下的真相。”
entries.en:
"Not all of it. Not clearly.

"Some memories feel like they belong to another person. Faces without names, a home among the stars... and then nothing."

§HShe brushes a thumb across the edge of her cloak.§!

"I know only that I've lost something important. What brought me here? Luck, fate... maybe both. I need time to uncover the rest."
What do you ask of us?

entries.zh: §H她望向星空，眉头微蹙，掩饰着眼底的渴望。§!\n\n“我不确定故乡是一个回忆，还是一个终点。但我的直觉告诉我，若是与你同行，我也许终能找到答案。”
entries.en: §HShe looks toward the stars, brow furrowed with a longing she tries to hide.§!\n\n"I don't know if home is a memory or a destination. But I sense that with you, I might finally find the answer."

entries.zh:
§H$NAME_nomadic_princess$稳住心神，仿佛在字斟句酌。§!

“如果人们无法彼此信任，那便只有悲哀。我虽年少，但至少懂得这个道理。如果你能给我留一个位置与各位并肩作战……我会尽我所能向他们提供帮助。”

§H她的声音柔和了下来。§!

“当我找到家园之时，我绝不会忘记那些曾助我归家的人。”
entries.en:
§H$NAME_nomadic_princess$ steadies herself, as if choosing her words with care.§!

"If people can't trust each other, there is only sorrow. I am young, but I have learned that much at least. If you give me a place among your people... I will aid them as best I can."

§HHer voice softens.§!

"And when I find home, I will not forget those who helped me get there."

entries.zh: 你与我们物种的相似程度令人惊讶。
entries.en: Your resemblance to our species is uncanny.

entries.zh:
§H$NAME_nomadic_princess$犹豫了一下，一丝疑虑掠过她的脸庞。§!

“我注意到了。这是我不理解的事情。”

§H她用手轻抚脸颊，仿佛希望通过触碰能唤回记忆。§!

“如果我来自你的族群，或者我们有着某种遥远的联系……真相就在我无法触及的地方。我只知道：我想帮忙。如果你愿意接纳我，我将为你的旅程献出我的双手与真心，直到我发现自己起航的地方。”
entries.en:
§H$NAME_nomadic_princess$ hesitates, a flicker of uncertainty passing across her features.§!

"I've noticed. It isn't something I understand."

§HShe brushes a hand along her cheek, as if hoping touch might summon memory.§!

"If I come from your people, or if we share some distant bond... the truth lies somewhere beyond my reach. All I know is that I want to help. If you'll have me, I'll lend my hands and my heart to your journey until I discover where mine began."

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!以§H英杰领袖§!的身份加入了我们的方舟舰。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! joins our Arkship as a §HParagon Leader§!.

entries.zh: $NAME_nomadic_princess$遗忘了她的过去，但如果她能够返回失去一切的地方，或许能找回她的记忆。
entries.en: $NAME_nomadic_princess$ has forgotten her past, yet her memories may be recovered by returning her to what was lost.

entries.zh:
最近，§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!的脑海中开始浮现出模糊的回忆，那是一种她也无法解释的熟悉感。据她描述，方舟号上的某些走廊让她觉得似曾相识，而星图中的某些星象布局也勾起了一种出人意料的联结感。

§H“我不明白为什么这些地方会吸引我，但我标注出了那些感觉……重要的地方。如果我们前往那里，或许能找回更多的记忆。”§!

她标出了几处与她深藏的记忆产生共鸣的坐标——这些地点本身可能也值得调查。
entries.en:
Lately, faint recollections have begun returning to §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!, a sense of familiarity she cannot explain. She reports that certain corridors of the Arkship feel as though she has walked them before, and star patterns in our charts evoke an unexpected sense of connection.

§H"I don't know why these places pull at me, but I marked the points that felt... important. If we travel there, perhaps more will return."§!

She has highlighted several coordinates that resonate with her buried memories - locations that may also warrant investigation in their own right.

entries.zh: 模糊的记忆指引着§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!飘向星海深处。前往那里应当能帮她想起更多往事。
entries.en: Faint memories pull §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! toward distant points in the stars. Traveling there should help her to remember more.
Coordinates marked by §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! as strangely familiar.

entries.zh: §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!星系没能提供多少答案。§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!感到一种无法解释的熟悉感，而我们的扫描仪在恒星轨道上检测到了一块漂浮的人造残骸碎片。其结构暗示其采用了深空设计，但哪怕有什么标记或识别符号，也早就因时间而消逝。\n\n§H“我曾希望来到这里能唤醒些什么，”§!她轻声说道。§H“但……还不是时候。”§!
entries.en: The §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! system offers few answers. §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! senses a familiarity she cannot explain, and our scans have detected a fragment of artificial debris drifting in the star's orbit. Its construction suggests deep-space design, but any markings or identifiers have long since faded.\n\n§H"I hoped coming here would spark something,"§! she says quietly. §H"But... not yet."§!

entries.zh: 我们的调查团队在§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!星系的残骸中发现了一个漂浮的小型数据水晶。它的外壳已经焦黑，但有一处细节依然清晰可见：一段旧注册码的碎片，字母为§H‘U-N-S’§!。
entries.en: Our survey team has recovered a small data crystal drifting amid the debris in the §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! system. Its casing is scorched, but one detail remains clear: a fragment of an old registry code, the letters §H'U N S'§!.

entries.zh: $nomads.1600.intro$这与我们的历史记载存在着惊人的相似性，但是$nomads.1600.outro$
entries.en: $nomads.1600.intro$ The resemblance to our own historical markings is uncanny, but $nomads.1600.outro$

entries.zh: 水晶解密后的内容还包括一组精确的坐标。\n\n与此同时，§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!也找回了另一段记忆。她想起了一个巨大的观景台，星辰在寂静的观察窗外流淌，还有一只指引的手指向一颗蓝色的星球——那是距离其恒星最近的第三颗行星。
entries.en: the crystal's decrypted contents also include a set of precise coordinates.\n\nAt the same time, §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! has recovered another memory. She recalls a vast observation deck, stars spilling across a silent viewport, and a guiding hand pointing toward a blue world, the third planet from its sun.

entries.zh: 我们必须帮她想起剩下的部分。
entries.en: We must help her remember the rest.

entries.zh: 她的过去无关紧要。我们已经得到了需要的东西。
entries.en: Her past is irrelevant. We have what we need.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!又浮现出了一段记忆。她想起了一座大厅，里面坐满了衣着考究的人，他们低沉而深思熟虑的语调中透着惯于发号施令者的自信。\n\n§H“他们在争论，”§!她低声说道。§H“声音不大，但措辞犀利……是关于一项任务。关于一次必须保密的发射。还有其他的，还有两艘飞船和我们一起出发了。但为什么？我们到底在逃离什么？”§!
entries.en: Another memory has surfaced for §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!. She remembers a hall of impeccably dressed figures, their hushed, deliberate tones carrying the confidence of those used to command.\n\n§H"They were arguing,"§! she murmurs. §H"Not loudly, but sharply... about a mission. About a launch that had to stay secret. And there were others, two more ships, sent along with us. But why? Were we running from something?"§!

entries.zh:
§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!浮现出了一段新的记忆。她回想起一艘巨大的世代飞船，其船体旨在承载整个未来。

随后是一次剧烈的震动：警报声响起，远处走廊里金属炸裂的火光闪现。她记得自己被一位女子抱起，带进了一个逃生舱。

§H“她紧紧抱着我。她说我必须活下去……说我太重要了。接着我就孤身一人了。我几乎能看见她的脸庞，但每次它都悄然逝去。”§!
entries.en:
A new memory has surfaced for §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!. She recalls a vast generational ship, its hull designed to hold entire futures.

Then a violent shudder: alarms, a flash of exploding metal in a distant corridor. She remembers being lifted by a woman and carried to an escape pod.

§H"She held me close. She said I had to survive... that I was too important. And then I was alone. I can almost see her face, but it slips away every time."§!

entries.zh: 世代飞船……像我们这艘一样的？
坐标指向了一艘巨大飞船的残骸，其上层结构与标准的方舟舰设计相符。\n\n初步探测结果表明发生了灾难性的内部故障。全面调查可能会发现与§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!恢复的记忆相关的线索。
entries.en: The coordinates led to the remains of a massive vessel, its superstructure consistent with standard Arkship design.\n\nPreliminary readings suggest catastrophic internal failure. A full investigation may uncover traces linked to §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!'s recovered memories.
Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ $arkship_cap$ or Science Ship in orbit.

entries.zh:
对毁坏方舟舰的分析让我们深入了解了§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!的起源。其内部结构和生命维持体系与她身上回收的碎片完全吻合。受损的日志中提到了一位指定的继承人，一个自出生起就接受培养、旨在有朝一日领导这艘飞船及其族群的个体。

记录证实，在结构崩解前的几秒钟内，只有一名未成年乘客被撤离。没有其他逃生舱发射。

§H“他们救了我，”§!她轻声说道。§H“我不只是个乘客……我本该领导他们，现在我恳求你帮我理解其中的原因。”§!
entries.en:
Analysis of the ruined Arkship has yielded significant insight into §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!'s origin. Its internal structure and life-support architecture match her recovered fragments exactly. Corrupted logs reference a designated heir, an individual trained from birth to one day guide the vessel and its people.

Records confirm that only a single juvenile passenger was evacuated seconds before structural failure. No other pods were launched.

§H"They saved me,"§! she says quietly. §H"I wasn't just a passenger... I was meant to lead them, and I implore you now to help me understand the reason why."§!

entries.zh: §H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!已恢复记忆，并获得了§Y$leader_trait_nomadic_princess_1$§!与§Y$leader_trait_nomadic_princess_2$§!特质。
entries.en: §H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! has recovered her memory, and gained the §Y$leader_trait_nomadic_princess_1$§! and §Y$leader_trait_nomadic_princess_2$§! Traits.

entries.zh: 在修复的方舟舰内，记忆各就其位。§H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!找回了曾经用于引导其族人的训练片段。她沉稳的姿态和深邃的洞察力，使她成为星际势力间天生的调停者。
entries.en: Within the recovered Arkship, memories settle into place. §H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! has regained fragments of the training once meant to guide her people. Her calm presence and steady insight make her a natural mediator among star-faring powers.

entries.zh: §H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!回到被修复好的方舟舰后，唤醒了她所受训练的全部潜能。她现在正式担负起她命中注定的重任。
entries.en: §H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!'s return to the recovered Arkship has awakened the full breadth of her training. She now steps into the role she was meant to fill.

entries.zh: 重建破碎的飞船并非易事，但这样做或许能揭示§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!的起源，以及她注定要继承的遗产。
entries.en: Rebuilding the shattered vessel will be difficult, but doing so may reveal the origins of §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! and the legacy she was meant to inherit.

entries.zh:
方舟舰已恢复运转，那些沉睡已久的系统立即响应§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!的出现。修复的数据库证实了她记忆中的猜想：她自幼便接受培养，旨在引导这艘飞船以及曾经生活在其中的子民。

最后一封音频日志幸存了下来。一个沉着而熟悉的女声谈论着继承协议，以及一个必须被保护的孩子。在方舟舰开始瓦解之际，她下令发射了逃生舱。

§H“那个声音……”§!$NAME_nomadic_princess$低声细语道。§H“我认得它。她曾是……我。或者说我是以她为原型的。一个克隆体……这就是为什么我能活下来。她想要拯救她自己。”§!

无论曾是什么将这艘船带入黑暗，现在它已在我们的旗帜下航行，并由重掌大权的继承人管理。
entries.en:
The Arkship is restored, its long-dormant systems immediately responding to §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!. Recovered databanks confirm what her memories only suggested: she was raised to guide this vessel and the people who once lived within its hull.

One final audio log survives. A woman's calm, familiar voice speaks of succession protocols and a child who must be protected. She orders the escape pod to launch as the Arkship begins to break apart.

§H"That voice..."§! $NAME_nomadic_princess$ whispers. §H"I know it. She was... me. Or I was made from her. A clone... That is why I survived. She wanted to save herself."§!

Whatever carried this ship into the dark, it now flies under our banner, and the stewardship of the heir who has reclaimed it.

entries.zh: 随着§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!的离去，她所承载的脆弱记忆之迹也已归于沉寂。她曾追寻的真相，如今再也无法找回。\n\n她的故事在此终结，虽未完结，但并未被遗忘。
entries.en: With §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! gone, the fragile trail of memories she carried has faded into silence. Whatever truths she sought can no longer be recovered.\n\nHer story ends here, unfinished, but not forgotten.
§R$NAME_nomadic_princess$ may not be dismissed before regaining her memories.§!

entries.zh: 一艘巨大的方舟战舰在战斗中被摧毁，留下了一片广阔的残骸。其基础设施、引擎和船体的残余可能为打捞提供有价值的材料。
entries.en: A colossal arkship has been destroyed in battle, leaving behind a vast field of wreckage. The remains of its infrastructure, engines, and hull may yield valuable materials for salvage.

entries.zh: 我们的一艘方舟舰陷入黑暗无助漂流，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。
entries.en: One of our Arkships lies dark and adrift, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.

entries.zh: 我们的一座驿站陷入了黑暗，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。
entries.en: One of our Waystations has gone dark, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.

entries.zh: 一艘游牧方舟舰的残骸在太空中悄然漂流。派遣一艘科学飞船勘测残骸可能会获得有价值的打捞品。
entries.en: The shattered remains of a nomadic arkship drift silently through the void. Sending a science ship to survey the wreckage may yield valuable salvage.

entries.zh:
§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中的§Y[from.GetName]§!方舟终于被摧毁了。

方舟不仅仅是一个战争的器具，它还是无数游牧生命体的家园。曾经生活和旅行于其中的几代人现在失去了维系他们的基础。

剩下的只有残骸，在虚空中悄无声息地漂流。
entries.en:
The Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system has at last been destroyed.

More than just a vessel of war, the Arkship was a home to countless nomadic lifeforms. Generations who once lived and traveled within have been left without the foundation that bound them together.

What remains is wreckage, drifting silently through the void.

entries.zh:
方舟舰§Y[from.GetName]§!已在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中被摧毁。

在所有民族之中，我们最明白这样的舰船意味着什么——一个仅凭船体与引擎承载的文明，一代又一代都在同样的舱壁内生老病死。这份理解并未拯救他们。它也无能为力。

他们的漂泊到此为止。
entries.en:
The Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! has been destroyed in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system.

We of all peoples understand what such a vessel represents - a civilization carried in hull and engine alone, each generation living and dying within the same walls. That understanding did not spare them. It could not.

Their wandering ends here.

entries.zh:
异星舰船§Y[from.GetName]§!已在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系被歼灭。

游牧舰队进行了激烈抵抗，但终究不敌我方。那些在群星之间无序漂泊的流浪者始终是个威胁。他们的方舟舰已化作四散的残骸。

不要让他们任何一人找到安全港。
entries.en:
The alien vessel §Y[from.GetName]§! has been eliminated from the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system.

The nomadic fleet resisted fiercely, but they were outmatched. Wanderers who drift between the stars without order are a persistent threat. Their Arkship has been reduced to scattered debris.

Let none of them find safe harbor.

entries.zh:
我们位于§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系的方舟舰§Y[from.GetName]§!已被敌人摧毁。

战斗异常激烈，但敌人的力量势不可挡。尽管我们的船员英勇无畏，但我们的防御最终瓦解，方舟舰永远地离开了我们，它的残骸散落在太空中。

这一天将永远被铭记。
entries.en:
Our Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed by the enemy.

The battle was fierce, but the strength of our foes proved overwhelming. Despite the valor of our crew, our defenses faltered, and the Arkship has been torn from us forever, its debris scattered through the void.

This day shall be remembered.

entries.zh:
我们的方舟舰§Y[from.GetName]§!已在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中陷落——并非毁于那些畏惧未知的定居帝国之手，而是毁于与我们一样熟悉虚空的流浪者之手。

§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!向我们发动了攻击，明知摧毁一个民族最后的家园意味着什么。流浪者之间没有团结，只有生存。

我们不会忘记这一切。
entries.en:
Our Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! has been lost in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system - not to settled empires who fear what they do not understand, but to wanderers who know the void as we do.

§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! struck against us, knowing full well what it means to destroy a people's last home. There is no solidarity among wanderers. There is only survival.

We will not forget this.

entries.zh:
我们的§Y[from.GetName]§!方舟在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!系中被摧毁了——不是被征服，而是被处决。

§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!根本不要什么领土或者朝贡，他们只要我们死。在将我们从星间灭绝的行动中，船上的每一条生命对他们而言都是可接受的伤亡数字。

但我们经历了这一切侥幸活了下来，我们绝不会被抹杀。
entries.en:
Our Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed - not through conquest, but through extermination.

§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! did not seek territory or tribute. They sought our end. Every soul aboard was an acceptable casualty in their campaign to purge us from the stars.

We survive. We endure. We will not be erased.

entries.zh: §Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!在维护作业期间，底层甲板发现了一个未登记且经过重重加固的容器，该容器正发出放射性信号。由于缺乏档案记录或识别标记，其来源和用途尚不明确。
entries.en: During maintenance operations aboard §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!, an unregistered, heavily reinforced container emitting radioactive signals was discovered on a lower deck. The lack of archival records or identifying markings leaves its origin and purpose unknown.

entries.zh: 在对§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!下层甲板进行例行维护时，我们的工程师发现了一个散发放射性信号的旧密封容器。其表面焦黑，并用厚重的工业焊缝加固，表明它从未打算被轻易打开。\n\n飞船的货物档案中没有它的记录，也没有任何标记表明它来自何处或预计要携带什么。 对该容器进行全面分析需要一些时间才能完成。
entries.en: During routine maintenance on a lower deck of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!, our engineers have discovered an old sealed container emitting radioactive signals. Its surface was scorched and reinforced with thick industrial welds, suggesting it had never been meant to be opened easily.\n\nThere was no record of it in the ship's cargo archives, and no markings to indicate where it had come from or what it was meant to carry. A comprehensive analysis of the container will take some time to complete.

entries.zh: 让我们看看里面有什么。
基础扫描显示，该集装箱内装着不起眼的货物和矿物，很可能是标准补给品运输的一部分。然而，在更深处藏着一个单一的、致密的物体，具有不寻常的特性。它的成分无法确定。\n\n该物体没有反射任何能量特征，吸收了大部分扫描波长，并且与飞船记录中任何已知材料都不符。即使通过远程成像，其确切形状也难以确定。鉴于其结构的这些异常，[Root.GetName]的一些科学家警告说它可能具有潜在危险。
entries.en: A basic scan showed the container held unremarkable goods and minerals, likely part of a standard supply shipment. However, lodged deeper within was a single, dense object with unusual properties. Its composition could not be determined.\n\nThe object reflected no energy signatures, absorbed most scanning wavelengths, and did not match any known materials in the ship's records. Even its exact shape proved difficult to define through remote imaging. Given these anomalies of its structure, some scientists of [Root.GetName] warned it could be potentially dangerous.

entries.zh: 收纳箱的第二层外壳抵制住了标准开箱工具，需要更多的时间和资源才能破开。进入内部之后，我们发现了一块黑暗且棱角分明的晶体，与船上记录的任何东西都不同。它散发出微弱的温暖，并吸收周围的光线，使其看起来像从内部散发出黑暗。它的存在立即引起了船员的注意。\n\n科学团队的初步评估表明，经过适当研究，这种晶体可能被用作能源，尽管具体方法尚不清楚。
entries.en: The second container's casing resisted standard tools, requiring both time and resources to breach. But once inside, we discovered a dark and sharply faceted crystal, unlike anything documented in the ship's records. It emitted a faint warmth and absorbed ambient light, making it appear to radiate darkness from within. Its presence immediately drew attention among the crew.\n\nPreliminary assessments by the science team suggested that, with proper study, the crystal might be harnessed as an energy source, though the method for doing so remains unclear.

entries.zh: 将水晶展示在公共区域。
entries.en: Display the crystal in the common area.

entries.zh: 在博物天枢中展示水晶。
entries.en: Display the crystal in the Grand Archive.

entries.zh:
水晶揭开神秘面纱的那一刻，它开始搏动。它没有发出任何声音，也没有表现出交流的意图，但当人们靠近时，它的核心会发出嗡嗡的震动。

它时不时地发出微弱而转瞬即逝的光芒。有人声称它会对哼唱做出闪烁的反应；另一些人则注意到其基座有轻微的震动，仿佛它正在倾听。

我们无法在其内部检测到任何生命体，但它似乎能感知到附近的存在。最奇怪的是，那些瞥见其微光的人们，常常会感到一种安静而莫名的喜悦。
entries.en:
The moment the crystal was unveiled, it began to pulse. It made no sound and showed no intention to communicate, yet its core thrummed when approached.

At intervals, it emitted a faint, fleeting glow. Some claimed it flickered in response to humming; others noted a subtle vibration in its cradle, as if it were listening.

No lifeform could be detected within, but it seemed aware of nearby presence. Strangest of all, those who glimpsed its glimmer often reported a quiet, inexplicable sense of joy.

entries.zh:
我们终于揭示了水晶的起源。通过对其脉冲模式的仔细分析，我们发现那些振动根本不是随机的。当序列被转换成声音时，其音调与一首古老的摇篮曲相符，那首摇篮曲至今仍在方舟舰上被哼唱着。

当旋律被播放出来时，倾听者们感受到了一种深刻的、来自祖先的平静。这首歌不仅仅是熟悉的；它是星际时代之前生命的一个遗留物，也许甚至回响着我们仍然称一个星球为家园时的记忆。

水晶被放置在公共空间里，它那沉静的脉动成为了我们共同起源的活生生的纽带。
entries.en:
We have finally uncovered the crystal's origin. Through careful analysis of its pulse patterns, we discovered that the vibrations were not random at all. When the sequence was translated into sound, the tones matched an old lullaby, one still hummed aboard the Arkship today.
