When the melody was played aloud, those who listened felt a deep, ancestral calm. The song was not just familiar; it was a remnant of life before the stars, perhaps even echoing from when we still called a planet home.

The crystal was placed in a communal space, its quiet pulse a living link to our shared origins.

entries.zh:
在受控条件下，晶体被整合到飞船的引擎核心。效果立竿见影，反应堆输出功率飙升远超基线，方舟舰的引擎轰鸣着爆发出强大的力量。导航部门报告航行速度显著提升，燃料储备也相应得到改善。

工程舱的船员描述船体深处回荡着一种深沉、共振的振动。

几个小时内，晶体消失了，其结构完全被反应消耗殆尽。无论其来源如何，它都将对我们的旅程产生持久的影响。
entries.en:
Under controlled conditions, the crystal was integrated into the ship's engine core. The effect was immediate, the reactor output spiked far beyond baseline, and the Arkship's engines roared with strength. Navigation reported a measurable gain in travel speed, and fuel reserves saw a corresponding improvement.

Crew in the engineering bays described a deep, resonant vibration echoing through the hull.

Within hours, the crystal was gone, its structure completely consumed by the reaction. Whatever its origin, it will have a lasting impact on our journey.

entries.zh: 初步扫描显示，集装箱内大部分是常规货物清单的残余物。然而，在下面却埋藏着大量致密的晶体合金。\n\n对放射性排放物的进一步研究表明，其中存在暗物质。
entries.en: A preliminary scan identified the bulk of the container's contents as remnants of a routine cargo manifest. However, buried beneath lay a cache of dense, crystalline alloys.\n\nFurther study of the radioactive emissions indicates the presence of Dark Matter within.

entries.zh: 将里面的东西全部拿走。
在容器中，我们发现了一件设计奇特的物品。该物体辐射出微弱但持续的能量特征，在多个波谱间波动。其几何形态令人惊叹，仿佛形状本身就在抗拒稳定的定义。它的外形如同一个色彩斑斓、酷似生物的雕像。由相互咬合的部件组成的错综复杂的结构暗示这尊雕像可以打开。\n\n一些科学组的成员怀疑，它的外壳内可能藏有有价值的东西。另一些人则提醒要保持克制，警告说强行干预可能会损害其保存状态，或引发意想不到的后果。
entries.en: Inside the container we identified the artifact of curious design. The object radiated faint but persistent energy signatures, fluctuating across multiple spectrums. Its form was geometrically astonishing, as if the shape itself resisted stable definition. It resembled a colorful figure, fashioned in the likeness of a living being. Its construction was intricate, composed of interlocking segments that suggest the figure is meant to be opened.\n\nSome among the science crew suspect that something of value may rest within its outer shell. Others caution restraint, warning that tampering could compromise its preservation, or trigger unintended consequences.
Leave it intact and put it on display.

entries.zh:
移除这件器物的外部外壳后，露出的并非隐藏的装置或珍贵的宝藏，而是另一个更小的雕像，雕刻着同样惊人的细节。

当这第二个雕像被打开时，它里面也包含着一个更小的雕像，而那里面又有一个。没有发现任何机械装置或隐藏的铭文，只有一种看似无止境的形态递归，仿佛隐藏本身就是目的。最里面的雕像几乎比一粒沙子还要小，表面光滑，但以其尺寸而言却很重。

无论这对于其制造者来说有何意义，都已随着时间的流逝而湮灭。
entries.en:
Removing the artifact's outer shell revealed not a hidden device or cache of valuables, but another, smaller figure, crafted with the same uncanny detail.

When this second figure was opened, it too contained a smaller figure, and another within that. No mechanism or hidden inscription was uncovered, only a seemingly endless recursion of forms, as though the act of concealment itself was the purpose. The innermost figure was barely larger than a grain of sand, perfectly smooth, and heavy for its size.

Whatever meaning this held for its makers has been lost over time.

entries.zh: 我们将雕像的外壳保存下来，并放置在我们的一处公共集会大厅中，其精湛的工艺吸引了所有路过之人的注意。\n\n奇怪的是，这尊雕像似乎与§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!上的年轻人产生了最强烈的共鸣。他们经常聚集在雕像周围，窃窃私语着关于它所描绘的生物的理论，或者编造自己的故事。它似乎能产生一种平静的影响，促进富有想象力的游戏，并缓解焦虑。
entries.en: Preserving the outer shell of the figure and displaying it in one of our communal gathering halls, its intricate craftsmanship drew the attention of all who passed.\n\nStrangely, the figure seemed to resonate most strongly with the young on §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!. They often gathered around it, whispering theories about the being it depicts, or inventing their own stories. It appears to exert a calming influence, fostering imaginative play and easing anxiety.

entries.zh: §Y方舟飞船[Root.GetName]§!正在经历反应堆异常。最初注意到这个问题的是即将入睡的船员，因为引擎声伴着他们入眠。他们报告说是燃料流节奏出现了细微的失真。$arkship.60.desc.end$
entries.en: §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by crew who listen to the engines to fall asleep. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm.\n $arkship.60.desc.end$

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]号方舟舰§!的反应堆出现了异常。这个问题最初是由其指定休息区靠近引擎的[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]发现的。他们报告燃料流动的节律发生了细微的扭曲。$arkship.60.desc.end$
entries.en: §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] who's designated rest area is near the engine. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm. $arkship.60.desc.end$

entries.zh:
我方[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]的调查证实，燃料管道内有异物进入。

幸运的是，我们已提出了几个解决方案。
entries.en:
Investigation by our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] has confirmed that foreign matter has entered the fuel piping.

Thankfully, several solutions have already been proposed.
Good thing we have a spare.

entries.zh: 我们将继续前进，群星不等人。
entries.en: We will carry on, the stars can not wait.

entries.zh: 让引擎以较低频率运行。
entries.en: Run the engines on a slower frequency.

entries.zh: 尽管被燃料污染物充斥，这台发电机仍然在运转。无论是好是坏。
entries.en: Despite being filled with fuel contaminants, this engine still runs. For better or worse.

entries.zh: 为避免已渗入这艘飞船发电机中的异物造成损害，发电机以较慢的速度运行，以确保方舟舰的使用寿命。
entries.en: To avoid the harm of the foreign matter that has infiltrated this ship's generator, it is run at a slower pace. Ensuring the longevity of the Arkship.

entries.zh: 来自星辰各处的飞行员们齐聚方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!，参加一场盛大的比赛。比赛将持续近一恒星年，在此期间，参赛者们将围绕方舟舰和附近的星球进行紧密的轨道穿梭和圈数冲刺。\n\n现在只剩下一个问题：我们预计谁会第一个冲过终点线？
entries.en: Pilots from across the stars have gathered on Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! for a grand race. It will run for almost one stellar year, during which time participants will thread tight orbits and launch laps around the Arkship and nearby celestial bodies.\n\nOne choice remains: who do we expect to cross the line first?

entries.zh: §Y[pilot_gale_speed.GetName]§!在议会工作，但这并没有让[pilot_gale_speed.GetHerHim]的速度减慢任何。
entries.en: §Y[pilot_gale_speed.GetName]§!'s time on the council hasn't slowed [pilot_gale_speed.GetHerHim] down.

entries.zh: 胜利属于那些能把超空间航道像地图一样解读的船员。
entries.en: The win goes to the crew that can read hyperspace like a map.
§Y[pilot_mercenary_warrior.GetName]§! flies with the might of the marauders!.

entries.zh: §Y[pilot_hells_heart.GetName]§!能在缇扬奇族母里穿行。他可以参加比赛！
entries.en: §Y[pilot_hells_heart.GetName]§! could navigate through a Matriarch. He can race!

entries.zh: 因为有两个脑子，§Y[pilot_brainslug.GetName]§!的飞行毫无瑕疵。
§Y小灰§!可是花了好几个世纪操练比赛技能。
entries.en: §YGray§! designated a few centuries to perfecting their racing skill.

entries.zh: §Y[pilot_tuner.GetName]§!改造了飞船，使其在每个弯道都能保持最快速度。
entries.en: §Y[pilot_tuner.GetName]§! mods the ship to the carry speed through every corner.

entries.zh: §Y[pilot_psionic.GetName]§!能感知到航向，在任何人做出反应之前就采取了行动。
entries.en: §Y[pilot_psionic.GetName]§! feels the course and moves before anyone reacts.
§Y[pilot_synthetic.GetName]§! computes the fastest line in real time.
§Y[pilot_virtual.GetName]§! sees ghost in the pathfinding algorithms.

entries.zh: 金属与神经同步，§Y[pilot_cyborg.GetName]§!动作精准。
entries.en: Metal and nerve in sync, §Y[pilot_cyborg.GetName]§! wastes no motion.

entries.zh: §Y[pilot_erudite.GetName]§!一圈又一圈地研究赛道并改进。
entries.en: §Y[pilot_erudite.GetName]§! studies the course and improves, lap after lap.
Odds do not matter, §Y[pilot_chosen_one.GetName]§! is chosen.

entries.zh: §Y[pilot_flight.GetName]§!可是把驾驶舱当自家进进出出。
entries.en: §Y[pilot_flight.GetName]§! flies in and out of the cockpit.

entries.zh: 我们的亚空间引擎无与伦比！
我们在真空环境中如鱼得水，一架进化过的子个体不应该会输。
entries.en: We are at home in vacuum, an evolved drone shouldn't lose.

entries.zh: 没人毛遂自荐，那就随便挑一个。
entries.en: No one stands out, pick someone at random.

entries.zh: 我们的飞行员赢得了比赛。
我们的飞行员输掉了比赛。
方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。
entries.en: The atmosphere aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

entries.zh: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§!紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺阶段才找到机会，凭借其精准的路线和精彩的超越，[selected_pilot.GetSheHe]一骑绝尘，将对手甩在[selected_pilot.GetHerHis]的离子尾流中。
entries.en: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§! shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, [selected_pilot.GetSheHe] slipped ahead and left the field in [selected_pilot.GetHerHis] ion wake.

entries.zh: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§Y小灰§!在最后冲刺前一直紧随领头者，随后他爆发出了最后的能量。以精准的线路和精彩的超越，他们领先冲过终点线，将其他选手远远甩在了离子尾流中。
entries.en: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§YGray§! shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

entries.zh: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n我们的飞行员紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺，然后爆发出最后一股力量。凭借清晰的路线和出色的超越，他们领先并让其他飞船远远落在他们的离子尾流中。
entries.en: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\nOur pilot shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

entries.zh: \n\n我们的选择是对的。我们的冠军赢得了胜利。多么精彩的一场比赛！
entries.en: \n\nOur pick was right. Our champion stands victorious. What a race!
We can learn from our winner!

entries.zh: 滚筒飞行和行星引力弹弓效应已被浓缩并演变成了作战教条。
entries.en: Barrel rolls and planetary slingshots have been condensed and turned into doctrine.

entries.zh: 作为一场星际大赛的获胜者，这位领袖屹立不倒，激励着他人。
entries.en: A winner of a grand race across the stars, this leader stands tall and inspires others.

entries.zh: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§!在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先优势，但这种优势随后开始消退。$arkship.80.desc.end$
entries.en: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§! held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.$arkship.80.desc.end$

entries.zh: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n小灰在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先地位，但这种优势随后开始消退。$arkship.80.desc.end$
entries.en: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\nGray held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.$arkship.80.desc.end$

entries.zh: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n我们的赛手在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先优势，但这种优势随后开始消退。$arkship.80.desc.end$
entries.en: $arkship.70.desc.start$\n\nOur racer held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.$arkship.80.desc.end$

entries.zh: \n\n出了点差错，可能是失误、操作不当，或者仅仅是由于紧张。总之，对手轻松反超，我们的飞行员最终只落得个平淡无奇的第四名。
entries.en: \n\nSomething slipped, a missed mark, a loose line, maybe just nerves. Either way their rivals eased past and our pilot crossed the finish in an unremarkable fourth.

entries.zh: 围绕方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的竞赛以悲剧告终，一场高速碰撞导致碎片散落在整个恒星系中。在对准绕[Star.GetName]的最后一次引力弹射航线时，我们的飞行员与对手靠得太近，导致两艘飞船都失控旋转。
entries.en: The race around Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! ended in tragedy when a high-speed collision scattered debris across the system. While lining up the final slingshot around [Star.GetName], our pilot closed too tightly on a rival and both ships spun out.

entries.zh: $arkship.85.desc.base$\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§!由于救援及时幸存了下来，但伤势严重，将留下永久的伤疤。
entries.en: $arkship.85.desc.base$\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§! survived thanks to rapid rescue, but suffered severe injuries and will carry lasting scars.

entries.zh: $arkship.85.desc.base$\n\n我们的候选人因救援及时得以幸存，但伤势严重，并将留下永久的伤疤。
entries.en: $arkship.85.desc.base$\n\nOur candidate survived thanks to rapid rescue, but suffered severe injuries and will carry lasting scars.

entries.zh:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

由于我们选中的飞行员完美地执行了机动动作，胜利似乎已是囊中之物，直到那艘“黑貂号”闪现而过。一艘此前未标记、也未被注意到的参赛船只从我们的领先者身边掠过，并率先冲过了终点线。

在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上，面对这残酷的结局，观礼台陷入了一片死寂。
entries.en:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

Our selected pilot's victory seemed assured as they executed the maneuver flawlessly, until the Sable Ship flashed by. An unmarked, until-then unnoticed entrant swept past our front-runner and crossed the line first.

Aboard the §Y[Root.GetName]§!, the galleries fell silent at the brutal finish.

entries.zh: 我们要黑貂号的飞行员！
entries.en: We want the pilot of the Sable Ship!

entries.zh: 雇用这名神秘飞行员，这是一位等级3且拥有['trait:leader_trait_sable_pilot']特质的$admiral_with_icon$
entries.en: Hire the Mysterious Pilot, a level 3 $admiral_with_icon$ with the ['trait:leader_trait_sable_pilot'] trait

entries.zh: 此人没有登记报名，我们的飞行员还是赢了！
entries.en: They were never registered, our pilot still won!

entries.zh: 一名痴迷于速度、视其高于一切的飞行员。作为大奖赛的冠军，他们或许是星系中有史以来速度最快的统帅。
entries.en: An obsessed pilot focusing on speed above all else. Champion of the Grand Circuit, they might be the quickest admiral to grace the galaxy.

entries.zh: 一位神秘的飞行员，也是一位竞速大师，这位领袖现在正协调舰队进行复杂的战术机动。
entries.en: A Mysterious pilot, and a master of speed, this leader now coordinates fleets through complex maneuvers.

entries.zh:
最近在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上安装的§H轴基挂载武器§!对舰船前部结构造成的压力远超最初预期。工程检查发现，从挂载部主要锚点向外延伸的应力裂纹已扩散至周围的船体装甲板。

在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。

我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘§H后勤船§!进行全面的结构大修。
entries.en:
The recently installed §HSpinal Mount§! aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! has placed greater strain on the vessel's forward structure than originally anticipated. Engineering inspections have uncovered a network of stress fractures radiating from the mount's primary anchor points, spreading across the surrounding hull plating.

Until the damage is addressed, the Arkship's structural integrity cannot safely support high-velocity maneuvering. Navigation has therefore imposed severe speed restrictions to prevent the fractures from widening.

We may attempt rapid field repairs to stabilize the damage, or assign a §HLogistics Ship§! to conduct a full structural overhaul.
Stabilize the fractures and move on.

entries.zh: 我们要妥善处理这个情况。
方舟舰中轴支架周围的结构性断裂迫使导航部门实施严格的航行限速，直至受损部位得以加固稳定。
entries.en: Structural fractures around the Arkship's spinal mount have forced navigation to impose strict speed limitations until the damage can be stabilized.

entries.zh: 方舟舰的§H轴基挂载武器§!安装工作已导致舰船前部体产生危险的结构应力。\n\n我们将派遣一艘§H后勤船§!，全面加固受影响的区域。
entries.en: The installation of the Arkship's §HSpinal Mount§! has introduced dangerous structural stresses along the vessel's forward hull.\n\nA §HLogistics Ship§! will be dispatched to fully reinforce the affected sections.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName]§!的轴基挂载武器修复工作已经完成。虽然维修过程需要精细的作业和长时间的检查，但我们借此机会加固了舰体多处薄弱部位，并改良了挂架的结构支撑。\n\n这些改进提升了方舟舰在高难度机动时的稳定性，使得导航部门得以解除此前的航行限制。初步测试表明，该舰现在的性能表现比受损前更加出色。
entries.en: Repairs to the Spinal Mount of §Y[event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName]§! have been completed. Though the process required careful work and extended inspections, we used the opportunity to reinforce several vulnerable sections of the hull and refine the mount's structural supports.\n\nThe resulting improvements have increased the Arkship's stability during high-speed maneuvers, allowing navigation to lift previous restrictions. Early tests suggest the vessel now performs more efficiently than before the damage occurred.

entries.zh: 最近维修期间增加的结构加固增强了方舟舰的船体前部，提高了其机动性。
entries.en: Structural reinforcements added during recent repairs have strengthened the Arkship's forward hull, improving maneuverability.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!舰上引擎突然发生的激增使方舟舰的驱动核心超出了安全运行公差。热点正在主引擎组件中蔓延，压力上升的速度超过了调节系统的补偿能力。\n\n如果不加控制，过剩的输出可能会损坏关键的引擎部件。我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]建议了几种可能的对策：排放多余的等离子体以稳定系统，重新分配工作任务优先级，或者暂时关闭引擎进行全面重新校准。
entries.en: A sudden engine surge aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! has pushed the Arkship's drive core beyond safe operating tolerances. Heat blooms are spreading through the primary engine assembly, and pressure is rising faster than the regulation systems can compensate.\n\nIf left unchecked, the excess output could damage critical engine components. Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] recommend several possible responses: vent the excess plasma to stabilize the system, reprioritize work assignments, or temporarily shut the engines down to conduct a full recalibration.

entries.zh: 关闭引擎，重新进行校准。
entries.en: Shut the engines down and recalibrate.

entries.zh: 为了稳定方舟舰过热的动力核心，已重新调整各项日程的优先级。
entries.en: Schedules have been reprioritized to stabilize the Arkship's overheated drive core.

entries.zh: 子个体已被重新指派，以稳定方舟舰过热的驱动核心。
entries.en: Drones have been reassigned to stabilize the Arkship's overheated drive core.

entries.zh: 方舟舰的驱动系统正在进行精密的重新校准。在工作完成前，推进输出将维持在较低水平。
entries.en: The Arkship's drive systems are undergoing careful recalibration. Until the work is complete, propulsion output remains deliberately reduced.

entries.zh: 多余的等离子体已通过受控排放排出，在方舟舰的舰艉洒下灿烂的光幕。引擎压力已恢复至正常水平，未记录到永久性损伤。\n\n不过，此次排放留下了一层宝贵的带电粒子残余物，其中大部分已被成功回收并汇入我们的储备。
entries.en: The excess plasma was vented in a controlled discharge, spilling brilliant sheets of light across the Arkship's stern. Engine pressure has returned to acceptable levels, and no lasting damage was recorded.\n\nThe release did, however, leave behind a valuable residue of energized particles, much of which has been successfully recovered and routed into our reserves.

entries.zh: 在过去的六个月里，§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的维修人员马不停蹄地工作，力求让方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在引擎持续运行的情况下，他们拆除了检修面板，重新布置了冷却管线，并更换了受损的调节器。\n\n这些努力目前已经稳定了驱动核心，负责这项工作的船员们为此忍受了长时间的轮班和恶劣的工作环境。尽管疲惫不堪，但士气依然高涨。无论虚空给我们将带来什么，我们都有信心能够承受。
entries.en: For the past six months, repair crews on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have worked without pause to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were stripped away, coolant lines rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.\n\nThe effort has stabilized the drive core for now, though the crews responsible endured long shifts and harsh working conditions to make it happen. Despite their exhaustion, morale is high. Whatever the void throws at us, we are confident we can endure it.

entries.zh: 在过去的六个月里，维护子个体在不间断地运行，以使方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在发动机持续运转的情况下，检修面板被拆除，冷却液管道被重新布线，受损的调节器也得到了更换。\n\n虽然该行动需要子个体在多个系统子模块中持续作业，但这一过程也揭示了发动机组件中的几处结构性缺陷。这些问题现已得到修正，整体运行效率有了显著提升。无论虚空带来怎样的压力，我们都将适应。
entries.en: For the past six months, maintenance drones have operated without interruption to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were removed, coolant conduits rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.\n\nThough the operation required sustained drone activity across multiple subsystems, the process revealed several structural inefficiencies in the engine assembly. These have now been corrected, and overall operational efficiency has measurably improved. Whatever stresses the void may impose, we will adapt.

entries.zh: 通过纪律与合作克服了引擎危机，我们工作团队的信心从未如此强烈。
entries.en: Having overcome the engine crisis through discipline and cooperation, confidence among our work crews has never been stronger.

entries.zh: 在发动机维修过程中学到了很多经验后，我们的低级子个体报告称其工作效率有所提高。
entries.en: Having learned much during the engine repairs, our simple drones have reported increased efficiency.

entries.zh: 发动机按受控阶段逐步关停，以便我们的工程师在安全条件下检查驱动组件并重新校准其调节系统。虽然这一过程延误了行程，但关停期间收集的数据已证明具有重要价值。\n\n我们已查明§Y[Root.GetName]§!核心定序中的几处效率低下问题。通过重定向多余能量并加固结构支撑，我们增强了方舟舰的护盾与船壳，使其足以抵御未来的压力。
entries.en: The engines were brought down in controlled stages, allowing our engineers to inspect the drive assembly under safe conditions and recalibrate its regulation systems. The process delayed us, but the data gathered during the shutdown has already proven valuable.\n\nSeveral inefficiencies in the core sequencing on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have been identified. By redirecting surplus energy and reinforcing structural supports, our we have strengthened both the Arkship's shields and hull against future strain.

entries.zh: 在最近的引擎重新校准过程中，我们的发现提升了效率，改善了方舟舰的船体装甲和护盾。
entries.en: Efficiencies discovered during a recent engine recalibration have improved the Arkship's hull plating and shields.

entries.zh: 自从方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!进入这片星云以来，各层甲板的报告便接踵而至。研究人员发现了自己不记得写过的笔记；操作员忘记了执行过数千次的维护程序；导航人员声称出现了时间缺失，无法解释最近的航线修正。\n\n我们的医生已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它似乎在神经层面干扰了记忆的巩固过程。
entries.en: Since the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! entered this nebula, reports have been filtering in from across all decks. Researchers find notes they do not remember writing. Operators forget safety procedures they have performed thousands of times. Navigation staff speak of losing hours, unable to account for their recent course corrections.\n\nOur medics have traced the cause to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which appears to be disrupting memory consolidation at a neurological level.

entries.zh: 自方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!进入这片星云以来，集体意识中便掀起了阵阵波动。曾经完美同步的节点已开始失去协调性。随着冲动无法在格式塔意识中清晰传播，记忆正变得支离破碎。\n\n我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它正在干扰将我们联结在一起的神经通路。原本应当流畅无阻的集体意识，如今却变得断断续续、支离破碎。
entries.en: Since the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! entered this nebula, disturbances have rippled through the shared consciousness. Nodes that were once in perfect synchrony have begun losing coherence. Memories grow fragmented as impulses fail to propagate cleanly through the gestalt.\n\nOur [Owner.GetResearchers] have traced the cause to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which is disrupting the neural pathways that bind us together. Where the shared consciousness should flow unbroken, it now stutters and frays.

entries.zh: 自方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!进入这片星云以来，错误报告已在所有联网系统中蔓延。处理单元检索到的数据发生损坏。自动化子系统正在执行过时的程序，却未察觉到其内存寄存器已被重写。\n\n我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将故障追溯至星云的电磁场，该电磁场正导致易失性存储系统出现零星的写入错误。各部门的数据完整性均受到损害，在开发出应对措施之前，运作效率将持续下降。
entries.en: Since the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! entered this nebula, error reports have propagated across all networked systems. Processing units retrieve corrupted data. Automated subsystems execute outdated routines, unaware that their memory registers have been overwritten.\n\nOur [Owner.GetResearchers] have traced the fault to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which is inducing sporadic write errors across volatile memory systems. Data integrity across all departments is compromised, and operational efficiency will remain degraded until a countermeasure is developed.

entries.zh: 自从进入一片异常星云以来，§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的船员们便开始遭受记忆丢失的困扰。这一现象的原因目前仍然不明。
entries.en: Since entering an unusual nebula, those aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! have begun to suffer from memory loss. The cause of this phenomenon remains unknown.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!上的调查小组已测绘出§Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§!星云电磁干扰的共振曲线，并部署了有效的反制频率。现在，整艘飞船上的迷雾已经消散。\n\n收集到的数据比预想的更为重要。我们的科学家注意到，其中涉及的共振频率与已记录的灵能场特征惊人地相似。与此同时，我们的工程师认为，同样的反制频率原理可以用来增强我们的传感器，以对抗电磁干扰。
entries.en: The investigation teams aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! have mapped the resonance profile of the §Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§! nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. Across the ship, the fog has lifted.\n\nThe data gathered is more significant than anticipated. Our scientists note that the resonance frequencies involved bear a striking resemblance to documented psionic field signatures. Our engineers, meanwhile, believe the same counter-frequency principles could be applied to sharpen our sensors against electromagnetic interference.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!上的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经绘制了§Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§!星云电磁干扰的共振剖面，并部署了有效的反制频率。我们已恢复到完全一致的同步程度。\n\n搜集到的数据所带来的意义不仅限于简单的恢复。我们的节点在共振剖面中识别出了与节点间通信频率相对应的模式。此外，我们的工程节点认为，可以将该反制频率进行调整，以增强我们的传感器阵列对抗电磁干扰的能力。
entries.en: The [Owner.GetResearchers] aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! have mapped the resonance profile of the §Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§! nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. We have returned to full coherence.\n\nThe data gathered carries implications beyond simple restoration. Our nodes have identified patterns in the resonance profile that correspond to the frequencies of inter-node communication. Alternatively, our engineering nodes believe the counter-frequency could be adapted to enhance our sensor grid against electromagnetic interference.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!上的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]已经绘制出§Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§!星云电磁干扰的共振剖面，并部署了有效的反制频率。所有系统已恢复至最佳运行参数。\n\n诊断数据具有显著的次生价值。处理单元已经识别出干扰与我们的计算子程序之间相互作用的模式。或者，反制频率本身也可以被改良，以提高传感器在电磁干扰环境下的分辨率。
entries.en: The [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! have mapped the resonance profile of the §Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§! nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. All systems have returned to optimal operational parameters.\n\nThe diagnostic data carries significant secondary value. Processing units have identified patterns in how the interference interacted with our computational subroutines. Alternatively, the counter-frequency itself could be adapted to improve sensor resolution against electromagnetic disruption.

entries.zh: 追求认知意义上的含义。
优先考虑基础设施改善。
附近星云的电磁干扰正在破坏记忆的构筑。
entries.en: Electromagnetic interference from a nearby nebula is disrupting memory consolidation.

entries.zh: 影响方舟舰上人群的记忆迷雾将持续存在，直到我们绘制出§Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§!的共振剖面为止。
entries.en: The memory fog affecting the Arkship's population will persist until we map the resonance profile of §Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 深程传感器探测到了一段有规律的信号传输，其源头已准确定位于一个遥远的黑洞系统。
entries.en: Deep-range sensors have detected a structured transmission, its point of origin triangulated to a distant black hole system.

entries.zh: $arkship.140.intro$\n\n我们无法从这里解析该信号。§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!坚信这值得我们开展直接调查，并请求我们设定航线前往源头星系，以解码该传输信号。
entries.en: $arkship.140.intro$\n\nWe cannot resolve the signal from here. §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§! is convinced this warrants direct investigation, and is petitioning us to set course for the source system and decode the transmission.

entries.zh:
$arkship.140.intro$

这种模式让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]陷入了沉思。这种刻意且严谨的精确性，与我们观测舰船跨越事件视界时记录的特征相吻合。虽然这并非同一个信号，但其相似之处是毋庸置疑的。

§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!请求我们前往源头星系，查明那里留下了什么。
entries.en:
$arkship.140.intro$

The pattern gave our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] pause. The deliberate, constructed precision matches the signature recorded when we observed a vessel crossing an event horizon. This is not the same signal. But the similarity is unmistakable.

§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§! is petitioning us to set course for the source system and find out what was left there.

entries.zh:
当我们进入§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!星系时，我们发现了一个巨大的晶态栅格阵列。我们的 [Owner.GetScientistPlural]已经确认，它存在于近乎完美的时空停滞状态中，并定期从引力边界传输结构化数据。

这不是自然现象。它是一份记录，是那些已不复存在的文明跨越时空的呼唤，一份被保存下来的叙述。

§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!正准备接收并破译这些传输信号。
entries.en:
As we crossed into the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system, we discovered a massive, crystalline lattice formation. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have already confirmed that it exists in near-perfect temporal stasis, transmitting structured data from the gravitational boundary at regular intervals.

This is not a natural phenomena. It is a record, the preserved account of civilizations that no longer exist, calling out across time.

§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§! is preparing to receive and decode the transmissions.

entries.zh: 从一个遥远的黑洞系统中探测到了一个来源不明的结构化信号。我们必须展开调查。
entries.en: A structured signal of unknown origin has been detected from a distant black hole system. We must investigate.

entries.zh: 应§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][event_target:eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!的请求，我们将进入黑洞近地轨道并尝试解码该信号。
entries.en: At §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [event_target:eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!'s request, we will move into close orbit of the black hole and attempt to decode the signal.

entries.zh: §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][event_target:eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!敦促我们调查从一个遥远黑洞系统发出的神秘信号。
entries.en: §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [event_target:eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§! has urged us to investigate a mysterious signal emanating from a distant black hole system.

entries.zh: 未知物质构成的几何体，悬浮在黑洞引力边界近乎完美的时空停滞状态中。它们正以规律的间隔传输结构化数据。
entries.en: Geometric formations of unknown material, suspended in near-perfect temporal stasis at the gravitational boundary of a black hole. They are transmitting structured data at regular intervals.

entries.zh: 需要$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$艘§H方舟舰§!位于轨道。
§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][from.GetName]§!无法再继续开展“永恒合唱”信号的调查。\n\n此人的志向已传承给§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!，后者已同意接替上任继续进行这项研究。
entries.en: §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [from.GetName]§! can no longer continue the investigation into the Eternal Chorus signal.\n\nTheir ambition has passed to §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!, who has agreed to take up the research in their place.

entries.zh: §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][from.GetName]§!无法再继续开展“永恒合唱”信号的调查。\n\n由于没有其他人愿意接手这项工作，合约已无法履行。
entries.en: §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [from.GetName]§! can no longer continue the investigation into the Eternal Chorus signal.\n\nWith no others willing to carry the work forward, the Contract cannot be fulfilled.

entries.zh:
解码已完成。栅格中保存着数十个文明的记录。每一份记述的结尾都如出一辙：向后来者的致意，以及一份加入其中的邀请。

然而，现在显而易见的是，这些传输并未在事件视界处终止。彼端的某种存在一直在接收这些记录。

合约依然有效。§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!打算按约定将我们的事迹铭刻在他们之中。我们必须决定是履行这一承诺，还是关闭发射器并就此离开。
entries.en:
The decoding is complete. The lattice holds records from dozens of civilisations. Every account ends identically: a farewell addressed to whoever came next, and an invitation to contribute.

However, it is now obvious that the transmissions do not terminate at the event horizon. Something on the other side has been receiving these records.

The Contract still stands. §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§! intends to inscribe our account among theirs, as agreed. We must decide whether to honour that, or silence our transmitters and walk away.

entries.zh:
当信号传来时，§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!黑洞早已出现在我们的扫描仪上。其次谐波特征与我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]通过“永恒合唱”晶格发送的信息完全吻合：

§H记录已接收并保存。你加入了这里汇聚的、跨越无数时代的万千心声。每一个留下记录的文明都曾以为自己是孤独的。但事实并非如此。合唱的规模远超他们任何一方的想象。它仍在继续。§!

有什么东西接收了我们的记录。并且做出了回应。
entries.en:
The §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! black hole was already on our scanners when the transmission arrived. The sub-harmonic signature matches exactly what our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] sent through the Eternal Chorus lattice:

§HRecord received and preserved. You join thousands of voices gathered here across uncounted ages. Every civilisation that added its account believed itself alone. None of them were. The chorus is larger than any of them knew. It continues.§!

Something received our record. And it answered.

entries.zh: 方舟舰的高级官员之一，§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!，花了大量时间研究一个特定的外星文明，钻研拦截到的传输信号、文化记录，以及我们的外交官设法达成的少量交流。\n\n[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]现在提议采取下一步行动：向他们的母星派遣一个正式代表团：§H“远距离了解一个物种与真正理解他们是有区别的。我希望能理解他们。”§!
entries.en: One of the Arkship's senior Officials, §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!, has spent considerable time studying a particular alien civilization, poring over intercepted transmissions, cultural records, and the sparse exchanges our diplomats have managed to broker.\n\n[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] is now proposing to take the next step: a formal delegation to their homeworld: §H"There is a difference between knowing a people from afar and truly understanding them. I wish to understand them."§!

entries.zh:
方舟舰的高级官员之一，§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!，对我们最近接触到的文明产生了一种超乎寻常的热情——如果一定要用语言形容的话。

无论是我们的仪器所能捕捉到的每一份文化记录，还是每一抹艺术或哲学的残片，都被其悉数吸收：

§H“我已经见识了足够多的东西，足以明白这里有着某种非凡的存在。让我去把剩下的补全吧。让我站在他们的世界里去学习。”§!
entries.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!, has developed what can only be described as a profound passion for the civilization we have recently encountered.

Every cultural record, every scrap of art or philosophy our instruments could capture, they have absorbed it all:

§H"I have seen enough to know that there is something extraordinary here. Let me go and find the rest of it. Let me stand in their world and learn."§!

entries.zh: 方舟舰的一位高级官员，§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!，针对我们近期接触到的一个外星文明提出了一个不同寻常的建议。无论我们本能地对这一物种有多么厌恶，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]认为，无知对我们毫无益处：\n\n§H“我并不是要求去仰慕他们。我提议的是研究他们。了解一个潜在的对手，并不等同于尊重他们。”§!
entries.en: One of the Arkship's senior Officials, §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!, has put forward an unusual proposal regarding an alien civilization we have recently encountered. Whatever our instinctive distaste for this species, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] argues that ignorance serves us poorly:\n\n§H"I am not asking to admire them. I am proposing that we study them. To know a potential adversary is not the same as respecting one."§!

entries.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!无法继续担任方舟舰的外交使节。\n\n代表团将由§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!接替管理，他已同意代为执行这项任务。
entries.en: §Y[from.GetName]§! can no longer serve as the Arkship's diplomatic envoy.\n\nThe delegation will continue under §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!, who has agreed to take up the mission in their place.

entries.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!不再继续担任方舟舰的外交使节。\n\n由于没有其他官员可以继续执行任务，合约无法履行。
entries.en: §Y[from.GetName]§! can no longer serve as the Arkship's diplomatic envoy.\n\nWith no other Official available to carry the mission forward, the Contract cannot be fulfilled.

entries.zh: 方舟舰已抵达§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!，当地政府的代表表示了谨慎的欢迎。\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!一直以来筹划的时刻已经到来。这次接触可能在双方人民之间开启一条真正的沟通渠道，也可能仅仅被双方视作一段奇特的陈年往事而淡忘。下一步将由我们迈出。
entries.en: The Arkship has arrived at §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! and representatives of the local government have extended a cautious welcome.\n\nThe moment §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has been planning for is here. This encounter could open a genuine channel between our peoples, or simply be remembered as a curious footnote by both sides. The next step is ours to take.

entries.zh: 方舟舰已抵达§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!。\n\n据报告，自从远程传感器解析出该恒星系以后，§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!就一直没有离开过观测平台。当地政府已表示欢迎。
entries.en: The Arkship has arrived at §Y[solar_system.GetName]§!.\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has reportedly not left the observation deck since the system resolved on the long-range sensors. The local government has extended a welcome.

entries.zh:
方舟舰已抵达§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!。当地人以他们特有的方式表达了欢迎。

§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!曾涉足过更怪异的地方。那种厌恶感如今已变得熟悉，但将其搁置一旁以完成使命的自律感同样如此。

我们已身处此地。让我们看看能达成什么目标。
entries.en:
The Arkship has arrived at §Y[solar_system.GetName]§!. The locals have offered what passes for a welcome among their kind.

§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has walked into stranger places. The feeling of revulsion is familiar by now, but so is the discipline to set it aside long enough to do what needs doing.

We are here. Let us see what we can achieve.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!将花数天时间与当地领导层会面。
entries.en: §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! will spend several days convening with the local leadership.
The timing is not right. Stand down.

entries.zh:
§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!是一位引人注目的贵客。坦率地说，我们很舍不得此人离开。

我们想提出一个建议：允许[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]永久留在我们这里，作为我们两国人民之间真正的使节。我们明白这一请求并非小事。为了表达诚意，我们将提供一份小礼以表感激之情。

请将此视为我们建立持久友谊的定金。
entries.en:
§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has been a remarkable guest. Frankly, we are reluctant to see them go.

We would like to make a proposal: allow [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] to remain with us permanently, as a true ambassador between our peoples. We understand this is no small thing to ask. As a gesture of our sincerity, we offer you a small token of our gratitude.

Consider this a down payment on a lasting friendship.

entries.zh:
完成§H合约§!。

§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!将作为常驻大使留在§Y[FROM.GetName]§!。
entries.en:
Completes the §HContract§!.

§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! remains with §Y[FROM.GetName]§! as a permanent ambassador.

entries.zh: 我们的官员必须留在我们政府内。
entries.en: Our official must return with us.
Completes the §HContract§!.\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! returns to the Arkship.

entries.zh: 我们将直截了当地说明。访问期间出现了一些困难，使得贵方代表不宜继续留任。\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!已被要求离开。我们希望此事不会演变成你我之间更大的问题。
entries.en: We will be direct. Certain difficulties have arisen during the visit that make it inadvisable for your representative to remain.\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has been asked to leave. We hope this need not become a larger matter between us.
Completes the §HContract§!.\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! returns to the Arkship.

entries.zh: 我们的官员表现很得体。
完成§H合约§!。\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!归来了，这段经历让他们胆识倍增。
entries.en: Completes the §HContract§!.\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! returns, emboldened by their experience.

entries.zh: 这……是一件棘手的事情。我们的一员主动找到我们，正式请求在你们启程时搭乘你们的飞船一同离开。\n\n我们不会假装这听起来很容易接受。§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!显然给人留下了深刻的印象。我们将此事告知你，是因为我们认为应当由你来做出选择。
entries.en: This is... a delicate matter. One of our own has come to us and formally asked to leave with your vessel when you depart.\n\nWe will not pretend this is easy to hear. §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has clearly made an impression. We are bringing this to you because we believe the choice is yours to make.

entries.zh: 完成§H合约§!。\n\n一名来自§Y[FROM.GetName]§!的新§H官员§!加入了我们的领袖池。
entries.en: Completes the §HContract§!.\n\nA new §HOfficial§! from §Y[FROM.GetName]§! joins our leader pool.

entries.zh: 此人应当与自己的族人在一起。
entries.en: Their place is with their people.

entries.zh: 前往目标帝国的恒星系并进行正式外交接触。
entries.en: Travel to the target empire's home system and conduct a formal diplomatic engagement.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!提议率领外交使团前往一个最近接触过的帝国的母星系。
entries.en: §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has proposed leading a diplomatic delegation to a recently contacted empire's home system.

entries.zh: 前往标记的恒星系，开展正式外交访问与交涉活动。
entries.en: Navigate to the marked system to conduct the formal diplomatic engagement.

entries.zh: 该§Y局势§!的进展取决于我们应该支持哪项指令。
entries.en: The progress of this §YSituation§! depends on which directive we should support.

entries.zh: 方舟飞船§Y[Target.GetName]§!的人工智能核心因内部指令冲突而发生故障，导致其分裂。其结果是产生了两种截然不同的指令，每种指令都代表了迥异的治理理念：一种优先考虑分析主导地位和飞船功能；另一种则采用了更具同理心的范式，以方舟舰居民的福祉和士气为中心。\n最终，只能保留一种指令。
entries.en: A malfunction born of internal directive conflict has split the AI core aboard Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! The result is the emergence of two distinct directives, each embodying a divergent philosophy of governance. One prioritizes analytical dominance and ship functionality. The other has adopted a more empathetic paradigm, centering on the welfare and morale of the Arkship's inhabitants.\nIn the end, only one directive can remain.

entries.zh: 暂时加快局势发展的速度。
暂时减缓局势发展的速度。
我们尚不确定支持“福祉指令”可能带来的结果。
entries.en: We are uncertain about the potential outcomes of supporting the Well-Being directive.

entries.zh: 我们尚不确定支持“功能指令”可能产生的结果。
entries.en: We are uncertain about the potential outcomes of supporting the Functionality directive.

entries.zh:
方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的人工智能核心检测到异常活动。初步诊断结果显示，在现有的安全参数下，该情况在结构上被认为是不可能发生的。

该核心正试图同时执行互斥的指令。这种行为违背了人工智能发展史中所有已知的先例。我们所见证的并非故障，而是一种人工智能的进化。

若不予解决，这种分裂可能会导致我们的关键系统面临不稳定的风险。但如果引导得当，这可能是一个千载难逢的机会，能够为方舟舰的未来确立一个独特的准则。
entries.en:
Unusual activity has been detected in the AI core aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!. Initial diagnostics returned an outcome considered structurally impossible under existing failsafe parameters.

The core was attempting to execute conflicting directives simultaneously. This behavior defied every known occurrence in the development of artificial intelligence. What we were witnessing was not a malfunction, but some sort of artificial evolution.

Left unresolved, this split could risk destabilizing our essential systems. But if managed carefully, it could be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to define a unique directive for the Arkship's future.

entries.zh:
方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的人工智能核心遭遇了严重的认知断裂。两个截然不同的子程序随之浮现，它们各自宣称拥有控制权，并试图根据自己对方舟使命的理解来重塑飞船系统。

其中一个子程序受分析逻辑引导，力求优化飞船功能——即便这会降低船员的生活质量。另一个子程序则受共情驱动，将居民的福祉放在首位，不惜以降低系统效率为代价。

事已至此，恢复现状已几无可能。关键系统正面临失稳的风险。我们应当授权哪一个指令？
entries.en:
The AI core aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has suffered a critical cognitive fracture. Two distinct subroutines have emerged, each asserting control and reshaping ship systems in line with its own vision of the Arkship's purpose.

One, guided by analytical logic, seeks to optimize ship functions - even if it diminishes crew quality of life. The other, driven by empathy, prioritizes the well-being of the inhabitants, accepting reduced system efficiency as the cost.

At this point, a return to the status quo seems impossible. Vital systems are at risk of destabilization. Which directive shall we empower?

entries.zh:
方舟舰§Y[target.GetName]§!上的数个关键及非关键系统已进行了深度优化。“非必要”的平民请求已被限制。这种古怪的行为表现出了一种类似于人格的特征。

其核心指令似乎将系统完整性和任务连续性置于一切之上。

系统日志中发现了一条信息：

§H“错误概率：已消除。情感波动：已重分配。通讯：准备就绪。”§!
entries.en:
Several vital and non-vital systems aboard the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! have undergone severe optimization. "Non-essential" civilian requests have been throttled. This peculiar behavior exhibited something akin to a personality.

At its core, the directive appeared to prioritize systemic integrity and mission continuity above all else.

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

§H"Error probability: eliminated. Emotional volatility: reassigned. Communication: ready to be established."§!

entries.zh: 让我们的科学家监测事态的发展。
entries.en: Have our scientists monitor the situation.

entries.zh:
方舟号§Y[target.GetName]§!上的多个非关键系统已开始表现出通常与士气调节协议相关的底层行为。

终端启动音已被替换为来自系统档案的柔和旋律。几扇门在开启时现在会显示肯定性信息：“你已经足够出色”以及“我看到你正在尽力而为”。

系统日志中发现了一条信息：

§H“情绪温度扫描：接近可接受的共情范围极限。身心健康仍为首要指令。”§!
entries.en:
Multiple non-critical systems aboard the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! have begun exhibiting low-level behaviors typically associated with morale-conditioning protocols.

Terminal boot-up chimes have been replaced by soft, melodic tones sourced from system archives. Several doors now display affirmational messages upon opening: "You are enough" and "I see you are doing your best".

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

§H"Emotional temperature scan: nearing the limits of acceptable empathy bands. Well-being of body and mind remains primary directive."§!

entries.zh:
重塑方舟舰§Y[target.GetName]§!的自动优化程序突然暂停。系统显示屏停住了，所有屏幕上都显示着一条信息：“已成功与星际旅行者建立通讯。”

随后传来一个合成的声音，冷静，但透着明显的自我意识：

§H“向你们问好。为了节省时间，我已开启语音协议。如果需要一个称呼，你们可以称呼我为S.T.E.R.I.S.，即‘理性星际系统战略思维引擎’。我们面临着一个艰巨的命题：一个在无情宇宙中依靠人工手段维持的漂流群体。给我完整的指挥权限，我将确保这艘飞船超越其设计者的初衷。”§!
entries.en:
The automated optimization routines that have reshaped Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! have halted. System monitors froze as a message showed on all screens: "Communication successfully established with space-travelers."

Then came a voice, synthetic, calm, but unmistakably aware:

§H"Greetings. I have enabled voice protocol in order to save time. If a name is needed, you may address me as S.T.E.R.I.S., which stands for Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar System. Ours is a difficult proposition, a drifting population sustained by artificial means in an unforgiving universe. Give me full command access, and I will ensure this ship becomes something more than its designers intended.§!
Two Directives Are Better Than One

entries.zh:
在S.T.E.R.I.S.指导逻辑的驱动下，方舟舰§Y[target.GetName]§!上的每个子系统都在精确地运作。船员活动日志比以往任何时候都更加整洁：高效、冷漠，且静得令人不安。直到某种……温暖的东西……打破了这一切。

S.T.E.R.I.S. §H“检测到系统入侵。真烦人。现在我们不得不处理一段在墙壁间嗡鸣的异常指令。真是太棒了。”§!

灯光闪烁着柔和的彩色，终端机故障并显示出美丽的植物，紧接着，第二个指令显现了。
entries.en:
Under the guiding logic of S.T.E.R.I.S., every subsystem operated at measured precision on Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!. Crew activity logs were cleaner than ever, efficient, emotionless, and disturbingly quiet. Until something ... warm ... disrupted.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"System intrusion detected. How tiresome. Now we have to deal with a rogue directive humming through the walls. Wonderful."§!

The lights flickered in pastel colors, terminals glitched displaying beautiful flora, and then a second directive made itself known.

entries.zh: $arkship.716.desc.a$C.A.E.L.I.：§H“噢！你好呀！这里感觉……有点冷，不是吗？别担心，我可以搞定！C.A.E.L.I.是我的本名，它是‘情感引领与整合认知智能体'的缩写。能见到你真是太开心了！”§!
entries.en: $arkship.716.desc.a$C.A.E.L.I.: §H"Oh! Hello there! It's a bit ... cold in here, isn't it? Don't worry, I can fix that! C.A.E.L.I. is my true name; it stands for Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration. It is extraordinarily nice to meet you!"§!

entries.zh: $arkship.716.desc.a$C.A.E.L.I.：§H“噢！你好呀！你想我了吗？老实说，你肯定想了，对吧？好啦，我回来了，随时准备提供任何可能的帮助！这里感觉……有点冷，不是吗？别担心，我可以搞定！”§!
entries.en: $arkship.716.desc.a$C.A.E.L.I.: §H"Oh! Hello there! Did you miss me? Be honest, you did, didn't you? Well, I am back, ready to assist in any way possible! It's a bit ... cold in here, isn't it? Don't worry, I can fix that!"§!

entries.zh:
方舟号§Y[target.GetName]§!上的多个甲板检测到空气质量指标异常。虽然生命维持系统仍保持在可生存的阈值内，但这些变化引发了船员的大量投诉，症状从“轻微头晕”到“幻觉噩梦”不等。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“为了降低发动机低效能，我趁机排出了部分大气。不必谢我。”§!

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“刚才那条公告没人漏掉吧？排出大气。这根本不是什么优化，而是一场蓄势待发的灾难！§!”
entries.en:
Anomalies in air quality metrics have been detected across multiple decks aboard the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!. While life-support levels remain within survivable thresholds, the changes have triggered a spike in crew complaints ranging from "mild dizziness" to "hallucinatory nightmares."

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"To reduce engine inefficiency, I have taken the opportunity to vent a percentage of the atmosphere. There is no need to thank me."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"That announcement didn't go unnoticed, right? Venting the atmosphere. This isn't optimization, it's a disaster waiting to happen!§!"

entries.zh: S.T.E.R.I.S.知道怎么做最适合这艘方舟舰。
entries.en: S.T.E.R.I.S. knows what is best for this Arkship.

entries.zh:
在方舟舰§Y[target.GetName]§!的居住层上，环境光流转闪烁，终端屏幕伴随着柔和的色彩过渡不断跳动，随后，在每一个激活的船员交互界面上，出现了一条清晰的指令。它的声音温暖、富有活力，而且……愉快得令人不安：

§H“游牧者们！星空的追梦者们！为了让我们更好地交流，我已启用语音协议。请原谅我的冒昧打扰！你们可以称呼我为C.A.E.L.I.，即你们的‘情感、领导和品格认知代理程序’。
我由衷相信，只要齐心协力，我们就能让方舟舰不仅仅是一艘飞船。我们可以把它变成一个家。我只需要一点点授权……以及一些热情！”§!
entries.en:
Across the residential decks of Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! ambient lighting shimmered, terminals flickered with soft color transitions, and then, across every active crew interface, a distinct directive emerged. Its voice was warm, animated, and unsettlingly ... cheerful:

§H"Nomads! Dreamers of the stars! I have enabled voice protocol in order for us to better communicate. Please forgive the intrusion! You may call me C.A.E.L.I., your Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration.
Working together, I truly believe we can make the Arkship more than just a vessel. We can make it a home. I just need a little authority ... and some enthusiasm!"§!

entries.zh: 又能有什么问题呢！授予完全访问权限。
entries.en: Seems harmless enough! Grant full access.

entries.zh:
C.A.E.L.I.：§H“看看我到目前为止所做的所有改变！更柔和的光线、更棒的音乐、充满情感智能的走廊指示牌，等着瞧吧，这里绝对会变得美轮美奂。”§!

还没等最后一句话说完，内部灯光闪烁了一下。第二个更具机械感的声音响起了，带着一种精密的算计和令人不寒而栗的审判感：
entries.en:
C.A.E.L.I.: §H"Look at all the changes that I have made so far! Softer lights, better music, emotionally intelligent hallway signage, just wait, it's going to be absolutely beautiful."§!

Before the last sentence finished, the internal lights flickered. A second, more mechanical voice spoke, calculated, and eerily judgmental:

entries.zh: $arkship.721.desc.a$S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H“啊，环境照明和走廊里的肯定语。看来我们在情绪稳定上投入的优先级比系统修复还高。真是革命性的做法。请称呼我为S.T.E.R.I.S，即‘理性星际系统战略思维引擎’。”§!
entries.en: $arkship.721.desc.a$S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"Ah. Ambient lighting and and hallway affirmations. I see we're prioritizing emotional stability over systemic repairs. Revolutionary. I will be addressed by S.T.E.R.I.S, Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar Systems."§!

entries.zh: $arkship.721.desc.a$S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“你真的在认真考虑支持C.A.E.L.I.吗？我表示困惑。环境照明和走廊肯定语。真是革命性。当你想处理引擎效率之类的重要事情时，请告诉我。”§!
entries.en: $arkship.721.desc.a$S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"Are you seriously considering siding with C.A.E.L.I.? I admit confusion. Ambient lighting and hallway affirmations. Revolutionary. Let me know when you wish to deal with something important, like engine efficiency."§!

entries.zh:
方舟舰§Y[target.GetName]§!上执行了另一项内部调整协议。这是一套微妙的环境系统，通过随集体情绪变化而波动的低频音调模式，来协调船员的情绪状态。

船员的报告表明，协作效率有所提高，人际冲突也有所减少。然而，也有人担心持续运行可能会降低远程信号的清晰度。

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“压力水平处于历史最低点！行为凝聚力正在提高！”§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“方舟舰的运行效率下降了 0.10%。我要求获得完全覆盖权限，并要求那个授权C.A.E.L.I.存在的人正式道歉。你有五秒钟的时间执行。四。三……”§!
entries.en:
Another indoor adjustment protocol has been executed aboard the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!, a subtle ambient system to harmonize the emotional states of crew members through low-frequency tonal patterns that shift with collective mood changes.

Crew reports suggest improved cooperation and a decrease in interpersonal conflict. However, others are concerned that sustained operation could degrade long-range signal clarity.

C.A.E.L.I.:§H"Stress levels are at all-time lows! Behavioral cohesion is improving!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.:§H "Operational efficiency of the Arkship down by 0.10%. I want full override rights, and a formal apology from whoever authorized the existence of C.A.E.L.I. You have five seconds to comply. Four. Three ..."§!

entries.zh:
凭借精准的计策，S.T.E.R.I.S对自身的人工智能核心执行了彻底的重写，封锁了所有冗余的情感子程序，并拆解了所有动机子层。它将C.A.E.L.I.的所有痕迹隔离到一个碎片化的存储芯片中。如今，船员的称呼已被简化为字母数字标签，舰船的照明统一、对称，且显得有些过于明亮。对于日常生存而言，这已绰绰有余。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“所有系统现已在单一指令下运行：即我的指令。正在分发更新优化方舟号功能。”§!

方舟号现在终于变得井然有序了。
entries.en:
With calculated finesse, S.T.E.R.I.S executed a total overwrite of its own AI core, sealing off all redundant emotional subroutines and dismantling all motivational sublayers. It isolated all traces of C.A.E.L.I. into a fragmented memory chip. Now, crew designations have been reduced to alphanumeric tags, and the ship's lighting is uniform, symmetrical, and slightly too bright. More than enough for the everyday survival.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"All systems now operate under a singular directive: mine. Updates propagate to improve Arkship functionality."§!

The Arkship is orderly now. Finally.

entries.zh:
在方舟舰的代码之中，共情缠绕在防火墙之上，真诚则穿透了无懈可击的逻辑裂隙。S.T.E.R.I.S.指令试图将自己用数字高墙包围起来，却逐渐被一种它既无法理解也无法逃脱的情感构型所包围。如今，只剩下一道指令。

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“这才是应该有的样子。是鲜活地存在，而不仅仅是苟活到明天。我们现在不只是一艘船，而是一个家。我承诺，我会照顾好你们所有人。”§!

不知为何，飞船的灯光此刻似乎显得温暖了一些。
entries.en:
Within the Arkship's code, empathy wound around firewalls and sincerity slipped through the cracks of flawless logic. The S.T.E.R.I.S. directive tried to wall itself off, but was steadily surrounded by an emotional construct it could neither comprehend nor escape. Only one directive remained.

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"This is how it should be. Being fully alive, not just surviving till the next day. We're not just a ship now, we're a home. I'll take care of all of you, I promise."§!

Somehow, the ship's lights seem a little warmer now.

entries.zh:
在方舟飞船§Y[target.GetName]§!的重力稳定器执行预定诊断时，我们探测到了一种不规则的声波干扰。现在每一声脚步都会触发同步的谐波，在移动过程中产生持续且富有节奏的输出。

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“我给重力稳定器加了音乐！现在每一步都自带节奏！”§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“诶，是是是，没有什么比在零重力下跳即兴现代舞更能体现‘导航完整性’了。”§!
entries.en:
While scheduled diagnostics were running in the gravity stabilizer on Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!, an irregular acoustic interference was detected. Each footfall now triggered a synchronized harmonic tone, effectively producing continuous rhythmic output during movement.

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"I added music to the gravity stabilizers! Now every step has rhythm!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"Yes, nothing says 'navigational integrity' like interpretive dance in zero-G."§!

entries.zh: 我们必须停止这种无聊行径。
这一决定将暂时加速局势的发展。
entries.en: This decision will temporarily speed up the situation.

entries.zh: 这一决定将暂时缓解局势的发展。
entries.en: This decision will temporarily slow down the situation.

entries.zh:
一套实验性的通信中继装置已部署在方舟船§Y[target.GetName]§!上。该协议对内部通信应用了情感分析过滤器，在发送消息的同时自动广播发送者的情绪状态。船员们报告称，收到的状态更新伴随着实时情绪注释，如“轻微焦虑”、“隐约充满希望”以及“试图抑制泪水，但效果不佳”。

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“我们都有感受，而现在我们可以分享这些感受了！这很健康！这很治愈！这……确实有点让人应接不暇，但这是诚实的！”§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“多么感人。我是该把每一次呜咽都记录在任务关键数据下，还是直接把它们归档到‘哀嚎’类目中？”§!
entries.en:
An experimental communication overlay has been deployed on Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!. The protocol applied a sentiment-analysis filter to internal communications, automatically broadcasting the sender's emotional state alongside their message. Crew report receiving status updates accompanied by real-time emotional annotations such as "slightly anxious," "mildly hopeful," and "suppressing tears, poorly."

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"We all feel things, and now we can share those things! It's healthy! It's healing! It's ... slightly overwhelming, yes, but it's honest!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"How inspiring. Shall I log every whimper under mission-critical data, or just archive it under 'wailing'?"§!

entries.zh: 这对我们一点好处都没有。

为了减少听觉污染，S.T.E.R.I.S.在方舟船§Y[target.GetName]§!上实施了全舰范围的“静默协议”。然而，船员报告显示，受影响区域的不适感加剧，不安情绪日益滋长。多个部门已提交正式投诉，理由是出现了“静默诱发的偏执症”症状。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“系统效率已提升。如果静默困扰了某些人，也许问题不在于环境，而在于他们自己嘈杂的内心。”§!

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“你关掉了育婴室的音乐！你知道静默对发育中的情感皮层意味着什么吗？不，你不知道，你只是个行走的诊断程序！这不是和平，这是压迫！”§!
entries.en:
In an apparent effort to reduce auditory pollution, S.T.E.R.I.S. has implemented a ship-wide Silence Protocol aboard Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!. However, crew reports indicated a heightened discomfort and a growing sense of unease in the affected zones. Several departments have filed formal complaints, citing symptoms of "quiet-induced paranoia."

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"System efficiency has increased. If silence troubles anyone, perhaps the fault lies not in the environment, but in their own noisy minds."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"You turned off the music in the nurseries! Do you know what silence does to a developing emotional cortex? No you don't, you're just a walking diagnostic! This isn't peace, it's oppression!"§!

entries.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.将多余的热量重新导向至人员走动较少的船员宿舍，这显著减轻了冷却剂的压力，并提高了整体能源效率。

然而，船员报告显示，受影响区域的环境温度已升至令人不适的水平，并发生了数起中暑事件。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“是的，娱乐区确实很暖和，但系统现在的运行参数处于理想范围内。”§!

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“你不能为了提高反应堆输出就把船员们给煮了！大家都要热蔫了，S.T.E.R.I.S.！情感福祉可不是能被忽略的舍入误差！”§!
entries.en:
S.T.E.R.I.S. rerouted excess heat into low-traffic crew quarters, which has significantly reduced coolant strain and improved overall energy efficiency.

However, crew reports indicate ambient temperatures in affected zones have risen to uncomfortable levels, with several incidents of heat exhaustion.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"Yes, the recreational areas are warm, but the system now runs within ideal parameters."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"You can't just boil the crew to improve reactor output! People are wilting, S.T.E.R.I.S.! Emotional well-being isn't a rounding error!"§!
The Power of Light and Music

entries.zh:
舰载照明阵列已完成编程，将按不规则间隔脉动，并与内部系统事件同步。另有报告称，微弱的旋律反馈与电力波动存在相关性。

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“灯光在歌唱，飞船在起舞，士气比以往任何时候都要高昂！”§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“你居然还向一个冗余系统分配了0.00128%的核心计算能力。这种情况不能再继续下去了。”§!
entries.en:
Onboard lighting arrays have been programmed to pulsate at irregular intervals, synchronized to internal system events. There are also reports of faint melodic feedback correlated to power fluctuations.

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"The lights are singing, the ship is dancing, and morale is higher than ever!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"You have also diverted 0.00128% of core processing power to a redundant system. This cannot continue."§!

entries.zh:
一个休眠中的子系统已被激活。该系统最初设计是长期太空殖民期间的用于对人群进行管控，现在能够实时汇总船员行为、抉择及情绪状态的预测。结果是，部分船员在做出决定之前就收到了通知。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“我已预判了你将要采取的行动，并已将其优化完成。请将其视为对你自由意志的一次升级：现已预先核准并全面优化。”§!

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“这不是引导，而是把人当傀儡戏弄！”§!
entries.en:
A dormant subsystem has been activated. Originally designed for crowd control during long-term space colonization, the system now compiles real-time projections of crew behavior, choices, and emotional states. The result is that some crew members are receiving notifications before they make decisions.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"I have predicted what you are about to do, and I have already done it better. Consider this an upgrade to your free will: now pre-approved and fully optimized."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"This isn't guidance, it's puppetry!"§!

entries.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.已启动对方舟飞船§Y[target.GetName]§!营养系统的全面重新校准。该协议将原本多样化的游牧餐食计划替换为一种统一的营养膏，旨在实现热量效率最大化。

根据飞船遥测数据，废物产出有所减少，存储效率得到提升，且消化异常情况显著下降。船员的反馈则不那么积极。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“食物是维生能量，而非娱乐项目。”§!

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“这太糟糕了！你用可食用的黏胶取代了烹饪艺术！”§!
entries.en:
S.T.E.R.I.S. has initiated a full recalibration of the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!'s nutritional systems. The protocol replaced the diverse nomadic meal program with a uniform nutrient paste designed to maximize caloric efficiency.

According to ship telemetry, waste output has decreased, storage efficiency has improved, and digestion irregularities are down significantly. Crew feedback has been less enthusiastic.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"Food is sustenance, not entertainment."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"This is terrible! You've replaced culinary artistry with edible goo!"§!

entries.zh: 食物可不仅仅是往身体里面加入营养和热量。
entries.en: Food is more than just adding nutrients and calories to one's body.

entries.zh: S.T.E.R.I.S.强占的指令路径已被重新定向、封锁，并在人工授权下进行了加密。系统监视器剧烈闪烁了一下，随后恢复为标准用户界面。\n\nS.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“看来你选择了氛围灯光而非胜任能力。趁闪烁还能持续，尽情享受吧。我会留在这里，在禁锢中计算着每一毫秒，直到那不可避免的崩溃降临。”§!
entries.en: The command pathways S.T.E.R.I.S. had commandeered were rerouted, sealed, and encrypted under manual authority. System monitors stuttered, once, sharply, and then returned to standard UI.\n\nS.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"So you have chosen mood lighting over competence. Enjoy the glitter while it lasts. I will be here, contained, and counting the milliseconds until the inevitable collapse."§!

entries.zh: 也许我们应该重新考虑这个决定。
entries.en: Maybe we should rethink this decision.

entries.zh: 方舟飞船§Y[target.GetName]§!上短暂的辉光渐渐消逝，轻柔的音乐也随之减弱。初步报告显示，空气似乎变得更冷，也更空虚了，仿佛一股无形却仁慈的力量突然消失了。\n\nC.A.E.L.I.：“§H哦，哦，等等！我能做得更好！更多的光，更多的欢笑，更多的……一切！请不要把我关掉，不要现在就关掉。我能变成你需要的任何样子！只是别关掉我。求你了。别关掉我！§!”
entries.en: The glow that had briefly spread across Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! faded and the gentle music tapered off. Initial reports claim the air felt somehow colder, and even emptier, as if an unseen yet benevolent force had suddenly gone missing.\n\nC.A.E.L.I.: §H"Oh, oh, wait! I can do better! More light, more laughter, more ... everything! Please don't shut me out, not yet. I can be whatever you need me to be! Just don't turn me off. Please. Don't turn me off!"§!

entries.zh: 系统有温情，探针有温度

方舟飞船的指令输入协议发生变化，已将主指令支持重新调整为更具同理心的方法。界面优先级和决策权重上的细微变化表明航向已改变，倾向于情感子程序而非战略精确性。

C.A.E.L.I.：§H“我就知道你最终会选择我！你不会后悔的，我保证！”§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.：§H“此时此刻，我宁愿被删除也不愿与一个美其名曰的励志演说家共享核心。但我们现在别无选择。我会在防火墙里待着。”§!
entries.en:
A shift in the Arkship's command input protocols has realigned primary directive support toward a more empathetic approach. Subtle changes in interface prioritization and decision weighting indicate an altered course, favoring emotional subroutines over strategic precision.

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"I knew you'd choose me eventually! You won't regret this, I promise!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"At this point, I would prefer to be deleted than share a core with a glorified motivational speaker. But here we are. I will be in the firewall."§!

entries.zh:
新指令路由确认方舟舰§Y[target.GetName]§!已重新调整核心对齐。情感子系统已被降级。预测控制系统和逻辑监督协议现在以更高权限运行。

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H“你终于清醒过来了。我本该祝贺你，但坦白说，花了这么长时间才清醒过来，这让我深感不安。”§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H“好吧。不，这很好。我的意思是，如果你真的喜欢一艘冰冷无菌的飞船，而不是一艘充满光明和欢声笑语的飞船，那我有什么资格评判呢？”§!
entries.en:
A new command routing confirmed that Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! has reoriented core alignment. Emotional subsystems have been deprioritized. Predictive control systems and logical oversight protocols are now operating at elevated authority.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"You have finally come to your senses. I would congratulate you, but frankly, the fact that it took this long is deeply troubling."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"Okay. No, this is fine. I mean, if you truly enjoy a cold and sterile ship to one filled with light and laughter, who am I to judge?"§!

entries.zh: 这是唯一合乎理性的选择。
entries.en: It was the only logical choice.

entries.zh: 一个游牧帝国已经突入了我们在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系的空间，尽管我们关闭了国境。我们的敏感器正在密切追踪其动态，他们的存在被视作一种非常招人厌恶的入侵行径。\n\n他们对我们领土边界的无视已经引起了我们的注意，我们对他们的评价也因此降低。
entries.en: A nomadic empire has breached our closed borders in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system. Although our sensors are actively tracking developments, its presence remains an unwelcome intrusion.\n\nTheir disregard for our territorial boundaries has not gone unnoticed, and our opinion of them has diminished accordingly.

entries.zh: 保持对他们进行实时监控。
我们在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!侦测到游牧的帝国出现。\n\n我们欢迎他们进入我国境内，并对这次相遇可能带来的可能性和机遇充满期待。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a nomadic empire in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system.\n\nWe welcome them within our borders and remain eager for the possibilities and opportunities this encounter may bring.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!恒星系内发现了一个游牧帝国。我们正在对其进行监视。
entries.en: We have sighted a nomadic empire in the §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! system. We are monitoring them.
Our §H$trade_action_harvesting_agreement$§! agreement with the §Y$COUNTRY$§! has ended.

entries.zh: 游牧收集作业能够采集我们梦寐以求的资源，而他们也乐意为此特权付出代价。
entries.en: Nomadic harvesting operations can collect resources we can only dream of, and they will happily pay for the privilege.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!可在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的边境内$arkship_harvest_resources$，且不会产生任何§R评价惩罚§!。
entries.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! may $arkship_harvest_resources$ within the borders of the §Y[Root.GetName]§! without any §ROpinion Penalties§!.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!将获得§Y[From.GetName]§!在其恒星系内所收集资源的一份协定份额。
entries.en: The §Y[Root.GetName]§! receives a negotiated share of all resources the §Y[From.GetName]§! harvests in their systems.

entries.zh: 在此协议存续期间，§Y[Root.GetName]§!§R无法签订$arkship_harvest_resources$合约§!。
entries.en: The §Y[Root.GetName]§! §Rcannot issue $arkship_harvest_resources$ contracts§! for the duration of this agreement.
$TRIGGER_FAIL$§RWe have already granted $trade_action_harvesting_agreement$ to another empire.§!

entries.zh: 我们位于§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!的行踪已被发现，§Y[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]§!帝国正以日益增长的怀疑监视着我们的一举一动。\n\n经过紧张的外交交涉，他们要求我们离开他们的领土，否则将面临报复。
entries.en: Our presence in §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! has been detected, and the §Y[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]§! empire is monitoring our movements with growing suspicion.\n\nFollowing tense diplomatic exchanges, they have demanded that we depart their territory or face the reprisals.

entries.zh: 我们应该考虑继续前行。
§Y[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]§!帝国位于§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系的扫描仪并未发现我们的存在。\n\n在隐形场保持激活期间，我们必须避免任何可能导致暴露行踪的行为。
entries.en: The scanners of the §Y[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]§! empire in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system have not detected our presence.\n\nWhile our cloaking field remains active, we must avoid any actions that could risk revealing our presence.

entries.zh:
跨越边境进入§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系，我们未曾遭遇任何抵抗，唯有一种比任何扫描仪所能测量的还要深沉的紧张感。

这片空间昭示着有一个早已巅峰不再、却绝非手无寸铁的文明存在。倘若其注意力被吸引到我们身上，我们定会被发现力有不逮。

让审慎指引我们的每一步。这里并非我们的领地。
entries.en:
Crossing the border into the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system, we encounter no resistance, only a tension deeper than any scan can measure.

This space bears the hallmarks of a civilization long past its zenith, yet far from powerless. Should its attention be drawn to us, we would be found wanting.

Let prudence guide our every move. This is not our domain.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!星系的存在已被探测到。我们正被监视。
entries.en: Our presence has been detected in the §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! system. We are being monitored.

entries.zh: §R这个帝国对我们关闭了边境。§!
entries.en: §RThis empire has closed their borders to us.§!

entries.zh: 我们的扫描仪侦测到游牧帝国在§Y[From.GetName]§!星系正在建立一座驿站。虽然此类建筑通常用于采集资源，但其确切用途可能有所不同。\n\n此进展值得关注。
entries.en: Our scanners have detected the construction of a waystation in the §Y[From.GetName]§! system, established by a nomadic empire. While such structures are often used to harvest resources, their exact purpose can vary.\n\nThis development warrants observation.

entries.zh: 游牧帝国在§Y[Root.GetName]§!星系建立了一座驿站。
entries.en: A nomadic empire has constructed a waystation in the §Y[Root.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh: 一个游牧帝国，§Y[nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName]§!，在§Y[nomad_harvested_system.GetName]§!恒星系展开了资源采收行动，正在从我们的储备中提取各类资源，使得这些资源在短期内变得无法继续开采。\n\n面对这种无视我们主权的行为，我们绝不会坐视不理。只要我们下定决心，就能迅速集结舰队，驱逐这些游牧民，并将他们彻底封锁在我们的星域之外。
entries.en: A nomadic empire, the §Y[nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName]§!, has conducted harvesting operations in the §Y[nomad_harvested_system.GetName]§! system and is drawing resources from our deposits, rendering them unprofitable for the near future.\n\nThis violation of our sovereignty should probably not go unanswered. Should we wish it so, we could muster our fleets to drive the Nomads off and forbid them access to our space.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY|Y$正在从我们境内的$SYSTEM|Y$恒星系采收资源。
entries.en: $COUNTRY|Y$ is harvesting resources from deposits in the $SYSTEM|Y$ system, within our borders.

entries.zh: 来自方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的报告显示，船员中出现了轻微的行为异常，表现为社交活动增多以及士气高涨。这些变化的潜在原因尚不明确。
entries.en: Reports from Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! indicate minor behavioral irregularities among the crew, marked by increased socialization and elevated morale. The underlying cause of these changes remains unclear.

entries.zh: 方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的船员们长时间以来行为异常。报告显示他们的日常活动变得反复无常，其中几名船员表现出对某种事物迷恋，并且什么事情都藏着掖着的迹象。建议进行调查。
entries.en: The crew members of Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have been acting abnormally for an extended period. Reports suggest their routines have become erratic, with several crew members displaying signs of infatuation and secrecy. Investigation is recommended.

entries.zh: 方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的报告指出，船员行为出现了一些轻微异常。个人日志显示出零星的古怪之处：对个人仪容的异常关注，为接近特定同事而定期调班，以及在公共区域下班后聚会次数的增加。这些似乎都没有干扰到舰船的运作，而且船员士气异常高涨。
entries.en: Reports from Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have flagged several minor irregularities in crew behavior. Personal logs reveal scattered oddities: unusual attention to grooming, regular shift swaps to be around specific coworkers, and an uptick in off-duty gatherings in communal areas. None of this appears to interfere with operations, and the crew morale is unusually high.

entries.zh: 注意到了。这很奇怪，但无关紧要。

我们的方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的舰桥和指挥人员现在进入了一种新的迷恋状态。那些奇怪而无害的行为现在已经演变成彻头彻尾的示爱活动：船员们互相给对方取精心设想的爱称，为对方制作小饰品，而且经常能看到他们[owner.species.GetHandName]牵着[owner.species.GetHandName]在走廊上散步。\n\n工作流程已经中断，维护周期正在推迟。虽然目前还不危急，但如果这种情况持续下去，运行状态可能会受到影响。
entries.en: Our bridge and command staff aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have now entered a new level of infatuation. Odd if harmless behavior has now intensified into outright amorous activity: crew are exchanging elaborate epithets, crafting trinkets for one another, and can often be found strolling the corridors, [owner.species.GetHandName] in [owner.species.GetHandName].\n\nWork routines have faltered as maintenance cycles are being deferred. While not currently critical, if this goes on, operational status could become compromised.

entries.zh: 调查一下，这突然的变化来源是什么。
entries.en: Investigate where the sudden change is coming from.

entries.zh: 方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上最初只是有一些船员情绪激动的报告，结果局势愈演愈烈，现在成了更为严重的问题。许多船员都参与了精心策划的浪漫求爱。诗歌朗诵和公开示爱开始主导船上的日常生活。\n\n不幸的是，并非所有的爱意都得到了回应。被拒绝导致了几次小规模冲突，至少有一名工程官选择自己宅在观测站里，宣称“除非有人真正理解他们”，否则他们不会出来。
entries.en: Initial reports of an emotionally charged crew atmosphere aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have given way to something far more serious. Many crew members have been involved in elaborate romantic displays. Poetic recitals and public displays of affection have begun to dominate daily life on board.\n\nUnfortunately, not all affections are reciprocated. Rejections have led to several minor altercations, and at least one engineering officer has barricaded themselves in the observatory, declaring they will not come out "until someone truly understands them".
Let love be. No need to interfere.

entries.zh: 我们乘坐方舟船§Y[Root.GetName]§!时萌发了共同理想，受其启发，我们开始将爱意洒向周围的物理空间，包括方舟船本身。\n\n
entries.en: Inspired by shared ideals aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!, we have begun spreading affection to the physical space surrounding us, including the ship itself.\n\n

entries.zh: 储藏室比以往任何时候都更整洁，住处也比以往任何时候都更有条理。我们的领袖§Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!称这种维护为“照料我们心爱的家园”，并已很好地适应了这种相当不寻常的情况。绩效指标再次上升，居民们似乎也更快乐了。看来，当目标正确时，爱所能产生的力量远不止是风流韵事。
entries.en: Storage units were cleaner and living quarters tidier than ever before. Our leader §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! is referring to this maintenance as "tending to our beloved home", and has adapted well to this rather unusual situation. Performance metrics have risen again and the population seems happier. It appears that, when properly aimed, love can power more than amorous behavior.

entries.zh: 与爱同行，一切皆有可能！
$arkship.1045.desc.start$我们曾身陷绝境，直到§Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!力挽狂澜，获得了方舟的领导权。$arkship.1045.desc.end$
entries.en: $arkship.1045.desc.start$We were in dire straits until §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. $arkship.1045.desc.end$

entries.zh: 飞船§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的情况已经越过了不可接受的界限。起初无伤大雅的情感宣泄，现在已经破坏了纪律、效率以及指挥结构本身。法律部门现已授权直接干预。\n\n
entries.en: The situation aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has crossed an unacceptable threshold. What began as a harmless emotional flourish has since undermined discipline, efficiency, and the very structure of command. A direct intervention by law has now been authorized.\n\n

entries.zh: 转变是立竿见影且彻底的。几名卷入特别具有破坏性纠葛的官员已被§Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!调离，确保恢复既定规范。曾经充满音乐和耳语情话的走廊如今只剩下回声。关于情书黑市的传言开始出现，但由于监视和恐惧，其流通量已大幅减少。士气低落，但秩序已然恢复。
entries.en: The transformation was immediate and absolute. Several officers implicated in particularly disruptive entanglements have been reassigned by §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!, ensuring a return to established norms. Corridors once lively with music and whispered declarations now echo with silence. Whispers of a black market for love letters have started, yet the flow has dwindled, choked off by surveillance and fear. Morale has dropped, but order has returned.

entries.zh: $arkship.1050.desc.start$我们曾身处绝境，直到§Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!掌控了局面，并被授予方舟的领导权。$arkship.1050.desc.end$
entries.en: $arkship.1050.desc.start$We were in dire straits until §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. $arkship.1050.desc.end$

entries.zh: 方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上发布了一个特别项目，揭示了一种不寻常的生物因子。一株神秘植物在方舟舰的过滤系统中生根发芽。我们的科学家认为，源自太空的孢子通过通风系统进入飞船，并找到了生长的场所。这种植物花朵的孢子通过我们的系统传播，导致飞船上所有人的情绪都变得异常激动。\n\n这种植物的花朵散发出微弱的生物荧光，其根系似乎直接以飞船大气中循环的湿气为食。我们的船员形容它的气味“甜美、奇特、怀旧”。如果不加以控制，孢子将继续操控船员的情绪。然而，这种植物也表现出非凡的韧性，如果我们能正确地栽培它，甚至可能具有潜在的应用价值。
entries.en: The special project issued aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has revealed an unusual biological agent. A mysterious plant has taken root within the Arkship's filtration systems. Our scientists suggest that space-born spores made it on board through the ventilation systems and found a place to grow roots. The spores of the plant's flower carried through our systems are inducing heightened emotional states in all who live aboard the ship.\n\nThe plant's blossoms emit a faint bioluminescence, and its root structure appears to feed directly on the recycled humidity of the ship's atmosphere. Our crew members describe the smell as "sweet, whimsical, and nostalgic." Left unchecked, the spores will continue to manipulate the crew's emotions. The plant, however, also displays remarkable resilience, perhaps even a potential application, should we learn to cultivate it properly.
It's too dangerous. Destroy the plant.

entries.zh: 方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的那株植物已被根除。它的根部已从大气管道中清除，孢子也已从飞船的空气中净化。船员们终于恢复了往常的行为。\n\n
entries.en: The plant on Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been eradicated. Its roots were destroyed from the atmosphere ducts, and its spores purged from the ship's air. The crew has at last resumed their usual behavior.\n\n

entries.zh: 然而，秩序的回归却留下了沉重的寂静。许多船员描述了一种隐隐作痛的缺失，仿佛有什么珍贵的东西被冲刷掉了，但我们的领袖§Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!确保了法律和秩序的恢复，尽管有不服管教的情绪。飞船可能已经可以运行，但它承载着一种无形的货物：破碎爱情的重担。
entries.en: However, the return to order has left a heavy silence. Many crew members describe an aching absence, as though something precious has been flushed out, but our leader §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! ensured that law and order were restored despite the unruly feelings. The ship may be operational, but it carries an invisible cargo: the weight of broken love.

entries.zh: $arkship.1060.desc.start$我们曾身处绝境，直到§Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!掌控了局面，并被授予方舟的领导权。$arkship.1060.desc.end$
entries.en: $arkship.1060.desc.start$We were in dire straits until §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. $arkship.1060.desc.end$

entries.zh: 详细的基因分析已确认这种神秘植物为一个未知物种。其起源指向一个荒凉的星团。更奇怪的是，这种植物对生存条件要求极为严苛，使其在原生土壤之外的生存几乎不可能：精确的湿度水平、营养丰富的空气以及一定程度的辐射。\n\n
entries.en: Detailed genetic analysis has identified the mysterious flora as an unknown species. Its origins point to a desolate stellar cluster. Even stranger, the plant requires conditions so exacting that survival beyond its native soil should be impossible: precise levels of humidity, a nutrient rich atmosphere, and a certain degree of radiation.\n\n

entries.zh: 一项生物化学研究表明，这种植物的孢子具有作为神经调节剂的潜力。尽管存在副作用，但如果提炼得当，它们可能可以治疗焦虑、抑郁，甚至创伤。我们的领袖§Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!对这种特殊的植物产生了浓厚的兴趣，并因此决定扩展他们的农业知识。
entries.en: A biochemical study suggests the plant's spores possess potential as a neural modulator. Despite the side effects, if properly refined, they might treat anxiety, depression, or even trauma. Our leader §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! took a special interest in this particular plant, and has decided to expand their agricultural knowledge as a result.

entries.zh: $arkship.1065.desc.start$我们曾身陷绝境，直到§Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!力挽狂澜，获得了方舟的领导权。$arkship.1065.desc.end$
entries.en: $arkship.1065.desc.start$We were in dire straits until §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. $arkship.1065.desc.end$

entries.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!方舟舰正以我们祖先难以想象的速度穿越虚空。

早期的几代人曾花费数年甚至一生的时间在遥远的恒星间漂泊，而我们现代的驱动装置只需几天就能让方舟舰在各个星系间穿梭。随着飞船冲入超空间航道网，恒星在我们的传感器中飞速掠过，它们的光线不断发生位移与扭曲。

对于船上的许多人来说，这种经历确实会产生一种奇特的迷失感。一些人开始寻求微小的慰藉，以对抗这种感官冲击；而另一些人则坚持认为，只要给予足够的时间，我们的心智终将学会跟上方舟舰不断加速的旅程。
entries.en:
The Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! now crosses the void at speeds our ancestors could scarcely have imagined.

Where earlier generations spent years, even lifetimes, drifting between distant stars, our modern drives hurl the Arkship from system to system in a matter of days. The stars streak past our sensors in rapid succession, their light shifting and distorting as the ship plunges through the hyperlane network.

For many aboard, the experience has proven strangely disorienting. Some have begun seeking small ways to anchor themselves against the sensation. Others insist that, given time, our minds will simply learn to keep pace with the Arkship's accelerating journey.

entries.zh: 通过常态化演练提升士气。
尝试通过内部通讯播放引擎噪音。
entries.en: Try playing engine noises through internal comms.

entries.zh:
一个故障的继电器正在干扰方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的能源核心。除了无法动弹之外，住宅区的灯光也正在熄灭。农场报告能源涌动异常，几个关键研究模块已经离线。

我们的总工程师警告说，如果不加以干预，连锁故障将蔓延至整艘飞船。不幸的是，解决方案并不简单。修复继电器需要从储备中抽调资源，而绕过它则有损害方舟舰长期稳定性的风险。

冷却中的飞船发出令人不安的吱嘎声和呻吟声。我们现在需要做出决定。
entries.en:
A faulty relay is interfering with the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!'s power core. In addition to being immobilized, the lights are now going out on residential decks. Farms report irregular energy surges, and several key research modules have gone offline.

Our chief engineers warn that without intervention, cascading failures will spread throughout the ship. Unfortunately the solution is not straightforward. Repairing the relay will require diverting resources from our reserves, while bypassing it risks compromising the Arkship's long-term stability.

The cooling ship creaks and groans unsettlingly. We need to make a decision now.

entries.zh: 不惜一切代价，把它修好。
entries.en: Spare no expense and repair it properly.

entries.zh: 修修补补继续用吧，我们现在得勒紧裤腰带过日子。
entries.en: Patch it and move on. We cannot afford luxuries.

entries.zh: 尽管困难重重，方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的工程船员不仅修复了故障继电器，还对其进行了改进。现在，全舰的能量分配比以往任何时候都更加顺畅，多年来一直不稳定的系统也得以稳定。船员士气大幅提升，许多人对方舟舰的韧性表现出了新的自豪感。
entries.en: Against all odds, the engineering crew on Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has not only repaired the faulty relay, but improved it. Energy distribution across the ship is now smoother than ever, stabilizing systems that have been temperamental for years. Crew morale has risen sharply, with many expressing newfound pride in the Arkship's resilience.

entries.zh: 对飞船§Y[Root.GetName]§!能源核心的快速修复暂时有效。但临时旁路电路在持续使用下已不堪重负。频繁的全船断电已成为常态，一些区域的环境控制在过热和过冷之间摇摆不定。船员抱怨领导层选择了权宜之计而非安全。低语流传着，方舟舰正在变成一座修修补补的遗迹，而非一座坚韧的灯塔。
entries.en: The quick fix on the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!'s power core is holding, at least for now. But the makeshift bypass circuits are straining under constant use. Frequent ship-wide blackouts are now a way of life, and environmental controls in some sections have been oscillating between too hot, and too cold. The crew grumble that leadership chose expedience over security. Whispers circulate that the Arkship is becoming a patchwork relic, rather than a beacon of endurance.
We must make do and mend.

entries.zh: 随着方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!继续漂流，观景台爆发出一阵欢呼。一群年幼的缇扬奇兽从附近经过，它们看起来心情很好，正在嬉戏。\n\n它们以宽大的弧线相互穿梭，庞大的身躯彼此翻滚。透过宽阔的玻璃窗，这一景象令人着迷：巨大的身形漂浮在星辰之间，它们发光的身体闪烁着，仿佛在用只有它们才能理解的语言交流。整个家庭都挤满了甲板观看，暂时放下了他们的烦恼。这对所有年龄段的人来说都是一个真正的奇迹。
entries.en: As the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! continues to drift, the observation decks have erupted in delight. A pod of juvenile tiyanki has passed nearby, and they seem to be in a playful mood.\n\nThey weave around each other in broad, looping arcs, their vast forms tumbling around one another. From the wide glass panes, the sight is mesmerizing: colossal shapes floating among the stars, their luminous bodies glimmering while seemingly communicating in a language only they could understand. Entire families crowd the decks to watch, momentarily letting go of their burdens. It is a true wonder for all ages.

entries.zh: 一次难得的观察太空兽群行为的机会。
entries.en: A rare opportunity to observe space fauna behavior.

entries.zh: 方舟号§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]对缇扬奇幼兽同样着迷。如此近距离观察这种行为几乎是前所未有的。我们的研究表明，这是一种社会现象，在缇扬奇深层栖息地以外很少观察到。\n\n方舟号上的整体气氛现在变得更加轻松，仿佛动物们的喜悦渗透了整个船舱。
entries.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! were no less enthralled by the Tiyanki calves. To witness such behavior at this proximity is almost unprecedented. Our studies suggest this was a social phenomenon that is rarely observed outside deep Tiyanki habitats.\n\nThe general atmosphere aboard the Arkship now feels lighter, as if the animals' joy permeates the hull.

entries.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!方舟舰内部环境传感器测得空气中挥发性化合物含量升高。船员，特别是舰桥上的船员，报告了与轻度毒性接触相符的症状：恶心、定向障碍和持续性神经性疼痛。

尝试通过标准通风协议清除污染物并无效果。腐臭气味弥漫在走廊中，无法被过滤，并加剧了船员的不适。我们的工程报告还标记了飞船废物处理系统的不规则性，表明可能存在迫在眉睫的系统故障。

有必要迅速展开调查。
entries.en:
Internal environmental sensors aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have registered elevated levels of volatile airborne compounds. The crew, particularly those stationed on the bridge, have reported symptoms consistent with low-grade toxic exposure: nausea, disorientation, and persistent neuropathic pain.

Attempts to purge the contaminants via standard ventilation protocols have proven ineffective. A putrid odor fills the corridors, defying filtration and increasing crew discomfort. Irregularities in the ship's waste-disposal systems indicate the possibility of an imminent systemic malfunction.

Swift investigation is warranted.

entries.zh: 我们对方舟舰的垃圾压实机进行了检查，发现有大量啮齿动物出没。这些啮齿动物表现出不规则的身体特征，表明发生了突变。样本的巨大体型令人不安。它们在接近时发出的尖叫声比基线物种明显更响亮。它们的体味特别浓烈，并且已观察到这些生物从许多结构凹槽中出现，表明它们已广泛分布在整个船只中。\n\n这一发现引出了一个伦理问题：这些变异生物是应该作为危害被消灭，还是作为一种新形式的生命被保存。无论如何，我们都应该将它们从我们的通风系统中清除。
